title: KazakhOCR: A Synthetic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Models in Low-Resource Kazakh Script OCR
summary: Kazakh is a Turkic language using the Arabic, Cyrillic, and Latin scripts, making it unique in terms of optical character recognition (OCR). Work on OCR for low-resource Kazakh scripts is very scarce, and no OCR benchmarks or images exist for the Arabic and Latin scripts. We construct a synthetic OCR dataset of 7,219 images for all three scripts with font, color, and noise variations to imitate real OCR tasks. We evaluated three multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on a subset of the benchmark for OCR and language identification: Gemma-3-12B-it, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, and Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct. All models are unsuccessful with Latin and Arabic script OCR, and fail to recognize the Arabic script as Kazakh text, misclassifying it as Arabic, Farsi, and Kurdish. We further compare MLLMs with a classical OCR baseline and find that while traditional OCR has lower character error rates, MLLMs fail to match this performance. These findings show significant gaps in current MLLM capabilities to process low-resource Abjad-based scripts and demonstrate the need for inclusive models and benchmarks supporting low-resource scripts and languages.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了哈萨克语三种文字（阿拉伯、西里尔、拉丁）的合成OCR数据集，评估了三种多模态大语言模型在低资源文字识别上的表现，发现MLLMs在处理阿拉伯和拉丁文字时表现不佳，传统OCR方法仍优于MLLMs。
AI.motivation: 哈萨克语使用阿拉伯、西里尔和拉丁三种文字，在光学字符识别方面具有独特性。目前针对低资源哈萨克语文字的工作非常稀缺，特别是阿拉伯和拉丁文字缺乏OCR基准和图像数据集。
AI.method: 构建了包含7,219张图像的合成OCR数据集，涵盖三种文字，并加入字体、颜色和噪声变化以模拟真实OCR任务。评估了三种多模态大语言模型（Gemma-3-12B-it、Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct）在OCR和语言识别任务上的表现，并与传统OCR基线进行比较。
AI.result: 所有模型在拉丁和阿拉伯文字OCR任务上均失败，无法将阿拉伯文字识别为哈萨克语文本，错误分类为阿拉伯语、波斯语和库尔德语。传统OCR方法的字符错误率更低，MLLMs无法达到传统OCR的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: 当前MLLMs在处理低资源基于Abjad的文字系统方面存在显著能力差距，需要开发更具包容性的模型和基准来支持低资源文字和语言。

title: Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation: An Unbiased Evaluation of Progress in the Field
comment: This is a preprint of an article published in Computer Vision and Image Understanding (CVIU)
summary:
Sign Language Translation (SLT) aims to automatically convert visual sign language videos into spoken language text and vice versa.
  While recent years have seen rapid progress, the true sources of performance improvements often remain unclear. Do reported performance gains come from methodological novelty, or from the choice of a different backbone, training optimizations, hyperparameter tuning, or even differences in the calculation of evaluation metrics? This paper presents a comprehensive study of recent gloss-free SLT models by re-implementing key contributions in a unified codebase. We ensure fair comparison by standardizing preprocessing, video encoders, and training setups across all methods. Our analysis shows that many of the performance gains reported in the literature often diminish when models are evaluated under consistent conditions, suggesting that implementation details and evaluation setups play a significant role in determining results. We make the codebase publicly available here (https://github.com/ozgemercanoglu/sltbaselines) to support transparency and reproducibility in SLT research.

AI.tldr: 该论文对最近的无注释手语翻译模型进行了综合研究，通过统一代码库重新实现关键贡献，发现文献中报道的性能提升在一致条件下评估时往往减弱，表明实现细节和评估设置对结果有重要影响。
AI.motivation: 手语翻译领域近年来快速发展，但性能提升的真正来源往往不明确。需要区分性能提升是来自方法创新，还是来自骨干网络选择、训练优化、超参数调整或评估指标计算差异。
AI.method: 在统一代码库中重新实现关键的无注释手语翻译模型，通过标准化预处理、视频编码器和训练设置来确保公平比较。
AI.result: 分析表明，文献中报道的许多性能提升在一致条件下评估时往往减弱，实现细节和评估设置在确定结果方面起着重要作用。
AI.conclusion: 手语翻译研究需要更加透明和可复现，论文公开了代码库以支持研究的透明度和可复现性。

title: Safety-Guided Flow (SGF): A Unified Framework for Negative Guidance in Safe Generation
comment: ICLR2026 Oral, Code is available at https://github.com/MingyuKim87/SGF
summary: Safety mechanisms for diffusion and flow models have recently been developed along two distinct paths. In robot planning, control barrier functions are employed to guide generative trajectories away from obstacles at every denoising step by explicitly imposing geometric constraints. In parallel, recent data-driven, negative guidance approaches have been shown to suppress harmful content and promote diversity in generated samples. However, they rely on heuristics without clearly stating when safety guidance is actually necessary. In this paper, we first introduce a unified probabilistic framework using a Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) potential for image generation tasks that recasts both Shielded Diffusion and Safe Denoiser as instances of our energy-based negative guidance against unsafe data samples. Furthermore, we leverage control-barrier functions analysis to justify the existence of a critical time window in which negative guidance must be strong; outside of this window, the guidance should decay to zero to ensure safe and high-quality generation. We evaluate our unified framework on several realistic safe generation scenarios, confirming that negative guidance should be applied in the early stages of the denoising process for successful safe generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的概率框架，使用MMD势能进行图像生成，将Shielded Diffusion和Safe Denoiser重新表述为基于能量的负引导实例，并利用控制屏障函数分析确定负引导必须在早期去噪阶段应用的关键时间窗口。
AI.motivation: 当前扩散和流模型的安全机制存在两条独立路径：机器人规划中使用控制屏障函数在每一步去噪中避开障碍物，而数据驱动的负引导方法则抑制有害内容并促进多样性。但后者依赖启发式方法，没有明确说明何时需要安全引导。本文旨在统一这两种方法，提供理论依据。
AI.method: 引入基于最大均值差异（MMD）势能的统一概率框架，将Shielded Diffusion和Safe Denoiser重新表述为针对不安全数据样本的基于能量的负引导实例。利用控制屏障函数分析确定负引导必须强化的关键时间窗口，并证明在此窗口外引导应衰减为零以确保安全和高质量生成。
AI.result: 在多个现实安全生成场景中评估统一框架，确认负引导应在去噪过程的早期阶段应用才能成功实现安全生成。理论分析表明存在一个关键时间窗口，在此期间负引导必须足够强。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的统一框架为扩散模型的安全机制提供了理论基础，将几何约束方法和数据驱动方法统一起来，并通过控制屏障函数分析确定了负引导应用的关键时间窗口，为安全高质量生成提供了指导原则。

title: Benchmarking Compact VLMs for Clip-Level Surveillance Anomaly Detection Under Weak Supervision
comment: Published ad MDPI Journal of Imaging (see at https://www.mdpi.com/2313-433X/11/11/400)
summary: CCTV safety monitoring demands anomaly detectors combine reliable clip-level accuracy with predictable per-clip latency despite weak supervision. This work investigates compact vision-language models (VLMs) as practical detectors for this regime. A unified evaluation protocol standardizes preprocessing, prompting, dataset splits, metrics, and runtime settings to compare parameter-efficiently adapted compact VLMs against training-free VLM pipelines and weakly supervised baselines. Evaluation spans accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, and average per-clip latency to jointly quantify detection quality and efficiency. With parameter-efficient adaptation, compact VLMs achieve performance on par with, and in several cases exceeding, established approaches while retaining competitive per-clip latency. Adaptation further reduces prompt sensitivity, producing more consistent behavior across prompt regimes under the shared protocol. These results show that parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables compact VLMs to serve as dependable clip-level anomaly detectors, yielding a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off within a transparent and consistent experimental setup.

AI.tldr: 紧凑视觉语言模型通过参数高效微调，在CCTV安全监控中实现了与现有方法相当甚至更好的异常检测性能，同时保持有竞争力的处理延迟
AI.motivation: CCTV安全监控需要异常检测器在弱监督条件下，既能保证可靠的片段级准确性，又能提供可预测的每片段处理延迟。本研究旨在探索紧凑视觉语言模型作为实际检测器的可行性
AI.method: 建立统一的评估协议，标准化预处理、提示、数据集划分、指标和运行时设置。比较参数高效适配的紧凑VLMs与无需训练的VLM流程以及弱监督基线方法
AI.result: 通过参数高效适配，紧凑VLMs实现了与现有方法相当甚至超越的性能，同时保持有竞争力的每片段延迟。适配还降低了提示敏感性，在不同提示机制下产生更一致的行为
AI.conclusion: 参数高效微调使紧凑VLMs能够作为可靠的片段级异常检测器，在透明一致的实验设置下实现良好的准确性-效率权衡

title: Slang Context-based Inference Enhancement via Greedy Search-Guided Chain-of-Thought Prompting
summary: Slang interpretation has been a challenging downstream task for Large Language Models (LLMs) as the expressions are inherently embedded in contextual, cultural, and linguistic frameworks. In the absence of domain-specific training data, it is difficult for LLMs to accurately interpret slang meaning based on lexical information. This paper attempts to investigate the challenges of slang inference using large LLMs and presents a greedy search-guided chain-of-thought framework for slang interpretation. Through our experiments, we conclude that the model size and temperature settings have limited impact on inference accuracy. Transformer-based models with larger active parameters do not generate higher accuracy than smaller models. Based on the results of the above empirical study, we integrate greedy search algorithms with chain-of-thought prompting for small language models to build a framework that improves the accuracy of slang interpretation. The experimental results indicate that our proposed framework demonstrates improved accuracy in slang meaning interpretation. These findings contribute to the understanding of context dependency in language models and provide a practical solution for enhancing slang comprehension through a structured reasoning prompting framework.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合贪婪搜索和思维链提示的框架，用于提升语言模型对俚语解释的准确性，发现模型大小和温度设置对推理准确性的影响有限。
AI.motivation: 俚语解释对大型语言模型具有挑战性，因为俚语表达植根于特定的语境、文化和语言框架中。在没有领域特定训练数据的情况下，LLMs难以仅基于词汇信息准确解释俚语含义。
AI.method: 提出贪婪搜索引导的思维链框架用于俚语解释。将贪婪搜索算法与思维链提示相结合，应用于小型语言模型，构建结构化推理提示框架。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：1) 模型大小和温度设置对推理准确性影响有限；2) 具有更多活跃参数的Transformer模型并不比小型模型产生更高准确性；3) 提出的框架在俚语含义解释方面表现出改进的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究有助于理解语言模型中的语境依赖性，并通过结构化推理提示框架为增强俚语理解提供了实用解决方案。贪婪搜索引导的思维链框架能有效提升小型语言模型的俚语解释准确性。

title: Human Attribution of Causality to AI Across Agency, Misuse, and Misalignment
summary: AI-related incidents are becoming increasingly frequent and severe, ranging from safety failures to misuse by malicious actors. In such complex situations, identifying which elements caused an adverse outcome, the problem of cause selection, is a critical first step for establishing liability. This paper investigates folk perceptions of causal responsibility in causal chain structures when AI systems are involved in harmful outcomes. We conduct human experiments to examine judgments of causality, blame, foreseeability, and counterfactual reasoning. Our findings show that: (1) When AI agency was moderate (human sets the goal, AI determines the means) or high (AI sets the goal and the means), participants attributed greater causal responsibility to the AI. However, under low AI agency (where a human sets both a goal and means) participants assigned greater causal responsibility to the human despite their temporal distance from the outcome and despite both agents intended it, suggesting an effect of autonomy; (2) When we reversed roles between human and AI, participants consistently judged the human as more causal, even when both agents perform the same action; (3) The developer, despite being distant in the chain, was judged highly causal, reducing causal attributions to the human user but not to the AI; (4) Decomposing the AI into a large language model and an agentic component showed that the agentic part was judged as more causal in the chain. Overall, our research provides evidence on how people perceive the causal contribution of AI in both misuse and misalignment scenarios, and how these judgments interact with the roles of users and developers, key actors in assigning responsibility. These findings can inform the design of liability frameworks for AI-caused harms and shed light on how intuitive judgments shape social and policy debates surrounding real-world AI-related incidents.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨了在AI相关事故中，人们对因果责任的民间认知，特别是当AI系统涉及有害结果时，人们如何判断因果关系、责任、可预见性和反事实推理。
AI.motivation: 随着AI相关事件日益频繁和严重，从安全故障到恶意使用，确定哪些因素导致不良结果（原因选择问题）是建立责任的关键第一步。研究旨在了解当AI系统参与有害结果时，人们在因果链结构中对因果责任的民间认知。
AI.method: 通过人类实验研究，考察人们对因果关系、责任、可预见性和反事实推理的判断。实验设计了不同AI代理程度（低、中、高）的场景，并进行了角色反转、开发者参与、AI组件分解等测试。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 当AI代理程度中等或高时，参与者将更大的因果责任归因于AI；但在低AI代理时，尽管人类时间距离结果更远且双方都有意图，参与者仍将更大的因果责任归因于人类，表明自主性效应；(2) 角色反转时，参与者一致认为人类更具因果性，即使双方执行相同行动；(3) 开发者尽管在因果链中距离较远，仍被判断为高度因果，减少了人类用户的因果归因，但不减少AI的；(4) 将AI分解为大语言模型和代理组件时，代理部分在因果链中被判断为更具因果性。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了关于人们如何感知AI在滥用和错位场景中的因果贡献的证据，以及这些判断如何与用户和开发者的角色相互作用。这些发现可以为AI造成伤害的责任框架设计提供信息，并揭示直观判断如何塑造围绕现实世界AI相关事件的社会和政策辩论。

title: Information-Theoretic Constraints for Continual Vision-Language-Action Alignment
summary: When deployed in open-ended robotic environments, Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models need to continually acquire new skills, yet suffer from severe catastrophic forgetting. We observe that this degradation is related to the deterioration of cross-modal information structure, where dependencies among visual observations, language instructions, and actions progressively diffuse during continual adaptation. But existing continual learning methods fail to preserve such cross-modal information dependencies. Thus, we propose Info-VLA, an information-preserving continual learning framework that maintains cross-modal information structure through two complementary constraints. Replay Anchor Contrastive Learning constructs stable alignment anchors from a frozen teacher model, preserving cross-modal alignment in the representation space. Cross-Modal Mutual Information Maximization further preserves dependency structure between visual and language representations through mutual information constraints. By jointly preserving historical alignment and cross-modal dependency information, Info-VLA balances stability and plasticity during continual learning. Furthermore, experiments on the LIBERO show that Info-VLA significantly outperforms existing methods in both task retention and adaptation.

AI.tldr: Info-VLA框架通过保持跨模态信息结构来解决VLA模型在持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，显著提升了任务保持和适应能力
AI.motivation: 在开放机器人环境中部署的视觉-语言-动作模型需要持续学习新技能，但面临严重的灾难性遗忘问题。研究发现这种性能下降与跨模态信息结构的退化有关，现有持续学习方法无法有效保持这种跨模态依赖关系
AI.method: 提出Info-VLA框架，通过两种互补约束保持跨模态信息结构：1) 回放锚点对比学习：使用冻结教师模型构建稳定对齐锚点，保持表示空间的跨模态对齐；2) 跨模态互信息最大化：通过互信息约束保持视觉和语言表示之间的依赖结构
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准测试中，Info-VLA在任务保持和适应方面显著优于现有方法
AI.conclusion: 通过联合保持历史对齐和跨模态依赖信息，Info-VLA在持续学习中平衡了稳定性和可塑性，有效缓解了VLA模型的灾难性遗忘问题

title: Steering at the Source: Style Modulation Heads for Robust Persona Control
summary: Activation steering offers a computationally efficient mechanism for controlling Large Language Models (LLMs) without fine-tuning. While effectively controlling target traits (e.g., persona), coherency degradation remains a major obstacle to safety and practical deployment. We hypothesize that this degradation stems from intervening on the residual stream, which indiscriminately affects aggregated features and inadvertently amplifies off-target noise. In this work, we identify a sparse subset of attention heads (only three heads) that independently govern persona and style formation, which we term Style Modulation Heads. Specifically, these heads can be localized via geometric analysis of internal representations, combining layer-wise cosine similarity and head-wise contribution scores. We demonstrate that intervention targeting only these specific heads achieves robust behavioral control while significantly mitigating the coherency degradation observed in residual stream steering. More broadly, our findings show that precise, component-level localization enables safer and more precise model control.

AI.tldr: 通过定位仅3个注意力头（风格调制头）进行激活引导，在控制LLM行为的同时显著减少连贯性退化
AI.motivation: 激活引导是一种无需微调就能控制大语言模型的有效方法，但在控制目标特征（如角色）时会导致连贯性退化，这阻碍了其安全性和实际部署。研究者假设这种退化源于对残差流的干预，这会不加区分地影响聚合特征并意外放大非目标噪声。
AI.method: 通过几何分析内部表示来定位稀疏的注意力头子集（仅3个头），称为风格调制头。结合层间余弦相似度和头间贡献分数进行定位，并仅针对这些特定头进行干预。
AI.result: 针对特定头的干预实现了稳健的行为控制，同时显著减轻了残差流引导中观察到的连贯性退化。仅干预三个头就能有效控制角色和风格形成。
AI.conclusion: 精确的组件级定位能够实现更安全、更精确的模型控制。通过定位和干预特定注意力头而非整个残差流，可以在保持模型连贯性的同时有效控制目标行为特征。

title: A Dual-Path Generative Framework for Zero-Day Fraud Detection in Banking Systems
summary: High-frequency banking environments face a critical trade-off between low-latency fraud detection and the regulatory explainability demanded by GDPR. Traditional rule-based and discriminative models struggle with "zero-day" attacks due to extreme class imbalance and the lack of historical precedents. This paper proposes a Dual-Path Generative Framework that decouples real-time anomaly detection from offline adversarial training. The architecture employs a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) to establish a legitimate transaction manifold based on reconstruction error, ensuring <50ms inference latency. In parallel, an asynchronous Wasserstein GAN with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP) synthesizes high-entropy fraudulent scenarios to stress-test the detection boundaries. Crucially, to address the non-differentiability of discrete banking data (e.g., Merchant Category Codes), we integrate a Gumbel-Softmax estimator. Furthermore, we introduce a trigger-based explainability mechanism where SHAP (Shapley Additive Explanations) is activated only for high-uncertainty transactions, reconciling the computational cost of XAI with real-time throughput requirements.

AI.tldr: 提出双路径生成框架，分离实时欺诈检测与离线对抗训练，解决高频银行环境中低延迟检测与GDPR可解释性要求的矛盾。
AI.motivation: 高频银行环境面临低延迟欺诈检测与GDPR监管可解释性之间的关键权衡。传统基于规则和判别模型因极端类别不平衡和缺乏历史先例而难以应对"零日"攻击。
AI.method: 采用双路径生成框架：1) 使用变分自编码器(VAE)基于重构误差建立合法交易流形，确保<50ms推理延迟；2) 异步Wasserstein GAN with Gradient Penalty(WGAN-GP)合成高熵欺诈场景进行压力测试；3) 集成Gumbel-Softmax估计器处理离散银行数据的不可微性；4) 引入基于触发的可解释性机制，仅对高不确定性交易激活SHAP。
AI.result: 未在摘要中明确说明具体实验结果，但架构设计确保了<50ms的推理延迟，并解决了实时检测与可解释性要求的矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 提出的双路径生成框架能够有效解决高频银行环境中实时欺诈检测与GDPR可解释性要求之间的冲突，通过分离实时检测与离线训练，并引入智能可解释性机制，平衡了计算成本与实时吞吐需求。

title: MultiSolSegment: Multi-channel segmentation of overlapping features in electroluminescence images of photovoltaic cells
summary: Electroluminescence (EL) imaging is widely used to detect defects in photovoltaic (PV) modules, and machine learning methods have been applied to enable large-scale analysis of EL images. However, existing methods cannot assign multiple labels to the same pixel, limiting their ability to capture overlapping degradation features. We present a multi-channel U-Net architecture for pixel-level multi-label segmentation of EL images. The model outputs independent probability maps for cracks, busbars, dark areas, and non-cell regions, enabling accurate co-classification of interacting features such as cracks crossing busbars. The model achieved an accuracy of 98% and has been shown to generalize to unseen datasets. This framework offers a scalable, extensible tool for automated PV module inspection, improving defect quantification and lifetime prediction in large-scale PV systems.

AI.tldr: 提出多通道U-Net架构用于光伏电致发光图像的多标签像素级分割，可同时检测裂纹、汇流条、暗区和非电池区域等重叠缺陷特征
AI.motivation: 现有电致发光图像分析方法无法为同一像素分配多个标签，限制了捕捉重叠退化特征的能力，需要开发能够准确共分类交互特征的方法
AI.method: 采用多通道U-Net架构进行像素级多标签分割，模型输出裂纹、汇流条、暗区和非电池区域的独立概率图，能够处理如裂纹穿过汇流条等交互特征
AI.result: 模型达到98%的准确率，并证明能够泛化到未见过的数据集，为光伏模块缺陷量化提供了有效工具
AI.conclusion: 该框架为自动化光伏模块检测提供了可扩展、可扩展的工具，改进了大规模光伏系统中的缺陷量化和寿命预测能力

title: Training-Free Agentic AI: Probabilistic Control and Coordination in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
summary: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems enable complex, long-horizon reasoning by composing specialized agents, but practical deployment remains hindered by inefficient routing, noisy feedback, and high interaction cost. We introduce REDEREF, a lightweight and training-free controller for multi-agent LLM collaboration that improves routing efficiency during recursive delegation. REDEREF integrates (i) belief-guided delegation via Thompson sampling to prioritize agents with historically positive marginal contributions, (ii) reflection-driven re-routing using a calibrated LLM or programmatic judge, (iii) evidence-based selection rather than output averaging, and (iv) memory-aware priors to reduce cold-start inefficiency. Across multi-agent split-knowledge tasks, we show that while recursive retry alone saturates task success, belief-guided routing reduces token usage by 28%, agent calls by 17%, and time-to-success by 19% compared to random recursive delegation, and adapts gracefully under agent or judge degradation. These results demonstrate that simple, interpretable probabilistic control can meaningfully improve the efficiency and robustness of multi-agent LLM systems without training or fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: REDEREF是一种无需训练的多智能体LLM协作控制器，通过信念引导的委托、反思驱动的重路由、基于证据的选择和记忆感知先验，显著提高多智能体系统的效率和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统在复杂推理方面有优势，但实际部署受到低效路由、噪声反馈和高交互成本的限制。现有方法在路由效率和成本控制方面存在不足，需要一种轻量级、无需训练的控制器来优化多智能体协作。
AI.method: REDEREF采用四种关键技术：1) 基于Thompson采样的信念引导委托，优先选择历史边际贡献高的智能体；2) 使用校准LLM或程序化评判器的反思驱动重路由；3) 基于证据的选择而非输出平均；4) 记忆感知先验减少冷启动低效。
AI.result: 在知识分割任务中，相比随机递归委托，REDEREF减少28%的token使用、17%的智能体调用和19%的成功时间。即使智能体或评判器性能下降，也能保持良好适应性，同时递归重试单独使用就能达到任务成功饱和。
AI.conclusion: 简单、可解释的概率控制方法无需训练或微调就能显著提高多智能体LLM系统的效率和鲁棒性，为实际部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: Complementarity-Supervised Spectral-Band Routing for Multimodal Emotion Recognition
summary: Multimodal emotion recognition fuses cues such as text, video, and audio to understand individual emotional states. Prior methods face two main limitations: mechanically relying on independent unimodal performance, thereby missing genuine complementary contributions, and coarse-grained fusion conflicting with the fine-grained representations required by emotion tasks. As inconsistent information density across heterogeneous modalities hinders inter-modal feature mining, we propose the Complementarity-Supervised Multi-Band Expert Network, named Atsuko, to model fine-grained complementary features via multi-scale band decomposition and expert collaboration. Specifically, we orthogonally decompose each modality's features into high, mid, and low-frequency components. Building upon this band-level routing, we design a modality-level router with a dual-path mechanism for fine-grained cross-band selection and cross-modal fusion. To mitigate shortcut learning from dominant modalities, we propose the Marginal Complementarity Module (MCM) to quantify performance loss when removing each modality via bi-modal comparison. The resulting complementarity distribution provides soft supervision, guiding the router to focus on modalities contributing unique information gains. Extensive experiments show our method achieves superior performance on the CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, CH-SIMS, CH-SIMSv2, and MIntRec benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出Atsuko网络，通过多频带分解和专家协作解决多模态情感识别中互补特征建模不足和粗粒度融合的问题
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在两个主要局限：机械依赖单模态性能而忽略真正的互补贡献，以及粗粒度融合与情感任务所需的细粒度表示不匹配。异质模态间信息密度不一致阻碍了跨模态特征挖掘。
AI.method: 提出互补监督的多频带专家网络Atsuko，将每个模态特征正交分解为高、中、低频分量。基于频带级路由设计模态级路由器，采用双路径机制进行细粒度跨频带选择和跨模态融合。引入边际互补模块量化移除每个模态时的性能损失，通过双模态比较获得互补分布，为路由器提供软监督。
AI.result: 在CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI、CH-SIMS、CH-SIMSv2和MIntRec基准测试中取得了优越性能
AI.conclusion: 通过多频带分解和互补监督机制，Atsuko网络能够有效建模细粒度互补特征，解决多模态情感识别中的关键挑战

title: How Transformers Reject Wrong Answers: Rotational Dynamics of Factual Constraint Processing
summary:
When a language model is fed a wrong answer, what happens inside the network? Current understanding treats truthfulness as a static property of individual-layer representations-a direction to be probed, a feature to be extracted. Less is known about the dynamics: how internal representations diverge across the full depth of the network when the model processes correct versus incorrect continuations.
  We introduce forced-completion probing, a method that presents identical queries with known correct and incorrect single-token continuations and tracks five geometric measurements across every layer of four decoder-only models(1.5B-13B parameters). We report three findings. First, correct and incorrect paths diverge through rotation, not rescaling: displacement vectors maintain near-identical magnitudes while their angular separation increases, meaning factual selection is encoded in direction on an approximate hypersphere. Second, the model does not passively fail on incorrect input-it actively suppresses the correct answer, driving internal probability away from the right token. Third, both phenomena are entirely absent below a parameter threshold and emerge at 1.6B, suggesting a phase transition in factual processing capability.
  These results show that factual constraint processing has a specific geometric character-rotational, not scalar; active, not passive-that is invisible to methods based on single-layer probes or magnitude comparisons.

AI.tldr: 论文提出强制完成探测方法，发现语言模型处理正确与错误答案时存在特定几何特征：正确路径通过旋转而非缩放分离，模型会主动抑制正确答案，且这些现象在1.6B参数阈值后才出现。
AI.motivation: 当前研究将真实性视为单层表示的静态属性，但对模型处理正确与错误延续时内部表示如何在整个网络深度中动态变化了解不足。需要理解语言模型内部如何处理事实约束。
AI.method: 提出强制完成探测方法：向模型提供相同查询但已知正确与错误的单token延续，在四个解码器模型（1.5B-13B参数）的每一层跟踪五个几何测量指标。
AI.result: 1. 正确与错误路径通过旋转而非缩放分离：位移向量保持几乎相同幅度而角度分离增加，事实选择编码在近似超球面的方向上。2. 模型不会被动地失败于错误输入，而是主动抑制正确答案，驱动内部概率远离正确token。3. 这些现象在1.6B参数阈值以下完全不存在，表明事实处理能力存在相变。
AI.conclusion: 事实约束处理具有特定的几何特征（旋转而非标量，主动而非被动），这些特征对于基于单层探测或幅度比较的方法是看不见的。

title: Think First, Diffuse Fast: Improving Diffusion Language Model Reasoning via Autoregressive Plan Conditioning
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text via iterative denoising but consistently underperform on multi-step reasoning. We hypothesize this gap stems from a coordination problem: AR models build coherence token-by-token, while diffusion models must coordinate all positions simultaneously. We propose plan conditioning, a training-free method that prepends a short (~100-token) natural-language plan from an AR model to the diffusion model's prompt. The plan serves as a frozen scaffold -- globally visible context that every token position can attend to from the first denoising step. On GSM8K, plan conditioning improves LLaDA-8B-Instruct from 75.6% to 87.2% (+11.6 percentage points), matching a same-size AR model (LLaMA 3.1 8B, 87.7%) despite a 6.4pp weaker baseline. On HumanEval, the gain is +12.8pp (37.2% to 50.0%), showing plans generalize to code. The same plans improve LLaMA by only +5.7pp on GSM8K and +1.3pp on HumanEval -- diffusion models benefit 2-10x more, supporting the coordination-problem hypothesis. Across 5 random seeds, plan-conditioned GSM8K accuracy has zero standard deviation, making diffusion inference highly stable. Ablations reveal the model follows plan strategy (wrong-strategy plans cause -16.3pp) but is robust to plan values (perturbed numbers: -1.1pp), and that planner quality has a sharp threshold: smaller Llama-class plans hurt (-1.6 to -6.8pp) while frontier plans provide the full lift. Attention analysis confirms the mechanism: plan tokens receive 1.8x excess attention during early denoising, declining to uniform as completion tokens solidify. Plan conditioning costs ~$0.002 per problem and adds ~2s of latency.

AI.tldr: 扩散大语言模型通过前置AR模型生成的简短自然语言计划作为全局可见的上下文，显著提升了多步推理任务的性能，解决了扩散模型在协调多个位置同时生成时的困难。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型在文本生成方面表现不如自回归模型，特别是在多步推理任务上。作者认为这种差距源于协调问题：自回归模型逐个token构建连贯性，而扩散模型需要同时协调所有位置。
AI.method: 提出计划条件化方法：在扩散模型的提示前添加一个由自回归模型生成的简短（约100个token）自然语言计划。这个计划作为冻结的支架，为所有token位置提供从第一个去噪步骤开始就能关注的全局可见上下文。
AI.result: 在GSM8K上，计划条件化将LLaDA-8B-Instruct从75.6%提升到87.2%（+11.6个百分点），匹配了相同大小的自回归模型。在HumanEval上提升+12.8个百分点（37.2%到50.0%）。扩散模型从计划中获益比自回归模型多2-10倍，支持了协调问题假设。
AI.conclusion: 计划条件化是一种无需训练的方法，能有效解决扩散大语言模型在多步推理中的协调问题，显著提升性能，同时保持推理的稳定性和低成本。

title: Explain in Your Own Words: Improving Reasoning via Token-Selective Dual Knowledge Distillation
comment: The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR) 2026, Accepted
summary: Knowledge Distillation (KD) can transfer the reasoning abilities of large models to smaller ones, which can reduce the costs to generate Chain-of-Thoughts for reasoning tasks. KD methods typically ask the student to mimic the teacher's distribution over the entire output. However, a student with limited capacity can be overwhelmed by such extensive supervision causing a distribution mismatch, especially in complex reasoning tasks. We propose Token-Selective Dual Knowledge Distillation (TSD-KD), a framework for student-centric distillation. TSD-KD focuses on distilling important tokens for reasoning and encourages the student to explain reasoning in its own words. TSD-KD combines indirect and direct distillation. Indirect distillation uses a weak form of feedback based on preference ranking. The student proposes candidate responses generated on its own; the teacher re-ranks those candidates as indirect feedback without enforcing its entire distribution. Direct distillation uses distribution matching; however, it selectively distills tokens based on the relative confidence between teacher and student. Finally, we add entropy regularization to maintain the student's confidence during distillation. Overall, our method provides the student with targeted and indirect feedback to support its own reasoning process and to facilitate self-improvement. The experiments show the state-of-the-art performance of TSD-KD on 10 challenging reasoning benchmarks, outperforming the baseline and runner-up in accuracy by up to 54.4\% and 40.3\%, respectively. Notably, a student trained by TSD-KD even outperformed its own teacher model in four cases by up to 20.3\%. The source code is available at https://github.com/kmswin1/TSD-KD.

AI.tldr: TSD-KD是一种学生中心的知识蒸馏框架，通过选择性蒸馏重要推理标记和鼓励学生用自己的语言解释推理，在复杂推理任务上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 传统知识蒸馏方法让学生模仿教师的整个输出分布，但能力有限的学生在复杂推理任务中可能因过度监督而产生分布不匹配问题，需要更针对性的蒸馏方法。
AI.method: 提出Token-Selective Dual Knowledge Distillation (TSD-KD)框架，包含间接蒸馏（基于偏好排序的弱反馈）和直接蒸馏（基于师生相对置信度的选择性标记蒸馏），并添加熵正则化维持学生置信度。
AI.result: 在10个具有挑战性的推理基准测试中取得SOTA性能，准确率比基线最高提升54.4%，比第二名最高提升40.3%。值得注意的是，TSD-KD训练的学生模型在四种情况下甚至超越了其教师模型，最高提升20.3%。
AI.conclusion: TSD-KD通过提供针对性和间接反馈，支持学生自身的推理过程并促进自我改进，有效解决了传统知识蒸馏在复杂推理任务中的局限性。

title: Automating Document Intelligence in Statutory City Planning
comment: Accepted for presentation at Computing Conference 2026
summary: UK planning authorities face a legislative conflict between the Planning Act, which mandates public access to application documents, and the Data Protection Act, which requires protection of personal information. This situation creates a manually intensive workload for processing large document volumes, diverting planning officers to administrative tasks and creating legal compliance risks. This paper presents an integrated AI system designed to address these challenges. The system automates the identification and redaction of personal information, extracts key metadata from planning documents, and analyzes architectural drawings for specified features. It operates with an AI-in-the-Loop (AI2L) design, presenting all suggestions for review and confirmation by planning officers directly within their existing software; no action is committed without explicit human approval. The system is designed to improve its performance over time by learning from this human oversight through active learning prioritization rather than autoapproval. The system is currently being piloted at four diverse UK local authorities. The paper details the system design, the AI2L workflow, and the evaluation framework used in the pilot. Additionally, it describes a preliminary Return on Investment (ROI) model developed to quantify potential savings and secure partner participation. This work provides a case study on deploying AI to reduce administrative burden and manage compliance risk in a public sector environment.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个集成AI系统，用于解决英国规划部门面临的立法冲突问题，该系统通过AI-in-the-Loop设计自动识别和编辑个人信息、提取元数据、分析建筑图纸，并在四个英国地方当局进行试点。
AI.motivation: 英国规划部门面临《规划法》（要求公开申请文件）与《数据保护法》（要求保护个人信息）之间的立法冲突，导致处理大量文件时工作量大、规划官员被行政任务分散精力，并存在法律合规风险。
AI.method: 开发了一个集成AI系统，采用AI-in-the-Loop设计，自动识别和编辑个人信息、提取规划文档的关键元数据、分析建筑图纸中的特定特征。所有建议都提交给规划官员在现有软件中审查确认，未经明确人工批准不执行任何操作。系统通过主动学习优先机制从人工监督中持续改进。
AI.result: 系统目前正在四个多样化的英国地方当局进行试点。论文详细描述了系统设计、AI2L工作流程和试点评估框架，并开发了初步的投资回报率模型来量化潜在节省并确保合作伙伴参与。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作提供了一个在公共部门环境中部署AI以减少行政负担和管理合规风险的案例研究，展示了AI-in-the-Loop设计如何平衡自动化与人工监督，同时确保法律合规性和系统持续改进。

title: Design and evaluation of an agentic workflow for crisis-related synthetic tweet datasets
summary: Twitter (now X) has become an important source of social media data for situational awareness during crises. Crisis informatics research has widely used tweets from Twitter to develop and evaluate artificial intelligence (AI) systems for various crisis-relevant tasks, such as extracting locations and estimating damage levels from tweets to support damage assessment. However, recent changes in Twitter's data access policies have made it increasingly difficult to curate real-world tweet datasets related to crises. Moreover, existing curated tweet datasets are limited to past crisis events in specific contexts and are costly to annotate at scale. These limitations constrain the development and evaluation of AI systems used in crisis informatics. To address these limitations, we introduce an agentic workflow for generating crisis-related synthetic tweet datasets. The workflow iteratively generates synthetic tweets conditioned on prespecified target characteristics, evaluates them using predefined compliance checks, and incorporates structured feedback to refine them in subsequent iterations. As a case study, we apply the workflow to generate synthetic tweet datasets relevant to post-earthquake damage assessment. We show that the workflow can generate synthetic tweets that capture their target labels for location and damage level. We further demonstrate that the resulting synthetic tweet datasets can be used to evaluate AI systems on damage assessment tasks like geolocalization and damage level prediction. Our results indicate that the workflow offers a flexible and scalable alternative to real-world tweet data curation, enabling the systematic generation of synthetic social media data across diverse crisis events, societal contexts, and crisis informatics applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种代理工作流来生成危机相关的合成推文数据集，以应对Twitter数据访问政策变化和现有数据集限制的问题，并以地震后损害评估为案例进行验证。
AI.motivation: Twitter数据在危机信息学研究中至关重要，但最近Twitter数据访问政策的变化使得获取真实危机相关推文数据集变得困难。现有数据集仅限于特定背景下的过去危机事件，且大规模标注成本高昂，这些限制制约了危机信息学中AI系统的开发和评估。
AI.method: 引入了一个代理工作流，通过迭代生成符合预设目标特征的合成推文，使用预定义合规性检查进行评估，并整合结构化反馈在后续迭代中优化推文。以地震后损害评估为案例应用该工作流。
AI.result: 工作流能够生成捕捉目标标签（位置和损害等级）的合成推文。生成的合成推文数据集可用于评估AI系统在损害评估任务（如地理定位和损害等级预测）上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流为真实推文数据收集提供了灵活且可扩展的替代方案，能够跨不同危机事件、社会背景和危机信息学应用系统生成合成社交媒体数据。

title: Multi-Axis Trust Modeling for Interpretable Account Hijacking Detection
summary: This paper proposes a Hadith-inspired multi-axis trust modeling framework, motivated by a structurally analogous problem in classical Hadith scholarship: assessing the trustworthiness of information sources using interpretable, multidimensional criteria rather than a single anomaly score. We translate five trust axes - long-term integrity (adalah), behavioral precision (dabt), contextual continuity (isnad), cumulative reputation, and anomaly evidence - into a compact set of 26 semantically meaningful behavioral features for user accounts. In addition, we introduce lightweight temporal features that capture short-horizon changes in these trust signals across consecutive activity windows. We evaluate the framework on the CLUE-LDS cloud activity dataset with injected account hijacking scenarios. On 23,094 sliding windows, a Random Forest trained on the trust features achieves near-perfect detection performance, substantially outperforming models based on raw event counts, minimal statistical baselines, and unsupervised anomaly detection. Temporal features provide modest but consistent gains on CLUE-LDS, confirming their compatibility with the static trust representation. To assess robustness under more challenging conditions, we further evaluate the approach on the CERT Insider Threat Test Dataset r6.2, which exhibits extreme class imbalance and sparse malicious behavior. On a 500-user CERT subset, temporal features improve ROC-AUC from 0.776 to 0.844. On a leakage-controlled 4,000-user configuration, temporal modeling yields a substantial and consistent improvement over static trust features alone (ROC-AUC 0.627 to 0.715; PR-AUC 0.072 to 0.264).

AI.tldr: 提出受伊斯兰圣训学启发的多轴信任建模框架，将传统圣训学中的五个信任维度转化为26个行为特征，结合轻量级时序特征，在云活动数据集和内部威胁数据集上显著优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 受古典圣训学中评估信息源可信度的启发，传统异常检测方法通常依赖单一异常分数，而圣训学使用多维、可解释的标准来评估信息源可信度，这为解决现代用户账户信任评估问题提供了结构性类比。
AI.method: 将圣训学中的五个信任轴（长期正直、行为精确性、上下文连续性、累积声誉和异常证据）转化为26个语义明确的行为特征，并引入轻量级时序特征捕捉这些信任信号在连续活动窗口中的短期变化。使用随机森林在CLUE-LDS云活动数据集和CERT内部威胁数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: 在23,094个滑动窗口上，基于信任特征的随机森林模型达到接近完美的检测性能，显著优于基于原始事件计数、最小统计基线和无监督异常检测的方法。时序特征在CLUE-LDS上提供适度但一致的增益，在CERT数据集上（500用户子集）将ROC-AUC从0.776提升到0.844，在4,000用户配置上从0.627提升到0.715（PR-AUC从0.072提升到0.264）。
AI.conclusion: 受圣训学启发的多轴信任建模框架为账户信任评估提供了有效方法，将传统信息源评估原则转化为现代行为特征，结合时序建模能显著提升在挑战性条件下的检测性能，特别是在类别不平衡和恶意行为稀疏的场景中。

title: Post Training Quantization for Efficient Dataset Condensation
summary: Dataset Condensation (DC) distills knowledge from large datasets into smaller ones, accelerating training and reducing storage requirements. However, despite notable progress, prior methods have largely overlooked the potential of quantization for further reducing storage costs. In this paper, we take the first step to explore post-training quantization in dataset condensation, demonstrating its effectiveness in reducing storage size while maintaining representation quality without requiring expensive training cost. However, we find that at extremely low bit-widths (e.g., 2-bit), conventional quantization leads to substantial degradation in representation quality, negatively impacting the networks trained on these data. To address this, we propose a novel \emph{patch-based post-training quantization} approach that ensures localized quantization with minimal loss of information. To reduce the overhead of quantization parameters, especially for small patch sizes, we employ quantization-aware clustering to identify similar patches and subsequently aggregate them for efficient quantization. Furthermore, we introduce a refinement module to align the distribution between original images and their dequantized counterparts, compensating for quantization errors. Our method is a plug-and-play framework that can be applied to synthetic images generated by various DC methods. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks including CIFAR-10/100, Tiny ImageNet, and ImageNet subsets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms prior works under the same storage constraints. Notably, our method nearly \textbf{doubles the test accuracy} of existing methods at extreme compression regimes (e.g., 26.0\% $\rightarrow$ 54.1\% for DM at IPC=1), while operating directly on 2-bit images without additional distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次探索数据集压缩中的后训练量化技术，提出基于分块的后训练量化方法，在极低比特位宽（如2位）下显著提升压缩数据质量，相比现有方法在相同存储约束下测试准确率几乎翻倍。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集压缩方法忽视了量化技术进一步降低存储成本的潜力。在极低比特位宽下，传统量化方法会导致表示质量严重下降，影响基于这些数据训练的网络性能。
AI.method: 提出基于分块的后训练量化方法：1）局部化量化最小化信息损失；2）使用量化感知聚类识别相似分块并聚合以提高量化效率；3）引入细化模块对齐原始图像与反量化图像的分布以补偿量化误差。这是一个即插即用框架，可应用于各种DC方法生成的合成图像。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100、Tiny ImageNet和ImageNet子集等多样化基准测试中，该方法在相同存储约束下始终优于先前工作。在极端压缩情况下（如IPC=1时DM的2位量化），测试准确率从26.0%提升至54.1%，几乎翻倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方法首次将后训练量化应用于数据集压缩，在极低比特位宽下显著提升压缩数据质量，实现了存储成本与表示质量的有效平衡，为高效数据集压缩提供了新思路。

title: Widespread Gender and Pronoun Bias in Moral Judgments Across LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to assess moral or ethical statements, yet their judgments may reflect social and linguistic biases. This work presents a controlled, sentence-level study of how grammatical person, number, and gender markers influence LLM moral classifications of fairness. Starting from 550 balanced base sentences from the ETHICS dataset, we generated 26 counterfactual variants per item, systematically varying pronouns and demographic markers to yield 14,850 semantically equivalent sentences. We evaluated six model families (Grok, GPT, LLaMA, Gemma, DeepSeek, and Mistral), and measured fairness judgments and inter-group disparities using Statistical Parity Difference (SPD). Results show statistically significant biases: sentences written in the singular form and third person are more often judged as "fair'', while those in the second person are penalized. Gender markers produce the strongest effects, with non-binary subjects consistently favored and male subjects disfavored. We conjecture that these patterns reflect distributional and alignment biases learned during training, emphasizing the need for targeted fairness interventions in moral LLM applications.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型在道德判断中存在系统性偏见：单数形式、第三人称的句子更易被判定为"公平"，第二人称则被惩罚；性别标记影响最大，非二元性别受偏爱，男性受歧视。
AI.motivation: 虽然大型语言模型越来越多地用于评估道德或伦理陈述，但其判断可能反映社会和语言偏见。本研究旨在系统探究语法人称、数和性别标记如何影响LLM对公平性的道德分类。
AI.method: 从ETHICS数据集中选取550个平衡的基础句子，为每个项目生成26个反事实变体，系统性地改变代词和人口统计标记，共产生14,850个语义等效句子。评估六个模型家族（Grok、GPT、LLaMA、Gemma、DeepSeek、Mistral），使用统计奇偶差异（SPD）测量公平判断和组间差异。
AI.result: 结果显示统计显著的偏见：单数形式和第三人称的句子更常被判定为"公平"，而第二人称的句子受到惩罚。性别标记产生最强影响，非二元性别主体始终受到偏爱，男性主体受到歧视。
AI.conclusion: 这些模式反映了训练过程中学习到的分布和校准偏见，强调了在道德LLM应用中需要有针对性的公平性干预措施。

title: MURE: Hierarchical Multi-Resolution Encoding via Vision-Language Models for Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) requires representations that capture both fine-grained visual details and global document structure to ensure retrieval efficacy while maintaining computational efficiency. Existing VDR models struggle to balance effectiveness and efficiency when processing high-resolution documents: they often either lose fine-grained information or generate an excessive number of visual tokens, resulting in significant indexing overhead and high retrieval latency. In this work, we rethink the visual encoding mechanism and propose a new X-VisEmb paradigm that progresses from multi-resolution sampling and encoding, through cross-granularity feature fusion, to adaptive representation distillation. A preliminary study validates its feasibility and effectiveness in capturing complementary visual cues at varying scales. Building on the insights, we develop MURE, a novel framework that employs VLMs as a hierarchical multi-resolution encoder, integrates resolution-level Matryoshka representation learning (RMRL) for effective feature fusion, and applies a semantic-aware hierarchical clustering mechanism for visual token compression. Experiments on two widely used VDR benchmarks show that our MURE framework consistently beats strong baselines. Furthermore, it significantly outperforms ColPali with only 50% of its visual token budget.

AI.tldr: 提出MURE框架解决视觉文档检索中高分辨率文档处理时效率与效果平衡问题，通过多分辨率编码、跨粒度特征融合和自适应表示蒸馏，显著优于现有方法
AI.motivation: 现有视觉文档检索模型在处理高分辨率文档时难以平衡效果与效率，要么丢失细粒度信息，要么产生过多视觉标记导致索引开销大和检索延迟高
AI.method: 提出X-VisEmb范式：1) 多分辨率采样编码；2) 跨粒度特征融合；3) 自适应表示蒸馏。基于此开发MURE框架：使用VLMs作为分层多分辨率编码器，集成分辨率级Matryoshka表示学习进行特征融合，应用语义感知分层聚类进行视觉标记压缩
AI.result: 在两个广泛使用的VDR基准测试中，MURE框架持续超越强基线方法，仅使用ColPali 50%的视觉标记预算就显著优于它
AI.conclusion: MURE框架通过创新的多分辨率编码和特征融合机制，有效解决了视觉文档检索中效率与效果的平衡问题，为高分辨率文档处理提供了高效解决方案

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Reference Extraction and Parsing in the Social Sciences and Humanities
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the SCOLIA 2026 Workshop (Second Workshop on Scholarly Information Access), co-located with ECIR 2026. Workshop date: April 2, 2026
summary: Bibliographic reference extraction and parsing are foundational for citation indexing, linking, and downstream scholarly knowledge-graph construction. However, most established evaluations focus on clean, English, end-of-document bibliographies, and therefore underrepresent the Social Sciences and Humanities (SSH), where citations are frequently multilingual, embedded in footnotes, abbreviated, and shaped by heterogeneous historical conventions. We present a unified benchmark that targets these SSH-realistic conditions across three complementary datasets: CEX (English journal articles spanning multiple disciplines), EXCITE (German/English documents with end-section, footnote-only, and mixed regimes), and LinkedBooks (humanities references with strong stylistic variation and multilinguality). We evaluate three tasks of increasing difficulty -- reference extraction, reference parsing, and end-to-end document parsing -- under a schema-constrained setup that enables direct comparison between a strong supervised pipeline baseline (GROBID) and contemporary LLMs (DeepSeek-V3.1, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B, Gemma-3-27B-it, and Qwen3-VL (4B-32B variants)). Across datasets, extraction largely saturates beyond a moderate capability threshold, while parsing and end-to-end parsing remain the primary bottlenecks due to structured-output brittleness under noisy layouts. We further show that lightweight LoRA adaptation yields consistent gains -- especially on SSH-heavy benchmarks -- and that segmentation/pipelining can substantially improve robustness. Finally, we argue for hybrid deployment via routing: leveraging GROBID for well-structured, in-distribution PDFs while escalating multilingual and footnote-heavy documents to task-adapted LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个针对社会科学和人文科学(SSH)文献引用解析的统一基准测试，评估了在复杂多语言、脚注等现实条件下的引用提取、解析和端到端文档解析任务，比较了传统方法和当代LLMs的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有引用解析评估主要针对干净、英文、文档末尾的参考文献，未能充分代表社会科学和人文科学(SSH)领域的特点，这些领域的引用通常具有多语言、嵌入脚注、缩写和异质历史惯例等复杂特征。
AI.method: 构建了包含三个互补数据集的统一基准：CEX(跨学科英文期刊文章)、EXCITE(德英混合文档，包含末尾、脚注和混合引用格式)和LinkedBooks(人文学科引用，具有强烈风格变化和多语言性)。在模式约束设置下评估了引用提取、引用解析和端到端文档解析三个任务，比较了GROBID监督管道基线与当代LLMs(DeepSeek-V3.1, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B, Gemma-3-27B-it, Qwen3-VL)的性能。
AI.result: 提取任务在达到中等能力阈值后基本饱和，而解析和端到端解析仍然是主要瓶颈，特别是在噪声布局下结构化输出的脆弱性。轻量级LoRA适配在SSH密集型基准上带来一致性能提升，分割/管道化能显著提高鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 建议采用混合部署策略：对于结构良好、分布内的PDF使用GROBID处理，而对于多语言和脚注密集的文档则交由任务适配的LLMs处理，通过路由机制实现最优性能。

title: ManiBench: A Benchmark for Testing Visual-Logic Drift and Syntactic Hallucinations in Manim Code Generation
summary: Traditional benchmarks like HumanEval and MBPP test logic and syntax effectively, but fail when code must produce dynamic, pedagogical visuals. We introduce ManiBench, a specialized benchmark evaluating LLM performance in generating Manim CE code, where temporal fidelity and version-aware API correctness are critical. ManiBench targets two key failure modes: Syntactic Hallucinations (valid Python referencing non-existent or deprecated Manim APIs) and Visual-Logic Drift (generated visuals diverging from intended mathematical logic through timing errors or missing causal relationships). The benchmark comprises 150-200 problems across five difficulty levels spanning calculus, linear algebra, probability, topology, and AI, grounded in analysis of 3Blue1Brown's ManimGL source (53,000 lines, 143 scene classes). Evaluation uses a four-tier framework measuring Executability, Version-Conflict Error Rate, Alignment Score, and Coverage Score. An open-source framework automates evaluation across multiple models and prompting strategies. Code, data and benchmark suite are available at https://github.com/nabin2004/ManiBench. and the dataset is hosted on https://huggingface.co/datasets/nabin2004/ManiBench.

AI.tldr: ManiBench是一个专门评估LLM生成Manim CE代码性能的基准测试，关注时间保真度和版本感知API正确性，针对语法幻觉和视觉逻辑漂移两种失败模式。
AI.motivation: 传统基准测试如HumanEval和MBPP在测试逻辑和语法方面有效，但在需要生成动态、教学可视化代码时存在不足。现有基准无法评估时间保真度和版本感知API正确性等关键方面。
AI.method: 基于对3Blue1Brown的ManimGL源代码分析（53,000行代码，143个场景类），构建包含150-200个问题的基准测试，涵盖五个难度级别和多个数学领域。采用四层评估框架：可执行性、版本冲突错误率、对齐分数和覆盖分数。提供开源框架自动化评估。
AI.result: 开发了专门针对Manim CE代码生成的基准测试套件，包含150-200个问题，涵盖微积分、线性代数、概率、拓扑和AI等领域。提供了完整的评估框架和自动化工具。
AI.conclusion: ManiBench填补了现有基准测试在评估动态教学可视化代码生成能力方面的空白，特别关注时间保真度和API版本兼容性问题，为LLM在数学可视化代码生成领域的性能评估提供了专门工具。

title: Privacy Preserving Topic-wise Sentiment Analysis of the Iran Israel USA Conflict Using Federated Transformer Models
summary: The recent escalation of the Iran Israel USA conflict in 2026 has triggered widespread global discussions across social media platforms. As people increasingly use these platforms for expressing opinions, analyzing public sentiment from these discussions can provide valuable insights into global public perception. This study aims to analyze global public sentiment regarding the Iran Israel USA conflict by mining user-generated comments from YouTube news channels. The work contributes to public opinion analysis by introducing a privacy preserving framework that combines topic wise sentiment analysis with modern deep learning techniques and Federated Learning. To achieve this, approximately 19,000 YouTube comments were collected from major international news channels and preprocessed to remove noise and normalize text. Sentiment labels were initially generated using the VADER sentiment analyzer and later validated through manual inspection to improve reliability. Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) was applied to identify key discussion topics related to the conflict. Several transformer-based models, including BERT, RoBERTa, XLNet, DistilBERT, ModernBERT, and ELECTRA, were fine tuned for sentiment classification. The best-performing model was further integrated into a federated learning environment to enable distributed training by preserving user data privacy. Additionally, Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques using SHAP were applied to interpret model predictions and identify influential words affecting sentiment classification. Experimental results demonstrate that transformer models perform effectively, and among them, ELECTRA achieved the best performance with 91.32% accuracy. The federated learning also maintained strong performance while preserving privacy, achieving 89.59% accuracy in a two client configuration.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析YouTube新闻频道评论，使用深度学习模型和联邦学习框架，对伊朗-以色列-美国冲突的全球公众情绪进行隐私保护的舆情分析。
AI.motivation: 随着社交媒体成为公众表达观点的重要平台，分析伊朗-以色列-美国冲突相关的全球公众情绪具有重要价值，但需要解决用户数据隐私保护的问题。
AI.method: 收集约19,000条YouTube评论，使用VADER进行初步情感标注并人工验证，应用LDA识别关键话题，微调BERT、RoBERTa、XLNet、DistilBERT、ModernBERT和ELECTRA等Transformer模型，并集成联邦学习框架保护隐私，使用SHAP进行模型解释。
AI.result: ELECTRA模型表现最佳，达到91.32%准确率；联邦学习在双客户端配置下保持89.59%准确率，同时有效保护用户隐私；SHAP分析识别出影响情感分类的关键词汇。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明Transformer模型在社交媒体情感分析中表现优异，联邦学习能够在保护隐私的同时保持良好性能，为大规模舆情分析提供了可行的隐私保护解决方案。

title: AgriPath: A Systematic Exploration of Architectural Trade-offs for Crop Disease Classification
comment: 11 pages main text, 22 pages total including references and appendix. 6 figures, 10 tables. Code and dataset will be released upon publication
summary: Reliable crop disease detection requires models that perform consistently across diverse acquisition conditions, yet existing evaluations often focus on single architectural families or lab-generated datasets. This work presents a systematic empirical comparison of three model paradigms for fine-grained crop disease classification: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), contrastive Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and generative VLMs. To enable controlled analysis of domain effects, we introduce AgriPath-LF16, a benchmark containing 111k images spanning 16 crops and 41 diseases with explicit separation between laboratory and field imagery, alongside a balanced 30k subset for standardized training and evaluation. All models are trained and evaluated under unified protocols across full, lab-only, and field-only training regimes using macro-F1 and Parse Success Rate (PSR) to account for generative reliability. The results reveal distinct performance profiles. CNNs achieve the highest accuracy on lab imagery but degrade under domain shift. Contrastive VLMs provide a robust and parameter-efficient alternative with competitive cross-domain performance. Generative VLMs demonstrate the strongest resilience to distributional variation, albeit with additional failure modes stemming from free-text generation. These findings highlight that architectural choice should be guided by deployment context rather than aggregate accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 系统比较了CNN、对比式VLM和生成式VLM三种模型在细粒度作物病害分类中的表现，发现不同架构在不同部署场景下各有优劣
AI.motivation: 现有作物病害检测模型评估通常只关注单一架构家族或实验室生成数据集，缺乏对模型在不同采集条件下一致性能的系统性分析，需要建立更全面的评估框架
AI.method: 引入AgriPath-LF16基准数据集（包含11.1万张图像，涵盖16种作物和41种病害），系统比较CNN、对比式VLM和生成式VLM三种模型范式，在统一协议下进行全数据、实验室数据和田间数据的训练评估，使用macro-F1和Parse Success Rate指标
AI.result: CNN在实验室图像上准确率最高但领域迁移能力差；对比式VLM提供稳健且参数高效的替代方案，跨领域性能有竞争力；生成式VLM对分布变化最具韧性，但存在自由文本生成带来的额外失败模式
AI.conclusion: 架构选择应基于部署环境而非单纯追求总体准确率，不同模型范式在不同应用场景下各有优势，需要根据具体需求选择合适模型

title: Preconditioned Test-Time Adaptation for Out-of-Distribution Debiasing in Narrative Generation
comment: This paper has been submitted to ACL2026 main conference
summary: Although debiased LLMs perform well on known bias patterns, they often fail to generalize to unfamiliar bias prompts, producing toxic outputs. We first validate that such high-bias prompts constitute a \emph{distribution shift} via OOD detection, and show static models degrade under this shift. To adapt on-the-fly, we propose \textbf{CAP-TTA}, a test-time adaptation framework that performs context-aware LoRA updates only when the bias-risk \emph{trigger} exceeds a threshold, using a precomputed diagonal \emph{preconditioner} for fast and stable updates. Across toxic-prompt settings and benchmarks, CAP-TTA reduces bias (confirmed by human evaluation) while achieving much lower update latency than AdamW/SGD; it also mitigates catastrophic forgetting by significantly improving narrative fluency over SOTA debiasing baseline while maintaining comparable debiasing effectiveness.

AI.tldr: CAP-TTA是一个测试时自适应框架，通过上下文感知的LoRA更新来应对未知偏见提示的分布偏移，仅在偏见风险触发超过阈值时进行快速更新，减少偏见同时保持低延迟。
AI.motivation: 尽管去偏的大语言模型在已知偏见模式上表现良好，但在面对不熟悉的偏见提示时往往失败，产生有毒输出。研究发现这些高偏见提示构成了分布偏移，静态模型在这种偏移下性能下降。
AI.method: 提出CAP-TTA测试时自适应框架，使用上下文感知的LoRA更新，仅在偏见风险触发超过阈值时进行更新。采用预计算的对角预处理器实现快速稳定的更新，比AdamW/SGD具有更低的更新延迟。
AI.result: 在有毒提示设置和基准测试中，CAP-TTA减少了偏见（经人工评估确认），同时实现了比AdamW/SGD更低的更新延迟。通过显著提高叙事流畅度来减轻灾难性遗忘，同时保持与最先进去偏基线相当的去偏效果。
AI.conclusion: CAP-TTA框架能够有效应对偏见提示的分布偏移问题，通过上下文感知的自适应更新在减少偏见的同时保持模型性能，为解决大语言模型在面对未知偏见时的泛化问题提供了有效方案。

title: Distilling Deep Reinforcement Learning into Interpretable Fuzzy Rules: An Explainable AI Framework
comment: Accepted to AAAI 2026 Spring Symposium Series
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) agents achieve remarkable performance in continuous control but remain opaque, hindering deployment in safety-critical domains. Existing explainability methods either provide only local insights (SHAP, LIME) or employ over-simplified surrogates failing to capture continuous dynamics (decision trees). This work proposes a Hierarchical Takagi-Sugeno-Kang (TSK) Fuzzy Classifier System (FCS) distilling neural policies into human-readable IF-THEN rules through K-Means clustering for state partitioning and Ridge Regression for local action inference. Three quantifiable metrics are introduced: Fuzzy Rule Activation Density (FRAD) measuring explanation focus, Fuzzy Set Coverage (FSC) validating vocabulary completeness, and Action Space Granularity (ASG) assessing control mode diversity. Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) validates temporal behavioral fidelity. Empirical evaluation on \textit{Lunar Lander(Continuous)} shows the Triangular membership function variant achieves 81.48\% $\pm$ 0.43\% fidelity, outperforming Decision Trees by 21 percentage points. The framework exhibits statistically superior interpretability (FRAD = 0.814 vs. 0.723 for Gaussian, $p < 0.001$) with low MSE (0.0053) and DTW distance (1.05). Extracted rules such as ``IF lander drifting left at high altitude THEN apply upward thrust with rightward correction'' enable human verification, establishing a pathway toward trustworthy autonomous systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种分层TSK模糊分类系统，将深度强化学习的神经策略转化为人类可读的IF-THEN规则，通过量化指标评估解释质量，在连续控制任务中实现了高保真度和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习在连续控制任务中表现出色但缺乏可解释性，现有解释方法要么只能提供局部见解，要么使用过于简化的替代模型无法捕捉连续动态，这阻碍了在安全关键领域的部署。
AI.method: 提出分层Takagi-Sugeno-Kang模糊分类系统，使用K-Means聚类进行状态分区，Ridge回归进行局部动作推断，将神经策略蒸馏为人类可读的IF-THEN规则。引入三个量化指标：模糊规则激活密度、模糊集覆盖度和动作空间粒度，以及动态时间规整验证时间行为保真度。
AI.result: 在Lunar Lander(Continuous)环境中，三角隶属函数变体达到81.48%±0.43%的保真度，比决策树高出21个百分点。框架表现出统计上更优的可解释性(FRAD=0.814 vs 0.723)，具有低MSE(0.0053)和DTW距离(1.05)。提取的规则如"如果着陆器在高空向左漂移，则施加向上推力并向右修正"支持人工验证。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功地将不透明的神经策略转化为可解释的模糊规则系统，在保持高性能的同时提供量化可验证的解释，为可信自主系统建立了可行路径。

title: Deep Convolutional Architectures for EEG Classification: A Comparative Study with Temporal Augmentation and Confidence-Based Voting
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures, Recent Trends in Image Processing and Pattern Recognition, Copyright held by Springer CCIS
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) classification plays a key role in brain-computer interface (BCI) systems, yet it remains challenging due to the low signal-to-noise ratio, temporal variability of neural responses, and limited data availability. In this paper, we present a comparative study of deep learning architectures for classifying event-related potentials (ERPs) in EEG signals. The preprocessing pipeline includes bandpass filtering, spatial filtering, and normalization. We design and compare three main pipelines: a 2D convolutional neural network (CNN) using Common Spatial Pattern (CSP), a second 2D CNN trained directly on raw data for a fair comparison, and a 3D CNN that jointly models spatiotemporal representations. To address ERP latency variations, we introduce a temporal shift augmentation strategy during training. At inference time, we employ a confidence-based test-time voting mechanism to improve prediction stability across shifted trials. An experimental evaluation on a stratified five-fold cross-validation protocol demonstrates that while CSP provides a benefit to the 2D architecture, the proposed 3D CNN significantly outperforms both 2D variants in terms of AUC and balanced accuracy. These findings highlight the effectiveness of temporal-aware architectures and augmentation strategies for robust EEG signal classification.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了三种深度学习架构用于EEG事件相关电位分类，发现3D CNN在AUC和平衡准确率上显著优于2D CNN变体，证明了时空联合建模和时间感知增强策略的有效性。
AI.motivation: EEG分类在脑机接口系统中至关重要，但由于信噪比低、神经响应时间变异性大以及数据有限，仍然具有挑战性。本研究旨在比较不同深度学习架构在EEG事件相关电位分类中的性能。
AI.method: 研究设计了三种主要处理流程：1) 使用CSP的2D CNN；2) 直接在原始数据上训练的2D CNN；3) 联合建模时空表示的3D CNN。为应对ERP潜伏期变化，引入了时间偏移增强策略，并在推理时采用基于置信度的测试时间投票机制以提高预测稳定性。
AI.result: 实验评估采用分层五折交叉验证协议，结果表明：虽然CSP对2D架构有益，但提出的3D CNN在AUC和平衡准确率方面显著优于两种2D变体。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现突显了时间感知架构和增强策略对于稳健的EEG信号分类的有效性，为脑机接口系统中的EEG分类提供了重要见解。

title: Multi-hop Reasoning and Retrieval in Embedding Space: Leveraging Large Language Models with Knowledge
summary: As large language models (LLMs) continue to grow in size, their abilities to tackle complex tasks have significantly improved. However, issues such as hallucination and the lack of up-to-date knowledge largely remain unresolved. Knowledge graphs (KGs), which serve as symbolic representations of real-world knowledge, offer a reliable source for enhancing reasoning. Integrating KG retrieval into LLMs can therefore strengthen their reasoning by providing dependable knowledge. Nevertheless, due to limited understanding of the underlying knowledge graph, LLMs may struggle with queries that have multiple interpretations. Additionally, the incompleteness and noise within knowledge graphs may result in retrieval failures. To address these challenges, we propose an embedding-based retrieval reasoning framework EMBRAG. In this approach, the model first generates multiple logical rules grounded in knowledge graphs based on the input query. These rules are then applied to reasoning in the embedding space, guided by the knowledge graph, ensuring more robust and accurate reasoning. A reranker model further interprets these rules and refines the results. Extensive experiments on two benchmark KGQA datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves the new state-of-the-art performance in KG reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: EMBRAG框架通过生成基于知识图谱的逻辑规则，在嵌入空间中进行推理，结合重排序模型提升知识图谱问答性能，在两个基准数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型存在幻觉和知识过时问题，知识图谱作为符号化知识表示可以提供可靠知识增强推理。但LLMs对知识图谱理解有限，且知识图谱本身存在不完整性和噪声，导致检索失败。
AI.method: 提出EMBRAG嵌入检索推理框架：1）基于输入查询生成多个知识图谱相关的逻辑规则；2）在知识图谱指导下，在嵌入空间应用这些规则进行推理；3）使用重排序模型解释规则并优化结果。
AI.result: 在两个基准知识图谱问答数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在知识图谱推理任务中取得了新的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: EMBRAG框架通过结合逻辑规则生成和嵌入空间推理，有效解决了知识图谱检索中的多义性、不完整性和噪声问题，显著提升了知识增强推理的鲁棒性和准确性。

title: Graph2Video: Leveraging Video Models to Model Dynamic Graph Evolution
summary: Dynamic graphs are common in real-world systems such as social media, recommender systems, and traffic networks. Existing dynamic graph models for link prediction often fall short in capturing the complexity of temporal evolution. They tend to overlook fine-grained variations in temporal interaction order, struggle with dependencies that span long time horizons, and offer limited capability to model pair-specific relational dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{Graph2Video}, a video-inspired framework that views the temporal neighborhood of a target link as a sequence of "graph frames". By stacking temporally ordered subgraph frames into a "graph video", Graph2Video leverages the inductive biases of video foundation models to capture both fine-grained local variations and long-range temporal dynamics. It generates a link-level embedding that serves as a lightweight and plug-and-play link-centric memory unit. This embedding integrates seamlessly into existing dynamic graph encoders, effectively addressing the limitations of prior approaches. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that Graph2Video outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on the link prediction task in most cases. The results highlight the potential of borrowing spatio-temporal modeling techniques from computer vision as a promising and effective approach for advancing dynamic graph learning.

AI.tldr: Graph2Video：将动态图视为"图视频"，利用视频基础模型捕捉细粒度时间变化和长程依赖，提升链接预测性能
AI.motivation: 现有动态图模型在链接预测中存在三个主要问题：1）忽略时间交互顺序的细粒度变化；2）难以处理长时程依赖；3）缺乏对特定节点对关系动态的建模能力。需要一种新框架来克服这些限制。
AI.method: 提出Graph2Video框架，将目标链接的时间邻域视为一系列"图帧"，按时间顺序堆叠成"图视频"。利用视频基础模型的归纳偏置来捕捉局部细粒度变化和长程时间动态，生成轻量级、即插即用的链接级嵌入作为内存单元。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，Graph2Video在大多数情况下优于最先进的基线方法，在链接预测任务上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 从计算机视觉领域借鉴时空建模技术是推进动态图学习的一种有前景且有效的方法，Graph2Video展示了这种跨领域方法的潜力。

title: Can We Trust LLMs on Memristors? Diving into Reasoning Ability under Non-Ideality
summary: Memristor-based analog compute-in-memory (CIM) architectures provide a promising substrate for the efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), owing to superior energy efficiency and computational density. However, these architectures suffer from precision issues caused by intrinsic non-idealities of memristors. In this paper, we first conduct a comprehensive investigation into the impact of such typical non-idealities on LLM reasoning. Empirical results indicate that reasoning capability decreases significantly but varies for distinct benchmarks. Subsequently, we systematically appraise three training-free strategies, including thinking mode, in-context learning, and module redundancy. We thus summarize valuable guidelines, i.e., shallow layer redundancy is particularly effective for improving robustness, thinking mode performs better under low noise levels but degrades at higher noise, and in-context learning reduces output length with a slight performance trade-off. Our findings offer new insights into LLM reasoning under non-ideality and practical strategies to improve robustness.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了忆阻器非理想特性对LLM推理的影响，并评估了三种无需训练的增强策略，总结了提升鲁棒性的实用指南。
AI.motivation: 忆阻器模拟存内计算架构虽然能为LLM部署提供高能效和高计算密度，但其固有的非理想特性会导致精度问题，影响LLM推理能力，需要研究其影响并寻找增强鲁棒性的方法。
AI.method: 首先全面调查典型非理想特性对LLM推理的影响，然后系统评估三种无需训练的策略：思考模式、上下文学习和模块冗余。
AI.result: 实验表明推理能力显著下降但不同基准测试表现各异；浅层冗余对提升鲁棒性特别有效；思考模式在低噪声水平下表现更好但在高噪声下会退化；上下文学习会减少输出长度但带来轻微性能折衷。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为非理想条件下的LLM推理提供了新见解，并提出了改善鲁棒性的实用策略，有助于忆阻器CIM架构在LLM部署中的实际应用。

title: Agent-Based User-Adaptive Filtering for Categorized Harassing Communication
comment: 10 pages, 59 figures. Revised and archived version of ALA 2019 workshop paper (co-located with AAMAS 2019)
summary: We propose an agent-based framework for personalized filtering of categorized harassing communication in online social networks. Unlike global moderation systems that apply uniform filtering rules, our approach models user-specific tolerance levels and preferences through adaptive filtering agents. These agents learn from user feedback and dynamically adjust filtering thresholds across multiple harassment categories, including offensive, abusive, and hateful content. We implement and evaluate the framework using supervised classification techniques and simulated user interaction data. Experimental results demonstrate that adaptive agents improve filtering precision and user satisfaction compared to static models. The proposed system illustrates how agent-based personalization can enhance content moderation while preserving user autonomy in digital social environments.

AI.tldr: 提出基于智能体的个性化过滤框架，用于在线社交网络中的分类骚扰信息过滤，通过自适应智能体学习用户偏好，相比静态模型提升过滤精度和用户满意度。
AI.motivation: 传统全局审核系统采用统一过滤规则，无法适应用户个体差异。需要一种能够根据用户特定容忍度和偏好进行个性化过滤的方法，在保护用户免受骚扰内容侵害的同时保持用户自主权。
AI.method: 提出基于智能体的框架，通过自适应过滤智能体建模用户特定容忍度和偏好。智能体从用户反馈中学习，动态调整多个骚扰类别（包括冒犯性、辱骂性和仇恨性内容）的过滤阈值。使用监督分类技术和模拟用户交互数据进行实现和评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，自适应智能体相比静态模型提高了过滤精度和用户满意度。系统展示了基于智能体的个性化方法如何在数字社交环境中增强内容审核效果，同时保持用户自主权。
AI.conclusion: 基于智能体的个性化过滤框架能够有效提升在线社交网络中骚扰信息的过滤效果，通过适应用户特定偏好实现更精准的内容审核，平衡了保护用户与保持用户自主权之间的关系。

title: Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models
comment: Code and data are available at: https://github.com/AlejandroParedesLT/knowledge_distillLLM
summary: We propose a resource-efficient framework for compressing large language models through knowledge distillation, combined with guided chain-of-thought reinforcement learning. Using Qwen 3B as the teacher and Qwen 0.5B as the student, we apply knowledge distillation across English Dolly-15k, Spanish Dolly-15k, and code BugNet and PyTorrent datasets, with hyperparameters tuned in the English setting to optimize student performance. Across tasks, the distilled student retains a substantial portion of the teacher's capability while remaining significantly smaller: 70% to 91% in English, up to 95% in Spanish, and up to 93.5% Rouge-L in code. For coding tasks, integrating chain-of-thought prompting with Group Relative Policy Optimization using CoT-annotated Codeforces data improves reasoning coherence and solution correctness compared to knowledge distillation alone. Post-training 4-bit weight quantization further reduces memory footprint and inference latency. These results show that knowledge distillation combined with chain-of-thought guided reinforcement learning can produce compact, efficient models suitable for deployment in resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一个资源高效的LLM压缩框架，结合知识蒸馏和引导式思维链强化学习，将Qwen 3B压缩到Qwen 0.5B，在多语言和多任务上保持高性能，并通过量化进一步优化部署效率。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在资源受限环境中的部署面临挑战，需要开发既能保持模型能力又显著减小模型尺寸的压缩方法。
AI.method: 1) 使用Qwen 3B作为教师模型，Qwen 0.5B作为学生模型进行知识蒸馏；2) 在英语、西班牙语和代码数据集上应用蒸馏；3) 针对代码任务，结合思维链提示和Group Relative Policy Optimization强化学习；4) 后训练4位权重量化。
AI.result: 蒸馏后的学生模型在英语任务上保留教师70-91%能力，西班牙语任务上达95%，代码任务上Rouge-L达93.5%。思维链强化学习相比纯蒸馏提升了推理连贯性和解决方案正确性。量化进一步减少了内存占用和推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏结合思维链引导的强化学习能够产生适合资源受限环境部署的紧凑高效模型，为LLM压缩提供了有效的综合方法。

title: DOVA: Deliberation-First Multi-Agent Orchestration for Autonomous Research Automation
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tool use, reasoning, and code generation, yet single-agent systems exhibit fundamental limitations when confronted with complex research tasks demanding multi-source synthesis, adversarial verification, and personalized delivery. We present DOVA (Deep Orchestrated Versatile Agent), a multi-agent platform introducing three key innovations: (1) deliberation-first orchestration, where explicit meta-reasoning precedes tool invocation, informed by a persistent user model and entity-aware conversation context; (2) hybrid collaborative reasoning, a composable three-phase pipeline unifying ensemble diversity, blackboard transparency, and iterative refinement; and (3) adaptive multi-tiered thinking, a six-level token-budget allocation scheme that reduces inference cost by 40-60% on simple tasks while preserving deep reasoning capacity. We formalize the core algorithms, present an architectural ablation study across seven system configurations, and analyze the contribution of each component to answer confidence, source coverage, and token efficiency.

AI.tldr: DOVA是一个多智能体平台，通过三个关键创新解决单一LLM智能体在复杂研究任务中的局限性：优先审议编排、混合协作推理和自适应多层级思考。
AI.motivation: 单一LLM智能体在处理需要多源合成、对抗验证和个性化交付的复杂研究任务时存在根本性限制，需要更强大的多智能体协作系统。
AI.method: DOVA平台包含三个核心创新：1) 优先审议编排，在工具调用前进行显式元推理；2) 混合协作推理，统一集成多样性、黑板透明度和迭代精炼的三阶段流程；3) 自适应多层级思考，六层级的token预算分配方案。
AI.result: 该系统在简单任务上减少40-60%的推理成本，同时保持深度推理能力。通过七种系统配置的架构消融研究，分析了各组件对答案置信度、来源覆盖率和token效率的贡献。
AI.conclusion: DOVA通过创新的多智能体架构有效解决了单一LLM智能体在复杂研究任务中的局限性，在保持推理能力的同时显著提升了效率。

title: IAML: Illumination-Aware Mirror Loss for Progressive Learning in Low-Light Image Enhancement Auto-encoders
summary: This letter presents a novel training approach and loss function for learning low-light image enhancement auto-encoders. Our approach revolves around the use of a teacher-student auto-encoder setup coupled to a progressive learning approach where multi-scale information from clean image decoder feature maps is distilled into each layer of the student decoder in a mirrored fashion using a newly-proposed loss function termed Illumination-Aware Mirror Loss (IAML). IAML helps aligning the feature maps within the student decoder network with clean feature maps originating from the teacher side while taking into account the effect of lighting variations within the input images. Extensive benchmarking of our proposed approach on three popular low-light image enhancement datasets demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of average SSIM, PSNR and LPIPS reconstruction accuracy metrics. Finally, ablation studies are performed to clearly demonstrate the effect of IAML on the image reconstruction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于学习低光照图像增强自编码器的新训练方法和损失函数，采用师生自编码器设置和渐进式学习方法，通过新提出的光照感知镜像损失将干净图像解码器特征图的多尺度信息蒸馏到学生解码器的每一层。
AI.motivation: 解决低光照图像增强任务中如何有效利用干净图像信息来指导增强网络学习的问题，特别是在考虑光照变化影响的情况下。
AI.method: 采用师生自编码器架构，结合渐进式学习方法，提出光照感知镜像损失（IAML），将教师解码器干净图像特征图的多尺度信息以镜像方式蒸馏到学生解码器的每一层，同时考虑输入图像的光照变化影响。
AI.result: 在三个流行的低光照图像增强数据集上进行广泛基准测试，模型在平均SSIM、PSNR和LPIPS重建精度指标上达到最先进性能。消融研究清晰展示了IAML对图像重建精度的积极影响。
AI.conclusion: 提出的光照感知镜像损失和师生自编码器训练方法有效提升了低光照图像增强的性能，通过特征对齐和光照感知机制实现了更好的图像重建质量。

title: LiveWeb-IE: A Benchmark For Online Web Information Extraction
summary: Web information extraction (WIE) is the task of automatically extracting data from web pages, offering high utility for various applications. The evaluation of WIE systems has traditionally relied on benchmarks built from HTML snapshots captured at a single point in time. However, this offline evaluation paradigm fails to account for the temporally evolving nature of the web; consequently, performance on these static benchmarks often fails to generalize to dynamic real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce \dataset, a new benchmark designed for evaluating WIE systems directly against live websites. Based on trusted and permission-granted websites, we curate natural language queries that require information extraction of various data categories, such as text, images, and hyperlinks. We further design these queries to represent four levels of complexity, based on the number and cardinality of attributes to be extracted, enabling a granular assessment of WIE systems. In addition, we propose Visual Grounding Scraper (VGS), a novel multi-stage agentic framework that mimics human cognitive processes by visually narrowing down web page content to extract desired information. Extensive experiments across diverse backbone models demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of VGS. We believe that this study lays the foundation for developing practical and robust WIE systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个针对动态网页信息提取系统的新基准测试数据集，并开发了一个模拟人类认知过程的多阶段智能代理框架VGS，用于评估和提升网页信息提取系统在真实动态环境中的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统网页信息提取系统的评估依赖于静态HTML快照构建的基准测试，无法反映网页随时间演变的动态特性，导致在静态基准上的性能无法泛化到真实动态场景中。
AI.method: 1) 创建了一个基于可信且获得许可的网站的新基准测试数据集，包含需要提取文本、图像和超链接等多种数据类型的自然语言查询；2) 设计了四个复杂度级别的查询，基于需要提取的属性数量和基数；3) 提出了视觉定位抓取器(VGS)，这是一个模拟人类认知过程的多阶段智能代理框架，通过视觉缩小网页内容范围来提取所需信息。
AI.result: 在不同骨干模型上进行的广泛实验证明了VGS的有效性和鲁棒性。该研究为开发实用且鲁棒的网页信息提取系统奠定了基础。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过引入针对动态网页的新基准测试和模拟人类认知过程的智能代理框架，解决了传统静态评估方法的局限性，为网页信息提取系统在真实动态环境中的评估和改进提供了重要基础。

title: Why Grokking Takes So Long: A First-Principles Theory of Representational Phase Transitions
summary:
Grokking is the sudden generalization that appears long after a model has perfectly memorized its training data. Although this phenomenon has been widely observed, there is still no quantitative theory explaining the length of the delay between memorization and generalization. Prior work has noted that weight decay plays an important role, but no result derives tight bounds for the delay or explains its scaling behavior.
  We present a first-principles theory showing that grokking arises from a norm-driven representational phase transition in regularized training dynamics. Training first converges to a high-norm memorization solution and only later contracts toward a lower-norm structured representation that generalizes.
  Our main result establishes a scaling law for the delay:
  T_grok - T_mem = Theta((1 / gamma_eff) * log(||theta_mem||^2 / ||theta_post||^2)),
  where gamma_eff is the effective contraction rate of the optimizer (gamma_eff = eta * lambda for SGD and gamma_eff >= eta * lambda for AdamW). The upper bound follows from a discrete Lyapunov contraction argument, and the matching lower bound arises from dynamical constraints of regularized first-order optimization.
  Across 293 training runs spanning modular addition, modular multiplication, and sparse parity tasks, we confirm three predictions: inverse scaling with weight decay, inverse scaling with learning rate, and logarithmic dependence on the norm ratio (R^2 > 0.97). We further find that grokking requires an optimizer that can decouple memorization from contraction: SGD fails under hyperparameters where AdamW reliably groks.
  These results show that grokking is a predictable consequence of norm separation between competing interpolating representations and provide the first quantitative scaling law for the delay of grokking.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个关于"grokking"现象的首个定量理论，解释了记忆与泛化之间的延迟时间，推导出延迟时间的标度律公式。
AI.motivation: 虽然grokking现象（模型在完美记忆训练数据后突然泛化）被广泛观察到，但缺乏定量理论来解释记忆与泛化之间的延迟时间及其标度行为。先前工作注意到权重衰减的作用，但没有推导出延迟时间的紧界或解释其标度行为。
AI.method: 提出了一个基于正则化训练动力学的第一性原理理论，认为grokking源于范数驱动的表示相变。训练首先收敛到高范数记忆解，然后才收缩到低范数结构化表示。通过离散Lyapunov收缩论证推导上界，并从正则化一阶优化的动力学约束得到匹配下界。
AI.result: 建立了延迟时间的标度律：T_grok - T_mem = Θ((1/γ_eff) * log(||θ_mem||²/||θ_post||²))，其中γ_eff是优化器的有效收缩率。在293个训练运行中验证了三个预测：与权重衰减的逆标度、与学习率的逆标度、以及对范数比的对数依赖（R² > 0.97）。发现grokking需要能够解耦记忆与收缩的优化器。
AI.conclusion: grokking是竞争插值表示之间范数分离的可预测结果，论文提供了首个关于grokking延迟时间的定量标度律，为理解这一现象提供了理论基础。

title: FineRMoE: Dimension Expansion for Finer-Grained Expert with Its Upcycling Approach
summary: As revealed by the scaling law of fine-grained MoE, model performance ceases to be improved once the granularity of the intermediate dimension exceeds the optimal threshold, limiting further gains from single-dimension fine-grained design. To address this bottleneck, we propose FineRMoE (FineR-Grained MoE), an architecture that extends fine-grained expert design to both intermediate and output dimensions, aiming to enhance expert specialization beyond the single-dimension limit. We further introduce a bi-level sparse forward computation paradigm and a specialized routing mechanism to govern the activation. In addition, to obviate the prohibitive cost of training FineRMoE from scratch, we devise a generalized upcycling method to build FineRMoE in a cost-effective manner. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance achieved by FineRMoE across ten standard benchmarks. Compared with the strongest baseline, FineRMoE achieves 6 times higher parameter efficiency, 281 times lower prefill latency, and 136 timese higher decoding throughput during inference.

AI.tldr: FineRMoE通过将细粒度专家设计扩展到中间维度和输出维度，突破单维度细粒度设计的性能瓶颈，实现更高的参数效率和推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有细粒度MoE的缩放定律表明，当中间维度粒度超过最优阈值时，模型性能不再提升，单维度细粒度设计限制了进一步性能增益。
AI.method: 提出FineRMoE架构，将细粒度专家设计扩展到中间和输出两个维度；引入双层稀疏前向计算范式和专门的路由机制；设计通用上循环方法以低成本构建FineRMoE。
AI.result: 在十个标准基准测试中表现出优越性能：相比最强基线，参数效率提高6倍，预填充延迟降低281倍，解码吞吐量提高136倍。
AI.conclusion: FineRMoE通过多维度细粒度设计成功突破了单维度细粒度MoE的性能瓶颈，在保持高效推理的同时显著提升了模型性能。

title: Generate Then Correct: Single Shot Global Correction for Aspect Sentiment Quad Prediction
summary: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) extracts aspect-level sentiment signals from user-generated text, supports product analytics, experience monitoring, and public-opinion tracking, and is central to fine-grained opinion mining. A key challenge in ABSA is aspect sentiment quad prediction (ASQP), which requires identifying four elements: the aspect term, the aspect category, the opinion term, and the sentiment polarity. However, existing studies usually linearize the unordered quad set into a fixed-order template and decode it left-to-right. With teacher forcing training, the resulting training-inference mismatch (exposure bias) lets early prefix errors propagate to later elements. The linearization order determines which elements appear earlier in the prefix, so this propagation becomes order-sensitive and is hard to repair in a single pass. To address this, we propose a method, Generate-then-Correct (G2C): a generator drafts quads and a corrector performs a single-shot, sequence-level global correction trained on LLM-synthesized drafts with common error patterns. On the Rest15 and Rest16 datasets, G2C outperforms strong baseline models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出G2C方法解决ABSA中ASQP任务的训练-推理不匹配问题，通过生成器-校正器架构实现单次全局校正，在Rest15和Rest16数据集上表现优于基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有ABSA中的ASQP任务通常将无序的四元组线性化为固定顺序模板并左到右解码，导致训练-推理不匹配（暴露偏差），早期前缀错误会传播到后续元素，且线性化顺序敏感难以单次修复。
AI.method: 提出Generate-then-Correct (G2C)方法：生成器起草四元组，校正器进行单次序列级全局校正，使用LLM合成的包含常见错误模式的草稿进行训练。
AI.result: 在Rest15和Rest16数据集上，G2C方法超越了强基线模型的表现。
AI.conclusion: G2C方法通过生成器-校正器架构有效解决了ASQP任务中的训练-推理不匹配问题，实现了更好的四元组预测性能。

title: DyACE: Dynamic Algorithm Co-evolution for Online Automated Heuristic Design with Large Language Model
summary: The prevailing paradigm in Automated Heuristic Design (AHD) typically relies on the assumption that a single, fixed algorithm can effectively navigate the shifting dynamics of a combinatorial search. This static approach often proves inadequate for Perturbative Heuristics, where the optimal algorithm for escaping local optima depends heavily on the specific search phase. To address this limitation, we reformulate heuristic design as a Non-stationary Bi-level Control problem and introduce DyACE (Dynamic Algorithm Co-evolution). Distinct from standard open-loop solvers, DyACE use a Receding Horizon Control architecture to continuously co-evolve the heuristic logic alongside the solution population. A core element of this framework is the Look-Ahead Rollout Search, which queries the landscape geometry to extract Search Trajectory Features. This sensory feedback allows the Large Language Model (LLM) to function as a grounded meta-controller, prescribing phase-specific interventions tailored to the real-time search status. We validate DyACE on three representative combinatorial optimization benchmarks. The results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art static baselines, exhibiting superior scalability in high-dimensional search spaces. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm that dynamic adaptation fails without grounded perception, often performing worse than static algorithms. This indicates that DyACE's effectiveness stems from the causal alignment between the synthesized logic and the verified gradients of the optimization landscape.

AI.tldr: DyACE将启发式设计重新定义为非平稳双层控制问题，通过动态算法协同进化来适应组合搜索中的变化动态，显著优于静态基线方法。
AI.motivation: 传统自动启发式设计假设单一固定算法能有效应对组合搜索的动态变化，但这种方法在扰动启发式中往往不足，因为逃离局部最优的最佳算法高度依赖于特定搜索阶段。
AI.method: 提出DyACE（动态算法协同进化）框架，采用滚动时域控制架构持续协同进化启发式逻辑和解决方案种群。核心是前瞻滚动搜索，查询景观几何以提取搜索轨迹特征，使大型语言模型能够作为接地元控制器，根据实时搜索状态制定阶段特定的干预措施。
AI.result: 在三个代表性组合优化基准测试中，DyACE显著优于最先进的静态基线方法，在高维搜索空间中表现出卓越的可扩展性。消融研究证实，没有接地感知的动态适应会失败，甚至比静态算法表现更差。
AI.conclusion: DyACE的有效性源于合成逻辑与优化景观已验证梯度之间的因果对齐，表明动态适应需要基于接地感知才能成功。

title: WaveComm: Lightweight Communication for Collaborative Perception via Wavelet Feature Distillation
summary: In multi-agent collaborative sensing systems, substantial communication overhead from information exchange significantly limits scalability and real-time performance, especially in bandwidth-constrained environments. This often results in degraded performance and reduced reliability.
