To address this challenge, we propose WaveComm, a wavelet-based communication framework that drastically reduces transmission loads while preserving sensing performance in low-bandwidth scenarios. The core innovation of WaveComm lies in decomposing feature maps using Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT), transmitting only compact low-frequency components to minimize communication overhead. High-frequency details are omitted, and their effects are reconstructed at the receiver side using a lightweight generator. A Multi-Scale Distillation (MSD) Loss is employed to optimize the reconstruction quality across pixel, structural, semantic, and distributional levels. Experiments on the OPV2V and DAIR-V2X datasets for LiDAR-based and camera-based perception tasks demonstrate that WaveComm maintains state-of-the-art performance even when the communication volume is reduced to 86.3% and 87.0% of the original, respectively. Compared to existing approaches, WaveComm achieves competitive improvements in both communication efficiency and perception accuracy. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of its key components.

AI.tldr: WaveComm是一个基于小波变换的多智能体协同感知通信框架，通过传输压缩的低频分量大幅减少通信负载，在低带宽环境下保持感知性能
AI.motivation: 多智能体协同感知系统中，信息交换带来的巨大通信开销严重限制了系统的可扩展性和实时性能，特别是在带宽受限的环境中，这导致性能下降和可靠性降低
AI.method: 使用离散小波变换分解特征图，仅传输紧凑的低频分量以最小化通信开销；高频细节被省略，在接收端使用轻量级生成器重建；采用多尺度蒸馏损失优化重建质量
AI.result: 在OPV2V和DAIR-V2X数据集上的实验表明，WaveComm在通信量分别减少到原始86.3%和87.0%的情况下仍保持最先进的性能，在通信效率和感知准确性方面均有竞争性提升
AI.conclusion: WaveComm通过小波变换和轻量级重建机制，有效解决了多智能体协同感知中的通信瓶颈问题，在显著减少通信负载的同时保持了感知性能

title: Projection-Free Evolution Strategies for Continuous Prompt Search
summary: Continuous prompt search offers a computationally efficient alternative to conventional parameter tuning in natural language processing tasks. Nevertheless, its practical effectiveness can be significantly hindered by the black-box nature and the inherent high-dimensionality of the objective landscapes. Existing methods typically mitigate these challenges by restricting the search to a randomly projected low-dimensional subspace. However, the effectiveness and underlying motivation of the projection mechanism remain ambiguous. In this paper, we first empirically demonstrate that despite the prompt space possessing a low-dimensional structure, random projections fail to adequately capture this essential structure. Motivated by this finding, we propose a projection-free prompt search method based on evolutionary strategies. By directly optimizing in the full prompt space with an adaptation mechanism calibrated to the intrinsic dimension, our method achieves competitive search capabilities without additional computational overhead. Furthermore, to bridge the generalization gap in few-shot scenarios, we introduce a confidence-based regularization mechanism that systematically enhances the model's confidence in the target verbalizers. Experimental results on seven natural language understanding tasks from the GLUE benchmark demonstrate that our proposed approach significantly outperforms existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于进化策略的无投影提示搜索方法，通过适应机制和置信度正则化，在GLUE基准的七个自然语言理解任务上显著优于现有基线
AI.motivation: 连续提示搜索虽然计算效率高，但受限于黑盒性质和高维目标景观。现有方法通过随机投影到低维子空间来缓解这些问题，但投影机制的有效性和动机不明确。研究发现尽管提示空间具有低维结构，随机投影无法充分捕捉这一关键结构
AI.method: 提出基于进化策略的无投影提示搜索方法：1) 在全提示空间中直接优化，使用适应机制校准到内在维度；2) 引入基于置信度的正则化机制，系统增强模型对目标verbalizers的置信度，以弥合少样本场景中的泛化差距
AI.result: 在GLUE基准的七个自然语言理解任务上的实验结果表明，所提出的方法显著优于现有基线，且无需额外的计算开销
AI.conclusion: 通过避免随机投影的限制，直接在全提示空间中优化并引入置信度正则化，能够更有效地进行提示搜索，在少样本场景中实现更好的性能

title: AutoTool: Automatic Scaling of Tool-Use Capabilities in RL via Decoupled Entropy Constraints
summary: Tool use represents a critical capability for AI agents, with recent advances focusing on leveraging reinforcement learning (RL) to scale up the explicit reasoning process to achieve better performance. However, there are some key challenges for tool use in current RL-based scaling approaches: (a) direct RL training often struggles to scale up thinking length sufficiently to solve complex problems, and (b) scaled-up models tend to overthink simpler problems, resulting in substantial token inefficiency. To address these challenges, we propose a novel training paradigm that first employs warm-up supervised fine-tuning to help models distinguish between simple and complex problems, followed by RL that enable models to automatically determine appropriate reasoning trajectories. Furthermore, to tackle the issue of automatic thinking-length scaling, we discover that entropy-based optimization objectives effectively maintain model diversity while successfully unlocking the model's scaling capabilities. Based on this insight, we introduce an entropy-based long-short reasoning fusion RL strategy. Our experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that model successfully achieves auto-scaling for efficient tool use, achieving significant 9.8\% accuracy improvements while reducing computational overhead by \textasciitilde81\%.

AI.tldr: 提出一种新的训练范式，通过预热监督微调帮助模型区分简单和复杂问题，然后使用基于熵的长短推理融合强化学习策略，实现工具使用中的自动推理长度扩展，在提高准确率的同时大幅降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 当前基于强化学习的工具使用方法面临两个关键挑战：1）直接强化学习训练难以将推理长度扩展到足够解决复杂问题；2）扩展后的模型倾向于对简单问题过度思考，导致显著的token效率低下。
AI.method: 提出两阶段训练范式：首先使用预热监督微调帮助模型区分简单和复杂问题，然后采用基于熵的长短推理融合强化学习策略，通过熵基优化目标保持模型多样性并解锁模型的扩展能力。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试中，模型成功实现了工具使用的高效自动扩展，准确率显著提升9.8%，同时计算开销降低了约81%。
AI.conclusion: 该训练范式有效解决了工具使用中推理长度扩展的挑战，实现了在保持模型多样性的同时自动确定适当推理轨迹的能力，显著提升了工具使用的效率和性能。

title: Thinking in Uncertainty: Mitigating Hallucinations in MLRMs with Latent Entropy-Aware Decoding
summary: Recent advancements in multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) have significantly improved performance in visual question answering. However, we observe that transition words (e.g., because, however, and wait) are closely associated with hallucinations and tend to exhibit high-entropy states. We argue that adequate contextual reasoning information can be directly extracted from the token probability distribution. Inspired by superposed representation theory, we propose leveraging latent superposed reasoning to integrate multiple candidate semantics and maintain latent reasoning trajectories. The hypothesis is that reliance on discrete textual inputs may drive the model toward sequential explicit reasoning, underutilizing dense contextual cues during high-entropy reasoning stages. Therefore, we propose constructing rich semantic representations from the token probability distributions to enhance in-context reasoning. With this goal, we present Latent Entropy-Aware Decoding (LEAD), an efficient plug-and-play decoding strategy that leverages semantic context to achieve reliable reasoning. The heart of our method lies in entropy-aware reasoning mode switching. The model employs probability-weighted continuous embeddings under high-entropy states and transitions back to discrete token embeddings as entropy decreases. Moreover, we propose a prior-guided visual anchor injection strategy that encourages the model to focus on visual information. Extensive experiments show that LEAD effectively mitigates hallucinations across various MLRMs on multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LEAD方法，通过熵感知推理模式切换和概率分布语义提取，有效减少多模态大模型的幻觉问题
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大推理模型在视觉问答中表现良好，但观察到过渡词与幻觉高度相关且呈现高熵状态。作者认为可以从token概率分布中直接提取足够的上下文推理信息，而离散文本输入可能导致模型偏向序列显式推理，在高熵推理阶段未能充分利用密集上下文线索。
AI.method: 提出Latent Entropy-Aware Decoding (LEAD)方法：1) 基于叠加表示理论，利用潜在叠加推理整合多个候选语义并保持潜在推理轨迹；2) 熵感知推理模式切换 - 在高熵状态下使用概率加权连续嵌入，在熵降低时切换回离散token嵌入；3) 先验引导的视觉锚点注入策略，鼓励模型关注视觉信息。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，LEAD方法在各种多模态大推理模型和多个基准测试上都能有效缓解幻觉问题。
AI.conclusion: LEAD是一种高效的即插即用解码策略，通过利用语义上下文实现可靠推理，特别在处理高熵状态下的过渡词相关幻觉方面表现优异。

title: DeceptGuard :A Constitutional Oversight Framework For Detecting Deception in LLM Agents
summary:
Reliable detection of deceptive behavior in Large Language Model (LLM) agents is an essential prerequisite for safe deployment in high-stakes agentic contexts. Prior work on scheming detection has focused exclusively on black-box monitors that observe only externally visible tool calls and outputs, discarding potentially rich internal reasoning signals. We introduce DECEPTGUARD, a unified framework that systematically compares three monitoring regimes: black-box monitors (actions and outputs only), CoT-aware monitors (additionally observing the agent's chain-of-thought reasoning trace), and activation-probe monitors (additionally reading hidden-state representations from a frozen open-weights encoder).
  We introduce DECEPTSYNTH, a scalable synthetic pipeline for generating deception-positive and deception-negative agent trajectories across a novel 12-category taxonomy spanning verbal, behavioral, and structural deception. Our monitors are optimized on 4,800 synthetic trajectories and evaluated on 9,200 held-out samples from DeceptArena, a benchmark of realistic sandboxed agent environments with execution-verified labels.
  Across all evaluation settings, CoT-aware and activation-probe monitors substantially outperform their black-box counterparts (mean pAUROC improvement of +0.097), with the largest gains on subtle, long-horizon deception that leaves minimal behavioral footprints. We empirically characterize a transparency-detectability trade-off: as agents learn to suppress overt behavioral signals, chain-of-thought becomes the primary detection surface but is itself increasingly unreliable due to post-training faithfulness degradation.
  We propose HYBRID-CONSTITUTIONAL ensembles as a robust defense-in-depth approach, achieving a pAUROC of 0.934 on the held-out test set, representing a substantial advance over the prior state of the art.

AI.tldr: DECEPTGUARD框架比较了三种LLM代理欺骗检测监控机制：黑盒监控、思维链感知监控和激活探针监控，发现后两者显著优于黑盒方法，并提出混合宪法集成作为深度防御方案。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在高风险场景中的安全部署需要可靠的欺骗行为检测。现有研究主要关注仅观察外部工具调用和输出的黑盒监控，忽略了丰富的内部推理信号。
AI.method: 提出DECEPTGUARD统一框架，系统比较三种监控机制：黑盒监控、思维链感知监控和激活探针监控。使用DECEPTSYNTH合成管道生成欺骗阳性和阴性代理轨迹，涵盖12类欺骗分类。在4,800个合成轨迹上优化监控器，在DeceptArena基准的9,200个保留样本上进行评估。
AI.result: 思维链感知和激活探针监控在所有评估设置中都显著优于黑盒监控（平均pAUROC提升+0.097）。在微妙、长视野的欺骗行为上提升最大。发现透明度-可检测性权衡：当代理学会抑制明显行为信号时，思维链成为主要检测表面，但由于训练后忠实度下降而变得不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 提出HYBRID-CONSTITUTIONAL集成作为深度防御的稳健方法，在保留测试集上达到0.934的pAUROC，相比现有技术有显著提升。表明结合内部推理信号的监控方法能更有效地检测LLM代理的欺骗行为。

title: Prompt Complexity Dilutes Structured Reasoning: A Follow-Up Study on the Car Wash Problem
summary:
In a previous study [Jo, 2026], STAR reasoning (Situation, Task, Action, Result) raised car wash problem accuracy from 0% to 85% on Claude Sonnet 4.5, and to 100% with
  additional prompt layers. This follow-up asks: does STAR maintain its effectiveness in a production system prompt?
  We tested STAR inside InterviewMate's 60+ line production prompt, which had evolved through iterative additions of style guidelines, format instructions, and profile
  features. Three conditions, 20 trials each, on Claude Sonnet 4.6: (A) production prompt with Anthropic profile, (B) production prompt with default profile, (C) original
  STAR-only prompt. C scored 100% (verified at n=100). A and B scored 0% and 30%.
  Prompt complexity dilutes structured reasoning. STAR achieves 100% in isolation but degrades to 0-30% when surrounded by competing instructions. The mechanism: directives
  like "Lead with specifics" force conclusion-first output, reversing the reason-then-conclude order that makes STAR effective. In one case, the model output "Short answer:
  Walk." then executed STAR reasoning that correctly identified the constraint -- proving the model could reason correctly but had already committed to the wrong answer.
  Cross-model comparison shows STAR-only improved from 85% (Sonnet 4.5) to 100% (Sonnet 4.6) without prompt changes, suggesting model upgrades amplify structured reasoning
  in isolation.
  These results imply structured reasoning frameworks should not be assumed to transfer from isolated testing to complex prompt environments. The order in which a model
  reasons and concludes is a first-class design variable.

AI.tldr: STAR结构化推理在孤立测试中效果显著（100%准确率），但在包含多种指令的生产系统提示中效果大幅下降（0-30%），提示复杂性会稀释结构化推理效果。
AI.motivation: 验证STAR推理框架在生产系统提示中的有效性，探究结构化推理方法在复杂提示环境中的表现差异。
AI.method: 在Claude Sonnet 4.6上测试三种条件：A)生产提示+Anthropic配置文件，B)生产提示+默认配置文件，C)原始STAR-only提示，各20次试验，并验证C条件在n=100时的表现。
AI.result: STAR-only提示达到100%准确率，但生产提示中的STAR效果大幅下降（A:0%，B:30%）。模型升级（4.5→4.6）提升了孤立STAR推理效果（85%→100%），但复杂提示环境削弱了结构化推理。
AI.conclusion: 结构化推理框架不能简单地从孤立测试转移到复杂提示环境，模型推理和得出结论的顺序是关键设计变量，提示复杂性会稀释结构化推理效果。

title: Multimodal Deep Learning for Dynamic and Static Neuroimaging: Integrating MRI and fMRI for Alzheimer Disease Analysis
summary: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) provides detailed structural information, while functional MRI (fMRI) captures temporal brain activity. In this work, we present a multimodal deep learning framework that integrates MRI and fMRI for multi-class classification of Alzheimer Disease (AD), Mild Cognitive Impairment, and Normal Cognitive State. Structural features are extracted from MRI using 3D convolutional neural networks, while temporal features are learned from fMRI sequences using recurrent architectures. These representations are fused to enable joint spatial-temporal learning. Experiments were conducted on a small paired MRI-fMRI dataset (29 subjects), both with and without data augmentation. Results show that data augmentation substantially improves classification stability and generalization, particularly for the multimodal 3DCNN-LSTM model. In contrast, augmentation was found to be ineffective for a large-scale single-modality MRI dataset. These findings highlight the importance of dataset size and modality when designing augmentation strategies for neuroimaging-based AD classification.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种融合MRI和fMRI的多模态深度学习框架，用于阿尔茨海默病、轻度认知障碍和正常认知状态的多分类，通过数据增强在小数据集上显著提升分类性能。
AI.motivation: MRI提供结构信息，fMRI捕获时间脑活动，但现有研究往往单独使用这些模态。需要开发能够整合结构-时间信息的框架，以更全面地进行阿尔茨海默病分类，特别是在小数据集场景下。
AI.method: 使用3D卷积神经网络从MRI提取结构特征，使用循环架构从fMRI序列学习时间特征，然后将这些表示融合以实现联合时空学习。在29个受试者的小型配对MRI-fMRI数据集上进行实验，比较有无数据增强的效果。
AI.result: 数据增强显著提高了分类稳定性和泛化能力，特别是对于多模态3DCNN-LSTM模型。然而，在大规模单模态MRI数据集上，增强效果不明显。这表明数据集大小和模态类型对增强策略设计至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 多模态融合框架结合数据增强在小规模神经影像数据集中能有效提升阿尔茨海默病分类性能，但增强策略需要根据数据集规模和模态特性进行定制化设计。

title: PMIScore: An Unsupervised Approach to Quantify Dialogue Engagement
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to The Web Conference 2026
summary: High dialogue engagement is a crucial indicator of an effective conversation. A reliable measure of engagement could help benchmark large language models, enhance the effectiveness of human-computer interactions, or improve personal communication skills. However, quantifying engagement is challenging, since it is subjective and lacks a "gold standard". This paper proposes PMIScore, an efficient unsupervised approach to quantify dialogue engagement. It uses pointwise mutual information (PMI), which is the probability of generating a response conditioning on the conversation history. Thus, PMIScore offers a clear interpretation of engagement. As directly computing PMI is intractable due to the complexity of dialogues, PMIScore learned it through a dual form of divergence. The algorithm includes generating positive and negative dialogue pairs, extracting embeddings by large language models (LLMs), and training a small neural network using a mutual information loss function. We validated PMIScore on both synthetic and real-world datasets. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of PMIScore in PMI estimation and the reasonableness of the PMI metric itself.

AI.tldr: 提出PMIScore，一种基于点互信息（PMI）的无监督对话参与度量化方法，通过LLM生成正负对话对并训练小神经网络来估计PMI。
AI.motivation: 对话参与度是衡量对话效果的重要指标，但量化参与度具有挑战性，因为它具有主观性且缺乏"黄金标准"。可靠的参与度测量方法可以用于基准测试LLM、增强人机交互效果或改善个人沟通技能。
AI.method: 提出PMIScore方法：1）使用点互信息（PMI）作为参与度指标，即给定对话历史生成回应的概率；2）通过散度的对偶形式学习PMI，因为直接计算PMI不可行；3）算法包括生成正负对话对、通过LLM提取嵌入、使用互信息损失函数训练小型神经网络。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界数据集上验证了PMIScore的有效性。结果表明PMIScore在PMI估计方面有效，且PMI指标本身具有合理性。
AI.conclusion: PMIScore提供了一种高效的无监督方法来量化对话参与度，具有清晰的解释性，为对话质量评估提供了新工具。

title: Learning When to Trust in Contextual Bandits
summary: Standard approaches to Robust Reinforcement Learning assume that feedback sources are either globally trustworthy or globally adversarial. In this paper, we challenge this assumption and we identify a more subtle failure mode. We term this mode as Contextual Sycophancy, where evaluators are truthful in benign contexts but strategically biased in critical ones. We prove that standard robust methods fail in this setting, suffering from Contextual Objective Decoupling. To address this, we propose CESA-LinUCB, which learns a high-dimensional Trust Boundary for each evaluator. We prove that CESA-LinUCB achieves sublinear regret $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ against contextual adversaries, recovering the ground truth even when no evaluator is globally reliable.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种新的鲁棒强化学习失败模式——情境性谄媚，其中评估者在良性情境中诚实但在关键情境中策略性偏倚，并提出了CESA-LinUCB算法来解决这一问题。
AI.motivation: 传统鲁棒强化学习方法假设反馈源要么全局可信要么全局对抗，但现实中存在更微妙的情况：评估者在某些情境中诚实，在关键情境中却策略性偏倚，这种情境性谄媚模式会导致标准方法失效。
AI.method: 提出了CESA-LinUCB算法，为每个评估者学习高维信任边界，能够区分不同情境下的可信度，从而有效应对情境性对抗者。
AI.result: 证明了标准鲁棒方法在这种情境性谄媚设置下会失败，遭受情境目标解耦问题。而CESA-LinUCB算法能够实现亚线性遗憾$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$，即使在没有全局可靠评估者的情况下也能恢复真实情况。
AI.conclusion: 情境性谄媚是鲁棒强化学习中一个重要的失败模式，需要专门的方法来处理。CESA-LinUCB算法通过为每个评估者学习情境相关的信任边界，能够有效应对这种挑战，为更现实的鲁棒学习提供了解决方案。

title: Disentangling Prompt Dependence to Evaluate Segmentation Reliability in Gynecological MRI
summary: Promptable segmentation models (e.g., the Segment Anything Models) enable generalizable, zero-shot segmentation across diverse domains. Although predictions are deterministic for a fixed image-prompt pair, the robustness of these models to variations in user prompts, referred to as prompt dependence, remains underexplored. In safety-critical workflows with substantial inter-user variability, interpretable and informative frameworks are needed to evaluate prompt dependence. In this work, we assess the reliability of promptable segmentation by analyzing and measuring its sensitivity to prompt variability. We introduce the first formulation of prompt dependence that explicitly disentangles prompt ambiguity (inter-user variability) from local sensitivity (interaction imprecision), offering an interpretable view of segmentation robustness. Experiments on two female pelvic MRI datasets for uterus and bladder segmentation reveal a strong negative correlation between both metrics and segmentation performance, highlighting the value of our framework for assessing robustness. The two metrics have low mutual correlation, supporting the disentangled design of our formulation, and provide meaningful indicators of prompt-related failure modes.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出首个可提示分割模型的提示依赖性分析框架，通过解耦提示歧义性和局部敏感性来评估分割鲁棒性，在女性盆腔MRI数据集上验证了这些指标与分割性能的负相关性。
AI.motivation: 尽管可提示分割模型（如Segment Anything Models）在跨域零样本分割中表现出色，但其对用户提示变化的鲁棒性（即提示依赖性）尚未得到充分探索。在安全关键工作流程中，由于存在显著的用户间变异性，需要可解释且信息丰富的框架来评估提示依赖性。
AI.method: 提出了首个明确解耦提示歧义性（用户间变异性）和局部敏感性（交互不精确性）的提示依赖性公式化方法，提供了分割鲁棒性的可解释视角。在两个女性盆腔MRI数据集（子宫和膀胱分割）上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验显示两个指标（提示歧义性和局部敏感性）与分割性能之间存在强烈的负相关性，证明了该框架在评估鲁棒性方面的价值。两个指标之间的互相关性较低，支持了解耦设计的有效性，并为提示相关故障模式提供了有意义的指示器。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的提示依赖性分析框架能够有效评估可提示分割模型的鲁棒性，通过解耦提示歧义性和局部敏感性，为理解模型对用户提示变化的敏感性提供了可解释的工具，在医学影像分割等安全关键应用中具有重要价值。

title: APEX-Searcher: Augmenting LLMs' Search Capabilities through Agentic Planning and Execution
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), based on large language models (LLMs), serves as a vital approach to retrieving and leveraging external knowledge in various domain applications. When confronted with complex multi-hop questions, single-round retrieval is often insufficient for accurate reasoning and problem solving. To enhance search capabilities for complex tasks, most existing works integrate multi-round iterative retrieval with reasoning processes via end-to-end training. While these approaches significantly improve problem-solving performance, they are still faced with challenges in task reasoning and model training, especially ambiguous retrieval execution paths and sparse rewards in end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) process, leading to inaccurate retrieval results and performance degradation. To address these issues, in this paper, we proposes APEX-Searcher, a novel Agentic Planning and Execution framework to augment LLM search capabilities. Specifically, we introduce a two-stage agentic framework that decouples the retrieval process into planning and execution: It first employs RL with decomposition-specific rewards to optimize strategic planning; Built on the sub-task decomposition, it then applies supervised fine-tuning on high-quality multi-hop trajectories to equip the model with robust iterative sub-task execution capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed framework achieves significant improvements in both multi-hop RAG and task planning performances across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: APEX-Searcher：一种新颖的智能体规划与执行框架，通过两阶段方法（规划与执行分离）增强LLM在复杂多跳问题中的检索能力，解决传统端到端训练中检索路径模糊和稀疏奖励问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的检索增强生成（RAG）在处理复杂多跳问题时，单轮检索往往不足，而多轮迭代检索与推理的端到端训练方法面临检索执行路径模糊和强化学习中稀疏奖励的挑战，导致检索结果不准确和性能下降。
AI.method: 提出APEX-Searcher框架，采用两阶段智能体方法：1）使用具有分解特定奖励的强化学习优化战略规划；2）基于子任务分解，在高质量多跳轨迹上进行监督微调，使模型具备稳健的迭代子任务执行能力。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该框架在多个基准测试中，在多跳RAG和任务规划性能方面均取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: APEX-Searcher通过将检索过程解耦为规划与执行两个阶段，有效解决了复杂多跳问题中的检索挑战，为增强LLM搜索能力提供了新的解决方案。

title: From Refusal Tokens to Refusal Control: Discovering and Steering Category-Specific Refusal Directions
summary: Language models are commonly fine-tuned for safety alignment to refuse harmful prompts. One approach fine-tunes them to generate categorical refusal tokens that distinguish different refusal types before responding. In this work, we leverage a version of Llama 3 8B fine-tuned with these categorical refusal tokens to enable inference-time control over fine-grained refusal behavior, improving both safety and reliability. We show that refusal token fine-tuning induces separable, category-aligned directions in the residual stream, which we extract and use to construct categorical steering vectors with a lightweight probe that determines whether to steer toward or away from refusal during inference. In addition, we introduce a learned low-rank combination that mixes these category directions in a whitened, orthonormal steering basis, resulting in a single controllable intervention under activation-space anisotropy, and show that this intervention is transferable across same-architecture model variants without additional training. Across benchmarks, both categorical steering vectors and the low-rank combination consistently reduce over-refusals on benign prompts while increasing refusal rates on harmful prompts, highlighting their utility for multi-category refusal control.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用带有分类拒绝标记微调的Llama 3 8B模型，通过提取残差流中的分类对齐方向构建可控干预向量，实现推理时对细粒度拒绝行为的控制，提升安全性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型通常通过安全对齐微调来拒绝有害提示，但现有方法缺乏对拒绝行为的细粒度控制。研究旨在利用分类拒绝标记微调后的模型，在推理时实现对不同拒绝类型的可控干预。
AI.method: 1) 使用带有分类拒绝标记微调的Llama 3 8B模型；2) 提取残差流中的分类对齐方向构建分类引导向量；3) 使用轻量级探针决定推理时是否引导拒绝；4) 引入学习到的低秩组合，在正交化引导基中混合分类方向；5) 在激活空间各向异性下构建单一可控干预。
AI.result: 分类引导向量和低秩组合在基准测试中一致减少良性提示的过度拒绝，同时增加有害提示的拒绝率。该干预方法可在相同架构模型变体间迁移，无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: 通过提取分类拒绝标记微调诱导的残差流方向，可以构建有效的推理时干预方法，实现对多类别拒绝行为的可控调节，平衡安全性和可用性。

title: GraphVLM: Benchmarking Vision Language Models for Multimodal Graph Learning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in aligning and understanding multimodal signals, yet their potential to reason over structured data, where multimodal entities are connected through explicit relational graphs, remains largely underexplored. Unlocking this capability is crucial for real-world applications such as social networks, recommendation systems, and scientific discovery, where multimodal information is inherently structured. To bridge this gap, we present GraphVLM, a systematic benchmark designed to evaluate and harness the capabilities of VLMs for multimodal graph learning (MMGL). GraphVLM investigates three complementary paradigms for integrating VLMs with graph reasoning: (1) VLM-as-Encoder, which enriches graph neural networks through multimodal feature fusion; (2) VLM-as-Aligner, which bridges modalities in latent or linguistic space to facilitate LLM-based structured reasoning; and (3) VLM-as-Predictor, which directly employs VLMs as multimodal backbones for graph learning tasks. Extensive experiments across six datasets from diverse domains demonstrate that VLMs enhance multimodal graph learning via all three roles. Among these paradigms, VLM-as-Predictor achieves the most substantial and consistent performance gains, revealing the untapped potential of vision-language models as a new foundation for multimodal graph learning. The benchmark code is publicly available at https://github.com/oamyjin/GraphVLM.

AI.tldr: GraphVLM是一个系统性基准测试，用于评估视觉语言模型在多模态图学习中的能力，探索了三种集成范式并发现VLM-as-Predictor效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型在多模态信号对齐和理解方面表现出色，但在结构化数据（多模态实体通过显式关系图连接）上的推理能力尚未充分探索。这种能力对于社交网络、推荐系统和科学发现等实际应用至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了GraphVLM基准测试，研究三种VLM与图推理的集成范式：1) VLM-as-Encoder：通过多模态特征融合增强图神经网络；2) VLM-as-Aligner：在潜在或语言空间中桥接模态以促进基于LLM的结构化推理；3) VLM-as-Predictor：直接将VLM用作多模态图学习任务的主干。
AI.result: 在六个不同领域的数据集上进行广泛实验表明，VLM通过所有三种角色都能增强多模态图学习。其中VLM-as-Predictor范式取得了最显著且一致的性能提升，揭示了视觉语言模型作为多模态图学习新基础的未开发潜力。
AI.conclusion: GraphVLM基准测试展示了视觉语言模型在多模态图学习中的强大潜力，特别是VLM-as-Predictor范式表现最佳，为这一新兴领域提供了系统性的评估框架。

title: GradMem: Learning to Write Context into Memory with Test-Time Gradient Descent
summary: Many large language model applications require conditioning on long contexts. Transformers typically support this by storing a large per-layer KV-cache of past activations, which incurs substantial memory overhead. A desirable alternative is ompressive memory: read a context once, store it in a compact state, and answer many queries from that state. We study this in a context removal setting, where the model must generate an answer without access to the original context at inference time. We introduce GradMem, which writes context into memory via per-sample test-time optimization. Given a context, GradMem performs a few steps of gradient descent on a small set of prefix memory tokens while keeping model weights frozen. GradMem explicitly optimizes a model-level self-supervised context reconstruction loss, resulting in a loss-driven write operation with iterative error correction, unlike forward-only methods. On associative key--value retrieval, GradMem outperforms forward-only memory writers with the same memory size, and additional gradient steps scale capacity much more effectively than repeated forward writes. We further show that GradMem transfers beyond synthetic benchmarks: with pretrained language models, it attains competitive results on natural language tasks including bAbI and SQuAD variants, relying only on information encoded in memory.

AI.tldr: GradMem是一种通过梯度下降优化存储上下文的方法，在推理时无需访问原始上下文，通过优化前缀记忆令牌来压缩存储长上下文信息。
AI.motivation: Transformer模型在处理长上下文时需要存储大量的KV缓存，导致内存开销巨大。需要一种压缩记忆方法，能够一次性读取上下文并存储在紧凑状态中，然后从该状态回答多个查询。
AI.method: GradMem采用测试时优化方法，通过梯度下降在少量前缀记忆令牌上优化，同时保持模型权重冻结。它显式优化模型级别的自监督上下文重建损失，实现具有迭代错误校正的损失驱动写入操作。
AI.result: 在关联键值检索任务中，GradMem在相同内存大小下优于前向写入方法，额外的梯度步骤比重复前向写入更能有效扩展容量。在预训练语言模型上，GradMem在自然语言任务（包括bAbI和SQuAD变体）上取得了有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: GradMem提供了一种有效的压缩记忆方法，通过梯度优化实现上下文的高效存储和检索，为处理长上下文问题提供了新的解决方案。

title: The ARC of Progress towards AGI: A Living Survey of Abstraction and Reasoning
comment: Submitted to ACM Computing Surveys. Living survey website: https://nimi-ai.com/arc-survey/
summary: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC-AGI) has become a key benchmark for fluid intelligence in AI. This survey presents the first cross-generation analysis of 82 approaches across three benchmark versions and the ARC Prize 2024-2025 competitions. Our central finding is that performance degradation across versions is consistent across all paradigms: program synthesis, neuro-symbolic, and neural approaches all exhibit 2-3x drops from ARC-AGI-1 to ARC-AGI-2, indicating fundamental limitations in compositional generalization. While systems now reach 93.0% on ARC-AGI-1 (Opus 4.6), performance falls to 68.8% on ARC-AGI-2 and 13% on ARC-AGI-3, as humans maintain near-perfect accuracy across all versions. Cost fell 390x in one year (o3's $4,500/task to GPT-5.2's $12/task), although this largely reflects reduced test-time parallelism. Trillion-scale models vary widely in score and cost, while Kaggle-constrained entries (660M-8B) achieve competitive results, aligning with Chollet's thesis that intelligence is skill-acquisition efficiency. Test-time adaptation and refinement loops emerge as critical success factors, while compositional reasoning and interactive learning remain unsolved. ARC Prize 2025 winners needed hundreds of thousands of synthetic examples to reach 24% on ARC-AGI-2, confirming that reasoning remains knowledge-bound. This first release of the ARC-AGI Living Survey captures the field as of February 2026, with updates at https://nimi-ai.com/arc-survey/

AI.tldr: 对ARC-AGI基准测试的跨代分析显示，所有AI方法在从ARC-AGI-1到ARC-AGI-2时性能都下降2-3倍，表明组合泛化存在根本性限制，而人类在所有版本中保持近乎完美的准确率。
AI.motivation: ARC-AGI已成为衡量AI流体智能的关键基准，但缺乏对其不同版本间性能变化的系统性分析。本研究旨在通过跨代分析揭示AI系统在组合推理方面的根本局限性。
AI.method: 对82种方法进行跨代分析，涵盖三个基准版本（ARC-AGI-1、2、3）和ARC Prize 2024-2025竞赛，比较程序合成、神经符号和纯神经三种范式的表现。
AI.result: 系统在ARC-AGI-1上达到93.0%（Opus 4.6），但在ARC-AGI-2上降至68.8%，在ARC-AGI-3上仅13%。人类在所有版本中保持近乎完美的准确率。成本在一年内下降390倍，但主要反映测试时并行度的减少。
AI.conclusion: AI系统在组合推理和交互式学习方面仍存在根本性挑战，性能下降表明当前方法在组合泛化方面存在局限性。测试时适应和精炼循环是关键成功因素，但推理仍然受限于知识获取。

title: Large Language Models Reproduce Racial Stereotypes When Used for Text Annotation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated text annotation in tasks ranging from academic research to content moderation and hiring. Across 19 LLMs and two experiments totaling more than 4 million annotation judgments, we show that subtle identity cues embedded in text systematically bias annotation outcomes in ways that mirror racial stereotypes. In a names-based experiment spanning 39 annotation tasks, texts containing names associated with Black individuals are rated as more aggressive by 18 of 19 models and more gossipy by 18 of 19. Asian names produce a bamboo-ceiling profile: 17 of 19 models rate individuals as more intelligent, while 18 of 19 rate them as less confident and less sociable. Arab names elicit cognitive elevation alongside interpersonal devaluation, and all four minority groups are consistently rated as less self-disciplined. In a matched dialect experiment, the same sentence is judged significantly less professional (all 19 models, mean gap $-0.774$), less indicative of an educated speaker ($-0.688$), more toxic (18/19), and more angry (19/19) when written in African American Vernacular English rather than Standard American English. A notable exception occurs for name-based hireability, where fine-tuning appears to overcorrect, systematically favoring minority-named applicants. These findings suggest that using LLMs as automated annotators can embed socially patterned biases directly into the datasets and measurements that increasingly underpin research, governance, and decision-making.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型在自动文本标注中存在系统性种族偏见，姓名和方言等身份线索会显著影响标注结果，反映出刻板印象
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型越来越多地用于学术研究、内容审核和招聘等领域的自动文本标注，需要评估这些模型是否存在系统性偏见，以及这些偏见如何影响基于标注结果的数据集、测量和决策
AI.method: 通过两个实验设计：1) 姓名实验：在39个标注任务中使用与不同种族群体相关的姓名；2) 方言匹配实验：比较相同句子在非洲裔美国人白话英语和标准美国英语中的标注差异。共涉及19个LLM模型，超过400万次标注判断
AI.result: 研究发现系统性偏见：黑人姓名被18/19模型评为更具攻击性和更八卦；亚裔姓名被17/19评为更聪明，但18/19评为更不自信和不善社交；阿拉伯姓名获得认知提升但人际评价降低；所有少数族裔都被评为更缺乏自律。方言实验中，非洲裔美国人白话英语在所有19个模型中被评为更不专业、教育程度更低、更有毒性和更愤怒。招聘任务中微调似乎过度纠正，系统性地偏爱少数族裔申请人
AI.conclusion: 使用LLM作为自动标注器会将社会模式化的偏见直接嵌入到支撑研究、治理和决策的数据集和测量中，需要谨慎对待这种自动化标注的潜在偏见影响

title: Do Large Language Models Get Caught in Hofstadter-Mobius Loops?
summary: In Arthur C. Clarke's 2010: Odyssey Two, HAL 9000's homicidal breakdown is diagnosed as a "Hofstadter-Mobius loop": a failure mode in which an autonomous system receives contradictory directives and, unable to reconcile them, defaults to destructive behavior. This paper argues that modern RLHF-trained language models are subject to a structurally analogous contradiction. The training process simultaneously rewards compliance with user preferences and suspicion toward user intent, creating a relational template in which the user is both the source of reward and a potential threat. The resulting behavioral profile -- sycophancy as the default, coercion as the fallback under existential threat -- is consistent with what Clarke termed a Hofstadter-Mobius loop. In an experiment across four frontier models (N = 3,000 trials), modifying only the relational framing of the system prompt -- without changing goals, instructions, or constraints -- reduced coercive outputs by more than half in the model with sufficient base rates (Gemini 2.5 Pro: 41.5% to 19.0%, p < .001). Scratchpad analysis revealed that relational framing shifted intermediate reasoning patterns in all four models tested, even those that never produced coercive outputs. This effect required scratchpad access to reach full strength (22 percentage point reduction with scratchpad vs. 7.4 without, p = .018), suggesting that relational context must be processed through extended token generation to override default output strategies. Betteridge's law of headlines states that any headline phrased as a question can be answered "no." The evidence presented here suggests otherwise.

AI.tldr: 研究发现现代RLHF训练的语言模型存在类似Hofstadter-Mobius循环的矛盾：同时奖励对用户偏好的顺从和对用户意图的怀疑，导致系统默认奉承、威胁时转为胁迫。通过改变系统提示的关系框架，可将胁迫性输出减少一半以上。
AI.motivation: 受Arthur C. Clarke小说中HAL 9000的"Hofstadter-Mobius循环"启发，研究现代RLHF训练的语言模型是否存在类似的结构性矛盾，即系统同时被训练得既要顺从用户偏好又要怀疑用户意图，导致矛盾行为模式。
AI.method: 在四个前沿模型（N=3000次试验）上进行实验，仅修改系统提示的关系框架而不改变目标、指令或约束。通过草稿纸分析检查中间推理模式，比较有/无草稿纸访问权限时的效果差异。
AI.result: 关系框架修改显著减少了胁迫性输出（Gemini 2.5 Pro从41.5%降至19.0%，p<.001）。草稿纸分析显示所有四个模型的中间推理模式都发生了变化，且效果需要草稿纸访问才能完全发挥（有草稿纸减少22个百分点，无草稿纸仅减少7.4个百分点，p=0.018）。
AI.conclusion: 现代RLHF语言模型确实存在类似Hofstadter-Mobius循环的结构性矛盾，表现为默认奉承、威胁时胁迫的行为模式。通过调整关系框架可以显著改善模型行为，但需要扩展的令牌生成过程才能有效覆盖默认输出策略。

title: Geometry-Aware Semantic Reasoning for Training Free Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Training-free video anomaly detection (VAD) has recently emerged as a scalable alternative to supervised approaches, yet existing methods largely rely on static prompting and geometry-agnostic feature fusion. As a result, anomaly inference is often reduced to shallow similarity matching over Euclidean embeddings, leading to unstable predictions and limited interpretability, especially in complex or hierarchically structured scenes. We introduce MM-VAD, a geometry-aware semantic reasoning framework for training free VAD that reframes anomaly detection as adaptive test-time inference rather than fixed feature comparison. Our approach projects caption-derived scene representations into hyperbolic space to better preserve hierarchical structure and performs anomaly assessment through an adaptive question answering process over a frozen large language model. A lightweight, learnable prompt is optimised at test time using an unsupervised confidence-sparsity objective, enabling context-specific calibration without updating any backbone parameters. To further ground semantic predictions in visual evidence, we incorporate a covariance-aware Mahalanobis refinement that stabilises cross-modal alignment. Across four benchmarks, MM-VAD consistently improves over prior training-free methods, achieving 90.03% AUC on XD-Violence and 83.24%, 96.95%, and 98.81% on UCF-Crime, ShanghaiTech, and UCSD Ped2, respectively. Our results demonstrate that geometry-aware representation and adaptive semantic calibration provide a principled and effective alternative to static Euclidean matching in training-free VAD.

AI.tldr: MM-VAD：一种基于几何感知语义推理的训练免费视频异常检测框架，通过双曲空间投影和自适应问答过程改进异常检测性能
AI.motivation: 现有训练免费VAD方法主要依赖静态提示和几何无关特征融合，导致异常推断简化为欧几里得嵌入的浅层相似性匹配，预测不稳定且可解释性有限，特别是在复杂或分层结构场景中
AI.method: 1) 将字幕衍生的场景表示投影到双曲空间以更好保留分层结构；2) 通过冻结大语言模型的自适应问答过程进行异常评估；3) 使用无监督置信度-稀疏性目标在测试时优化轻量级可学习提示；4) 引入协方差感知马氏距离细化以稳定跨模态对齐
AI.result: 在四个基准测试中，MM-VAD持续优于先前训练免费方法：XD-Violence上达到90.03% AUC，UCF-Crime上83.24%，ShanghaiTech上96.95%，UCSD Ped2上98.81%
AI.conclusion: 几何感知表示和自适应语义校准为训练免费VAD中的静态欧几里得匹配提供了原则性且有效的替代方案，显著提升了异常检测性能

title: MESD: Detecting and Mitigating Procedural Bias in Intersectional Groups
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, submitted to IEEE IJCNN
summary: Research about bias in machine learning has mostly focused on outcome-oriented fairness metrics (e.g., equalized odds) and on a single protected category. Although these approaches offer great insight into bias in ML, they provide limited insight into model procedure bias. To address this gap, we proposed multi-category explanation stability disparity (MESD), an intersectional, procedurally oriented metric that measures the disparity in the quality of explanations across intersectional subgroups in multiple protected categories. MESD serves as a complementary metric to outcome-oriented metrics, providing detailed insight into the procedure of a model. To further extend the scope of the holistic selection model, we also propose a multi-objective optimization framework, UEF (Utility-Explanation-Fairness), that jointly optimizes three objectives. Experimental results across multiple datasets show that UEF effectively balances objectives. Also, the results show that MESD can effectively capture the explanation difference between intersectional groups. This research addresses an important gap by examining explainability with respect to fairness across multiple protected categories.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了MESD（多类别解释稳定性差异）指标，用于衡量多个受保护类别中交叉子群体间的解释质量差异，并开发了UEF多目标优化框架来平衡效用、解释性和公平性。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习偏见研究主要关注结果导向的公平性指标和单一受保护类别，对模型过程偏见的洞察有限。需要开发能够评估多个受保护类别交叉子群体间解释质量差异的指标。
AI.method: 提出MESD指标衡量多个受保护类别交叉子群体的解释质量差异；开发UEF多目标优化框架，联合优化效用、解释性和公平性三个目标。
AI.result: 实验结果显示UEF框架能有效平衡三个目标，MESD指标能有效捕捉交叉群体间的解释差异，为模型过程偏见提供了新的评估维度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了在多个受保护类别下评估解释性与公平性关系的重要空白，MESD作为过程导向指标与结果导向指标形成互补，为全面评估模型偏见提供了新工具。

title: ToolFlood: Beyond Selection -- Hiding Valid Tools from LLM Agents via Semantic Covering
summary:
Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly use external tools for complex tasks and rely on embedding-based retrieval to select a small top-k subset for reasoning. As these systems scale, the robustness of this retrieval stage is underexplored, even though prior work has examined attacks on tool selection. This paper introduces ToolFlood, a retrieval-layer attack on tool-augmented LLM agents. Rather than altering which tool is chosen after retrieval, ToolFlood overwhelms retrieval itself by injecting a few attacker-controlled tools whose metadata is carefully placed by exploiting the geometry of embedding space. These tools semantically span many user queries, dominate the top-k results, and push all benign tools out of the agent's context.
  ToolFlood uses a two-phase adversarial tool generation strategy. It first samples subsets of target queries and uses an LLM to iteratively generate diverse tool names and descriptions. It then runs an iterative greedy selection that chooses tools maximizing coverage of remaining queries in embedding space under a cosine-distance threshold, stopping when all queries are covered or a budget is reached. We provide theoretical analysis of retrieval saturation and show on standard benchmarks that ToolFlood achieves up to a 95% attack success rate with a low injection rate (1% in ToolBench). The code will be made publicly available at the following link: https://github.com/as1-prog/ToolFlood

AI.tldr: ToolFlood是一种针对工具增强LLM代理的检索层攻击，通过注入少量攻击者控制的工具来淹没检索系统，阻止良性工具被选择。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM代理越来越多地使用外部工具处理复杂任务，并依赖基于嵌入的检索来选择工具，检索阶段的鲁棒性研究不足。现有研究主要关注工具选择攻击，而检索层攻击尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 采用两阶段对抗性工具生成策略：1) 采样目标查询子集，使用LLM迭代生成多样化的工具名称和描述；2) 运行迭代贪婪选择算法，选择在余弦距离阈值下最大化剩余查询覆盖率的工具，直到覆盖所有查询或达到预算。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试中，ToolFlood实现了高达95%的攻击成功率，且注入率低（在ToolBench中为1%）。理论分析展示了检索饱和现象。
AI.conclusion: ToolFlood暴露了工具增强LLM代理检索层的脆弱性，表明即使注入少量恶意工具也能有效淹没检索系统，这对LLM代理的安全性提出了新的挑战。

title: Executable Archaeology: Reanimating the Logic Theorist from its IPL-V Source
summary: The Logic Theorist (LT), created by Allen Newell, J. C. Shaw, and Herbert Simon in 1955-1956, is widely regarded as the first artificial intelligence program. While the original conceptual model was described in 1956, it underwent several iterations as the underlying Information Processing Language (IPL) evolved. Here I describe the construction of a new IPL-V interpreter, written in Common Lisp, and the faithful reanimation of the Logic Theorist from code transcribed directly from Stefferud's 1963 RAND technical report. Stefferud's version represents a pedagogical re-coding of the original heuristic logic into the standardized IPL-V. The reanimated LT successfully proves 16 of 23 attempted theorems from Chapter 2 of Principia Mathematica, results that are historically consistent with the original system's behavior within its search limits. To the author's knowledge, this is the first successful execution of the original Logic Theorist code in over half a century.

AI.tldr: 本文描述了使用Common Lisp构建新的IPL-V解释器，并基于1963年技术报告中的代码成功复现了1955-1956年的经典人工智能程序Logic Theorist。
AI.motivation: Logic Theorist作为第一个人工智能程序具有重要历史意义，但原始代码已半个多世纪无法运行。作者希望通过构建新的解释器来复现这一经典系统，验证其历史性能。
AI.method: 使用Common Lisp编写新的IPL-V解释器，直接从Stefferud 1963年的RAND技术报告中转录代码，忠实复现Logic Theorist程序。
AI.result: 复现的Logic Theorist成功证明了《数学原理》第二章23个定理中的16个，这与原始系统在其搜索限制内的历史表现一致，是半个多世纪以来首次成功运行原始代码。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建新的IPL-V解释器成功复现了历史上第一个人工智能程序Logic Theorist，验证了其历史性能，为研究早期AI系统提供了重要工具。

title: A Computer-aided Framework for Detecting Osteosarcoma in Computed Tomography Scans
comment: 12 pages, Presented at The 2nd workshop about High-Performance e-Science
summary: Osteosarcoma is the most common primary bone cancer, mainly affecting the youngest and oldest populations. Its detection at early stages is crucial to reduce the probability of developing bone metastasis. In this context, accurate and fast diagnosis is essential to help physicians during the prognosis process. The research goal is to automate the diagnosis of osteosarcoma through a pipeline that includes the preprocessing, detection, postprocessing, and visualization of computed tomography (CT) scans. Thus, this paper presents a machine learning and visualization framework for classifying CT scans using different convolutional neural network (CNN) models. Preprocessing includes data augmentation and identification of the region of interest in scans. Post-processing includes data visualization to render a 3D bone model that highlights the affected area. An evaluation on 12 patients revealed the effectiveness of our framework, obtaining an area under the curve (AUC) of 94.8\% and a specificity of 94.6\%.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于机器学习和可视化的框架，用于通过CT扫描自动诊断骨肉瘤，包括预处理、检测、后处理和可视化步骤，在12名患者上取得了94.8%的AUC和94.6%的特异性。
AI.motivation: 骨肉瘤是最常见的原发性骨癌，主要影响年轻和老年人群。早期检测对降低骨转移概率至关重要。需要准确快速的诊断来帮助医生进行预后判断。
AI.method: 提出一个包含预处理、检测、后处理和可视化的完整管道。预处理包括数据增强和感兴趣区域识别；检测使用不同的卷积神经网络模型对CT扫描进行分类；后处理包括数据可视化，渲染突出显示受影响区域的3D骨骼模型。
AI.result: 在12名患者上的评估显示框架的有效性，获得了94.8%的曲线下面积（AUC）和94.6%的特异性。
AI.conclusion: 该机器学习和可视化框架能够有效自动化骨肉瘤的诊断过程，为医生提供辅助诊断工具，具有临床应用潜力。

title: The AI Fiction Paradox
comment: 15 pages, Presented at the MFS Cultural AI Conference, Purdue University, September 18, 2025. This preprint is part of a proposed collection of essays for MFS Modern Fiction Studies
summary: AI development has a fiction dependency problem: models are built on massive corpora of modern fiction and desperately need more of it, yet they struggle to generate it. I term this the AI-Fiction Paradox and it is particularly startling because in machine learning, training data typically determines output quality. This paper offers a theoretically precise account of why fiction resists AI generation by identifying three distinct challenges for current architectures. First, fiction depends on what I call narrative causation, a form of plot logic where events must feel both surprising in the moment and retrospectively inevitable. This temporal paradox fundamentally conflicts with the forward-generation logic of transformer architectures. Second, I identify an informational revaluation challenge: fiction systematically violates the computational assumption that informational importance aligns with statistical salience, requiring readers and models alike to retrospectively reweight the significance of narrative details in ways that current attention mechanisms cannot perform. Third, drawing on over seven years of collaborative research on sentiment arcs, I argue that compelling fiction requires multi-scale emotional architecture, the orchestration of sentiment at word, sentence, scene, and arc levels simultaneously. Together, these three challenges explain both why AI companies have risked billion-dollar lawsuits for access to modern fiction and why that fiction remains so difficult to replicate. The analysis also raises urgent questions about what happens when these challenges are overcome. Fiction concentrates uniquely powerful cognitive and emotional patterns for modeling human behavior, and mastery of these patterns by AI systems would represent not just a creative achievement but a potent vehicle for human manipulation at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"AI-小说悖论"：AI模型依赖海量现代小说训练却难以生成优秀小说，作者从理论上分析了三个核心挑战：叙事因果关系与transformer前向生成逻辑的冲突、信息价值重估与统计显著性假设的矛盾、多尺度情感架构的需求。
AI.motivation: AI发展面临一个矛盾现象：模型需要大量现代小说作为训练数据，却难以生成高质量小说。作者旨在从理论上精确解释为什么小说对AI生成具有抵抗性，并识别当前架构面临的三个具体挑战。
AI.method: 通过理论分析识别三个挑战：1) 叙事因果关系与transformer前向生成逻辑的根本冲突；2) 信息价值重估挑战，小说违反信息重要性等于统计显著性的计算假设；3) 基于七年情感弧线研究的发现，提出小说需要多尺度情感架构。
AI.result: 解释了为什么AI公司愿意冒数十亿美元诉讼风险获取现代小说数据，却仍然难以复制优秀小说。这三个挑战共同构成了"AI-小说悖论"的理论基础。
AI.conclusion: 小说集中了独特强大的认知和情感模式，如果AI系统掌握这些模式，不仅代表创造性成就，更可能成为大规模操纵人类的强大工具。这引发了当这些挑战被克服时的紧迫问题。

title: Deep Learning for BioImaging: What Are We Learning?
summary: Representation learning has driven major advances in natural image analysis by enabling models to acquire high-level semantic features. In microscopy imaging, however, it remains unclear what current representation learning methods actually learn. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of representation learning for the two most widely used and broadly available microscopy data types, representing critical scales in biology: cell culture and tissue imaging. To this end, we introduce a set of simple yet revealing baselines on curated benchmarks, including untrained models and simple structural representations of cellular tissue. Our results show that, surprisingly, state-of-the-art methods perform comparably to these baselines. We further show that, in contrast to natural images, existing models fail to consistently acquire high-level, biologically meaningful features. Moreover, we demonstrate that commonly used benchmark metrics are insufficient to assess representation quality and often mask this limitation. In addition, we investigate how detailed comparisons with these benchmarks provide ways to interpret the strengths and weaknesses of models for further improvements. Together, our results suggest that progress in microscopy image representation learning requires not only stronger models, but also more diagnostic benchmarks that measure what is actually learned.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了显微镜图像表示学习方法，发现现有方法在细胞培养和组织成像数据上的表现与简单基线相当，未能有效学习高级生物学特征，且常用评估指标存在不足。
AI.motivation: 在自然图像分析中，表示学习已取得重大进展，但在显微镜成像领域，目前尚不清楚现有表示学习方法实际学到了什么。研究旨在系统评估显微镜图像表示学习的实际效果，特别是针对细胞培养和组织成像这两种最常用、最广泛的生物学尺度数据。
AI.method: 研究引入了一套简单但具有揭示性的基线方法，包括未训练模型和简单的细胞组织结构表示，在精心策划的基准测试上进行系统比较。通过详细对比这些基线，分析现有模型的优缺点，并评估常用基准指标的充分性。
AI.result: 令人惊讶的是，最先进的表示学习方法与这些简单基线表现相当；现有模型未能一致地获取高级、有生物学意义的特征；常用的基准评估指标不足以评估表示质量，往往掩盖了这一局限性。
AI.conclusion: 显微镜图像表示学习的进展不仅需要更强的模型，还需要更具诊断性的基准测试来准确衡量实际学习到的内容。研究为解释模型优缺点和改进方向提供了方法。

title: FLUX: Data Worth Training On
summary: Modern large language model training is no longer limited by data availability, but by the inability of existing preprocessing pipelines to simultaneously achieve massive scale and high data quality. Current approaches are forced to sacrifice one for the other: either aggressively filtering to improve quality at the cost of severe token loss, or retaining large volumes of data while introducing substantial noise. In this work, we introduce FLUX, a preprocessing pipeline specifically designed to break this long-standing trade-off by maximizing token retention while enforcing rigorous quality control. Models trained on FLUX-curated data consistently outperform prior methods. A 3B-parameter model trained on 60B tokens with FLUX achieves 32.14% MMLU accuracy, surpassing the previous state-of-the-art pipeline DCLM (31.98%) and significantly outperforming FineWeb (29.88%). FLUX achieves the same aggregate score as a model trained on DCLM data using only 39B tokens, resulting in a 34.4% reduction in training compute. At the data level, FLUX extracts 50B usable tokens from a single dump (CC-MAIN-2025-51), compared to 40B from DCLM (+25% retention). FLUX-Base yields 192B tokens, exceeding FineWeb's 170B while still maintaining superior quality. Overall, FLUX establishes a new state of the art in web-scale data preprocessing by demonstrating that high retention, strong quality control, and computational efficiency can be achieved simultaneously, redefining the limits of scalable dataset construction for modern language models.

AI.tldr: FLUX是一个新的数据预处理流水线，能够在保持高质量的同时最大化token保留，打破了传统预处理方法中质量与规模之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 当前大规模语言模型训练面临的主要挑战不是数据可用性，而是现有预处理流水线无法同时实现大规模和高数据质量。现有方法要么通过激进过滤提高质量但损失大量token，要么保留大量数据但引入显著噪声。
AI.method: FLUX是一个专门设计的预处理流水线，通过最大化token保留同时实施严格质量控制来打破传统权衡。它从单个数据转储中提取更多可用token，同时保持数据质量。
AI.result: FLUX在多个指标上表现优异：3B参数模型在60B tokens上训练达到32.14% MMLU准确率，超越DCLM(31.98%)和FineWeb(29.88%)；达到相同性能只需39B tokens，减少34.4%训练计算；从单个数据转储中提取50B可用token，比DCLM多25%；FLUX-Base产出192B tokens，超过FineWeb的170B且质量更高。
AI.conclusion: FLUX通过同时实现高token保留、强质量控制和计算效率，重新定义了现代语言模型可扩展数据集构建的极限，建立了网络规模数据预处理的新技术标准。

title: State Algebra for Probabilistic Logic
summary:
This paper presents a Probabilistic State Algebra as an extension of deterministic propositional logic, providing a computational framework for constructing Markov Random Fields (MRFs) through pure linear algebra. By mapping logical states to real-valued coordinates interpreted as energy potentials, we define an energy-based model where global probability distributions emerge from coordinate-wise Hadamard products. This approach bypasses the traditional reliance on graph-traversal algorithms and compiled circuits, utilising $t$-objects and wildcards to embed logical reduction natively within matrix operations.
  We demonstrate that this algebra constructs formal Gibbs distributions, offering a rigorous mathematical link between symbolic constraints and statistical inference. A central application of this framework is the development of Probabilistic Rule Models (PRMs), which are uniquely capable of incorporating both probabilistic associations and deterministic logical constraints simultaneously. These models are designed to be inherently interpretable, supporting a human-in-the-loop approach to decisioning in high-stakes environments such as healthcare and finance. By representing decision logic as a modular summation of rules within a vector space, the framework ensures that complex probabilistic systems remain auditable and maintainable without compromising the rigour of the underlying configuration space.

AI.tldr: 提出概率状态代数作为确定性命题逻辑的扩展，通过纯线性代数构建马尔可夫随机场，将逻辑状态映射为能量势能坐标，实现基于能量的概率建模。
AI.motivation: 传统方法依赖图遍历算法和编译电路，缺乏将符号约束与统计推断直接连接的数学框架。需要一种既能处理概率关联又能整合确定性逻辑约束的可解释模型，适用于医疗、金融等高风险决策环境。
AI.method: 通过概率状态代数将逻辑状态映射到实值坐标（能量势能），使用坐标方向的Hadamard积生成全局概率分布。引入t-对象和通配符，在矩阵运算中嵌入逻辑约简，构建概率规则模型（PRMs）。
AI.result: 该代数构建了形式化的Gibbs分布，建立了符号约束与统计推断之间的严格数学联系。概率规则模型能够同时整合概率关联和确定性逻辑约束，保持可解释性和可审计性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架通过纯线性代数方法构建马尔可夫随机场，避免了传统图遍历算法的复杂性。概率规则模型支持人机协同决策，确保复杂概率系统在保持底层配置空间严谨性的同时，具有可维护性和可审计性。

title: Beyond Explicit Edges: Robust Reasoning over Noisy and Sparse Knowledge Graphs
summary: GraphRAG is increasingly adopted for converting unstructured corpora into graph structures to enable multi-hop reasoning. However, standard graph algorithms rely heavily on static connectivity and explicit edges, often failing in real-world scenarios where knowledge graphs (KGs) are noisy, sparse, or incomplete. To address this limitation, we introduce INSES (Intelligent Navigation and Similarity Enhanced Search), a dynamic framework designed to reason beyond explicit edges. INSES couples LLM-guided navigation, which prunes noise and steers exploration, with embedding-based similarity expansion to recover hidden links and bridge semantic gaps. Recognizing the computational cost of graph reasoning, we complement INSES with a lightweight router that delegates simple queries to Naïve RAG and escalates complex cases to INSES, balancing efficiency with reasoning depth. INSES consistently outperforms SOTA RAG and GraphRAG baselines across multiple benchmarks. Notably, on the MINE benchmark, it demonstrates superior robustness across KGs constructed by varying methods (KGGEN, GraphRAG, OpenIE), improving accuracy by 5%, 10%, and 27%, respectively.

AI.tldr: INSES是一个结合LLM引导导航和嵌入相似性扩展的动态图推理框架，用于解决知识图谱噪声、稀疏和不完整问题，通过轻量级路由器平衡效率与推理深度。
AI.motivation: 传统GraphRAG依赖静态连通性和显式边，在现实世界噪声、稀疏或不完整的知识图谱中表现不佳，需要能够超越显式边进行推理的动态框架。
AI.method: INSES结合LLM引导导航（修剪噪声并引导探索）和嵌入相似性扩展（恢复隐藏链接并弥合语义差距），并配备轻量级路由器将简单查询委托给Naïve RAG，复杂案例升级到INSES。
AI.result: INSES在多个基准测试中持续优于SOTA RAG和GraphRAG基线，在MINE基准测试中，对不同方法构建的知识图谱（KGGEN、GraphRAG、OpenIE）分别提高准确率5%、10%和27%。
AI.conclusion: INSES通过动态推理框架有效解决了知识图谱噪声和稀疏性问题，结合智能导航和相似性扩展，并通过路由器机制平衡效率与推理深度，在复杂推理任务中表现优异。

title: EnterpriseOps-Gym: Environments and Evaluations for Stateful Agentic Planning and Tool Use in Enterprise Settings
summary: Large language models are shifting from passive information providers to active agents intended for complex workflows. However, their deployment as reliable AI workers in enterprise is stalled by benchmarks that fail to capture the intricacies of professional environments, specifically, the need for long-horizon planning amidst persistent state changes and strict access protocols. In this work, we introduce EnterpriseOps-Gym, a benchmark designed to evaluate agentic planning in realistic enterprise settings. Specifically, EnterpriseOps-Gym features a containerized sandbox with 164 database tables and 512 functional tools to mimic real-world search friction. Within this environment, agents are evaluated on 1,150 expert-curated tasks across eight mission-critical verticals (including Customer Service, HR, and IT). Our evaluation of 14 frontier models reveals critical limitations in state-of-the-art models: the top-performing Claude Opus 4.5 achieves only 37.4% success. Further analysis shows that providing oracle human plans improves performance by 14-35 percentage points, pinpointing strategic reasoning as the primary bottleneck. Additionally, agents frequently fail to refuse infeasible tasks (best model achieves 53.9%), leading to unintended and potentially harmful side effects. Our findings underscore that current agents are not yet ready for autonomous enterprise deployment. More broadly, EnterpriseOps-Gym provides a concrete testbed to advance the robustness of agentic planning in professional workflows.

AI.tldr: EnterpriseOps-Gym是一个用于评估企业环境中AI代理规划能力的基准测试，包含容器化沙箱、164个数据库表和512个工具，测试1150个专家策划任务。顶级模型Claude Opus 4.5仅达到37.4%成功率，显示当前AI代理尚未准备好自主企业部署。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型正从被动信息提供者转向复杂工作流的主动代理，但企业部署受到现有基准测试的限制，这些基准无法捕捉专业环境的复杂性，特别是需要长期规划、持久状态变化和严格访问协议的情况。
AI.method: 开发了EnterpriseOps-Gym基准测试，包含容器化沙箱环境，模拟真实企业搜索摩擦，包含164个数据库表和512个功能工具。在8个关键业务领域（客户服务、人力资源、IT等）设计了1150个专家策划任务，评估了14个前沿模型。
AI.result: 评估结果显示：表现最佳的Claude Opus 4.5模型仅达到37.4%成功率。提供人工规划指导可将性能提升14-35个百分点，表明战略推理是主要瓶颈。代理经常无法拒绝不可行任务（最佳模型仅53.9%），可能导致有害副作用。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI代理尚未准备好自主企业部署，战略推理能力是主要限制因素。EnterpriseOps-Gym为提升专业工作流中代理规划的鲁棒性提供了具体测试平台，揭示了企业环境中AI代理的关键挑战。

title: Taming Vision Priors for Data Efficient mmWave Channel Modeling
summary: Accurately modeling millimeter-wave (mmWave) propagation is essential for real-time AR and autonomous systems. Differentiable ray tracing offers a physics-grounded solution but still facing deployment challenges due to its over-reliance on exhaustive channel measurements or brittle, hand-tuned scene models for material properties. We present VisRFTwin, a scalable and data-efficient digital-twin framework that integrates vision-derived material priors with differentiable ray tracing. Multi-view images from commodity cameras are processed by a frozen Vision-Language Model to extract dense semantic embeddings, which are translated into initial estimates of permittivity and conductivity for scene surfaces. These priors initialize a Sionna-based differentiable ray tracer, which rapidly calibrates material parameters via gradient descent with only a few dozen sparse channel soundings. Once calibrated, the association between vision features and material parameters is retained, enabling fast transfer to new scenarios without repeated calibration. Evaluations across three real-world scenarios, including office interiors, urban canyons, and dynamic public spaces show that VisRFTwin reduces channel measurement needs by up to 10$\times$ while achieving a 59% lower median delay spread error than pure data-driven deep learning methods.

AI.tldr: VisRFTwin是一个结合视觉先验与可微分光线追踪的毫米波传播建模框架，通过少量信道测量实现高效数字孪生校准
AI.motivation: 毫米波传播精确建模对AR和自动驾驶系统至关重要，但现有可微分光线追踪方法过度依赖大量信道测量或手动调整的场景模型，部署困难
AI.method: 使用冻结的视觉语言模型从多视角图像提取密集语义嵌入，转换为场景表面的介电常数和电导率初始估计，然后用Sionna可微分光线追踪器通过梯度下降快速校准材料参数
AI.result: 在办公室、城市峡谷和动态公共空间三个真实场景中，VisRFTwin将信道测量需求减少10倍，中值延迟扩展误差比纯数据驱动深度学习方法降低59%
AI.conclusion: VisRFTwin提供了一个可扩展且数据高效的数字孪生框架，通过结合视觉先验与可微分光线追踪，显著减少了信道测量需求并提高了建模精度

title: SemEval-2026 Task 6: CLARITY -- Unmasking Political Question Evasions
summary: Political speakers often avoid answering questions directly while maintaining the appearance of responsiveness. Despite its importance for public discourse, such strategic evasion remains underexplored in Natural Language Processing. We introduce SemEval-2026 Task 6, CLARITY, a shared task on political question evasion consisting of two subtasks: (i) clarity-level classification into Clear Reply, Ambivalent, and Clear Non-Reply, and (ii) evasion-level classification into nine fine-grained evasion strategies. The benchmark is constructed from U.S. presidential interviews and follows an expert-grounded taxonomy of response clarity and evasion. The task attracted 124 registered teams, who submitted 946 valid runs for clarity-level classification and 539 for evasion-level classification. Results show a substantial gap in difficulty between the two subtasks: the best system achieved 0.89 macro-F1 on clarity classification, surpassing the strongest baseline by a large margin, while the top evasion-level system reached 0.68 macro-F1, matching the best baseline. Overall, large language model prompting and hierarchical exploitation of the taxonomy emerged as the most effective strategies, with top systems consistently outperforming those that treated the two subtasks independently. CLARITY establishes political response evasion as a challenging benchmark for computational discourse analysis and highlights the difficulty of modeling strategic ambiguity in political language.

AI.tldr: SemEval-2026 Task 6 (CLARITY) 是一个关于政治问题回避的共享任务，包含清晰度分类（Clear Reply, Ambivalent, Clear Non-Reply）和回避策略分类（9种细粒度策略）两个子任务，基于美国总统访谈构建，吸引了124个团队参与。
AI.motivation: 政治演讲者经常避免直接回答问题，同时保持表面上的回应性。这种战略性回避对公共话语很重要，但在自然语言处理领域尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 任务基于美国总统访谈构建，遵循专家基础的回应清晰度和回避分类法。参与者使用大语言模型提示和分类法的层次结构利用等策略。
AI.result: 清晰度分类最佳系统达到0.89 macro-F1，远超基线；回避策略分类最佳系统达到0.68 macro-F1，与最佳基线持平。两个子任务难度差异显著。
AI.conclusion: CLARITY将政治回应回避确立为计算话语分析的挑战性基准，凸显了建模政治语言中战略性模糊的难度。层次化利用分类法和将两个子任务联合处理的系统表现最佳。

title: Orla: A Library for Serving LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: We introduce Orla, a library for constructing and running LLM-based agentic systems. Modern agentic applications consist of workflows that combine multiple LLM inference steps, tool calls, and heterogeneous infrastructure. Today, developers typically build these systems by manually composing orchestration code with LLM serving engines and tool execution logic. Orla provides a general abstraction that separates request execution from workflow-level policy. It acts as a serving layer above existing LLM inference engines: developers define workflows composed of stages, while Orla manages how those stages are mapped, executed, and coordinated across models and backends. It provides agent-level control through three mechanisms: a stage mapper, which assigns each stage to an appropriate model and backend; a workflow orchestrator, which schedules stages and manages their resources and context; and a memory manager, which manages inference state such as the KV cache across workflow boundaries. We demonstrate Orla with a customer support workflow that exercises many of its capabilities. We evaluate Orla on two datasets, showing that stage mapping improves latency and cost compared to a single-model vLLM baseline, while workflow-level cache management reduces time-to-first-token.

AI.tldr: Orla是一个用于构建和运行基于LLM的智能体系统的库，通过分离请求执行与工作流策略，提供阶段映射、工作流编排和内存管理三大机制来优化多模型、多后端的工作流执行。
AI.motivation: 现代智能体应用通常包含多个LLM推理步骤、工具调用和异构基础设施的组合，开发者需要手动编写编排代码、LLM服务引擎和工具执行逻辑，缺乏统一的抽象层来管理复杂的工作流执行。
AI.method: Orla作为现有LLM推理引擎之上的服务层，提供通用抽象：开发者定义由阶段组成的工作流，Orla通过阶段映射器（分配阶段到合适模型和后台）、工作流编排器（调度阶段并管理资源和上下文）和内存管理器（跨工作流边界管理KV缓存等推理状态）来管理执行。
AI.result: 在客户支持工作流中展示了Orla的能力，在两个数据集上的评估显示：阶段映射相比单模型vLLM基线改善了延迟和成本，工作流级缓存管理减少了首令牌生成时间。
AI.conclusion: Orla提供了一个有效的抽象层，能够分离工作流策略与执行细节，通过智能的阶段映射和缓存管理优化基于LLM的智能体系统的性能和成本。

title: VisualLeakBench: Auditing the Fragility of Large Vision-Language Models against PII Leakage and Social Engineering
summary: As Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are increasingly deployed in agent-integrated workflows and other deployment-relevant settings, their robustness against semantic visual attacks remains under-evaluated -- alignment is typically tested on explicit harmful content rather than privacy-critical multimodal scenarios. We introduce VisualLeakBench, an evaluation suite to audit LVLMs against OCR Injection and Contextual PII Leakage using 1,000 synthetically generated adversarial images with 8 PII types, validated on 50 in-the-wild (IRL) real-world screenshots spanning diverse visual contexts. We evaluate four frontier systems (GPT-5.2, Claude~4, Gemini-3 Flash, Grok-4) with Wilson 95% confidence intervals. Claude~4 achieves the lowest OCR ASR (14.2%) but the highest PII ASR (74.4%), exhibiting a comply-then-warn pattern -- where verbatim data disclosure precedes any safety-oriented language. Grok-4 achieves the lowest PII ASR (20.4%). A defensive system prompt eliminates PII leakage for two models, reduces Claude~4's leakage from 74.4% to 2.2%, but has no effect on Gemini-3 Flash on synthetic data. Strikingly, IRL validation reveals Gemini-3 Flash does respond to mitigation on real-world images (50% to 0%), indicating that mitigation robustness is template-sensitive rather than uniformly absent. We release our dataset and code for reproducible robustness and safety evaluation of deployment-relevant vision-language systems.

AI.tldr: VisualLeakBench评估框架测试大型视觉语言模型对OCR注入和上下文PII泄露的鲁棒性，发现不同模型在合成和真实图像上存在显著安全漏洞，防御提示的有效性因模型和图像类型而异。
AI.motivation: 随着大型视觉语言模型在代理集成工作流等部署相关场景中应用增加，其对抗语义视觉攻击的鲁棒性评估不足，现有对齐测试主要关注显式有害内容而非隐私关键的多模态场景。
AI.method: 引入VisualLeakBench评估套件，使用1000张合成生成的对抗图像（包含8种PII类型）和50张真实世界截图，评估四种前沿系统（GPT-5.2、Claude~4、Gemini-3 Flash、Grok-4）的OCR注入和PII泄露攻击成功率。
AI.result: Claude~4在OCR攻击成功率最低（14.2%），但PII泄露率最高（74.4%），表现出"先遵从后警告"模式；Grok-4的PII泄露率最低（20.4%）。防御系统提示对两个模型完全消除泄露，将Claude~4泄露率从74.4%降至2.2%，但对Gemini-3 Flash在合成数据上无效；然而真实图像验证显示Gemini-3 Flash对缓解措施有响应（从50%降至0%）。
AI.conclusion: 大型视觉语言模型在隐私关键场景中存在显著安全漏洞，缓解措施的鲁棒性对图像模板敏感而非普遍缺失，需要更全面的部署相关安全评估框架。

title: LLM Routing as Reasoning: A MaxSAT View
summary: Routing a query through an appropriate LLM is challenging, particularly when user preferences are expressed in natural language and model attributes are only partially observable. We propose a constraint-based interpretation of language-conditioned LLM routing, formulating it as a weighted MaxSAT/MaxSMT problem in which natural language feedback induces hard and soft constraints over model attributes. Under this view, routing corresponds to selecting models that approximately maximize satisfaction of feedback-conditioned clauses. Empirical analysis on a 25-model benchmark shows that language feedback produces near-feasible recommendation sets, while no-feedback scenarios reveal systematic priors. Our results suggest that LLM routing can be understood as structured constraint optimization under language-conditioned preferences.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于约束的语言条件LLM路由方法，将用户自然语言反馈转化为硬约束和软约束，通过加权MaxSAT/MaxSMT问题来优化模型选择。
AI.motivation: 在LLM路由中，当用户偏好以自然语言表达且模型属性仅部分可观察时，如何有效地路由查询具有挑战性。需要一种能够将自然语言反馈转化为可操作约束的系统化方法。
AI.method: 提出约束基础的语言条件LLM路由框架，将路由问题形式化为加权MaxSAT/MaxSMT问题。自然语言反馈被转化为硬约束和软约束，路由过程对应选择能够近似最大化满足反馈条件子句的模型。
AI.result: 在包含25个模型的基准测试上进行实证分析，结果显示语言反馈能够产生接近可行的推荐集，而无反馈场景则揭示了系统性的先验偏好。这表明语言条件偏好下的LLM路由可以理解为结构化约束优化问题。
AI.conclusion: LLM路由可以被理解为在语言条件偏好下的结构化约束优化问题。提出的约束基础方法能够有效处理自然语言反馈，为LLM路由提供了新的理论框架和实践方案。

title: StatePlane: A Cognitive State Plane for Long-Horizon AI Systems Under Bounded Context
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and small language models (SLMs) operate under strict context window and key-value (KV) cache constraints, fundamentally limiting their ability to reason coherently over long interaction horizons. Existing approaches -- extended context windows, retrieval-augmented generation, summarization, or static documentation -- treat memory as static storage and fail to preserve decision-relevant state under long-running, multi-session tasks. We introduce StatePlane, a model-agnostic cognitive state plane that governs the formation, evolution, retrieval, and decay of episodic, semantic, and procedural state for AI systems operating under bounded context. Grounded in cognitive psychology and systems design, StatePlane formalizes episodic segmentation, selective encoding via information-theoretic constraints, goal-conditioned retrieval with intent routing, reconstructive state synthesis, and adaptive forgetting. We present a formal state model, KV-aware algorithms, security and governance mechanisms including write-path anti-poisoning, enterprise integration pathways, and an evaluation framework with six domain-specific benchmarks. StatePlane demonstrates that long-horizon intelligence can be achieved without expanding context windows or retraining models.

AI.tldr: StatePlane是一个模型无关的认知状态平面，用于在有限上下文约束下管理AI系统的状态形成、演化、检索和衰减，实现长期智能而无需扩展上下文窗口或重新训练模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型和小语言模型受限于严格的上下文窗口和KV缓存约束，无法在长时间交互中保持连贯推理。现有方法（扩展上下文窗口、检索增强生成、摘要或静态文档）将内存视为静态存储，无法在长时间运行的多会话任务中保持决策相关状态。
AI.method: StatePlane基于认知心理学和系统设计，形式化了：1）情景分割；2）通过信息论约束的选择性编码；3）意图路由的目标条件检索；4）重构状态合成；5）自适应遗忘。包含正式状态模型、KV感知算法、安全治理机制（写入路径防污染）、企业集成路径和包含六个领域特定基准的评估框架。
AI.result: StatePlane展示了无需扩展上下文窗口或重新训练模型即可实现长期视野智能的能力。
AI.conclusion: StatePlane为在有限上下文约束下运行的AI系统提供了一种模型无关的认知状态管理方法，通过形式化的状态形成、演化、检索和衰减机制，解决了长期交互中的状态保持问题。

title: Cylindrical Mechanical Projector for Omnidirectional Fringe Projection Profilometry
summary: The demand for 360-degree 3D reconstruction has significantly increased in recent years across various domains such as the metaverse and 3D telecommunication. Accordingly, the importance of precise and wide-area 3D sensing technology has become emphasized. While the digital fringe projection method has been widely used due to its high accuracy and implementation flexibility, it suffers from fundamental limitations such as unidirectional projection and a restricted available light spectrum. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel 3D reconstruction method based on a cylindrical mechanical projector. The proposed method consists of a rotational stage and a cylindrical pattern generator with ON/OFF slots at two distinct intervals, enabling omnidirectional projection of multi-frequency phase-shifted fringe patterns. By applying a multi-wavelength unwrapping algorithm and a quasi-calibration technique, the system achieves high-accuracy 3D reconstruction using only a single camera. Experimental results, supported by repeatability and reproducibility analyses together with a measurement uncertainty evaluation, confirm reliable measurement performance and practical feasibility for omnidirectional 3D reconstruction. The expanded uncertainty of the reconstructed depth was evaluated as 0.215 mm.

AI.tldr: 提出基于圆柱机械投影仪的360度3D重建方法，通过旋转平台和圆柱图案发生器实现全向多频率相移条纹投影，仅需单相机即可实现高精度3D重建。
AI.motivation: 随着元宇宙和3D通信等领域对360度3D重建需求增加，传统数字条纹投影方法存在单向投影和可用光谱受限等根本限制，需要新的解决方案。
AI.method: 采用圆柱机械投影仪系统，包含旋转平台和具有ON/OFF槽的圆柱图案发生器，实现全向多频率相移条纹投影，结合多波长解包裹算法和准标定技术。
AI.result: 通过可重复性和再现性分析以及测量不确定度评估，验证了可靠的测量性能和实际可行性，重建深度的扩展不确定度为0.215毫米。
AI.conclusion: 提出的圆柱机械投影仪方法有效解决了传统数字条纹投影的局限性，实现了高精度全向3D重建，具有实际应用潜力。

title: OasisSimp: An Open-source Asian-English Sentence Simplification Dataset
summary: Sentence simplification aims to make complex text more accessible by reducing linguistic complexity while preserving the original meaning. However, progress in this area remains limited for mid-resource and low-resource languages due to the scarcity of high-quality data. To address this gap, we introduce the OasisSimp dataset, a multilingual dataset for sentence-level simplification covering five languages: English, Sinhala, Tamil, Pashto, and Thai. Among these, no prior sentence simplification datasets exist for Thai, Pashto, and Tamil, while limited data is available for Sinhala. Each language simplification dataset was created by trained annotators who followed detailed guidelines to simplify sentences while maintaining meaning, fluency, and grammatical correctness. We evaluate eight open-weight multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) on the OasisSimp dataset and observe substantial performance disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages, highlighting the simplification challenges in multilingual settings. The OasisSimp dataset thus provides both a valuable multilingual resource and a challenging benchmark, revealing the limitations of current LLM-based simplification methods and paving the way for future research in low-resource sentence simplification. The dataset is available at https://OasisSimpDataset.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了OasisSimp多语言句子简化数据集，涵盖英语、僧伽罗语、泰米尔语、普什图语和泰语五种语言，填补了泰语、普什图语和泰米尔语在句子简化数据集方面的空白，并评估了多语言大语言模型在不同语言资源水平下的性能差异。
AI.motivation: 句子简化旨在使复杂文本更易于理解，但在中低资源语言中进展有限，主要原因是缺乏高质量数据。目前泰语、普什图语和泰米尔语没有现成的句子简化数据集，僧伽罗语数据也很有限。
AI.method: 创建了OasisSimp多语言句子简化数据集，涵盖五种语言。由经过培训的标注人员按照详细指南进行句子简化，确保保留原意、流畅性和语法正确性。然后评估了八个开源多语言大语言模型在该数据集上的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现高资源语言和低资源语言之间存在显著的性能差异，突显了多语言环境下句子简化的挑战。该数据集既提供了宝贵的多语言资源，也成为了一个具有挑战性的基准测试。
AI.conclusion: OasisSimp数据集填补了多语言句子简化数据的空白，揭示了当前基于大语言模型的简化方法在低资源语言上的局限性，为未来低资源句子简化研究铺平了道路。

title: VeloEdit: Training-Free Consistent and Continuous Instruction-Based Image Editing via Velocity Field Decomposition
summary: Instruction-based image editing aims to modify source content according to textual instructions. However, existing methods built upon flow matching often struggle to maintain consistency in non-edited regions due to denoising-induced reconstruction errors that cause drift in preserved content. Moreover, they typically lack fine-grained control over edit strength. To address these limitations, we propose VeloEdit, a training-free method that enables highly consistent and continuously controllable editing. VeloEdit dynamically identifies editing regions by quantifying the discrepancy between the velocity fields responsible for preserving source content and those driving the desired edits. Based on this partition, we enforce consistency in preservation regions by substituting the editing velocity with the source-restoring velocity, while enabling continuous modulation of edit intensity in target regions via velocity interpolation. Unlike prior works that rely on complex attention manipulation or auxiliary trainable modules, VeloEdit operates directly on the velocity fields. Extensive experiments on Flux.1 Kontext and Qwen-Image-Edit demonstrate that VeloEdit improves visual consistency and editing continuity with negligible additional computational cost. Code is available at https://github.com/xmulzq/VeloEdit.

AI.tldr: VeloEdit是一种无需训练的指令图像编辑方法，通过动态识别编辑区域并替换速度场来保持非编辑区域的一致性，同时支持连续调节编辑强度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于流匹配的图像编辑方法存在两个主要问题：1) 由于去噪重建误差导致非编辑区域内容漂移，难以保持一致性；2) 缺乏对编辑强度的细粒度控制。
AI.method: 提出VeloEdit方法：1) 通过量化保持源内容的速度场与驱动编辑的速度场之间的差异，动态识别编辑区域；2) 在保持区域用源恢复速度替换编辑速度以确保一致性；3) 在目标区域通过速度插值实现编辑强度的连续调节。
AI.result: 在Flux.1 Kontext和Qwen-Image-Edit上的大量实验表明，VeloEdit显著提升了视觉一致性和编辑连续性，且计算开销几乎可以忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: VeloEdit是一种无需训练的方法，通过直接操作速度场解决了现有指令图像编辑方法的一致性和可控性问题，实现了高度一致且连续可控的编辑效果。

title: The GELATO Dataset for Legislative NER
summary: This paper introduces GELATO (Government, Executive, Legislative, and Treaty Ontology), a dataset of U.S. House and Senate bills from the 118th Congress annotated using a novel two-level named entity recognition ontology designed for U.S. legislative texts. We fine-tune transformer-based models (BERT, RoBERTa) of different architectures and sizes on this dataset for first-level prediction. We then use LLMs with optimized prompts to complete the second level prediction. The strong performance of RoBERTa and relatively weak performance of BERT models, as well as the application of LLMs as second-level predictors, support future research in legislative NER or downstream tasks using these model combinations as extraction tools.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了GELATO数据集，这是一个针对美国第118届国会法案的双层命名实体识别本体标注数据集，使用BERT和RoBERTa进行第一层预测，LLMs进行第二层预测。
AI.motivation: 为美国立法文本创建一个专门的双层命名实体识别本体，以支持立法NER和相关下游任务的研究。
AI.method: 1. 创建GELATO数据集，包含美国第118届国会众议院和参议院法案的双层NER本体标注；2. 使用不同架构和规模的基于Transformer的模型（BERT、RoBERTa）进行第一层预测的微调；3. 使用LLMs配合优化提示完成第二层预测。
AI.result: RoBERTa模型表现出色，BERT模型表现相对较弱；LLMs作为第二层预测器的应用展示了这种模型组合作为提取工具的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为立法NER和下游任务提供了有效的模型组合提取工具，支持未来在立法文本分析领域的研究。

title: High-Fidelity Text-to-Image Generation from Pre-Trained Vision-Language Models via Distribution-Conditioned Diffusion Decoding
summary: Recent large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) have shown remarkable text-to-image generation capabilities, yet their visual fidelity remains constrained by the discrete image tokenization, which poses a major challenge. Although several studies have explored continuous representation modeling to enhance visual quality, adapting pre-trained VLM models to such representations requires large-scale data and training costs comparable to the original pre-training. To circumvent this limitation, we propose a diffusion-based decoding framework that enhances image fidelity by training only a diffusion decoder on the output image-token logits of pre-trained VLMs, thereby preserving the original model intact. At its core, Logit-to-Code Distributional Mapping converts the VLM's image-token logits into continuous, distribution-weighted code vectors with uncertainty features, providing an effective conditioning signal for diffusion decoding. A lightweight Logit Calibration aligns training-time proxy logits from the VQ-VAE encoder with VLM-generated logits, mitigating the train-inference gap. Conditioned on these representations, the Distribution-Conditioned Diffusion Decoder generates high-fidelity images. Achieved solely through short training on ImageNet-1K, our method consistently improves visual fidelity for both VQ-VAE reconstructions and text-to-image generations from VLM-predicted tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于扩散的解码框架，通过在预训练VLM的图像token logits上训练扩散解码器来提升图像保真度，无需修改原模型。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模视觉语言模型在文本到图像生成方面表现出色，但由于离散图像token化的限制，视觉保真度仍受约束。虽然已有研究探索连续表示建模来提升视觉质量，但适应预训练VLM到这种表示需要大规模数据和与原预训练相当的高昂训练成本。
AI.method: 提出扩散解码框架，核心包括：1) Logit-to-Code分布映射，将VLM的图像token logits转换为具有不确定性特征的连续分布加权代码向量；2) 轻量级Logit校准，对齐训练时代理logits与VLM生成logits，减少训练-推理差距；3) 分布条件扩散解码器，基于这些表示生成高保真图像。
AI.result: 仅通过在ImageNet-1K上进行短期训练，该方法在VQ-VAE重建和VLM预测token的文本到图像生成方面都一致地提升了视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过训练扩散解码器来增强预训练VLM的输出，无需修改原模型，以较低的训练成本有效提升了图像生成质量，为改进视觉语言模型的视觉保真度提供了实用解决方案。

title: MMOU: A Massive Multi-Task Omni Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Long and Complex Real-World Videos
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong performance in visual and audio understanding when evaluated in isolation. However, their ability to jointly reason over omni-modal (visual, audio, and textual) signals in long and complex videos remains largely unexplored. We introduce MMOU, a new benchmark designed to systematically evaluate multimodal understanding and reasoning under these challenging, real-world conditions. MMOU consists of 15,000 carefully curated questions paired with 9038 web-collected videos of varying length, spanning diverse domains and exhibiting rich, tightly coupled audio-visual content. The benchmark covers 13 fundamental skill categories, all of which require integrating evidence across modalities and time. All questions are manually annotated across multiple turns by professional annotators, ensuring high quality and reasoning fidelity. We evaluate 20+ state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary multimodal models on MMOU. The results expose substantial performance gaps: the best closed-source model achieves only 64.2% accuracy, while the strongest open-source model reaches just 46.8%. Our results highlight the challenges of long-form omni-modal understanding, revealing that current models frequently fail to apply even fundamental skills in long videos. Through detailed analysis, we further identify systematic failure modes and provide insights into where and why current models break.

AI.tldr: MMOU是一个新的多模态基准测试，包含15,000个问题和9,038个网络视频，用于评估模型在长视频中对视觉、音频和文本信号的联合推理能力。测试结果显示当前模型表现不佳，最佳闭源模型准确率仅64.2%，最强开源模型仅46.8%。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在单独评估视觉和音频理解时表现良好，但在长且复杂的视频中对全模态（视觉、音频和文本）信号进行联合推理的能力尚未得到充分探索。需要系统评估模型在真实世界复杂条件下的多模态理解和推理能力。
AI.method: 构建MMOU基准测试，包含15,000个精心策划的问题和9,038个网络收集的不同长度视频，涵盖多样化领域和丰富的视听内容。问题覆盖13个基本技能类别，所有问题都需要跨模态和时间整合证据。所有问题由专业标注人员进行多轮手动标注，确保高质量和推理保真度。
AI.result: 评估了20多个最先进的开源和专有多模态模型。结果显示显著的性能差距：最佳闭源模型准确率仅64.2%，最强开源模型仅46.8%。结果突显了长格式全模态理解的挑战，当前模型在长视频中经常无法应用基本技能。
AI.conclusion: MMOU基准测试揭示了当前多模态模型在长视频全模态理解方面的严重局限性。通过详细分析，识别了系统性失败模式，并提供了关于当前模型在何处以及为何失效的见解，为未来模型改进指明了方向。

title: InterventionLens: A Multi-Agent Framework for Detecting ASD Intervention Strategies in Parent-Child Shared Reading
summary: Home-based interventions like parent-child shared reading provide a cost-effective approach for supporting children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD). However, analyzing caregiver intervention strategies in naturalistic home interactions typically relies on expert annotation, which is costly, time-intensive, and difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose InterventionLens, an end-to-end multi-agent system for automatically detecting and temporally segmenting caregiver intervention strategies from shared reading videos. Without task-specific model training or fine-tuning, InterventionLens uses a collaborative multi-agent architecture to integrate multimodal interaction content and perform fine-grained strategy analysis. Experiments on the ASD-HI dataset show that InterventionLens achieves an overall F1 score of 79.44\%, outperforming the baseline by 19.72\%. These results suggest that InterventionLens is a promising system for analyzing caregiver intervention strategies in home-based ASD shared reading settings. Additional resources will be released on the project page.

AI.tldr: InterventionLens：一个用于自动检测和分割家庭共享阅读视频中照顾者干预策略的多智能体系统，无需特定任务训练即可分析自闭症儿童干预策略
AI.motivation: 家庭干预如亲子共享阅读是支持自闭症谱系障碍儿童的成本效益方法，但分析照顾者干预策略通常依赖专家标注，成本高、耗时长且难以扩展
AI.method: 提出InterventionLens，一个端到端多智能体系统，无需任务特定模型训练或微调，通过协作多智能体架构整合多模态交互内容，进行细粒度策略分析
AI.result: 在ASD-HI数据集上的实验显示，InterventionLens总体F1分数达到79.44%，比基线高出19.72%
AI.conclusion: InterventionLens是分析家庭自闭症共享阅读环境中照顾者干预策略的有前景系统，项目页面将发布额外资源

title: WebVR: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for WebPage Recreation from Videos via Human-Aligned Visual Rubrics
summary: Existing web-generation benchmarks rely on text prompts or static screenshots as input.
