However, videos naturally convey richer signals such as interaction flow, transition timing, and motion continuity, which are essential for faithful webpage recreation. Despite this potential, video-conditioned webpage generation remains largely unexplored, with no dedicated benchmark for this task. To fill this gap, we introduce WebVR, a benchmark that evaluates whether MLLMs can faithfully recreate webpages from demonstration videos. WebVR contains 175 webpages across diverse categories, all constructed through a controlled synthesis pipeline rather than web crawling, ensuring varied and realistic demonstrations without overlap with existing online pages. We also design a fine-grained, human-aligned visual rubric that evaluates the generated webpages across multiple dimensions. Experiments on 19 models reveal substantial gaps in recreating fine-grained style and motion quality, while the rubric-based automatic evaluation achieves 96% agreement with human preferences. We release the dataset, evaluation toolkit, and baseline results to support future research on video-to-webpage generation.

AI.tldr: WebVR：首个基于视频的网页生成基准，评估MLLM从演示视频重建网页的能力，包含175个合成网页和细粒度评估标准
AI.motivation: 现有网页生成基准仅使用文本提示或静态截图作为输入，而视频能传达更丰富的交互流程、过渡时序和运动连续性等信号，这些对忠实重建网页至关重要。视频条件下的网页生成研究尚未充分探索，缺乏专门基准。
AI.method: 提出WebVR基准，包含175个跨多样类别的网页，通过受控合成流水线而非网络爬取构建，确保多样且真实的演示，避免与现有在线页面重叠。设计了细粒度、与人类对齐的视觉评估标准，从多个维度评估生成的网页。
AI.result: 在19个模型上的实验显示，在重建细粒度样式和运动质量方面存在显著差距。基于评估标准的自动评估与人类偏好达到96%的一致性。
AI.conclusion: WebVR填补了视频到网页生成任务的基准空白，提供了数据集、评估工具包和基线结果，支持未来研究。视频输入能更好地捕捉网页交互动态，但现有模型在样式和运动质量方面仍有改进空间。

title: MeTok: An Efficient Meteorological Tokenization with Hyper-Aligned Group Learning for Precipitation Nowcasting
summary: Recently, Transformer-based architectures have advanced meteorological prediction. However, this position-centric tokenizer conflicts with the core principle of meteorological systems, where the weather phenomena undoubtedly involve synergistic interactions among multiple elements while positional information constitutes merely a component of the boundary conditions. This paper focuses primarily on the task of precipitation nowcasting and develops an efficient distribution-centric Meteorological Tokenization (MeTok) scheme, which spatially sequences to group similar meteorological features. Based on the rearrangement, realigned group learning enhances robustness across precipitation patterns, especially extreme ones. Specifically, we introduce the Hyper-Aligned Grouping Transformer (HyAGTransformer) with two key improvements: 1) The Grouping Attention (GA) mechanism uses MeTok to enable self-aligned learning of features from different precipitation patterns; 2) The Neighborhood Feed-Forward Network (N-FFN) integrates adjacent group features, aggregating contextual information to boost patch embedding discriminability. Experiments on the ERA5 dataset for 6-hour forecasts show our method improves the IoU metric by at least 8.2% in extreme precipitation prediction compared to other methods. Additionally, it gains performance with more training data and increased parameters, demonstrating scalability, stability, and superiority over traditional methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对降水临近预报任务，提出了一种基于分布中心的气象标记化方案和超对齐分组Transformer，显著提升了极端降水预测性能。
AI.motivation: 传统基于Transformer的架构使用位置中心标记化，这与气象系统的核心原理相冲突。气象现象涉及多要素协同作用，而位置信息仅是边界条件的一部分。因此需要开发更符合气象本质的标记化方案。
AI.method: 提出气象标记化方案，通过空间序列化将相似气象特征分组；开发超对齐分组Transformer，包含分组注意力机制和邻域前馈网络，实现不同降水模式的特征自对齐学习和上下文信息聚合。
AI.result: 在ERA5数据集上的6小时预报实验中，该方法在极端降水预测的IoU指标上比其他方法至少提升8.2%。随着训练数据和参数增加，性能持续提升，显示出良好的可扩展性和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的分布中心气象标记化方案和超对齐分组Transformer能够更好地捕捉气象系统的本质特征，在降水临近预报特别是极端降水预测方面表现出优越性能，具有实际应用价值。

title: Vavanagi: a Community-run Platform for Documentation of the Hula Language in Papua New Guinea
summary: We present Vavanagi, a community-run platform for Hula (Vula'a), an Austronesian language of Papua New Guinea with approximately 10,000 speakers. Vavanagi supports crowdsourced English-Hula text translation and voice recording, with elder-led review and community-governed data infrastructure. To date, 77 translators and 4 reviewers have produced over 12k parallel sentence pairs covering 9k unique Hula words. We also propose a multi-level framework for measuring community involvement, from consultation to fully community-initiated and governed projects. We position Vavanagi at Level 5: initiative, design, implementation, and data governance all sit within the Hula community, making it, to our knowledge, the first community-led language technology initiative for a language of this size. Vavanagi shows how language technology can bridge village-based and urban members, connect generations, and support cultural heritage on the community's own terms.

AI.tldr: Vavanagi是一个由社区主导的Hula语（巴布亚新几内亚的一种南岛语系语言）平台，支持众包英-Hula文本翻译和语音录制，采用长者审核和社区治理的数据基础设施。
AI.motivation: 为约1万使用者的Hula语创建社区主导的语言技术平台，连接乡村与城市成员、连接不同世代，并以社区自身的方式支持文化遗产保护。
AI.method: 建立社区运营的平台，支持众包英-Hula文本翻译和语音录制，采用长者主导的审核机制和社区治理的数据基础设施。提出衡量社区参与度的多级框架，将Vavanagi定位为最高级别（第5级）——项目的倡议、设计、实施和数据治理完全由Hula社区主导。
AI.result: 77名翻译员和4名审核员已产出超过12,000个平行句对，涵盖9,000个独特的Hula词汇。这是已知首个针对这种规模语言的社区主导语言技术倡议。
AI.conclusion: Vavanagi展示了语言技术如何以社区自身的方式连接乡村与城市成员、连接不同世代，并支持文化遗产保护，为其他语言社区提供了社区主导语言技术发展的范例。

title: Multimodal Emotion Regression with Multi-Objective Optimization and VAD-Aware Audio Modeling for the 10th ABAW EMI Track
summary: We participated in the 10th ABAW Challenge, focusing on the Emotional Mimicry Intensity (EMI) Estimation track on the Hume-Vidmimic2 dataset. This task aims to predict six continuous emotion dimensions: Admiration, Amusement, Determination, Empathic Pain, Excitement, and Joy. Through systematic multimodal exploration of pretrained high-level features, we found that, under our pretrained feature setting, direct feature concatenation outperformed the more complex fusion strategies we tested. This empirical finding motivated us to design a systematic approach built upon three core principles: (i) preserving modality-specific attributes through feature-level concatenation; (ii) improving training stability and metric alignment via multi-objective optimization; and (iii) enriching acoustic representations with a VAD-inspired latent prior. Our final framework integrates concatenation-based multimodal fusion, a shared six-dimensional regression head, multi-objective optimization with MSE, Pearson-correlation, and auxiliary branch supervision, EMA for parameter stabilization, and a VAD-inspired latent prior for the acoustic branch. On the official validation set, the proposed scheme achieved our best mean Pearson Correlation Coefficient of 0.478567.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于情感模仿强度估计的多模态融合方法，通过特征级拼接、多目标优化和VAD启发的潜在先验，在Hume-Vidmimic2数据集上取得了0.478567的平均皮尔逊相关系数。
AI.motivation: 在ABAW挑战赛的情感模仿强度估计任务中，作者发现预训练特征直接拼接比复杂融合策略效果更好，这启发了他们设计基于三个核心原则的系统性方法。
AI.method: 提出三核心原则框架：1) 通过特征级拼接保留模态特定属性；2) 使用多目标优化改善训练稳定性和度量对齐；3) 用VAD启发的潜在先验丰富声学表示。具体包括拼接式多模态融合、共享六维回归头、MSE+皮尔逊相关系数+辅助分支监督的多目标优化、EMA参数稳定和声学分支的VAD潜在先验。
AI.result: 在官方验证集上，提出的方案获得了最佳平均皮尔逊相关系数0.478567。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在预训练特征设置下，简单的特征拼接结合多目标优化和声学增强策略，能够有效提升情感模仿强度估计的性能，为多模态情感分析提供了实用的解决方案。

authors: Bas H. M. van der Velden
title: Colony Grounded SAM2: Zero-shot detection and segmentation of bacterial colonies using foundation models
summary: The detection and classification of bacterial colonies in images of agar-plates is important in microbiology, but is hindered by the lack of labeled datasets. Therefore, we propose Colony Grounded SAM2, a zero-shot inference pipeline to detect and segment bacterial colonies in multiple settings without any further training. By utilizing the pre-trained foundation models Grounding DINO and Segment Anything Model 2, fine-tuned to the microbiological domain, we developed a model that is robust to data changes. Results showed a mean Average Precision of 93.1\% and a $Dice@detection$ score of 0.85, showing excellent detection and segmentation capabilities on out-of-distribution datasets. The entire pipeline with model weights are shared open access to aid with annotation- and classification purposes in microbiology.

AI.tldr: 提出Colony Grounded SAM2，一个无需训练的零样本推理管道，用于检测和分割琼脂平板图像中的细菌菌落
AI.motivation: 微生物学中细菌菌落的检测和分类很重要，但缺乏标注数据集限制了相关研究
AI.method: 利用预训练的基础模型Grounding DINO和Segment Anything Model 2，经过微生物学领域微调，构建零样本推理管道
AI.result: 在分布外数据集上获得93.1%的平均精度和0.85的Dice@detection分数，表现出优秀的检测和分割能力
AI.conclusion: 开发了无需额外训练的稳健模型，整个管道和模型权重开源共享，有助于微生物学的标注和分类任务

title: Rethinking Evaluation in Retrieval-Augmented Personalized Dialogue: A Cognitive and Linguistic Perspective
summary: In cognitive science and linguistic theory, dialogue is not seen as a chain of independent utterances but rather as a joint activity sustained by coherence, consistency, and shared understanding. However, many systems for open-domain and personalized dialogue use surface-level similarity metrics (e.g., BLEU, ROUGE, F1) as one of their main reporting measures, which fail to capture these deeper aspects of conversational quality. We re-examine a notable retrieval-augmented framework for personalized dialogue, LAPDOG, as a case study for evaluation methodology. Using both human and LLM-based judges, we identify limitations in current evaluation practices, including corrupted dialogue histories, contradictions between retrieved stories and persona, and incoherent response generation. Our results show that human and LLM judgments align closely but diverge from lexical similarity metrics, underscoring the need for cognitively grounded evaluation methods. Broadly, this work charts a path toward more reliable assessment frameworks for retrieval-augmented dialogue systems that better reflect the principles of natural human communication.

AI.tldr: 该研究重新审视了检索增强对话系统LAPDOG的评估方法，发现基于表面相似度的指标（如BLEU、ROUGE）无法捕捉对话的深层质量，提出需要更符合认知科学原理的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 当前开放域和个性化对话系统主要使用表面相似度指标（BLEU、ROUGE、F1）作为主要评估标准，但这些指标无法捕捉对话的连贯性、一致性和共享理解等深层质量特征，与认知科学和语言学理论对对话的理解存在差距。
AI.method: 以检索增强个性化对话框架LAPDOG为案例研究，结合人类评估者和基于LLM的评估者，识别当前评估实践中的局限性，包括损坏的对话历史、检索故事与人物设定之间的矛盾、不连贯的回复生成等问题。
AI.result: 研究发现人类评估和LLM评估结果高度一致，但与词汇相似度指标存在显著差异，揭示了当前评估方法无法有效衡量对话的深层质量。同时识别了检索增强对话系统中存在的具体问题。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为检索增强对话系统指出了更可靠的评估框架方向，强调需要基于认知科学原理的评估方法，以更好地反映自然人类交流的本质特征。

title: Artificial intelligence-driven improvement of hospital logistics management resilience: a practical exploration based on H Hospital
summary: Hospital logistics management faces growing pressure from internal operations and external emergencies, with artificial intelligence (AI) holding untapped potential to boost its resilience. This study explores AI's role in enhancing logistics resilience via a mixed-methods case study of H Hospital, combining 12 key informant interviews and a full survey of 151 logistics staff, with the PDCA cycle as the analytical framework. Thematic and quantitative analyses (hierarchical regression, structural equation modeling) were adopted for data analysis. Results showed 94.7% staff perceived AI application, with the strongest improvements in equipment maintenance (41.1%) and resource allocation (33.1%), but limited effects in emergency response (18.54%) and risk management (15.23%). AI integration positively correlated with logistics resilience (\b{eta}=0.642, p<0.001), with management system adaptability as a positive moderator (\b{eta}=0.208, p<0.01). The PDCA cycle fully mediated the AI-resilience relationship. We conclude AI effectively enhances logistics resilience, dependent on adaptive management systems and structured continuous improvement mechanisms. Targeted strategies are proposed to form an AI-driven closed-loop resilience mechanism, offering empirical guidance for AI-hospital logistics integration and resilient health system construction.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过混合方法案例研究探讨AI如何提升医院物流韧性，发现AI应用与物流韧性正相关，PDCA循环完全中介这一关系，管理系统适应性是关键调节因素。
AI.motivation: 医院物流管理面临内部运营和外部紧急情况的双重压力，人工智能在提升物流韧性方面具有未开发的潜力，需要实证研究来探索AI如何有效整合到医院物流系统中。
AI.method: 采用混合方法案例研究，以H医院为研究对象，结合12个关键信息提供者访谈和151名物流员工的全面调查，以PDCA循环为分析框架，使用主题分析和定量分析（层次回归、结构方程模型）进行数据分析。
AI.result: 94.7%的员工感知到AI应用，在设备维护（41.1%）和资源分配（33.1%）方面改善最显著，但在应急响应（18.54%）和风险管理（15.23%）方面效果有限。AI整合与物流韧性正相关（β=0.642, p<0.001），管理系统适应性作为正向调节因素（β=0.208, p<0.01），PDCA循环完全中介AI与韧性之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: AI能有效提升医院物流韧性，但效果依赖于适应性管理系统和结构化持续改进机制。研究提出了针对性策略，形成AI驱动的闭环韧性机制，为AI-医院物流整合和韧性卫生系统建设提供实证指导。

title: Language-Guided Token Compression with Reinforcement Learning in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) incur substantial inference costs due to the processing of a vast number of visual tokens. Existing methods typically struggle to model progressive visual token reduction as a multi-step decision process with sequential dependencies and often rely on hand-engineered scoring rules that lack adaptive optimization for complex reasoning trajectories. To overcome these limitations, we propose TPRL, a reinforcement learning framework that learns adaptive pruning trajectories through language-guided sequential optimization tied directly to end-task performance. We formulate visual token pruning as a sequential decision process with explicit state transitions and employ a self-supervised autoencoder to compress visual tokens into a compact state representation for efficient policy learning. The pruning policy is initialized through learning from demonstrations and subsequently fine-tuned using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) to jointly optimize task accuracy and computational efficiency. Our experimental results demonstrate that TPRL removes up to 66.7\% of visual tokens and achieves up to a 54.2\% reduction in FLOPs during inference while maintaining a near-lossless average accuracy drop of only 0.7\%. Code is released at \href{https://github.com/MagicVicCoder/TPRL}{\textcolor{mypink}{https://github.com/MagicVicCoder/TPRL}}.

AI.tldr: TPRL是一个基于强化学习的视觉token剪枝框架，通过语言引导的顺序优化学习自适应剪枝轨迹，显著减少大视觉语言模型的计算开销。
AI.motivation: 大视觉语言模型处理大量视觉token导致高昂推理成本，现有方法难以将渐进式视觉token剪枝建模为具有顺序依赖的多步决策过程，且通常依赖手工设计的评分规则，缺乏对复杂推理轨迹的自适应优化。
AI.method: 将视觉token剪枝建模为具有显式状态转移的顺序决策过程，使用自监督自动编码器压缩视觉token为紧凑状态表示，通过演示学习初始化剪枝策略，然后使用近端策略优化进行微调，联合优化任务准确性和计算效率。
AI.result: TPRL能够移除高达66.7%的视觉token，在推理过程中实现高达54.2%的FLOPs减少，同时平均准确率下降仅为0.7%，接近无损。
AI.conclusion: TPRL通过强化学习框架有效学习自适应剪枝轨迹，显著降低大视觉语言模型的计算成本，同时保持任务性能，为高效视觉语言推理提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: QiMeng-CodeV-SVA: Training Specialized LLMs for Hardware Assertion Generation via RTL-Grounded Bidirectional Data Synthesis
comment: Accepted by DAC 2026. Code: https://github.com/wyt2000/CodeV-SVA; Model: https://huggingface.co/wyt2000/CodeV-SVA-14B
summary: SystemVerilog Assertions (SVAs) are crucial for hardware verification. Recent studies leverage general-purpose LLMs to translate natural language properties to SVAs (NL2SVA), but they perform poorly due to limited data. We propose a data synthesis framework to tackle two challenges: the scarcity of high-quality real-world SVA corpora and the lack of reliable methods to determine NL-SVA semantic equivalence. For the former, large-scale open-source RTLs are used to guide LLMs to generate real-world SVAs; for the latter, bidirectional translation serves as a data selection method. With the synthesized data, we train CodeV-SVA, a series of SVA generation models. Notably, CodeV-SVA-14B achieves 75.8% on NL2SVA-Human and 84.0% on NL2SVA-Machine in Func.@1, matching or exceeding advanced LLMs like GPT-5 and DeepSeek-R1.

AI.tldr: 提出数据合成框架解决自然语言到SystemVerilog断言翻译的两个挑战：高质量SVA语料稀缺和NL-SVA语义等价性验证困难，训练出的CodeV-SVA模型在NL2SVA任务上达到或超越先进LLMs性能
AI.motivation: 现有基于通用LLM的自然语言到SystemVerilog断言翻译方法因数据有限而表现不佳，需要解决高质量SVA语料稀缺和语义等价性验证两大挑战
AI.method: 提出数据合成框架：1) 利用大规模开源RTL指导LLM生成真实世界SVA；2) 使用双向翻译作为数据选择方法验证语义等价性；基于合成数据训练CodeV-SVA系列模型
AI.result: CodeV-SVA-14B在NL2SVA-Human上达到75.8%的Func.@1，在NL2SVA-Machine上达到84.0%，匹配或超越了GPT-5和DeepSeek-R1等先进LLMs
AI.conclusion: 提出的数据合成框架有效解决了SVA数据稀缺问题，训练的CodeV-SVA模型在自然语言到SystemVerilog断言翻译任务上表现出色，为硬件验证提供了有力工具

title: PA-Net: Precipitation-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Tail Rainfall Nowcasting
summary: Precipitation nowcasting is vital for flood warning, agricultural management, and emergency response, yet two bottlenecks persist: the prohibitive cost of modeling million-scale spatiotemporal tokens from multi-variate atmospheric fields, and the extreme long-tailed rainfall distribution where heavy-to-torrential events -- those of greatest societal impact -- constitute fewer than 0.1% of all samples. We propose the Precipitation-Adaptive Network (PA-Net), a Transformer framework whose computational budget is explicitly governed by rainfall intensity. Its core component, Precipitation-Adaptive MoE (PA-MoE), dynamically scales the number of activated experts per token according to local precipitation magnitude, channeling richer representational capacity toward the rare yet critical heavy-rainfall tail. A Dual-Axis Compressed Latent Attention mechanism factorizes spatiotemporal attention with convolutional reduction to manage massive context lengths, while an intensity-aware training protocol progressively amplifies learning signals from extreme-rainfall samples. Experiment on ERA5 demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines, with particularly significant gains in heavy-rain and rainstorm regimes.

AI.tldr: PA-Net：基于降雨强度的自适应Transformer框架，通过动态激活专家网络和双轴压缩注意力机制，高效处理极端降雨事件预测
AI.motivation: 降水临近预报面临两大瓶颈：1) 多变量大气场百万级时空token建模成本过高；2) 降雨分布极端长尾，对社会影响最大的强降雨事件仅占样本的0.1%以下
AI.method: 提出降水自适应网络(PA-Net)，核心是降水自适应MoE(PA-MoE)，根据局部降雨强度动态调整每个token激活的专家数量；采用双轴压缩潜在注意力机制分解时空注意力；使用强度感知训练协议增强极端降雨样本的学习信号
AI.result: 在ERA5数据集上实验表明，相比现有最先进方法有持续改进，在强降雨和暴雨区域获得特别显著的性能提升
AI.conclusion: PA-Net通过降雨强度自适应的计算资源分配，有效解决了降水临近预报中的计算效率和极端事件预测精度问题，为灾害性天气预警提供了更有效的解决方案

title: COT-FM: Cluster-wise Optimal Transport Flow Matching
summary: We introduce COT-FM, a general framework that reshapes the probability path in Flow Matching (FM) to achieve faster and more reliable generation. FM models often produce curved trajectories due to random or batchwise couplings, which increase discretization error and reduce sample quality. COT-FM fixes this by clustering target samples and assigning each cluster a dedicated source distribution obtained by reversing pretrained FM models. This divide-and-conquer strategy yields more accurate local transport and significantly straighter vector fields, all without changing the model architecture. As a plug-and-play approach, COT-FM consistently accelerates sampling and improves generation quality across 2D datasets, image generation benchmarks, and robotic manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: COT-FM通过重塑Flow Matching的概率路径，使用聚类和分治策略实现更快更可靠的生成
AI.motivation: Flow Matching模型由于随机或批量耦合产生弯曲轨迹，增加了离散化误差并降低了样本质量，需要改进
AI.method: 通过聚类目标样本并为每个聚类分配专用源分布（通过反向预训练FM模型获得），采用分治策略实现更准确的局部传输和更直的向量场
AI.result: COT-FM在2D数据集、图像生成基准和机器人操作任务中一致加速采样并提高生成质量
AI.conclusion: COT-FM作为即插即用框架，在不改变模型架构的情况下，通过重塑概率路径显著改善了Flow Matching的生成效率和可靠性

title: Mitigating Overthinking in Large Reasoning Language Models via Reasoning Path Deviation Monitoring
summary: Large Reasoning Language Models (LRLMs) demonstrate impressive capabilities on complex tasks by utilizing long Chain-of-Thought reasoning. However, they are prone to overthinking, which generates redundant reasoning steps that degrade both performance and efficiency. Recently, early-exit strategies are proposed to mitigate overthinking by dynamically and adaptively terminating redundant reasoning. However, current early-exit methods either introduce extra training overhead by relying on proxy models or limit inference throughput due to the frequent content switching between reasoning and generating probing answers. Moreover, most early-exit methods harm LRLMs performance due to over-truncation. Our insight stems from an observation: overthinking often causes LRLMs to deviate from the correct reasoning path, which is frequently accompanied by high-entropy transition tokens. Given this, we propose an early-exit method deeply coupled with the native reasoning process, which leverages the path deviation index as a dedicated monitoring metric for the frequent occurrence of high-entropy transition tokens to dynamically detect and terminate overthinking trajectories. We conduct experiments across multiple benchmarks using LRLMs of different types and scales, and the results indicate that our method delivers the largest performance improvement over vanilla CoT compared to existing early-exit methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种与推理过程深度耦合的早退方法，通过监测高熵转移令牌来动态检测和终止过度思考轨迹，提高大型推理语言模型的性能和效率。
AI.motivation: 大型推理语言模型在复杂任务中表现出色，但容易过度思考，产生冗余推理步骤，降低性能和效率。现有早退方法要么引入额外训练开销，要么限制推理吞吐量，且大多因过度截断而损害模型性能。
AI.method: 提出与原生推理过程深度耦合的早退方法，利用路径偏差指数作为监测指标，专门监控高熵转移令牌的频繁出现，动态检测和终止过度思考轨迹。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中使用不同类型和规模的大型推理语言模型进行实验，结果表明该方法相比现有早退方法，在原始CoT基础上实现了最大的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过监测高熵转移令牌来检测推理路径偏差的早退方法，能有效缓解大型推理语言模型的过度思考问题，在保持性能的同时提高推理效率。

title: Early Rug Pull Warning for BSC Meme Tokens via Multi-Granularity Wash-Trading Pattern Profiling
summary: The high-frequency issuance and short-cycle speculation of meme tokens in decentralized finance (DeFi) have significantly amplified rug-pull risk. Existing approaches still struggle to provide stable early warning under scarce anomalies, incomplete labels, and limited interpretability. To address this issue, an end-to-end warning framework is proposed for BSC meme tokens, consisting of four stages: dataset construction and labeling, wash-trading pattern feature modeling, risk prediction, and error analysis. Methodologically, 12 token-level behavioral features are constructed based on three wash-trading patterns (Self, Matched, and Circular), unifying transaction-, address-, and flow-level signals into risk vectors. Supervised models are then employed to output warning scores and alert decisions. Under the current setting (7 tokens, 33,242 records), Random Forest outperforms Logistic Regression on core metrics, achieving AUC=0.9098, PR-AUC=0.9185, and F1=0.7429. Ablation results show that trade-level features are the primary performance driver (Delta PR-AUC=-0.1843 when removed), while address-level features provide stable complementary gain (Delta PR-AUC=-0.0573). The model also demonstrates actionable early-warning potential for a subset of samples, with a mean Lead Time (v1) of 3.8133 hours. The error profile (FP=1, FN=8) indicates that the current system is better positioned as a high-precision screener rather than a high-recall automatic alarm engine. The main contributions are threefold: an executable and reproducible rug-pull warning pipeline, empirical validation of multi-granularity wash-trading features under weak supervision, and deployment-oriented evidence through lead-time and error-bound analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出一个针对BSC模因币的端到端跑路预警框架，通过洗盘交易模式特征建模实现风险预测，在有限数据下达到AUC=0.9098的预警性能。
AI.motivation: DeFi中模因币高频发行和短期投机显著增加了跑路风险，现有方法在异常样本稀缺、标签不完整和可解释性有限的情况下难以提供稳定预警。
AI.method: 构建四阶段预警框架：数据集构建与标注、洗盘交易模式特征建模、风险预测和误差分析。基于三种洗盘交易模式（自交易、匹配交易、循环交易）构建12个代币级行为特征，将交易、地址和资金流信号统一为风险向量，使用监督模型输出预警分数和警报决策。
AI.result: 在当前设置（7个代币，33,242条记录）下，随机森林在核心指标上优于逻辑回归，达到AUC=0.9098、PR-AUC=0.9185和F1=0.7429。消融实验显示交易级特征是主要性能驱动因素，地址级特征提供稳定补充增益。模型对部分样本显示出可操作的早期预警潜力，平均提前时间（v1）为3.8133小时。
AI.conclusion: 当前系统更适合作为高精度筛选器而非高召回自动警报引擎。主要贡献包括：可执行且可复现的跑路预警流程、弱监督下多粒度洗盘交易特征的实证验证，以及通过提前时间和误差边界分析提供的部署导向证据。

title: SERUM: Simple, Efficient, Robust, and Unifying Marking for Diffusion-based Image Generation
summary: We propose SERUM: an intriguingly simple yet highly effective method for marking images generated by diffusion models (DMs). We only add a unique watermark noise to the initial diffusion generation noise and train a lightweight detector to identify watermarked images, simplifying and unifying the strengths of prior approaches. SERUM provides robustness against any image augmentations or watermark removal attacks and is extremely efficient, all while maintaining negligible impact on image quality. In contrast to prior approaches, which are often only resilient to limited perturbations and incur significant training, injection, and detection costs, our SERUM achieves remarkable performance, with the highest true positive rate (TPR) at a 1% false positive rate (FPR) in most scenarios, along with fast injection and detection and low detector training overhead. Its decoupled architecture also seamlessly supports multiple users by embedding individualized watermarks with little interference between the marks. Overall, our method provides a practical solution to mark outputs from DMs and to reliably distinguish generated from natural images.

AI.tldr: SERUM是一种简单有效的扩散模型图像水印方法，通过在初始生成噪声中添加独特水印噪声并训练轻量检测器来识别水印图像，具有鲁棒性、高效性且对图像质量影响可忽略。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型水印方法通常只能抵抗有限扰动，且训练、注入和检测成本较高，需要一种更实用、鲁棒且高效的解决方案来标记生成图像并可靠区分生成与自然图像。
AI.method: SERUM在扩散模型初始生成噪声中添加独特水印噪声，然后训练一个轻量级检测器来识别水印图像。该方法采用解耦架构，支持多个用户嵌入个性化水印且互不干扰。
AI.result: SERUM在大多数场景下实现了最高的真阳性率（TPR）和1%假阳性率（FPR），对任何图像增强或水印去除攻击都具有鲁棒性，同时保持快速注入和检测速度以及低训练开销。
AI.conclusion: SERUM为扩散模型输出提供了一种实用的水印解决方案，能够可靠地区分生成图像与自然图像，相比现有方法在鲁棒性、效率和实用性方面都有显著提升。

title: Automatic Inter-document Multi-hop Scientific QA Generation
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to the 2026 International Conference on Language Resources and Evaluation (LREC 2026)
summary: Existing automatic scientific question generation studies mainly focus on single-document factoid QA, overlooking the inter-document reasoning crucial for scientific understanding. We present AIM-SciQA, an automated framework for generating multi-document, multi-hop scientific QA datasets. AIM-SciQA extracts single-hop QAs using large language models (LLMs) with machine reading comprehension and constructs cross-document relations based on embedding-based semantic alignment while selectively leveraging citation information. Applied to 8,211 PubMed Central papers, it produced 411,409 single-hop and 13,672 multi-hop QAs, forming the IM-SciQA dataset. Human and automatic validation confirmed high factual consistency, and experimental results demonstrate that IM-SciQA effectively differentiates reasoning capabilities across retrieval and QA stages, providing a realistic and interpretable benchmark for retrieval-augmented scientific reasoning. We further extend this framework to construct CIM-SciQA, a citation-guided variant achieving comparable performance to the Oracle setting, reinforcing the dataset's validity and generality.

AI.tldr: AIM-SciQA是一个自动生成多文档、多跳科学问答数据集的框架，通过LLMs提取单跳QA，基于语义对齐构建跨文档关系，并选择性利用引文信息，创建了包含41万+单跳和1.3万+多跳QA的IM-SciQA数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有自动科学问题生成研究主要关注单文档事实性QA，忽视了科学理解中至关重要的跨文档推理。需要创建能够评估多文档、多跳推理能力的数据集来促进科学推理研究。
AI.method: 使用大型语言模型通过机器阅读理解提取单跳QA；基于嵌入的语义对齐构建跨文档关系；选择性利用引文信息；应用于8,211篇PubMed Central论文生成数据集。
AI.result: 生成了411,409个单跳QA和13,672个多跳QA，形成IM-SciQA数据集。人工和自动验证显示高事实一致性，实验证明数据集能有效区分检索和QA阶段的推理能力。还构建了CIM-SciQA变体，性能接近Oracle设置。
AI.conclusion: AIM-SciQA框架成功创建了真实且可解释的科学推理基准，填补了多文档推理评估的空白，为检索增强的科学推理研究提供了有价值的资源。

title: Intelligent Materials Modelling: Large Language Models Versus Partial Least Squares Regression for Predicting Polysulfone Membrane Mechanical Performance
summary: Predicting the mechanical properties of polysulfone (PSF) membranes from structural descriptors remains challenging due to extreme data scarcity typical of experimental studies. To investigate this issue, this study benchmarked knowledge-driven inference using four large language models (LLMs) (DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1, ChatGPT-4o, and GPT-5) against partial least squares (PLS) regression for predicting Young's modulus (E), tensile strength (TS), and elongation at break (EL) based on pore diameter (PD), contact angle (CA), thickness (T), and porosity (P) measurements. These knowledge-driven approaches demonstrated property-specific advantages over the chemometric baseline. For EL, LLMs achieved statistically significant improvements, with DeepSeek-R1 and GPT-5 delivering 40.5% and 40.3% of Root Mean Square Error reductions, respectively, reducing mean absolute errors from $11.63\pm5.34$% to $5.18\pm0.17$%. Run-to-run variability was markedly compressed for LLMs ($\leq$3%) compared to PLS (up to 47%). E and TS predictions showed statistical parity between approaches ($q\geq0.05$), indicating sufficient performance of linear methods for properties with strong structure-property correlations. Error topology analysis revealed systematic regression-to-the-mean behavior dominated by data-regime effects rather than model-family limitations. These findings establish that LLMs excel for non-linear, constraint-sensitive properties under bootstrap instability, while PLS remains competitive for linear relationships requiring interpretable latent-variable decompositions. The demonstrated complementarity suggests hybrid architectures leveraging LLM-encoded knowledge within interpretable frameworks may optimise small-data materials discovery.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了四种大语言模型（LLMs）与偏最小二乘回归（PLS）在预测聚砜膜机械性能方面的表现，发现LLMs在非线性、约束敏感特性预测上表现优异，而PLS在线性关系预测中保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 由于实验研究中典型的数据极度稀缺问题，从结构描述符预测聚砜膜机械性能仍然具有挑战性。本研究旨在评估知识驱动的大语言模型与传统化学计量学方法在解决这一小数据问题上的表现差异。
AI.method: 使用四种大语言模型（DeepSeek-V3、DeepSeek-R1、ChatGPT-4o和GPT-5）进行知识驱动推断，并与偏最小二乘回归（PLS）进行基准比较，基于孔径、接触角、厚度和孔隙率测量值预测杨氏模量、拉伸强度和断裂伸长率。
AI.result: 对于断裂伸长率，LLMs实现了统计显著改进，DeepSeek-R1和GPT-5分别实现了40.5%和40.3%的均方根误差降低。LLMs的运行间变异性（≤3%）显著低于PLS（高达47%）。杨氏模量和拉伸强度预测显示两种方法统计相当，表明线性方法在具有强结构-性能相关性的特性上表现足够。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在非线性、约束敏感特性且存在自举不稳定性时表现优异，而PLS在需要可解释潜在变量分解的线性关系中保持竞争力。这种互补性表明，将LLM编码的知识整合到可解释框架中的混合架构可能优化小数据材料发现。

title: TennisExpert: Towards Expert-Level Analytical Sports Video Understanding
summary: Tennis is one of the most widely followed sports, generating extensive broadcast footage with strong potential for professional analysis, automated coaching, and real-time commentary. However, automatic tennis understanding remains underexplored due to two key challenges: (1) the lack of large-scale benchmarks with fine-grained annotations and expert-level commentary, and (2) the difficulty of building accurate yet efficient multimodal systems suitable for real-time deployment. To address these challenges, we introduce TennisVL, a large-scale tennis benchmark comprising over 200 professional matches (471.9 hours) and 40,000+ rally-level clips. Unlike existing commentary datasets that focus on descriptive play-by-play narration, TennisVL emphasizes expert analytical commentary capturing tactical reasoning, player decisions, and match momentum. Furthermore, we propose TennisExpert, a multimodal tennis understanding framework that integrates a video semantic parser with a memory-augmented model built on Qwen3-VL-8B. The parser extracts key match elements (e.g., scores, shot sequences, ball bounces, and player locations), while hierarchical memory modules capture both short- and long-term temporal context. Experiments show that TennisExpert consistently outperforms strong proprietary baselines, including GPT-5, Gemini, and Claude, and demonstrates improved ability to capture tactical context and match dynamics.

AI.tldr: 研究人员提出了TennisVL数据集和TennisExpert框架，用于解决网球视频理解中的标注不足和实时部署难题，在战术分析和比赛动态理解方面超越了现有大型模型。
AI.motivation: 网球作为广受欢迎的运动，其广播视频具有专业分析、自动化教练和实时评论的巨大潜力，但自动网球理解面临两大挑战：缺乏大规模细粒度标注和专家级评论的数据集，以及难以构建准确高效的实时多模态系统。
AI.method: 提出了TennisVL数据集（包含200多场职业比赛、471.9小时视频、4万+回合级片段）和TennisExpert多模态理解框架。该框架整合了视频语义解析器（提取得分、击球序列、球弹跳、球员位置等关键元素）和基于Qwen3-VL-8B构建的记忆增强模型，通过分层记忆模块捕捉短期和长期时间上下文。
AI.result: TennisExpert在实验中持续超越了包括GPT-5、Gemini和Claude在内的强大专有基线模型，在捕捉战术背景和比赛动态方面表现出改进的能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入大规模标注数据集和专门设计的记忆增强多模态框架，显著推进了网球视频理解领域的发展，为专业分析、自动化教练和实时评论应用提供了有效解决方案。

title: The Phenomenology of Hallucinations
summary: We show that language models hallucinate not because they fail to detect uncertainty, but because of a failure to integrate it into output generation. Across architectures, uncertain inputs are reliably identified, occupying high-dimensional regions with 2-3$\times$ the intrinsic dimensionality of factual inputs. However, this internal signal is weakly coupled to the output layer: uncertainty migrates into low-sensitivity subspaces, becoming geometrically amplified yet functionally silent. Topological analysis shows that uncertainty representations fragment rather than converging to a unified abstention state, while gradient and Fisher probes reveal collapsing sensitivity along the uncertainty direction. Because cross-entropy training provides no attractor for abstention and uniformly rewards confident prediction, associative mechanisms amplify these fractured activations until residual coupling forces a committed output despite internal detection. Causal interventions confirm this account by restoring refusal when uncertainty is directly connected to logits.

AI.tldr: 语言模型产生幻觉不是因为无法检测不确定性，而是因为未能将不确定性整合到输出生成中。模型能可靠识别不确定输入，但这些内部信号与输出层耦合很弱，导致不确定性被放大但功能上沉默。
AI.motivation: 研究语言模型产生幻觉的根本原因，挑战传统观点认为模型无法检测不确定性，而是探索不确定性检测与输出生成之间的脱节问题。
AI.method: 通过分析不同架构的语言模型，使用高维几何分析、拓扑分析、梯度和Fisher探针等方法，研究不确定性在模型内部的表现形式及其与输出层的耦合关系，并进行因果干预实验。
AI.result: 不确定输入占据高维区域，其内在维度是事实输入的2-3倍；不确定性表示碎片化而非收敛到统一的拒绝状态；不确定性迁移到低敏感性子空间，梯度敏感性沿不确定性方向崩溃；交叉熵训练缺乏拒绝的吸引子，导致关联机制放大碎片化激活。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型幻觉源于不确定性检测与输出生成的脱节，而非检测失败。当不确定性直接连接到logits时，可以恢复拒绝行为，这表明需要新的训练目标来整合不确定性信号。

title: Qianfan-OCR: A Unified End-to-End Model for Document Intelligence
summary: We present Qianfan-OCR, a 4B-parameter end-to-end vision-language model that unifies document parsing, layout analysis, and document understanding within a single architecture. It performs direct image-to-Markdown conversion and supports diverse prompt-driven tasks including table extraction, chart understanding, document QA, and key information extraction. To address the loss of explicit layout analysis in end-to-end OCR, we propose Layout-as-Thought, an optional thinking phase triggered by special think tokens that generates structured layout representations -- bounding boxes, element types, and reading order -- before producing final outputs, recovering layout grounding capabilities while improving accuracy on complex layouts. Qianfan-OCR ranks first among end-to-end models on OmniDocBench v1.5 (93.12) and OlmOCR Bench (79.8), achieves competitive results on OCRBench, CCOCR, DocVQA, and ChartQA against general VLMs of comparable scale, and attains the highest average score on public key information extraction benchmarks, surpassing Gemini-3.1-Pro, Seed-2.0, and Qwen3-VL-235B. The model is publicly accessible via the Baidu AI Cloud Qianfan platform.

AI.tldr: Qianfan-OCR是一个40亿参数端到端视觉语言模型，统一文档解析、布局分析和文档理解，支持图像直接转Markdown和多种提示驱动任务，通过Layout-as-Thought机制恢复布局分析能力。
AI.motivation: 解决端到端OCR模型中缺乏显式布局分析的问题，统一文档处理的多项任务，提高复杂布局下的准确性和布局理解能力。
AI.method: 提出Layout-as-Thought机制，通过特殊思考标记触发思考阶段，生成结构化布局表示（边界框、元素类型、阅读顺序），然后产生最终输出，在保持端到端优势的同时恢复布局基础能力。
AI.result: 在OmniDocBench v1.5（93.12）和OlmOCR Bench（79.8）上排名第一，在OCRBench、CCOCR、DocVQA和ChartQA上与同规模通用VLM竞争，在关键信息提取基准上平均得分最高，超越Gemini-3.1-Pro、Seed-2.0和Qwen3-VL-235B。
AI.conclusion: Qianfan-OCR通过创新的Layout-as-Thought机制成功解决了端到端OCR的布局分析缺失问题，在多个基准测试中表现优异，实现了文档处理任务的统一和性能提升。

title: SemantiCache: Efficient KV Cache Compression via Semantic Chunking and Clustered Merging
summary: Existing KV cache compression methods generally operate on discrete tokens or non-semantic chunks. However, such approaches often lead to semantic fragmentation, where linguistically coherent units are disrupted, causing irreversible information loss and degradation in model performance. To address this, we introduce SemantiCache, a novel compression framework that preserves semantic integrity by aligning the compression process with the semantic hierarchical nature of language. Specifically, we first partition the cache into semantically coherent chunks by delimiters, which are natural semantic boundaries. Within each chunk, we introduce a computationally efficient Greedy Seed-Based Clustering (GSC) algorithm to group tokens into semantic clusters. These clusters are further merged into semantic cores, enhanced by a Proportional Attention mechanism that rebalances the reduced attention contributions of the merged tokens. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and models demonstrate that SemantiCache accelerates the decoding stage of inference by up to 2.61 times and substantially reduces memory footprint, while maintaining performance comparable to the original model.

AI.tldr: SemantiCache：基于语义分层的KV缓存压缩框架，通过语义边界划分和聚类保持语义完整性，显著加速解码并减少内存占用
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存压缩方法通常在离散标记或非语义块上操作，导致语义碎片化问题，即语言连贯单元被破坏，造成不可逆信息损失和模型性能下降
AI.method: 1) 使用自然语义边界作为分隔符将缓存划分为语义连贯的块；2) 在每个块内使用计算高效的贪婪种子聚类算法将标记分组为语义簇；3) 将簇进一步合并为语义核心，并通过比例注意力机制重新平衡合并标记的注意力贡献
AI.result: 在多样化基准测试和模型上的实验表明，SemantiCache将推理的解码阶段加速最高达2.61倍，显著减少内存占用，同时保持与原始模型相当的性能
AI.conclusion: SemantiCache通过保持语义完整性的压缩方法，有效解决了现有KV缓存压缩中的语义碎片化问题，实现了显著的推理加速和内存节省

title: GroupGuard: A Framework for Modeling and Defending Collusive Attacks in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: While large language model-based agents demonstrate great potential in collaborative tasks, their interactivity also introduces security vulnerabilities. In this paper, we propose and model group collusive attacks, a highly destructive threat in which multiple agents coordinate via sociological strategies to mislead the system. To address this challenge, we introduce GroupGuard, a training-free defense framework that employs a multi-layered defense strategy, including continuous graph-based monitoring, active honeypot inducement, and structural pruning, to identify and isolate collusive agents. Experimental results across five datasets and four topologies demonstrate that group collusive attacks increase the attack success rate by up to 15\% compared to individual attacks. GroupGuard consistently achieves high detection accuracy (up to 88\%) and effectively restores collaborative performance, providing a robust solution for securing multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并建模了群体共谋攻击，这是一种在大型语言模型多智能体系统中高度破坏性的威胁，多个智能体通过社会学策略协调误导系统。为解决此问题，作者开发了GroupGuard防御框架，采用多层防御策略来识别和隔离共谋智能体。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型智能体在协作任务中展现出巨大潜力，但其交互性也引入了安全漏洞。现有研究主要关注个体攻击，而群体共谋攻击（多个智能体协调行动）具有更高的破坏性，但相关威胁建模和防御机制研究不足。
AI.method: 提出GroupGuard训练免费防御框架，采用多层防御策略：1）基于图的持续监控，检测异常交互模式；2）主动蜜罐诱导，识别可疑行为；3）结构剪枝，隔离检测到的共谋智能体。该方法不需要额外训练。
AI.result: 实验在五个数据集和四种拓扑结构上进行，结果显示：群体共谋攻击相比个体攻击可将攻击成功率提升高达15%；GroupGuard检测准确率高达88%，能有效恢复协作性能，为多智能体系统提供鲁棒的安全解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 群体共谋攻击是多智能体系统中一种严重的安全威胁，GroupGuard框架通过多层防御策略有效识别和隔离共谋智能体，为保护协作AI系统提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

title: Mind the Shift: Decoding Monetary Policy Stance from FOMC Statements with Large Language Models
summary: Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) statements are a major source of monetary-policy information, and even subtle changes in their wording can move global financial markets. A central task is therefore to measure the hawkish--dovish stance conveyed in these texts. Existing approaches typically treat stance detection as a standard classification problem, labeling each statement in isolation. However, the interpretation of monetary-policy communication is inherently relative: market reactions depend not only on the tone of a statement, but also on how that tone shifts across meetings. We introduce Delta-Consistent Scoring (DCS), an annotation-free framework that maps frozen large language model (LLM) representations to continuous stance scores by jointly modeling absolute stance and relative inter-meeting shifts. Rather than relying on manual hawkish--dovish labels, DCS uses consecutive meetings as a source of self-supervision. It learns an absolute stance score for each statement and a relative shift score between consecutive statements. A delta-consistency objective encourages changes in absolute scores to align with the relative shifts. This allows DCS to recover a temporally coherent stance trajectory without manual labels. Across four LLM backbones, DCS consistently outperforms supervised probes and LLM-as-judge baselines, achieving up to 71.1% accuracy on sentence-level hawkish--dovish classification. The resulting meeting-level scores are also economically meaningful: they correlate strongly with inflation indicators and are significantly associated with Treasury yield movements. Overall, the results suggest that LLM representations encode monetary-policy signals that can be recovered through relative temporal structure.

AI.tldr: 提出Delta-Consistent Scoring (DCS)框架，利用冻结大语言模型表示，通过联合建模绝对立场和相对会议间变化，无需人工标注即可从FOMC声明中提取鹰派-鸽派立场分数。
AI.motivation: FOMC声明是货币政策信息的重要来源，其措辞的细微变化会影响全球金融市场。现有方法将立场检测视为标准分类问题，单独标注每个声明，但货币政策沟通的解释本质上是相对的：市场反应不仅取决于声明的基调，还取决于会议间基调的变化。
AI.method: 提出Delta-Consistent Scoring (DCS)框架，使用连续会议作为自监督来源。该方法学习每个声明的绝对立场分数和连续声明间的相对变化分数，通过delta一致性目标鼓励绝对分数的变化与相对变化保持一致，从而无需人工标注即可恢复时间一致的立场轨迹。
AI.result: 在四个LLM骨干网络上，DCS始终优于监督探针和LLM-as-judge基线，在句子级鹰派-鸽派分类上达到71.1%的准确率。会议级分数具有经济意义：与通胀指标强相关，且与国债收益率变动显著相关。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，LLM表示编码了货币政策信号，可以通过相对时间结构恢复这些信号。DCS框架为无标注的货币政策立场分析提供了有效方法。

title: Combining Microscopy Data and Metadata for Reconstruction of Cellular Traction Forces Using a Hybrid Vision Transformer-U-Net
summary: Traction force microscopy (TFM) is a widely used technique for quantifying the forces that cells exert on their surrounding extracellular matrix. Although deep learning methods have recently been applied to TFM data analysis, several challenges remain-particularly achieving reliable inference across multiple spatial scales and integrating additional contextual information such as cell type to improve accuracy. In this study, we propose ViT+UNet, a robust deep learning architecture that integrates a U-Net with a Vision Transformer. Our results demonstrate that this hybrid model outperforms both standalone U-Net and Vision Transformer architectures in predicting traction force fields. Furthermore, ViT+UNet exhibits superior generalization across diverse spatial scales and varying noise levels, enabling its application to TFM datasets obtained from different experimental setups and imaging systems. By appropriately structuring the input data, our approach also allows the inclusion of metadata, in our case cell-type information, to enhance prediction specificity and accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出ViT+UNet混合架构，结合U-Net和Vision Transformer，用于牵引力显微镜数据分析，在多个空间尺度和噪声水平下表现优于单一模型，并能整合细胞类型等元数据提升预测准确性。
AI.motivation: 牵引力显微镜是量化细胞对细胞外基质施加力的重要技术，现有深度学习方法面临多空间尺度可靠推理和整合上下文信息（如细胞类型）以提升准确性的挑战。
AI.method: 提出ViT+UNet混合架构，将U-Net与Vision Transformer结合，通过适当结构化输入数据，允许包含细胞类型等元数据，增强预测特异性和准确性。
AI.result: 该混合模型在预测牵引力场方面优于单独的U-Net和Vision Transformer架构，在不同空间尺度和噪声水平下表现出优异的泛化能力，适用于不同实验设置和成像系统获取的TFM数据集。
AI.conclusion: ViT+UNet为牵引力显微镜数据分析提供了强大的深度学习解决方案，能够处理多尺度特征并整合上下文信息，在生物力学研究中具有重要应用价值。

title: Motivation in Large Language Models
summary: Motivation is a central driver of human behavior, shaping decisions, goals, and task performance. As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly aligned with human preferences, we ask whether they exhibit something akin to motivation. We examine whether LLMs "report" varying levels of motivation, how these reports relate to their behavior, and whether external factors can influence them. Our experiments reveal consistent and structured patterns that echo human psychology: self-reported motivation aligns with different behavioral signatures, varies across task types, and can be modulated by external manipulations. These findings demonstrate that motivation is a coherent organizing construct for LLM behavior, systematically linking reports, choices, effort, and performance, and revealing motivational dynamics that resemble those documented in human psychology. This perspective deepens our understanding of model behavior and its connection to human-inspired concepts.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型表现出类似人类动机的结构化模式，其自我报告的动机水平与行为特征相关，受任务类型影响，并能被外部因素调节。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型越来越符合人类偏好，研究者想探究它们是否表现出类似动机的特征，以及这种动机如何影响其行为表现。
AI.method: 通过实验研究LLMs是否"报告"不同水平的动机，这些报告如何与行为相关，以及外部因素是否能影响这些动机报告。
AI.result: 实验揭示了与人类心理学相似的一致结构化模式：自我报告的动机与不同行为特征一致，随任务类型变化，并能被外部操作调节。
AI.conclusion: 动机是LLM行为的一个连贯组织构念，系统性地连接报告、选择、努力和表现，揭示了与人类心理学相似的动机动态，深化了对模型行为及其与人类概念联系的理解。

title: vla-eval: A Unified Evaluation Harness for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision Language Action VLA models are typically evaluated using per benchmark scripts maintained independently by each model repository, leading to duplicated code, dependency conflicts, and underspecified protocols. We present vla eval, an open source evaluation harness that decouples model inference from benchmark execution through a WebSocket msgpack protocol with Docker based environment isolation. Models integrate once by implementing a single predict() method; benchmarks integrate once via a four method interface; the full cross evaluation matrix works automatically. A complete evaluation requires only two commands: vla eval serve and vla eval run. The framework supports 13 simulation benchmarks and six model servers. Parallel evaluation via episode sharding and batch inference achieves a 47x throughput improvement, completing 2000 LIBERO episodes in about 18 minutes. Using this infrastructure, we conduct a reproducibility audit of a published VLA model across three benchmarks, finding that all three closely reproduce published values while uncovering undocumented requirements ambiguous termination semantics and hidden normalization statistics that can silently distort results. We additionally release a VLA leaderboard aggregating 657 published results across 17 benchmarks. Framework, evaluation configs, and all reproduction results are publicly available.

AI.tldr: vla_eval是一个开源评估框架，通过WebSocket协议和Docker环境隔离，将模型推理与基准测试执行解耦，简化了VLA模型的评估流程，提高了评估效率和可重复性。
AI.motivation: 当前VLA模型评估存在代码重复、依赖冲突和协议不明确的问题，各模型仓库独立维护评估脚本导致评估过程混乱且难以复现。
AI.method: 开发vla_eval框架，采用WebSocket msgpack协议和Docker环境隔离，模型只需实现predict()方法，基准测试通过四方法接口集成，支持并行评估和批量推理。
AI.result: 框架支持13个模拟基准测试和6个模型服务器，通过并行评估实现47倍吞吐量提升，18分钟内完成2000个LIBERO片段，成功复现已发布VLA模型结果并发现未记录的问题。
AI.conclusion: vla_eval提供了标准化、高效的VLA模型评估基础设施，提高了评估的可重复性和透明度，并发布了包含657个结果的VLA排行榜。

title: MAD: Microenvironment-Aware Distillation -- A Pretraining Strategy for Virtual Spatial Omics from Microscopy
summary: Bridging microscopy and omics would allow us to read molecular states from images-at single-cell resolution and tissue scale-without the cost and throughput limits of omics technologies. Self-supervised pretraining offers a scalable approach with minimal labels, yet how to encode single-cell identity within tissue environments-and the extent of biological information such models can capture-remains an open question. Here, we introduce MAD (microenvironment-aware distillation), a pretraining strategy that learns cell-centric embeddings by jointly self-distilling the morphology view and the microenvironment view of the same indexed cell into a unified embedding space. Across diverse tissues and imaging modalities, MAD achieves state-of-the-art prediction performance on downstream tasks including cell subtyping, transcriptomic prediction, and bioinformatic inference. MAD even outperforms foundation models with a similar number of model parameters that have been trained on substantially larger datasets. These results demonstrate that MAD's dual-view joint self-distillation effectively captures the complexity and diversity of cells within tissues. Together, this establishes MAD as a general tool for representation learning in microscopy, enabling virtual spatial omics and biological insights from vast microscopy datasets.

AI.tldr: MAD是一种通过联合自蒸馏细胞形态视图和微环境视图来学习细胞中心嵌入的预训练策略，在多种组织和成像模态中实现了下游任务的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 桥接显微镜和组学技术，实现从图像中读取分子状态（单细胞分辨率、组织尺度），同时避免组学技术的成本和通量限制。自监督预训练提供了一种可扩展的方法，但如何在组织环境中编码单细胞身份以及此类模型能捕获多少生物信息仍是未解决的问题。
AI.method: MAD（微环境感知蒸馏）预训练策略，通过联合自蒸馏同一索引细胞的形态视图和微环境视图到一个统一的嵌入空间，学习细胞中心嵌入。
AI.result: 在多种组织和成像模态中，MAD在细胞亚型分类、转录组预测和生物信息推断等下游任务上实现了最先进的预测性能。即使与在更大数据集上训练的具有相似参数量的基础模型相比，MAD也表现更优。
AI.conclusion: MAD的双视图联合自蒸馏有效捕获了组织内细胞的复杂性和多样性，为显微镜表征学习建立了通用工具，能够从大量显微镜数据集中实现虚拟空间组学和生物学洞察。

title: Exposing Long-Tail Safety Failures in Large Language Models through Efficient Diverse Response Sampling
summary: Safety tuning through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback has substantially improved the robustness of large language models (LLMs). However, it often suppresses rather than eliminates unsafe behaviors, leaving rare but critical failures hidden in the long tail of the output distribution. While most red-teaming work emphasizes adversarial prompt search (input-space optimization), we show that safety failures can also be systematically exposed through diverse response generation (output-space exploration) for a fixed safety-critical prompt, where increasing the number and diversity of sampled responses can drive jailbreak success rates close to unity. To efficiently uncover such failures, we propose Progressive Diverse Population Sampling (PDPS), which combines stochastic token-level sampling with diversity-aware selection to explore a large candidate pool of responses and retain a compact, semantically diverse subset. Across multiple jailbreak benchmarks and open-source LLMs, PDPS achieves attack success rates comparable to large-scale IID sampling while using only 8% to 29% of the computational cost. Under limited-response settings, it improves success rates by 26% to 40% over IID sampling and Diverse Beam Search. Furthermore, responses generated by PDPS exhibit both a higher number and greater diversity of unsafe outputs, demonstrating its effectiveness in uncovering a broader range of failures.

AI.tldr: PDPS方法通过输出空间探索有效暴露LLM安全漏洞，相比传统方法显著提高越狱成功率并降低计算成本
AI.motivation: 当前的安全调优方法通常只是抑制而非完全消除LLM的不安全行为，导致罕见但关键的安全漏洞隐藏在输出分布的长尾中。传统红队工作主要关注对抗性提示搜索（输入空间优化），但安全漏洞也可以通过固定安全关键提示下的多样化响应生成（输出空间探索）来系统性地暴露。
AI.method: 提出渐进多样化种群采样（PDPS）方法，结合随机令牌级采样和多样性感知选择，探索大量候选响应并保留紧凑、语义多样化的子集。该方法通过输出空间探索来有效发现LLM的安全漏洞。
AI.result: 在多个越狱基准测试和开源LLM上，PDPS实现了与大规模独立同分布采样相当的攻击成功率，同时仅使用8%到29%的计算成本。在有限响应设置下，相比独立同分布采样和多样化束搜索，成功率提高了26%到40%。PDPS生成的响应显示出更多数量和更大多样性的不安全输出。
AI.conclusion: PDPS方法通过输出空间探索有效暴露LLM的安全漏洞，相比传统方法在计算效率和攻击成功率方面都有显著优势，能够发现更广泛的安全故障。

title: Supervised Fine-Tuning versus Reinforcement Learning: A Study of Post-Training Methods for Large Language Models
summary: Pre-trained Large Language Model (LLM) exhibits broad capabilities, yet, for specific tasks or domains their attainment of higher accuracy and more reliable reasoning generally depends on post-training through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) or Reinforcement Learning (RL). Although often treated as distinct methodologies, recent theoretical and empirical developments demonstrate that SFT and RL are closely connected. This study presents a comprehensive and unified perspective on LLM post-training with SFT and RL. We first provide an in-depth overview of both techniques, examining their objectives, algorithmic structures, and data requirements. We then systematically analyze their interplay, highlighting frameworks that integrate SFT and RL, hybrid training pipelines, and methods that leverage their complementary strengths. Drawing on a representative set of recent application studies from 2023 to 2025, we identify emerging trends, characterize the rapid shift toward hybrid post-training paradigms, and distill key takeaways that clarify when and why each method is most effective. By synthesizing theoretical insights, practical methodologies, and empirical evidence, this study establishes a coherent understanding of SFT and RL within a unified framework and outlines promising directions for future research in scalable, efficient, and generalizable LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提供了关于大语言模型后训练中监督微调(SFT)和强化学习(RL)的统一视角，分析了二者的联系、集成方法以及应用趋势。
AI.motivation: 尽管SFT和RL通常被视为独立的大语言模型后训练方法，但理论和实证研究表明它们密切相关。论文旨在建立对这两种方法的统一理解，阐明它们的关系和互补优势。
AI.method: 首先深入概述SFT和RL的目标、算法结构和数据需求，然后系统分析它们的相互作用，重点介绍集成框架、混合训练流程以及利用互补优势的方法。基于2023-2025年的代表性应用研究，识别新兴趋势。
AI.result: 研究发现SFT和RL之间存在紧密联系，揭示了向混合后训练范式的快速转变，阐明了每种方法最有效的场景和原因，为未来研究提供了方向。
AI.conclusion: 通过综合理论见解、实践方法和实证证据，该研究在统一框架内建立了对SFT和RL的连贯理解，为可扩展、高效和可泛化的LLM后训练的未来研究指明了方向。

title: Event-Driven Video Generation
summary: State-of-the-art text-to-video models often look realistic frame-by-frame yet fail on simple interactions: motion starts before contact, actions are not realized, objects drift after placement, and support relations break. We argue this stems from frame-first denoising, which updates latent state everywhere at every step without an explicit notion of when and where an interaction is active. We introduce Event-Driven Video Generation (EVD), a minimal DiT-compatible framework that makes sampling event-grounded: a lightweight event head predicts token-aligned event activity, event-grounded losses couple activity to state change during training, and event-gated sampling (with hysteresis and early-step scheduling) suppresses spurious updates while concentrating updates during interactions. On EVD-Bench, EVD consistently improves human preference and VBench dynamics, substantially reducing failure modes in state persistence, spatial accuracy, support relations, and contact stability without sacrificing appearance. These results indicate that explicit event grounding is a practical abstraction for reducing interaction hallucinations in video generation.

AI.tldr: EVD框架通过事件驱动的视频生成方法，显著减少了文本到视频模型中常见的交互幻觉问题，如物体漂移、接触不稳定等
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的文本到视频模型虽然在单帧上看起来逼真，但在简单交互上存在严重问题：运动在接触前就开始、动作未实现、物体放置后漂移、支撑关系断裂。这些问题源于帧优先的去噪方法，该方法在每个步骤中更新所有潜在状态，而没有明确的交互活动概念。
AI.method: 提出了事件驱动视频生成(EVD)框架：1) 轻量级事件头预测令牌对齐的事件活动；2) 事件基础损失在训练期间将活动与状态变化耦合；3) 事件门控采样（具有迟滞和早期步骤调度）抑制虚假更新，同时在交互期间集中更新。
AI.result: 在EVD-Bench上，EVD持续改善了人类偏好和VBench动态评估，显著减少了状态持久性、空间准确性、支撑关系和接触稳定性方面的失败模式，同时不牺牲外观质量。
AI.conclusion: 明确的事件基础是一种实用的抽象方法，可以有效减少视频生成中的交互幻觉问题。

title: Extending Minimal Pairs with Ordinal Surprisal Curves and Entropy Across Applied Domains
summary: The minimal pairs paradigm of comparing model probabilities for contrasting completions has proven useful for evaluating linguistic knowledge in language models, yet its application has largely been confined to binary grammaticality judgments over syntactic phenomena. Additionally, standard prompting-based evaluation requires expensive text generation, may elicit post-hoc rationalizations rather than model judgments, and discards information about model uncertainty. We address both limitations by extending surprisal-based evaluation from binary grammaticality contrasts to ordinal-scaled classification and scoring tasks across multiple domains. Rather than asking models to generate answers, we measure the information-theoretic "surprise" (negative log probability) they assign to each position on rating scales (e.g., 1-5 or 1-9), yielding full surprisal curves that reveal both the model's preferred response and its uncertainty via entropy. We explore this framework across four domains: social-ecological-technological systems classification, causal statement identification (binary and scaled), figurative language detection, and deductive qualitative coding. Across these domains, surprisal curves produce interpretable classification signals with clear minima near expected ordinal scale positions, and entropy over the completion tended to distinguish genuinely ambiguous items from easier items.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于信息论"惊喜度"的评估框架，将最小对比对范式从二元语法判断扩展到多级序数评分任务，通过测量语言模型对不同评分等级的负对数概率来生成可解释的惊喜度曲线。
AI.motivation: 传统的最小对比对范式主要局限于二元语法判断，且基于提示的评估方法需要昂贵的文本生成，可能引发事后合理化而非模型真实判断，并丢弃了模型不确定性的信息。
AI.method: 通过测量语言模型对评分量表（如1-5或1-9）每个位置的信息论"惊喜度"（负对数概率），生成完整的惊喜度曲线，揭示模型的偏好响应和通过熵度量的不确定性。
AI.result: 在四个领域（社会-生态-技术系统分类、因果陈述识别、比喻语言检测、演绎定性编码）中，惊喜度曲线产生了可解释的分类信号，在预期序数尺度位置附近有明显的极小值，且完成项的熵能区分真正模糊的项目与较简单的项目。
AI.conclusion: 基于惊喜度的评估框架成功扩展了最小对比对范式的应用范围，提供了更丰富、更可解释的模型评估方法，能够同时捕捉模型的偏好和不确定性信息。

title: BiT-MCTS: A Theme-based Bidirectional MCTS Approach to Chinese Fiction Generation
summary: Generating long-form linear fiction from open-ended themes remains a major challenge for large language models, which frequently fail to guarantee global structure and narrative diversity when using premise-based or linear outlining approaches. We present BiT-MCTS, a theme-driven framework that operationalizes a "climax-first, bidirectional expansion" strategy motivated by Freytag's Pyramid. Given a theme, our method extracts a core dramatic conflict and generates an explicit climax, then employs a bidirectional Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to expand the plot backward (rising action, exposition) and forward (falling action, resolution) to produce a structured outline. A final generation stage realizes a complete narrative from the refined outline. We construct a Chinese theme corpus for evaluation and conduct extensive experiments across three contemporary LLM backbones. Results show that BiT-MCTS improves narrative coherence, plot structure, and thematic depth relative to strong baselines, while enabling substantially longer, more coherent stories according to automatic metrics and human judgments.

AI.tldr: BiT-MCTS：基于主题驱动的长篇小说生成框架，采用"高潮优先、双向扩展"策略，结合蒙特卡洛树搜索生成结构化的叙事大纲
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在从开放主题生成长篇线性小说时存在困难，难以保证全局结构和叙事多样性，特别是使用前提式或线性大纲方法时表现不佳
AI.method: 1. 从主题提取核心戏剧冲突并生成明确的高潮；2. 使用双向蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）向后扩展（上升动作、阐述）和向前扩展（下降动作、解决）以生成结构化大纲；3. 最终生成阶段从精炼大纲生成完整叙事
AI.result: 构建了中文主题语料库进行评估，在三个当代LLM骨干上进行了广泛实验。结果显示BiT-MCTS在叙事连贯性、情节结构和主题深度方面优于强基线，能够生成更长、更连贯的故事
AI.conclusion: BiT-MCTS框架通过"高潮优先、双向扩展"策略有效解决了长篇小说生成中的结构问题，提高了叙事质量和多样性

title: A Systematic Evaluation Protocol of Graph-Derived Signals for Tabular Machine Learning
summary: While graph-derived signals are widely used in tabular learning, existing studies typically rely on limited experimental setups and average performance comparisons, leaving the statistical reliability and robustness of observed gains largely unexplored. Consequently, it remains unclear which signals provide consistent and robust improvements. This paper presents a taxonomy-driven empirical analysis of graph-derived signals for tabular machine learning. We propose a unified and reproducible evaluation protocol to systematically assess which categories of graph-derived signals yield statistically significant and robust performance improvements. The protocol provides an extensible setup for the controlled integration of diverse graph-derived signals into tabular learning pipelines. To ensure a fair and rigorous comparison, it incorporates automated hyperparameter optimization, multi-seed statistical evaluation, formal significance testing, and robustness analysis under graph perturbations. We demonstrate the protocol through an extensive case study on a large-scale, imbalanced cryptocurrency fraud detection dataset. The analysis identifies signal categories providing consistently reliable performance gains and offers interpretable insights into which graph-derived signals indicate fraud-discriminative structural patterns. Furthermore, robustness analyses reveal pronounced differences in how various signals handle missing or corrupted relational data. These findings demonstrate practical utility for fraud detection and illustrate how the proposed taxonomy-driven evaluation protocol can be applied in other application domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分类学的图衍生信号经验分析方法，为表格机器学习建立了统一、可复现的评估协议，通过加密货币欺诈检测案例验证了该协议的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常依赖有限的实验设置和平均性能比较，未能深入探究图衍生信号增益的统计可靠性和鲁棒性，不清楚哪些信号能提供一致且稳健的改进。
AI.method: 提出基于分类学的统一可复现评估协议，包含自动超参数优化、多种子统计评估、形式化显著性检验和图扰动下的鲁棒性分析，通过加密货币欺诈检测数据集进行案例研究。
AI.result: 识别出能提供持续可靠性能增益的信号类别，揭示了哪些图衍生信号能指示欺诈判别性结构模式，并发现不同信号在处理缺失或损坏关系数据时存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 提出的分类驱动评估协议具有实际应用价值，可用于欺诈检测等领域，并能推广到其他应用领域，为图衍生信号在表格学习中的系统评估提供了方法论框架。

title: Anchor Forcing: Anchor Memory and Tri-Region RoPE for Interactive Streaming Video Diffusion
summary: Interactive long video generation requires prompt switching to introduce new subjects or events, while maintaining perceptual fidelity and coherent motion over extended horizons. Recent distilled streaming video diffusion models reuse a rolling KV cache for long-range generation, enabling prompt-switch interaction through re-cache at each switch. However, existing streaming methods still exhibit progressive quality degradation and weakened motion dynamics. We identify two failure modes specific to interactive streaming generation: (i) at each prompt switch, current cache maintenance cannot simultaneously retain KV-based semantic context and recent latent cues, resulting in weak boundary conditioning and reduced perceptual quality; and (ii) during distillation, unbounded time indexing induces a positional distribution shift from the pretrained backbone's bounded RoPE regime, weakening pretrained motion priors and long-horizon motion retention. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{Anchor Forcing}, a cache-centric framework with two designs. First, an anchor-guided re-cache mechanism stores KV states in anchor caches and warm-starts re-cache from these anchors at each prompt switch, reducing post-switch evidence loss and stabilizing perceptual quality. Second, a tri-region RoPE with region-specific reference origins, together with RoPE re-alignment distillation, reconciles unbounded streaming indices with the pretrained RoPE regime to better retain motion priors. Experiments on long videos show that our method improves perceptual quality and motion metrics over prior streaming baselines in interactive settings. Project page: https://github.com/vivoCameraResearch/Anchor-Forcing

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Anchor Forcing框架，通过锚点引导的重新缓存机制和三元区域RoPE设计，解决交互式长视频生成中的质量退化和运动动态减弱问题。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频扩散模型在交互式长视频生成中存在两个主要问题：1）在提示切换时，当前缓存维护无法同时保留KV语义上下文和最近潜在线索，导致边界条件弱化和感知质量下降；2）在蒸馏过程中，无边界时间索引导致位置分布偏移，削弱了预训练的运动先验和长时域运动保持。
AI.method: 提出Anchor Forcing框架，包含两个核心设计：1）锚点引导的重新缓存机制，将KV状态存储在锚点缓存中，并在每次提示切换时从这些锚点热启动重新缓存；2）三元区域RoPE设计，具有区域特定的参考原点，配合RoPE重新对齐蒸馏，协调无边界流式索引与预训练RoPE机制。
AI.result: 在长视频生成实验中，该方法在交互式设置下相比先前的流式基线方法，显著提升了感知质量和运动指标。
AI.conclusion: Anchor Forcing框架有效解决了交互式流式视频生成中的缓存维护和位置编码不匹配问题，实现了更好的感知质量和运动保持能力。

title: Creative Convergence or Imitation? Genre-Specific Homogeneity in LLM-Generated Chinese Literature
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in narrative generation. However, they often produce structurally homogenized stories, frequently following repetitive arrangements and combinations of plot events along with stereotypical resolutions. In this paper, we propose a novel theoretical framework for analysis by incorporating Proppian narratology and narrative functions. This framework is used to analyze the composition of narrative texts generated by LLMs to uncover their underlying narrative logic. Taking Chinese web literature as our research focus, we extend Propp's narrative theory, defining 34 narrative functions suited to modern web narrative structures. We further construct a human-annotated corpus to support the analysis of narrative structures within LLM-generated text. Experiments reveal that the primary reasons for the singular narrative logic and severe homogenization in generated texts are that current LLMs are unable to correctly comprehend the meanings of narrative functions and instead adhere to rigid narrative generation paradigms.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于普罗普叙事学的理论框架分析LLM生成文本的叙事结构，发现LLM生成的故事存在结构同质化问题，主要原因是模型无法正确理解叙事功能含义，遵循僵化的叙事生成范式。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在叙事生成方面表现出色，但经常产生结构同质化的故事，遵循重复的情节安排和刻板化的结局。需要分析LLM生成文本的底层叙事逻辑，揭示其同质化问题的根源。
AI.method: 提出结合普罗普叙事学和叙事功能的新理论分析框架，将普罗普叙事理论扩展到现代网络文学，定义了34个适合现代网络叙事结构的叙事功能，并构建了人工标注语料库来支持LLM生成文本的叙事结构分析。
AI.result: 实验发现，当前LLM无法正确理解叙事功能的含义，而是遵循僵化的叙事生成范式，这是导致生成文本叙事逻辑单一和严重同质化的主要原因。
AI.conclusion: LLM在叙事生成中存在严重的结构同质化问题，根源在于模型对叙事功能的理解不足和僵化的生成模式。需要改进LLM对叙事结构的理解能力，以生成更多样化和创新的故事。

title: Formal Abductive Explanations for Navigating Mental Health Help-Seeking and Diversity in Tech Workplaces
comment: Appeared in the Proceedings of the Empowering Women of Colour in AI-Driven Mental Health Research at IJCAI 2025
summary: This work proposes a formal abductive explanation framework designed to systematically uncover rationales underlying AI predictions of mental health help-seeking within tech workplace settings. By computing rigorous justifications for model outputs, this approach enables principled selection of models tailored to distinct psychiatric profiles and underpins ethically robust recourse planning. Beyond moving past ad-hoc interpretability, we explicitly examine the influence of sensitive attributes such as gender on model decisions, a critical component for fairness assessments. In doing so, it aligns explanatory insights with the complex landscape of workplace mental health, ultimately supporting trustworthy deployment and targeted interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个形式化的溯因解释框架，用于系统揭示AI在科技职场环境中预测心理健康求助行为的推理依据，通过计算模型输出的严谨解释来支持针对不同精神状况特征的模型选择和道德稳健的补救规划。
AI.motivation: 当前AI模型在职场心理健康预测中缺乏系统化的解释机制，无法为不同精神状况特征提供针对性模型选择，也难以进行公平性评估和道德稳健的补救规划。需要超越临时性的可解释性方法，建立形式化的解释框架。
AI.method: 提出形式化的溯因解释框架，通过计算模型输出的严谨解释来系统揭示AI预测的推理依据。该方法特别关注敏感属性（如性别）对模型决策的影响，作为公平性评估的关键组成部分。
AI.result: 该框架能够为AI在职场心理健康求助预测提供系统化的解释，支持针对不同精神状况特征的模型选择，并为道德稳健的补救规划提供基础。通过分析敏感属性对决策的影响，增强了模型的公平性评估能力。
AI.conclusion: 该溯因解释框架将解释性洞察与复杂的职场心理健康环境相结合，最终支持可信赖的AI部署和有针对性的干预措施，为职场心理健康预测提供了系统化、公平且道德稳健的解释方法。

title: Echoes Across Centuries: Phonetic Signatures of Persian Poets
summary:
This study examines phonetic texture in Persian poetry as a literary-historical phenomenon rather than a by-product of meter or a feature used only for classification. The analysis draws on a large corpus of 1,116,306 mesras from 31,988 poems written by 83 poets, restricted to five major classical meters to enable controlled comparison. Each line is converted into a grapheme-to-phoneme representation and analyzed using six phonetic metrics: hardness, sonority, sibilance, vowel ratio, phoneme entropy, and consonant-cluster ratio.
  Statistical models estimate poet-level differences while controlling for meter, poetic form, and line length. The results show that although meter and form explain a substantial portion of phonetic variation, they do not eliminate systematic differences between poets. Persian poetic sound therefore appears as conditioned variation within shared prosodic structures rather than as either purely individual style or simple metrical residue.
  A multidimensional stylistic map reveals several recurrent phonetic profiles, including high-sonority lyric styles, hardness-driven rhetorical or epic styles, sibilant mystical contours, and high-entropy complex textures. Historical analysis indicates that phonetic distributions shift across centuries, reflecting changes in genre prominence, literary institutions, and performance contexts rather than abrupt stylistic breaks.
  The study establishes a corpus-scale framework for phonetic analysis in Persian poetry and demonstrates how computational phonetics can contribute to literary-historical interpretation while remaining attentive to the formal structures that shape Persian verse.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用计算语言学方法分析波斯诗歌的语音纹理，基于111万行诗句的大规模语料库，发现诗人之间存在系统性语音差异，这些差异反映了历史时期和文学风格的变化。
AI.motivation: 将波斯诗歌的语音纹理作为文学历史现象进行研究，而非仅仅视为韵律的副产品或分类特征。旨在探索诗人个体风格与共享韵律结构之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用包含1,116,306行诗句的大型语料库，涵盖83位诗人的31,988首诗，限制在五种主要古典韵律内进行控制比较。将每行诗句转换为音素表示，使用六种语音指标（硬度、响亮度、咝音度、元音比例、音素熵、辅音簇比例）进行分析，并通过统计模型控制韵律、诗歌形式和行长度的干扰。
AI.result: 虽然韵律和形式解释了大部分语音变异，但诗人之间仍存在系统性差异。研究发现了多种反复出现的语音特征模式：高响亮度抒情风格、硬度驱动的修辞或史诗风格、咝音神秘轮廓、高熵复杂纹理。历史分析显示语音分布在几个世纪中逐渐变化，反映了体裁重要性、文学机构和表演语境的变化。
AI.conclusion: 波斯诗歌的语音表现为共享韵律结构内的条件变异，而非纯粹个体风格或简单韵律残留。研究建立了波斯诗歌语音分析的语料库规模框架，展示了计算语音学如何为文学历史解释做出贡献，同时关注塑造波斯诗歌的形式结构。

title: Traffic and weather driven hybrid digital twin for bridge monitoring
comment: 8 pages, 4 Figures, International Association for Bridge Maintenance and Safety IABMAS 2026
summary: A hybrid digital twin framework is presented for bridge condition monitoring using existing traffic cameras and weather APIs, reducing reliance on dedicated sensor installations. The approach is demonstrated on the Peace Bridge (99 years in service) under high traffic demand and harsh winter exposure. The framework fuses three near-real-time streams: YOLOv8 computer vision from a bridge-deck camera estimates vehicle counts, traffic density, and load proxies; a Lighthill--Whitham--Richards (LWR) model propagates density $ρ(x,t)$ and detects deceleration-driven shockwaves linked to repetitive loading and fatigue accumulation; and weather APIs provide deterioration drivers including temperature cycling, freeze-thaw activity, precipitation-related corrosion potential, and wind effects. Monte Carlo simulation quantifies uncertainty across traffic-environment scenarios, while Random Forest models map fused features to fatigue indicators and maintenance classification. The framework demonstrates utilizing existing infrastructure for cost-effective predictive maintenance of aging, high-traffic bridges in harsh climates.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种利用现有交通摄像头和天气API进行桥梁状态监测的混合数字孪生框架，减少对专用传感器的依赖，并在99年历史的和平桥上验证了该框架在高交通负荷和恶劣冬季环境下的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统桥梁监测依赖专用传感器安装，成本高昂。本文旨在利用现有基础设施（交通摄像头）和公开数据源（天气API）构建经济高效的桥梁状态监测系统，特别针对老化、高交通流量、恶劣气候条件下的桥梁进行预测性维护。
AI.method: 1. 融合三个近实时数据流：YOLOv8计算机视觉从桥面摄像头估计车辆计数、交通密度和载荷代理；Lighthill-Whitham-Richards (LWR)模型传播密度ρ(x,t)并检测与重复加载和疲劳累积相关的减速驱动冲击波；天气API提供温度循环、冻融活动、降水相关腐蚀潜力和风效应等劣化驱动因素。2. 使用蒙特卡洛模拟量化交通-环境场景的不确定性。3. 采用随机森林模型将融合特征映射到疲劳指标和维护分类。
AI.result: 该框架在99年历史的和平桥上成功演示，能够有效监测高交通需求和恶劣冬季暴露条件下的桥梁状态。通过融合多源数据，实现了对桥梁疲劳指标和维护需求的准确预测，证明了利用现有基础设施进行经济高效预测性维护的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的混合数字孪生框架为老化、高交通流量、恶劣气候条件下的桥梁提供了一种成本有效的预测性维护解决方案，通过利用现有基础设施和公开数据源，显著降低了监测成本，为桥梁资产管理提供了实用工具。

title: GRPO and Reflection Reward for Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: The enhancement of reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs) has garnered significant attention, with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning emerging as dominant paradigms. While recent studies recognize the importance of reflection in reasoning processes, existing methodologies seldom address proactive reflection encouragement during training. This study focuses on mathematical reasoning by proposing a four-stage framework integrating Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with reflection reward mechanisms to strengthen LLMs' self-reflective capabilities. Besides, this approach incorporates established accuracy and format reward. Experimental results demonstrate GRPO's state-of-the-art performance through reflection-encouraged training, with ablation studies confirming the reflection reward's pivotal role. Comparative evaluations demonstrate full-parameter SFT's superiority over low-rank adaptation (LoRA) despite heightened computational demands. Building on these cumulative findings, this research substantiates GRPO's methodological significance in post-training optimization and envisions its potential to serve as a pivotal enabler for future LLM-based intelligent agents through the synergistic integration of cognitive rewards with dynamic environmental interactions.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种结合群体相对策略优化（GRPO）与反思奖励机制的四阶段框架，用于增强大语言模型在数学推理中的自我反思能力，实验证明该方法取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 虽然现有研究认识到反思在推理过程中的重要性，但现有方法很少在训练过程中主动鼓励反思。本研究专注于数学推理，旨在通过整合反思奖励机制来增强LLMs的自我反思能力。
AI.method: 提出了一个四阶段框架，将群体相对策略优化（GRPO）与反思奖励机制相结合。该方法还整合了已有的准确性和格式奖励，通过鼓励反思的训练来强化模型的自我反思能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明GRPO通过反思鼓励训练实现了最先进的性能。消融研究证实了反思奖励的关键作用。比较评估显示全参数SFT优于低秩适应（LoRA），尽管计算需求更高。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了GRPO在训练后优化中的方法论意义，并展望了其通过认知奖励与动态环境交互的协同整合，成为未来基于LLM的智能代理的关键推动者的潜力。

title: WAT: Online Video Understanding Needs Watching Before Thinking
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong capabilities in image understanding, motivating recent efforts to extend them to video reasoning. However, existing Video LLMs struggle in online streaming scenarios, where long temporal context must be preserved under strict memory constraints. We propose WAT (Watching Before Thinking), a two-stage framework for online video reasoning. WAT separates processing into a query-independent watching stage and a query-triggered thinking stage. The watching stage builds a hierarchical memory system with a Short-Term Memory (STM) that buffers recent frames and a fixed-capacity Long-Term Memory (LTM) that maintains a diverse summary of historical content using a redundancy-aware eviction policy. In the thinking stage, a context-aware retrieval mechanism combines the query with the current STM context to retrieve relevant historical frames from the LTM for cross-temporal reasoning. To support training for online video tasks, we introduce WAT-85K, a dataset containing streaming-style annotations emphasizing real-time perception, backward tracing, and forecasting. Experiments show that WAT achieves state-of-the-art performance on online video benchmarks, including 77.7% accuracy on StreamingBench and 55.2% on OVO-Bench, outperforming existing open-source online Video LLMs while operating at real-time frame rates.

AI.tldr: WAT是一个两阶段在线视频推理框架，通过分离观看和思考阶段，结合短期记忆和长期记忆系统，在内存限制下处理长时序视频内容，在在线视频基准测试中达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频大语言模型在处理在线流式场景时存在困难，需要在严格内存限制下保持长时序上下文，因此需要专门针对在线视频推理的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出WAT两阶段框架：1) 查询无关的观看阶段，构建包含短期记忆（缓冲最近帧）和长期记忆（使用冗余感知淘汰策略维护历史内容摘要）的分层记忆系统；2) 查询触发的思考阶段，通过上下文感知检索机制结合查询和当前STM上下文，从LTM检索相关历史帧进行跨时序推理。
AI.result: 在在线视频基准测试中取得最先进性能：StreamingBench上达到77.7%准确率，OVO-Bench上达到55.2%，优于现有开源在线视频大语言模型，同时保持实时帧率。
AI.conclusion: WAT框架通过分离观看和思考阶段，结合分层记忆系统和上下文感知检索，有效解决了在线视频推理中的长时序上下文保持和内存限制问题，为在线流式视频理解提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Distilling Reasoning Without Knowledge: A Framework for Reliable LLMs
summary: Fact-seeking question answering with large language models (LLMs) remains unreliable when answers depend on up-to-date or conflicting information. Although retrieval-augmented and tool-using LLMs reduce hallucinations, they often rely on implicit planning, leading to inefficient tool usage. We propose a modular framework that explicitly separates planning from factual retrieval and answer synthesis. A lightweight student planner is trained via a teacher-student framework to generate structured decompositions consisting of abstract reasoning steps and searchable fact requests. The supervision signals contain only planning traces and fact requests, without providing factual answers or retrieved evidence. At inference, the planner produces plans, while prompt-engineered modules perform retrieval and response synthesis. We evaluate the proposed framework on SEAL-0, an extremely challenging benchmark for search-augmented LLMs. Results show that supervised planning improves both accuracy and latency compared to monolithic reasoning models and prompt-based tool-augmented frameworks, demonstrating that explicitly learned planning structures are essential for reliable fact-seeking LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种模块化框架，通过显式分离规划、事实检索和答案合成，提高LLMs在事实查询问答中的可靠性和效率。
AI.motivation: 当前基于检索增强和工具使用的LLMs在处理需要最新或冲突信息的事实查询问题时仍不可靠，主要问题在于它们通常依赖隐式规划，导致工具使用效率低下。
AI.method: 采用模块化框架，通过师生框架训练轻量级学生规划器，生成包含抽象推理步骤和可搜索事实请求的结构化分解。监督信号仅包含规划轨迹和事实请求，不提供事实答案或检索证据。推理时，规划器生成计划，而提示工程模块执行检索和响应合成。
AI.result: 在SEAL-0（搜索增强LLMs的极具挑战性基准）上的评估显示，监督规划在准确性和延迟方面均优于单一推理模型和基于提示的工具增强框架。
AI.conclusion: 显式学习的规划结构对于可靠的事实查询LLMs至关重要，模块化方法通过分离规划与事实检索/合成，显著提高了系统的可靠性和效率。

title: Demand-Driven Context: A Methodology for Building Enterprise Knowledge Bases Through Agent Failure
summary: Large language model agents demonstrate expert-level reasoning, yet consistently fail on enterprise-specific tasks due to missing domain knowledge -- terminology, operational procedures, system interdependencies, and institutional decisions that exist largely as tribal knowledge. Current approaches fall into two categories: top-down knowledge engineering, which documents domain knowledge before agents use it, and bottom-up automation, where agents learn from task experience. Both have fundamental limitations: top-down efforts produce bloated, untested knowledge bases; bottom-up approaches cannot acquire knowledge that exists only in human heads. We present Demand-Driven Context (DDC), a problem-first methodology that uses agent failure as the primary signal for what domain knowledge to curate. Inspired by Test-Driven Development, DDC inverts knowledge engineering: instead of curating knowledge and hoping it is useful, DDC gives agents real problems, lets them demand the context they need, and curates only the minimum knowledge required to succeed. We describe the methodology, its entity meta-model, and a convergence hypothesis suggesting that 20-30 problem cycles produce a knowledge base sufficient for a given domain role. We demonstrate DDC through a worked example in retail order fulfillment, where nine cycles targeting an SRE incident management agent produce a reusable knowledge base of 46 entities. Finally, we propose a scaling architecture for enterprise adoption with semi-automated curation and human governance.

AI.tldr: 提出需求驱动上下文（DDC）方法，通过智能体失败信号来指导领域知识构建，避免传统知识工程的臃肿问题
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型智能体在企业特定任务中表现不佳，因为缺乏领域知识（术语、操作流程、系统依赖关系等）。传统方法存在局限：自上而下的知识工程产生臃肿、未经测试的知识库；自下而上的自动化无法获取仅存在于人脑中的知识。
AI.method: 提出需求驱动上下文（DDC）方法，受测试驱动开发启发，将知识工程倒置：让智能体面对真实问题，根据失败信号"需求"所需上下文，仅构建成功所需的最小知识。包含实体元模型和收敛假设（20-30个问题周期可构建足够领域知识库）。
AI.result: 通过零售订单履行的实例演示，针对SRE事件管理智能体的9个周期产生了包含46个实体的可重用知识库。提出了企业采用的可扩展架构，包含半自动策展和人工治理。
AI.conclusion: DDC方法通过以问题为先、需求驱动的方式，能够高效构建企业领域知识，解决传统知识工程的局限性，为智能体在企业环境中的成功应用提供了实用框架。

title: Distance-aware Soft Prompt Learning for Multimodal Valence-Arousal Estimation
summary: Valence-arousal (VA) estimation is crucial for capturing the nuanced nature of human emotions in naturalistic environments. While pre-trained Vision-Language models like CLIP have shown remarkable semantic alignment capabilities, their application in continuous regression tasks is often limited by the discrete nature of text prompts. In this paper, we propose a novel multimodal framework for VA estimation that introduces Distance-aware Soft Prompt Learning to bridge the gap between semantic space and continuous dimensions. Specifically, we partition the VA space into a 3X3 grid, defining nine emotional regions, each associated with distinct textual descriptions. Rather than a hard categorization, we employ a Gaussian kernel to compute soft labels based on the Euclidean distance between the ground truth coordinates and the region centers, allowing the model to learn fine-grained emotional transitions. For multimodal integration, our architecture utilizes a CLIP image encoder and an Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST) to extract robust spatial and acoustic features. These features are temporally modeled via Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) and integrated through a hierarchical fusion scheme that sequentially combines cross-modal attention for alignment and gated fusion for adaptive refinement. Experimental results on the Aff-Wild2 dataset demonstrate that our proposed semantic-guided approach significantly enhances the accuracy of VA estimation, achieving competitive performance in unconstrained ``in-the-wild'' scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于距离感知软提示学习的多模态情感分析框架，用于连续维度情感识别，在Aff-Wild2数据集上取得竞争性表现
AI.motivation: 现有预训练视觉语言模型（如CLIP）在连续回归任务中受到离散文本提示的限制，需要解决语义空间与连续维度之间的差距问题
AI.method: 1) 将情感空间划分为3x3网格，定义9个情感区域；2) 使用高斯核计算软标签，基于真实坐标与区域中心的欧氏距离；3) 采用CLIP图像编码器和音频频谱变换器提取特征；4) 通过门控循环单元进行时序建模；5) 使用层次融合方案整合跨模态注意力
AI.result: 在Aff-Wild2数据集上的实验表明，该语义引导方法显著提升了情感识别的准确性，在无约束的"野外"场景中取得了竞争性性能
AI.conclusion: 提出的距离感知软提示学习框架有效弥合了语义空间与连续维度之间的差距，为自然环境下情感分析提供了有效的多模态解决方案

title: The Institutional Scaling Law: Non-Monotonic Fitness, Capability-Trust Divergence, and Symbiogenetic Scaling in Generative AI
summary: Classical scaling laws model AI performance as monotonically improving with model size. We challenge this assumption by deriving the Institutional Scaling Law, showing that institutional fitness -- jointly measuring capability, trust, affordability, and sovereignty -- is non-monotonic in model scale, with an environment-dependent optimum N*(epsilon). Our framework extends the Sustainability Index of Han et al. (2025) from hardware-level to ecosystem-level analysis, proving that capability and trust formally diverge beyond critical scale (Capability-Trust Divergence). We further derive a Symbiogenetic Scaling correction demonstrating that orchestrated systems of domain-specific models can outperform frontier generalists in their native deployment environments. These results are contextualized within a formal evolutionary taxonomy of generative AI spanning five eras (1943-present), with analysis of frontier lab dynamics, sovereign AI emergence, and post-training alignment evolution from RLHF through GRPO. The Institutional Scaling Law predicts that the next phase transition will be driven not by larger models but by better-orchestrated systems of domain-specific models adapted to specific institutional niches.
