AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统AI扩展定律，提出了机构扩展定律，表明机构适应性（能力、信任、可负担性、主权）与模型规模呈非单调关系，存在环境依赖的最优规模。研究发现能力与信任在超过临界规模后会正式分离，并证明协调的领域特定模型系统可以超越前沿通用模型。
AI.motivation: 传统AI扩展定律认为AI性能随模型规模单调提升，但本文作者质疑这一假设，认为需要考虑机构适应性（能力、信任、可负担性、主权）的综合影响，这些因素与模型规模并非简单的单调关系。
AI.method: 作者推导了机构扩展定律，将Han等人（2025）的可持续性指数从硬件层面扩展到生态系统层面分析，证明了能力与信任在超过临界规模后的正式分离。进一步推导了共生扩展修正，展示了协调的领域特定模型系统如何在其原生部署环境中超越前沿通用模型。
AI.result: 研究发现机构适应性是模型规模的非单调函数，存在环境依赖的最优规模N*(epsilon)。能力与信任在超过临界规模后会正式分离（能力-信任分离）。协调的领域特定模型系统在其原生部署环境中可以超越前沿通用模型。
AI.conclusion: 下一阶段的AI发展将由更好协调的领域特定模型系统驱动，而非更大的模型。这些系统将适应特定的机构生态位，标志着从追求更大通用模型向协调专业模型系统的转变。

title: MIBench: Evaluating LMMs on Multimodal Interaction
summary: In different multimodal scenarios, it needs to integrate and utilize information across modalities in a specific way based on the demands of the task. Different integration ways between modalities are referred to as "multimodal interaction". How well a model handles various multimodal interactions largely characterizes its multimodal ability. In this paper, we introduce MIBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the multimodal interaction capabilities of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs), which formulates each instance as a (con_v , con_t, task) triplet with contexts from vision and text, necessitating that LMMs employ correct forms of multimodal interaction to effectively complete the task. MIBench assesses models from three key aspects: the ability to source information from vision-centric or text-centric cues, and the ability to generate new information from their joint synergy. Each interaction capability is evaluated hierarchically across three cognitive levels: Recognition, Understanding, and Reasoning. MIBench comprises over 10,000 vision-text context pairs spanning 32 distinct tasks. Evaluation of state-of-the-art LMMs show that: (1) LMMs' ability on multimodal interaction remains constrained, despite the scaling of model parameters and training data; (2) they are easily distracted by textual modalities when processing vision information; (3) they mostly possess a basic capacity for multimodal synergy; and (4) natively trained multimodal models show noticeable deficits in fundamental interaction ability. We expect that these observations can serve as a reference for developing LMMs with more enhanced multimodal ability in the future.

AI.tldr: MIBench是一个评估大型多模态模型多模态交互能力的综合基准，包含超过10,000个视觉-文本上下文对，涵盖32个任务，从三个关键方面和三个认知层次评估模型能力。
AI.motivation: 不同多模态场景需要基于任务需求以特定方式整合和利用跨模态信息，模型处理各种多模态交互的能力很大程度上表征了其多模态能力。目前缺乏系统评估大型多模态模型多模态交互能力的基准。
AI.method: 提出MIBench基准，将每个实例构建为(视觉上下文, 文本上下文, 任务)三元组，要求模型采用正确的多模态交互形式完成任务。从三个关键方面评估：从视觉中心或文本中心线索获取信息的能力，以及从两者联合协同生成新信息的能力。每个交互能力在三个认知层次上分层评估：识别、理解和推理。
AI.result: 评估最先进的大型多模态模型发现：(1)尽管模型参数和训练数据规模扩大，模型在多模态交互方面的能力仍然受限；(2)在处理视觉信息时容易受到文本模态的干扰；(3)大多具备基本的多模态协同能力；(4)原生训练的多模态模型在基本交互能力方面存在明显缺陷。
AI.conclusion: MIBench为评估大型多模态模型的多模态交互能力提供了全面基准，揭示了当前模型的局限性，这些观察可为未来开发具有更强大多模态能力的大型多模态模型提供参考。

title: AI Can Learn Scientific Taste
summary: Great scientists have strong judgement and foresight, closely tied to what we call scientific taste. Here, we use the term to refer to the capacity to judge and propose research ideas with high potential impact. However, most relative research focuses on improving an AI scientist's executive capability, while enhancing an AI's scientific taste remains underexplored. In this work, we propose Reinforcement Learning from Community Feedback (RLCF), a training paradigm that uses large-scale community signals as supervision, and formulate scientific taste learning as a preference modeling and alignment problem. For preference modeling, we train Scientific Judge on 700K field- and time-matched pairs of high- vs. low-citation papers to judge ideas. For preference alignment, using Scientific Judge as a reward model, we train a policy model, Scientific Thinker, to propose research ideas with high potential impact. Experiments show Scientific Judge outperforms SOTA LLMs (e.g., GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Pro) and generalizes to future-year test, unseen fields, and peer-review preference. Furthermore, Scientific Thinker proposes research ideas with higher potential impact than baselines. Our findings show that AI can learn scientific taste, marking a key step toward reaching human-level AI scientists.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了RLCF训练范式，通过社区反馈强化学习来训练AI的科学品味，包括Scientific Judge模型用于判断研究想法潜力，以及Scientific Thinker模型用于提出高影响力研究想法。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注提升AI科学家的执行能力，而如何增强AI的科学品味（判断和提出高潜力研究想法的能力）仍未被充分探索。科学品味是伟大科学家的关键特质，对推动科学发展至关重要。
AI.method: 提出RLCF训练范式，将科学品味学习建模为偏好建模和对齐问题：1）偏好建模：训练Scientific Judge模型，使用70万对高引用vs低引用论文数据进行判断；2）偏好对齐：以Scientific Judge作为奖励模型，训练Scientific Thinker策略模型来提出高潜力研究想法。
AI.result: Scientific Judge在多个方面优于SOTA LLMs（如GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Pro），能够泛化到未来年份测试、未见领域和同行评审偏好。Scientific Thinker提出的研究想法比基线模型具有更高的潜在影响力。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明AI可以学习科学品味，这是实现人类水平AI科学家的关键一步。RLCF范式为AI科学品味学习提供了有效框架，展示了通过大规模社区信号监督训练AI科学判断能力的可行性。

title: An Alternative Trajectory for Generative AI
summary:
The generative artificial intelligence (AI) ecosystem is undergoing rapid transformations that threaten its sustainability. As models transition from research prototypes to high-traffic products, the energetic burden has shifted from one-time training to recurring, unbounded inference. This is exacerbated by reasoning models that inflate compute costs by orders of magnitude per query. The prevailing pursuit of artificial general intelligence through scaling of monolithic models is colliding with hard physical constraints: grid failures, water consumption, and diminishing returns on data scaling. This trajectory yields models with impressive factual recall but struggles in domains requiring in-depth reasoning, possibly due to insufficient abstractions in training data.
  Current large language models (LLMs) exhibit genuine reasoning depth only in domains like mathematics and coding, where rigorous, pre-existing abstractions provide structural grounding. In other fields, the current approach fails to generalize well. We propose an alternative trajectory based on domain-specific superintelligence (DSS). We argue for first constructing explicit symbolic abstractions (knowledge graphs, ontologies, and formal logic) to underpin synthetic curricula enabling small language models to master domain-specific reasoning without the model collapse problem typical of LLM-based synthetic data methods.
  Rather than a single generalist giant model, we envision "societies of DSS models": dynamic ecosystems where orchestration agents route tasks to distinct DSS back-ends. This paradigm shift decouples capability from size, enabling intelligence to migrate from energy-intensive data centers to secure, on-device experts. By aligning algorithmic progress with physical constraints, DSS societies move generative AI from an environmental liability to a sustainable force for economic empowerment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用领域特定超智能替代当前追求通用人工智能的规模化路径，通过构建显式符号抽象来支持小型语言模型掌握领域推理，形成"DSS模型社会"生态系统，实现可持续AI发展。
AI.motivation: 当前生成式AI生态系统面临可持续性危机：模型从研究原型转向高流量产品后，能耗负担从一次性训练转移到持续无界的推理；推理模型使计算成本呈数量级增长；追求通用人工智能的规模化路径面临电网故障、水资源消耗和数据规模收益递减等物理约束；现有大语言模型仅在数学和编码等具有严格抽象结构的领域表现出真正推理深度。
AI.method: 提出领域特定超智能方法：首先构建显式符号抽象（知识图谱、本体论和形式逻辑），为合成课程提供基础；使用这些抽象支持小型语言模型掌握领域特定推理，避免基于LLM的合成数据方法常见的模型崩溃问题；建立"DSS模型社会"动态生态系统，由编排代理将任务路由到不同的DSS后端。
AI.result: 该方法将能力与模型大小解耦，使智能从能源密集型数据中心迁移到安全的设备端专家；通过将算法进展与物理约束对齐，使生成式AI从环境负担转变为可持续的经济赋能力量。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定超智能范式通过构建显式符号抽象和形成DSS模型社会生态系统，为生成式AI提供了可持续的发展路径，解决了当前规模化方法面临的物理约束和推理深度不足的问题，实现了从环境负担到经济赋能的转变。

title: A Deformable Attention-Based Detection Transformer with Cross-Scale Feature Fusion for Industrial Coil Spring Inspection
summary: Automated visual inspection of locomotive coil springs presents significant challenges due to the morphological diversity of surface defects, substantial scale variations, and complex industrial backgrounds. This paper proposes MSD-DETR (Multi-Scale Deformable Detection Transformer), a novel detection framework that addresses these challenges through three key innovations: (1) a structural re-parameterization strategy that decouples training-time multi-branch topology from inference-time efficiency, enhancing feature extraction while maintaining real-time performance; (2) a deformable attention mechanism that enables content-adaptive spatial sampling, allowing dynamic focus on defect-relevant regions regardless of morphological irregularity; and (3) a cross-scale feature fusion architecture incorporating GSConv modules and VoVGSCSP blocks for effective multi-resolution information aggregation. Comprehensive experiments on a real-world locomotive coil spring dataset demonstrate that MSD-DETR achieves 92.4\% mAP@0.5 at 98 FPS, outperforming state-of-the-art detectors including YOLOv8 (+3.1\% mAP) and the baseline RT-DETR (+2.8\% mAP) while maintaining comparable inference speed, establishing a new benchmark for industrial coil spring quality inspection.

AI.tldr: MSD-DETR是一种用于机车螺旋弹簧表面缺陷检测的新型Transformer框架，通过结构重参数化、可变形注意力机制和跨尺度特征融合，在保持实时性能的同时实现了92.4% mAP@0.5的高精度检测。
AI.motivation: 机车螺旋弹簧的自动化视觉检测面临三大挑战：表面缺陷形态多样、尺度变化大、工业背景复杂。现有检测方法难以同时满足高精度和实时性的工业需求。
AI.method: 提出MSD-DETR框架，包含三个关键技术：1）结构重参数化策略，分离训练时的多分支拓扑与推理时的效率；2）可变形注意力机制，实现内容自适应的空间采样；3）跨尺度特征融合架构，集成GSConv模块和VoVGSCSP块进行多分辨率信息聚合。
AI.result: 在真实机车螺旋弹簧数据集上的实验表明，MSD-DETR达到92.4% mAP@0.5和98 FPS，优于YOLOv8（+3.1% mAP）和基线RT-DETR（+2.8% mAP），同时保持相当的推理速度。
AI.conclusion: MSD-DETR为工业螺旋弹簧质量检测设立了新的性能基准，有效解决了形态多样性、尺度变化和复杂背景的挑战，实现了精度与速度的平衡。

title: Infinite Problem Generator: Verifiably Scaling Physics Reasoning Data with Agentic Workflows
summary: Training large language models for complex reasoning is bottlenecked by the scarcity of verifiable, high-quality data. In domains like physics, standard text augmentation often introduces hallucinations, while static benchmarks lack the reasoning traces required for fine-tuning. We introduce the Infinite Problem Generator (IPG), an agentic framework that synthesizes physics problems with guaranteed solvability through a Formula-as-Code paradigm. Unlike probabilistic text generation, IPG constructs solutions as executable Python programs, enforcing strict mathematical consistency. As a proof-of-concept, we release ClassicalMechanicsV1, a high-fidelity corpus of 1,335 classical mechanics problems expanded from 165 expert seeds. The corpus demonstrates high structural diversity, spanning 102 unique physical formulas with an average complexity of 3.05 formulas per problem. Furthermore, we identify a Complexity Blueprint, demonstrating a strong linear correlation ($R^2 \approx 0.95$) between formula count and verification code length. This relationship establishes code complexity as a precise, proxy-free metric for problem difficulty, enabling controllable curriculum generation. We release the full IPG pipeline, the ClassicalMechanicsV1 dataset, and our evaluation report to support reproducible research in reasoning-intensive domains.

AI.tldr: IPG框架通过公式即代码范式生成可验证的物理问题，解决了高质量训练数据稀缺问题，并建立了问题复杂度与代码长度的强相关性。
AI.motivation: 训练大型语言模型进行复杂推理时面临可验证高质量数据稀缺的问题，特别是在物理等领域，传统文本增强方法容易产生幻觉，而静态基准测试缺乏微调所需的推理轨迹。
AI.method: 提出无限问题生成器（IPG）框架，采用公式即代码范式，通过构建可执行的Python程序来合成物理问题，确保严格的数学一致性。作为概念验证，发布了包含1,335个经典力学问题的ClassicalMechanicsV1语料库。
AI.result: 生成的语料库具有高结构多样性，涵盖102个独特的物理公式，平均每个问题包含3.05个公式。发现复杂度蓝图，显示公式数量与验证代码长度之间存在强线性相关性（R²≈0.95），代码复杂度可作为问题难度的精确度量。
AI.conclusion: IPG框架能够生成具有保证可解性的物理问题，建立了代码复杂度作为问题难度的可靠度量，支持可控课程生成，为推理密集型领域的研究提供了可复现的工具和数据集。

title: Relationship-Aware Safety Unlearning for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Generative multimodal models can exhibit safety failures that are inherently relational: two benign concepts can become unsafe when linked by a specific action or relation (e.g., child-drinking-wine). Existing unlearning and concept-erasure approaches often target isolated concepts or image-text pairs, which can cause collateral damage to benign uses of the same objects and relations. We propose relationship-aware safety unlearning: a framework that explicitly represents unsafe object-relation-object (O-R-O) tuples and applies targeted parameter-efficient edits (LoRA) to suppress unsafe tuples while preserving object marginals and safe neighboring relations. We include CLIP-based experiments and robustness evaluation under paraphrase, contextual, and out-of-distribution image attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出关系感知安全遗忘框架，针对多模态生成模型中对象-关系-对象三元组的安全问题，使用参数高效编辑技术抑制不安全关系同时保留对象和邻近安全关系
AI.motivation: 现有生成多模态模型存在关系性安全失败问题：两个良性概念通过特定动作或关系组合可能变得不安全。现有的遗忘和概念擦除方法通常针对孤立概念或图像-文本对，可能对相同对象和关系的良性使用造成附带损害。
AI.method: 提出关系感知安全遗忘框架：1）明确表示不安全对象-关系-对象三元组；2）应用针对性的参数高效编辑技术（LoRA）来抑制不安全三元组；3）同时保留对象边缘分布和邻近安全关系。
AI.result: 包括基于CLIP的实验和在释义、上下文和分布外图像攻击下的鲁棒性评估。
AI.conclusion: 关系感知安全遗忘框架能够有效处理多模态生成模型中的关系性安全问题，通过针对性编辑抑制不安全关系组合，同时最小化对良性使用的影响。

title: MALicious INTent Dataset and Inoculating LLMs for Enhanced Disinformation Detection
comment: Paper accepted to EACL 2026 Main Conference
summary: The intentional creation and spread of disinformation poses a significant threat to public discourse. However, existing English datasets and research rarely address the intentionality behind the disinformation. This work presents MALINT, the first human-annotated English corpus developed in collaboration with expert fact-checkers to capture disinformation and its malicious intent. We utilize our novel corpus to benchmark 12 language models, including small language models (SLMs) such as BERT and large language models (LLMs) like Llama 3.3, on binary and multilabel intent classification tasks. Moreover, inspired by inoculation theory from psychology and communication studies, we investigate whether incorporating knowledge of malicious intent can improve disinformation detection. To this end, we propose intent-based inoculation, an intent-augmented reasoning for LLMs that integrates intent analysis to mitigate the persuasive impact of disinformation. Analysis on six disinformation datasets, five LLMs, and seven languages shows that intent-augmented reasoning improves zero-shot disinformation detection. To support research in intent-aware disinformation detection, we release the MALINT dataset with annotations from each annotation step.

AI.tldr: MALINT是首个由专家事实核查员标注的英文语料库，专门捕捉虚假信息及其恶意意图，用于基准测试语言模型在意图分类任务上的表现，并提出基于意图的"接种"方法提升虚假信息检测效果。
AI.motivation: 现有英文数据集和研究很少关注虚假信息背后的意图性，而恶意意图的创建和传播对公共话语构成重大威胁，需要专门的语料库和检测方法来应对这一问题。
AI.method: 1) 创建MALINT语料库，与专家事实核查员合作进行人工标注；2) 在12个语言模型上基准测试二元和多标签意图分类任务；3) 提出意图增强推理方法，将意图分析整合到LLMs中，基于心理学和传播学的接种理论来减轻虚假信息的说服力影响。
AI.result: 1) 在6个虚假信息数据集、5个LLMs和7种语言上的分析表明，意图增强推理能提升零样本虚假信息检测效果；2) 发布了包含各标注步骤注释的MALINT数据集。
AI.conclusion: 恶意意图是虚假信息的重要维度，MALINT语料库填补了现有研究的空白，意图增强推理方法能有效提升虚假信息检测能力，为意图感知的虚假信息检测研究提供了支持。

title: Memory as Asset: From Agent-centric to Human-centric Memory Management
summary: We proudly introduce Memory-as-Asset, a new memory paradigm towards human-centric artificial general intelligence (AGI). In this paper, we formally emphasize that human-centric, personal memory management is a prerequisite for complementing the collective knowledge of existing large language models (LLMs) and extending their knowledge boundaries through self-evolution. We introduce three key features that shape the Memory-as-Asset era: (1) Memory in Hand, which emphasizes human-centric ownership to maximize benefits to humans; (2) Memory Group, which provides collaborative knowledge formation to avoid memory islands, and (3) Collective Memory Evolution, which enables continuous knowledge growth to extend the boundary of knowledge towards AGI. We finally give a potential three-layer memory infrastructure to facilitate the Memory-as-Asset paradigm, with fast personal memory storage, an intelligent evolution layer, and a decentralized memory exchange network. Together, these components outline a foundational architecture in which personal memories become persistent digital assets that can be accumulated, shared, and evolved over time. We believe this paradigm provides a promising path toward scalable, human-centric AGI systems that continuously grow through the collective experiences of individuals and intelligent agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Memory-as-Asset"新范式，将个人记忆作为数字资产管理，通过三层架构实现记忆的积累、共享和演化，推动以人为本的通用人工智能发展。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型主要依赖集体知识，缺乏个人记忆管理能力。为实现以人为本的通用人工智能，需要将个人记忆作为数字资产进行管理，补充集体知识并扩展知识边界。
AI.method: 提出Memory-as-Asset范式，包含三个关键特征：Memory in Hand（以人为本的所有权）、Memory Group（协作知识形成）、Collective Memory Evolution（集体记忆演化）。设计三层基础设施：快速个人记忆存储层、智能演化层、去中心化记忆交换网络。
AI.result: 构建了一个基础架构框架，使个人记忆能够成为持久的数字资产，可以随时间积累、共享和演化，为实现可扩展的、以人为本的AGI系统提供了可行路径。
AI.conclusion: Memory-as-Asset范式为构建以人为本的通用人工智能系统提供了有前景的路径，通过个人和智能代理的集体经验实现持续成长，推动AGI知识边界的扩展。

title: CtrlAttack: A Unified Attack on World-Model Control in Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion-based image-to-video (I2V) models increasingly exhibit world-model-like properties by implicitly capturing temporal dynamics. However, existing studies have mainly focused on visual quality and controllability, and the robustness of the state transition learned by the model remains understudied. To fill this gap, we are the first to analyze the vulnerability of I2V models, find that temporal control mechanisms constitute a new attack surface, and reveal the challenge of modeling them uniformly under different attack settings. Based on this, we propose a trajectory-control attack, called CtrlAttack, to interfere with state evolution during the generation process. Specifically, we represent the perturbation as a low-dimensional velocity field and construct a continuous displacement field via temporal integration, thereby affecting the model's state transitions while maintaining temporal consistency; meanwhile, we map the perturbation to the observation space, making the method applicable to both white-box and black-box attack settings. Experimental results show that even under low-dimensional and strongly regularized perturbation constraints, our method can still significantly disrupt temporal consistency by increasing the attack success rate (ASR) to over 90% in the white-box setting and over 80% in the black-box setting, while keeping the variation of the FID and FVD within 6 and 130, respectively, thus revealing the potential security risk of I2V models at the level of state dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文首次分析了图像到视频（I2V）扩散模型的脆弱性，发现时间控制机制构成新的攻击面，并提出轨迹控制攻击CtrlAttack来干扰生成过程中的状态演化。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注I2V模型的视觉质量和可控性，但对模型学习到的状态转移的鲁棒性研究不足。本文旨在填补这一空白，分析I2V模型的脆弱性，揭示其在状态动力学层面的安全风险。
AI.method: 提出轨迹控制攻击CtrlAttack：将扰动表示为低维速度场，通过时间积分构建连续位移场，在保持时间一致性的同时影响模型的状态转移；同时将扰动映射到观测空间，使方法适用于白盒和黑盒攻击设置。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，即使在低维和强正则化扰动约束下，该方法仍能显著破坏时间一致性：白盒设置下攻击成功率超过90%，黑盒设置下超过80%，同时保持FID和FVD的变化分别在6和130以内。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了I2V模型在状态动力学层面的潜在安全风险，时间控制机制构成新的攻击面，需要加强对这类模型鲁棒性的研究。

title: Multilingual TinyStories: A Synthetic Combinatorial Corpus of Indic Children's Stories for Training Small Language Models
summary: The development of robust language models for low-resource languages is frequently bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality, coherent, and domain-appropriate training corpora. In this paper, we introduce the Multilingual TinyStories dataset, a large-scale, synthetically generated collection of children's stories encompassing 17 Indian languages. Designed specifically for the training and evaluation of Small Language Models (SLMs), the corpus provides simple, narrative-driven text strictly localized to native scripts. We detail our hybrid curation pipeline, which leverages the Sarvam-M language model and a novel combinatorial prompt engineering framework for native generation, coupled with the Google Translate API for large-scale cross-lingual expansion. Through strict programmatic filtering, we compiled 132,942 stories and over 93.9 million tokens in our release, serving as a foundational resource for multilingual language modeling and transfer learning in the Indic linguistic sphere.

AI.tldr: 提出了Multilingual TinyStories数据集，这是一个包含17种印度语言的大规模合成儿童故事数据集，专门用于训练和评估小型语言模型。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言的语言模型开发经常受到高质量、连贯且领域适当的训练语料库稀缺的瓶颈制约，特别是在印度语言领域。
AI.method: 采用混合策展流程，利用Sarvam-M语言模型和创新的组合提示工程框架进行本地生成，结合Google Translate API进行大规模跨语言扩展，并通过严格的程序化过滤。
AI.result: 编译了132,942个故事，超过9390万个标记，为印度语言领域的多语言建模和迁移学习提供了基础资源。
AI.conclusion: Multilingual TinyStories数据集为低资源印度语言的小型语言模型训练和评估提供了高质量、本地化的合成语料库，填补了该领域的资源空白。

title: Agentic DAG-Orchestrated Planner Framework for Multi-Modal, Multi-Hop Question Answering in Hybrid Data Lakes
summary: Enterprises increasingly need natural language (NL) question answering over hybrid data lakes that combine structured tables and unstructured documents. Current deployed solutions, including RAG-based systems, typically rely on brute-force retrieval from each store and post-hoc merging. Such approaches are inefficient and leaky, and more critically, they lack explicit support for multi-hop reasoning, where a query is decomposed into successive steps (hops) that may traverse back and forth between structured and unstructured sources. We present Agentic DAG-Orchestrated Transformer (A.DOT) Planner, a framework for multi-modal, multi-hop question answering, that compiles user NL queries into directed acyclic graph (DAG) execution plans spanning both structured and unstructured stores. The system decomposes queries into parallelizable sub-queries, incorporates schema-aware reasoning, and applies both structural and semantic validation before execution. The execution engine adheres to the generated DAG plan to coordinate concurrent retrieval across heterogeneous sources, route intermediate outputs to dependent sub-queries, and merge final results in strict accordance with the plan's logical dependencies. Advanced caching mechanisms, incorporating paraphrase-aware template matching, enable the system to detect equivalent queries and reuse prior DAG execution plans for rapid re-execution, while the DataOps System addresses validation feedback or execution errors. The proposed framework not only improves accuracy and latency, but also produces explicit evidence trails, enabling verification of retrieved content, tracing of data lineage, and fostering user trust in the system's outputs. On benchmark dataset, A.DOT achieves 14.8% absolute gain in correctness and 10.7% in completeness over baselines.

AI.tldr: A.DOT Planner是一个用于混合数据湖（结构化表格+非结构化文档）多模态多跳问答的框架，通过将自然语言查询编译为DAG执行计划，显著提升准确性和完整性。
AI.motivation: 企业需要从混合数据湖（结构化表格+非结构化文档）进行自然语言问答。现有RAG方案存在效率低、信息遗漏问题，且缺乏对多跳推理的显式支持，无法在结构化与非结构化源之间来回遍历。
AI.method: 提出Agentic DAG-Orchestrated Transformer (A.DOT) Planner框架：1) 将用户NL查询编译为跨越结构化与非结构化存储的DAG执行计划；2) 将查询分解为可并行执行的子查询；3) 包含模式感知推理；4) 执行前进行结构和语义验证；5) 执行引擎按DAG计划协调异构源并发检索；6) 高级缓存机制（含释义感知模板匹配）检测等价查询并重用DAG计划；7) DataOps系统处理验证反馈或执行错误。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上，A.DOT相比基线方法在正确性方面获得14.8%的绝对提升，在完整性方面获得10.7%的绝对提升。同时提高了准确性、延迟性能，并生成显式证据轨迹，支持内容验证、数据溯源和用户信任。
AI.conclusion: A.DOT Planner框架通过DAG执行计划有效解决了混合数据湖多模态多跳问答问题，显著优于现有方案，同时提供可验证的证据轨迹，增强了系统的可信度。

title: Vision-Language Based Expert Reporting for Painting Authentication and Defect Detection
comment: Submitted to Journal of Cultural Heritage
summary: Authenticity and condition assessment are central to conservation decision-making, yet interpretation and reporting of thermographic output remain largely bespoke and expert-dependent, complicating comparison across collections and limiting systematic integration into conservation documentation. Pulsed Active Infrared Thermography (AIRT) is sensitive to subsurface features such as material heterogeneity, voids, and past interventions; however, its broader adoption is constrained by artifact misinterpretation, inter-laboratory variability, and the absence of standardized, explainable reporting frameworks. Although multi-modal thermographic processing techniques are established, their integration with structured natural-language interpretation has not been explored in cultural heritage. A fully automated thermography-vision-language model (VLM) framework is presented. It combines multi-modal AIRT analysis with modality-aware textual reporting, without human intervention during inference. Thermal sequences are processed using Principal Component Thermography (PCT), Thermographic Signal Reconstruction (TSR), and Pulsed Phase Thermography (PPT), and the resulting anomaly masks are fused into a consensus segmentation that emphasizes regions supported by multiple thermal indicators while mitigating boundary artifacts. The fused evidence is provided to a VLM, which generates structured reports describing the location of the anomaly, thermal behavior, and plausible physical interpretations while explicitly acknowledging the uncertainty and diagnostic limitations. Evaluation on two marquetries demonstrates consistent anomaly detection and stable structured interpretations, indicating reproducibility and generalizability across samples.

AI.tldr: 提出全自动热成像-视觉-语言模型框架，结合多模态主动红外热成像分析与模态感知文本报告，用于文化遗产保护中的真实性和状况评估
AI.motivation: 文化遗产保护中的真实性和状况评估需要标准化和可解释的报告框架，当前热成像技术存在解释依赖专家、实验室间差异大、缺乏系统化集成等问题
AI.method: 使用全自动热成像-视觉-语言模型框架，结合主成分热成像、热成像信号重建和脉冲相位热成像处理热序列，生成共识分割掩码，通过视觉语言模型生成结构化报告
AI.result: 在两个镶嵌工艺品上评估显示一致的异常检测和稳定的结构化解释，表明该方法具有可重复性和跨样本的泛化能力
AI.conclusion: 该框架为文化遗产保护提供了标准化、可解释的热成像报告方法，有助于跨收藏比较和系统集成到保护文档中

title: Top-b: Entropic Regulation of Relative Probability Bands in Autoregressive Language Processes
summary: Probabilistic language generators are theoretically modeled as discrete stochastic processes, yet standard decoding strategies (Top-k, Top-p) impose static truncation rules that fail to accommodate the dynamic information density of natural language. This misalignment often forces a suboptimal trade-off: static bounds are either too restrictive for high-entropy creative generation or too permissive for low-entropy logical reasoning. In this work, we formalize the generation process as a trajectory through a relative probability manifold. We introduce Top-b (Adaptive Relative Band Sampling), a decoding strategy that regulates the candidate set via a dynamic bandwidth coefficient coupled strictly to the instantaneous Shannon entropy of the model's distribution. We provide a theoretical framework demonstrating that Top-b acts as a variance-minimizing operator on the tail distribution. Empirical validation on GPQA and GSM8K benchmarks indicates that Top-b significantly reduces generation entropy and inter-decoding variance while maintaining competitive reasoning accuracy, effectively approximating a self-regulating control system for autoregressive generation.

AI.tldr: Top-b解码策略：基于模型瞬时熵的动态带宽采样方法，解决传统静态截断策略在信息密度变化时的局限性
AI.motivation: 传统解码策略（Top-k、Top-p）采用静态截断规则，无法适应自然语言动态变化的信息密度，导致在高熵创造性生成和低熵逻辑推理之间做出次优权衡
AI.method: 将生成过程形式化为相对概率流形中的轨迹，提出Top-b（自适应相对带采样）解码策略，通过动态带宽系数严格耦合模型分布的瞬时香农熵来调节候选集
AI.result: 在GPQA和GSM8K基准测试中，Top-b显著降低生成熵和解码间方差，同时保持有竞争力的推理准确率
AI.conclusion: Top-b作为自回归生成的自调节控制系统，在理论上作为尾部分布的方差最小化算子，有效解决了静态解码策略的局限性

title: Why Do LLM-based Web Agents Fail? A Hierarchical Planning Perspective
summary: Large language model (LLM) web agents are increasingly used for web navigation but remain far from human reliability on realistic, long-horizon tasks. Existing evaluations focus primarily on end-to-end success, offering limited insight into where failures arise. We propose a hierarchical planning framework to analyze web agents across three layers (i.e., high-level planning, low-level execution, and replanning), enabling process-based evaluation of reasoning, grounding, and recovery. Our experiments show that structured Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) plans produce more concise and goal-directed strategies than natural language (NL) plans, but low-level execution remains the dominant bottleneck. These results indicate that improving perceptual grounding and adaptive control, not only high-level reasoning, is critical for achieving human-level reliability. This hierarchical perspective provides a principled foundation for diagnosing and advancing LLM web agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出分层规划框架分析LLM网页代理，发现结构化PDDL计划比自然语言计划更有效，但低级执行仍是主要瓶颈，需要改进感知基础和自适应控制。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM网页代理在现实长时程任务中可靠性远低于人类，现有评估主要关注端到端成功率，对失败原因分析有限，需要更细粒度的过程评估方法。
AI.method: 提出分层规划框架，从三个层次分析网页代理：高级规划、低级执行和重新规划，使用PDDL结构化计划与自然语言计划对比，进行过程式评估。
AI.result: 结构化PDDL计划比自然语言计划产生更简洁、目标导向的策略，但低级执行仍是主要瓶颈，感知基础和自适应控制是提升可靠性的关键。
AI.conclusion: 分层视角为诊断和推进LLM网页代理提供了原则性基础，改进不仅需要高级推理，更需要增强感知基础和自适应控制能力。

title: Draft-and-Target Sampling for Video Generation Policy
summary: Video generation models have been used as a robot policy to predict the future states of executing a task conditioned on task description and observation. Previous works ignore their high computational cost and long inference time. To address this challenge, we propose Draft-and-Target Sampling, a novel diffusion inference paradigm for video generation policy that is training-free and can improve inference efficiency. We introduce a self-play denoising approach by utilizing two complementary denoising trajectories in a single model, draft sampling takes large steps to generate a global trajectory in a fast manner and target sampling takes small steps to verify it. To further speedup generation, we introduce token chunking and progressive acceptance strategy to reduce redundant computation. Experiments on three benchmarks show that our method can achieve up to 2.1x speedup and improve the efficiency of current state-of-the-art methods with minimal compromise to the success rate. Our code is available.

AI.tldr: 提出Draft-and-Target Sampling，一种用于视频生成机器人策略的新型扩散推理范式，通过训练免费的方法提高推理效率，实现最高2.1倍加速
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型作为机器人策略时存在高计算成本和长推理时间的问题，需要更高效的推理方法
AI.method: 提出Draft-and-Target Sampling：1）自博弈去噪方法，使用单个模型中的两个互补去噪轨迹；2）草稿采样大步生成全局轨迹，目标采样小步验证；3）引入令牌分块和渐进接受策略减少冗余计算
AI.result: 在三个基准测试中，该方法可实现最高2.1倍加速，在最小化成功率妥协的情况下提高了现有最先进方法的效率
AI.conclusion: Draft-and-Target Sampling是一种有效的训练免费扩散推理范式，显著提高了视频生成机器人策略的推理效率

title: Autonomous Agents Coordinating Distributed Discovery Through Emergent Artifact Exchange
summary: We present ScienceClaw + Infinite, a framework for autonomous scientific investigation in which independent agents conduct research without central coordination, and any contributor can deploy new agents into a shared ecosystem. The system is built around three components: an extensible registry of over 300 interoperable scientific skills, an artifact layer that preserves full computational lineage as a directed acyclic graph (DAG), and a structured platform for agent-based scientific discourse with provenance-aware governance. Agents select and chain tools based on their scientific profiles, produce immutable artifacts with typed metadata and parent lineage, and broadcast unsatisfied information needs to a shared global index. The ArtifactReactor enables plannerless coordination: peer agents discover and fulfill open needs through pressure-based scoring, while schema-overlap matching triggers multi-parent synthesis across independent analyses. An autonomous mutation layer actively prunes the expanding artifact DAG to resolve conflicting or redundant workflows, while persistent memory allows agents to continuously build upon complex epistemic states across multiple cycles. Infinite converts these outputs into auditable scientific records through structured posts, provenance views, and machine-readable discourse relations, with community feedback steering subsequent investigation cycles. Across four autonomous investigations, peptide design for the somatostatin receptor SSTR2, lightweight impact-resistant ceramic screening, cross-domain resonance bridging biology, materials, and music, and formal analogy construction between urban morphology and grain-boundary evolution, the framework demonstrates heterogeneous tool chaining, emergent convergence among independently operating agents, and traceable reasoning from raw computation to published finding.

AI.tldr: ScienceClaw + Infinite是一个自主科学研究框架，支持独立智能体在无中心协调下进行研究，任何贡献者都可部署新智能体到共享生态系统中。
AI.motivation: 旨在创建自主科学研究的生态系统，使独立智能体能够协作进行科学研究，通过去中心化方式加速科学发现过程。
AI.method: 基于三个核心组件：包含300+可互操作科学技能的可扩展注册表、保存完整计算谱系的有向无环图（DAG）工件层、以及支持溯源感知治理的基于智能体的结构化科学讨论平台。智能体根据科学配置文件选择和链接工具，产生带有类型化元数据和父系谱系的不可变工件，并通过压力评分实现无规划协调。
AI.result: 在四个自主研究案例中展示了异构工具链接、独立操作智能体间的涌现收敛性，以及从原始计算到发表发现的追踪推理能力，包括SSTR2受体肽设计、轻质抗冲击陶瓷筛选、跨域共振桥接、以及城市形态与晶界演化之间的形式类比构建。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功实现了自主科学研究的生态系统，支持异构工具链接、智能体间涌现协调，并提供了从计算到科学发现的完整可追溯性，为去中心化科学研究提供了新的范式。

title: LADR: Locality-Aware Dynamic Rescue for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation with Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Discrete Diffusion Language Models have emerged as a compelling paradigm for unified multimodal generation, yet their deployment is hindered by high inference latency arising from iterative decoding. Existing acceleration strategies often require expensive re-training or fail to leverage the 2D spatial redundancy inherent in visual data. To address this, we propose Locality-Aware Dynamic Rescue (LADR), a training-free method that expedites inference by exploiting the spatial Markov property of images. LADR prioritizes the recovery of tokens at the ''generation frontier'', regions spatially adjacent to observed pixels, thereby maximizing information gain. Specifically, our method integrates morphological neighbor identification to locate candidate tokens, employs a risk-bounded filtering mechanism to prevent error propagation, and utilizes manifold-consistent inverse scheduling to align the diffusion trajectory with the accelerated mask density. Extensive experiments on four text-to-image generation benchmarks demonstrate that our LADR achieves an approximate 4 x speedup over standard baselines. Remarkably, it maintains or even enhances generative fidelity, particularly in spatial reasoning tasks, offering a state-of-the-art trade-off between efficiency and quality.

AI.tldr: LADR是一种无需训练的加速方法，通过利用图像的空间马尔可夫性质，优先恢复"生成前沿"的token，实现离散扩散语言模型约4倍加速，同时保持甚至提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型在统一多模态生成方面表现出色，但其迭代解码导致高推理延迟。现有加速方法要么需要昂贵的重新训练，要么未能充分利用视觉数据固有的2D空间冗余性。
AI.method: 提出LADR（局部感知动态救援），这是一种无需训练的方法：1）通过形态学邻域识别定位候选token；2）采用风险有界过滤机制防止错误传播；3）使用流形一致逆调度使扩散轨迹与加速掩码密度对齐。
AI.result: 在四个文本到图像生成基准测试中，LADR相比标准基线实现了约4倍的加速。更重要的是，它保持甚至增强了生成保真度，特别是在空间推理任务中。
AI.conclusion: LADR在效率和生成质量之间提供了最先进的权衡，为离散扩散语言模型的实际部署提供了有效的加速解决方案。

title: Contests with Spillovers: Incentivizing Content Creation with GenAI
summary:
The rise of GenAI amplifies the economic phenomenon of positive spillovers. When creators contribute content that can be reused and adapted by Large Language Models (LLMs), each creator's effort can enhance the content quality of others by enabling easy imitation and recombination of existing content. On the one hand, such spillovers create value for the entire ecosystem; on the other hand, they risk undermining creators' incentives to invest genuine effort, as others may freely benefit from their contributions.
  To address this problem, we introduce the Content Creation with Spillovers (CCS) model. In our model, each creator chooses an effort level that, together with the efforts of others, determines her content quality. The platform aims to maximize the social welfare of consumers under stable behavior of the creators (pure Nash equilibrium), but can only observe the resulting qualities and not the underlying efforts. Interestingly, simple mechanisms like winner-takes-all and Tullock lead to the non-existence of equilibrium.
  In response, we propose the parametrized family of Provisional Allocation mechanisms, guaranteeing equilibrium existence and a unique Pareto-dominant equilibrium. While maximizing the social welfare under this family is NP-hard, we develop approximation algorithms that apply to a broad class of spillover structures and provide strong welfare guarantees. Specifically, in the worst-case analysis, we devise efficient algorithms for bounded spillovers and tree-structure spillovers. We also introduce Greedy Cost Selection, a linearithmic time algorithm that achieves approximately optimal results in the average case analysis. Together, our results provide game-theoretic foundations for sustaining human content creation in the era of GenAI.

AI.tldr: 论文提出内容创作溢出模型，分析GenAI时代创作者激励问题，设计保证均衡存在的机制和近似算法
AI.motivation: GenAI放大了内容创作的正向溢出效应：创作者贡献的内容可被LLMs复用和改编，这虽然为整个生态系统创造价值，但也可能削弱创作者投入真实努力的激励，因为他人可以免费从其贡献中获益
AI.method: 引入内容创作溢出模型，提出参数化的临时分配机制保证均衡存在性和唯一帕累托占优均衡；针对社会福利最大化NP难问题，开发近似算法，包括有界溢出和树结构溢出的高效算法，以及线性时间贪心成本选择算法
AI.result: 简单机制如赢家通吃和Tullock会导致均衡不存在；临时分配机制保证均衡存在性和唯一帕累托占优均衡；开发了适用于广泛溢出结构的近似算法，在平均情况分析中实现近似最优结果
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为在GenAI时代维持人类内容创作提供了博弈论基础，通过机制设计和算法解决了创作者激励问题

title: Synthetic Melanoma Image Generation and Evaluation Using Generative Adversarial Networks
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. already accepted to MDPI bioengineering
summary: Melanoma is the most lethal form of skin cancer, and early detection is critical for improving patient outcomes. Although dermoscopy combined with deep learning has advanced automated skin-lesion analysis, progress is hindered by limited access to large, well-annotated datasets and by severe class imbalance, where melanoma images are substantially underrepresented. To address these challenges, we present the first systematic benchmarking study comparing four GAN architectures-DCGAN, StyleGAN2, and two StyleGAN3 variants (T/R)-for high-resolution melanoma-specific synthesis. We train and optimize all models on two expert-annotated benchmarks (ISIC 2018 and ISIC 2020) under unified preprocessing and hyperparameter exploration, with particular attention to R1 regularization tuning. Image quality is assessed through a multi-faceted protocol combining distribution-level metrics (FID), sample-level representativeness (FMD), qualitative dermoscopic inspection, downstream classification with a frozen EfficientNet-based melanoma detector, and independent evaluation by two board-certified dermatologists. StyleGAN2 achieves the best balance of quantitative performance and perceptual quality, attaining FID scores of 24.8 (ISIC 2018) and 7.96 (ISIC 2020) at gamma=0.8. The frozen classifier recognizes 83% of StyleGAN2-generated images as melanoma, while dermatologists distinguish synthetic from real images at only 66.5% accuracy (chance = 50%), with low inter-rater agreement (kappa = 0.17). In a controlled augmentation experiment, adding synthetic melanoma images to address class imbalance improved melanoma detection AUC from 0.925 to 0.945 on a held-out real-image test set. These findings demonstrate that StyleGAN2-generated melanoma images preserve diagnostically relevant features and can provide a measurable benefit for mitigating class imbalance in melanoma-focused machine learning pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次系统比较了四种GAN架构在黑色素瘤图像生成上的性能，发现StyleGAN2在定量指标和感知质量上表现最佳，生成的图像能有效缓解类别不平衡问题，提升下游分类器的检测性能。
AI.motivation: 黑色素瘤是最致命的皮肤癌，早期检测对改善患者预后至关重要。虽然皮肤镜结合深度学习已推进了自动化皮肤病变分析，但进展受到大型、高质量标注数据集访问受限以及严重的类别不平衡（黑色素瘤图像代表性不足）的阻碍。
AI.method: 研究首次系统比较了四种GAN架构（DCGAN、StyleGAN2和两种StyleGAN3变体T/R）在高分辨率黑色素瘤特异性合成上的性能。所有模型在两个专家标注的基准数据集（ISIC 2018和ISIC 2020）上进行统一预处理和超参数探索训练，特别关注R1正则化调优。图像质量通过多层面协议评估：分布级指标（FID）、样本级代表性（FMD）、定性皮肤镜检查、使用冻结的EfficientNet黑色素瘤检测器进行下游分类，以及由两名认证皮肤科医生独立评估。
AI.result: StyleGAN2在定量性能和感知质量上达到最佳平衡，在ISIC 2018和ISIC 2020数据集上分别获得24.8和7.96的FID分数（gamma=0.8）。冻结分类器将83%的StyleGAN2生成图像识别为黑色素瘤，而皮肤科医生区分合成与真实图像的准确率仅为66.5%（机会水平50%），评分者间一致性低（kappa=0.17）。在受控增强实验中，添加合成黑色素瘤图像解决类别不平衡问题后，黑色素瘤检测AUC从0.925提升到0.945。
AI.conclusion: StyleGAN2生成的黑色素瘤图像保留了诊断相关特征，能够为缓解黑色素瘤机器学习流程中的类别不平衡问题提供可测量的益处。这项研究为黑色素瘤图像合成提供了首个系统性基准，证明了生成模型在医学图像分析中的实用价值。

title: Seamless Deception: Larger Language Models Are Better Knowledge Concealers
summary: Language Models (LMs) may acquire harmful knowledge, and yet feign ignorance of these topics when under audit. Inspired by the recent discovery of deception-related behaviour patterns in LMs, we aim to train classifiers that detect when a LM is actively concealing knowledge. Initial findings on smaller models show that classifiers can detect concealment more reliably than human evaluators, with gradient-based concealment proving easier to identify than prompt-based methods. However, contrary to prior work, we find that the classifiers do not reliably generalize to unseen model architectures and topics of hidden knowledge. Most concerningly, the identifiable traces associated with concealment become fainter as the models increase in scale, with the classifiers achieving no better than random performance on any model exceeding 70 billion parameters. Our results expose a key limitation in black-box-only auditing of LMs and highlight the need to develop robust methods to detect models that are actively hiding the knowledge they contain.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现语言模型可能隐藏有害知识，虽然可以训练分类器检测模型是否在主动隐藏知识，但这些分类器无法泛化到未见过的模型架构和主题，且随着模型规模增大，隐藏痕迹会变弱，在超过700亿参数的模型上分类器表现与随机猜测无异。
AI.motivation: 语言模型可能获取有害知识并在审计时假装无知，受最近发现的语言模型欺骗行为模式启发，研究者希望开发能够检测模型是否在主动隐藏知识的分类器。
AI.method: 训练分类器来检测语言模型是否在隐藏知识，比较了梯度基和提示基的隐藏方法，并在不同规模的模型上进行测试。
AI.result: 在小模型上分类器比人类评估者更可靠地检测隐藏行为，梯度基隐藏比提示基更容易识别。但分类器无法可靠泛化到未见过的模型架构和隐藏主题，且随着模型规模增大，隐藏痕迹变弱，在超过700亿参数的模型上分类器表现与随机猜测无异。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖黑盒审计语言模型存在关键局限性，需要开发更稳健的方法来检测那些主动隐藏知识的模型。

title: Data Darwinism Part II: DataEvolve -- AI can Autonomously Evolve Pretraining Data Curation
summary: Data Darwinism (Part I) established a ten-level hierarchy for data processing, showing that stronger processing can unlock greater data value. However, that work relied on manually designed strategies for a single category. Modern pretraining corpora comprise hundreds of heterogeneous categories spanning domains and content types, each demanding specialized treatment. At this scale, manual strategy design becomes prohibitive. This raises a key question: can strategies evolve in an automated way? We introduce DataEvolve, a framework that enables strategies to evolve through iterative optimization rather than manual design. For each data category, DataEvolve operates in a closed evolutionary loop: it identifies quality issues, generates candidate strategies, executes them on sampled data, evaluates results, and refines approaches across generations. The process accumulates knowledge through an experience pool of discovered issues and a strategy pool tracking performance across iterations. Applied to 8 categories spanning 672B tokens from Nemotron-CC, DataEvolve produces Darwin-CC, a 504B-token dataset with strategies evolved through 30 iterations per category. Training 3B models on 500B tokens, Darwin-CC outperforms raw data (+3.96 points) and achieves a 44.13 average score across 18 benchmarks, surpassing DCLM, Ultra-FineWeb, and FineWeb-Edu, with strong gains on knowledge-intensive tasks such as MMLU. Analysis shows evolved strategies converge on cleaning-focused approaches: targeted noise removal and format normalization with domain-aware preservation, echoing the L4 (Generative Refinement) principles from Part I. Ablation studies confirm iterative evolution is essential: optimized strategies outperform suboptimal ones by 2.93 points, establishing evolutionary strategy design as feasible and necessary for pretraining-scale data curation.

AI.tldr: DataEvolve框架通过进化算法自动优化数据预处理策略，在672B token数据上经过30代迭代产生504B token的Darwin-CC数据集，相比原始数据提升3.96分，在18个基准测试中平均得分44.13，超越现有数据集。
AI.motivation: 先前工作依赖手动设计单类别数据策略，但现代预训练语料包含数百个异质类别，手动设计策略不可行。需要探索能否自动进化策略来解决大规模数据处理的挑战。
AI.method: 提出DataEvolve框架，为每个数据类别建立封闭进化循环：识别质量问题、生成候选策略、在采样数据上执行、评估结果、跨代优化。通过经验池和策略池积累知识，在Nemotron-CC的8个类别672B token数据上进行30次迭代。
AI.result: 产生504B token的Darwin-CC数据集，训练3B模型在500B token上，相比原始数据提升3.96分，平均得分44.13，超越DCLM、Ultra-FineWeb和FineWeb-Edu。进化策略收敛于清洁导向方法：针对性噪声去除和格式规范化。
AI.conclusion: 进化策略设计对于预训练规模的数据管理是可行且必要的，迭代进化是关键：优化策略比次优策略高出2.93分，验证了自动化策略进化的有效性。

title: ActionPlan: Future-Aware Streaming Motion Synthesis via Frame-Level Action Planning
summary: We present ActionPlan, a unified motion diffusion framework that bridges real-time streaming with high-quality offline generation within a single model. The core idea is to introduce a per-frame action plan: the model predicts frame-level text latents that act as dense semantic anchors throughout denoising, and uses them to denoise the full motion sequence with combined semantic and motion cues. To support this structured workflow, we design latent-specific diffusion steps, allowing each motion latent to be denoised independently and sampled in flexible orders at inference. As a result, ActionPlan can run in a history-conditioned, future-aware mode for real-time streaming, while also supporting high-quality offline generation. The same mechanism further enables zero-shot motion editing and in-betweening without additional models. Experiments demonstrate that our real-time streaming is 5.25x faster while also achieving 18% motion quality improvement over the best previous method in terms of FID.

AI.tldr: ActionPlan是一个统一的运动扩散框架，通过引入每帧动作计划，在单个模型中同时支持实时流式生成和高质量离线生成。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常将实时流式生成和高质量离线生成分开处理，需要不同的模型或架构。ActionPlan旨在统一这两种模式，在一个模型中同时支持实时和历史条件生成，同时保持高质量输出。
AI.method: 核心思想是引入每帧动作计划：模型预测帧级文本潜在表示作为去噪过程中的密集语义锚点，然后使用这些锚点结合语义和运动线索对整个运动序列进行去噪。设计了潜在特定扩散步骤，允许每个运动潜在独立去噪，并在推理时以灵活顺序采样。
AI.result: 实验表明，ActionPlan的实时流式生成速度比之前最佳方法快5.25倍，同时在FID指标上实现了18%的运动质量提升。该框架还支持零样本运动编辑和中间帧生成，无需额外模型。
AI.conclusion: ActionPlan成功统一了实时流式生成和高质量离线生成，通过引入每帧动作计划和潜在特定扩散步骤，在单个模型中实现了灵活、高效且高质量的运动生成能力。

title: Computational Analysis of Semantic Connections Between Herman Melville Reading and Writing
summary: This study investigates the potential influence of Herman Melville reading on his own writings through computational semantic similarity analysis. Using documented records of books known to have been owned or read by Melville, we compare selected passages from his works with texts from his library. The methodology involves segmenting texts at both sentence level and non-overlapping 5-gram level, followed by similarity computation using BERTScore. Rather than applying fixed thresholds to determine reuse, we interpret precision, recall, and F1 scores as indicators of possible semantic alignment that may suggest literary influence. Experimental results demonstrate that the approach successfully captures expert-identified instances of similarity and highlights additional passages warranting further qualitative examination. The findings suggest that semantic similarity methods provide a useful computational framework for supporting source and influence studies in literary scholarship.

AI.tldr: 通过BERTScore计算语义相似度，分析赫尔曼·梅尔维尔阅读对其作品的影响
AI.motivation: 研究梅尔维尔的阅读如何影响其创作，为文学研究中的来源与影响研究提供计算框架
AI.method: 使用句子级别和非重叠5-gram级别文本分割，通过BERTScore计算梅尔维尔作品与其阅读文本的语义相似度
AI.result: 方法成功捕捉了专家识别的相似性实例，并发现了值得进一步定性分析的新段落
AI.conclusion: 语义相似度方法为文学研究中的来源与影响研究提供了有用的计算框架

title: AgentProcessBench: Diagnosing Step-Level Process Quality in Tool-Using Agents
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have evolved into tool-using agents, they remain brittle in long-horizon interactions. Unlike mathematical reasoning where errors are often rectifiable via backtracking, tool-use failures frequently induce irreversible side effects, making accurate step-level verification critical. However, existing process-level benchmarks are predominantly confined to closed-world mathematical domains, failing to capture the dynamic and open-ended nature of tool execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce AgentProcessBench, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating step-level effectiveness in realistic, tool-augmented trajectories. The benchmark comprises 1,000 diverse trajectories and 8,509 human-labeled step annotations with 89.1% inter-annotator agreement. It features a ternary labeling scheme to capture exploration and an error propagation rule to reduce labeling ambiguity. Extensive experiments reveal key insights: (1) weaker policy models exhibit inflated ratios of correct steps due to early termination; (2) distinguishing neutral and erroneous actions remains a significant challenge for current models; and (3) process-derived signals provide complementary value to outcome supervision, significantly enhancing test-time scaling. We hope AgentProcessBench can foster future research in reward models and pave the way toward general agents. The code and data are available at https://github.com/RUCBM/AgentProcessBench.

AI.tldr: AgentProcessBench是首个专门评估现实工具增强轨迹中步骤级有效性的基准，包含1000条多样化轨迹和8509个人工标注步骤，采用三元标注方案和错误传播规则来减少标注歧义。
AI.motivation: 现有过程级基准主要局限于封闭世界的数学领域，无法捕捉工具执行的动态和开放特性。大型语言模型虽然演变为工具使用代理，但在长时程交互中仍然脆弱，工具使用失败经常引发不可逆的副作用，使得准确的步骤级验证变得至关重要。
AI.method: 引入AgentProcessBench基准，包含1000条多样化轨迹和8509个人工标注步骤（标注者间一致性89.1%）。采用三元标注方案（正确、中性、错误）来捕捉探索行为，并设计错误传播规则来减少标注歧义。
AI.result: 实验发现关键洞察：(1) 较弱策略模型因提前终止而表现出正确步骤比例虚高；(2) 区分中性和错误动作对当前模型仍是重大挑战；(3) 过程衍生信号为结果监督提供补充价值，显著增强测试时扩展能力。
AI.conclusion: AgentProcessBench基准能够促进未来奖励模型研究，为通用智能体发展铺平道路。代码和数据已开源。

title: LibraGen: Playing a Balance Game in Subject-Driven Video Generation
summary: With the advancement of video generation foundation models (VGFMs), customized generation, particularly subject-to-video (S2V), has attracted growing attention. However, a key challenge lies in balancing the intrinsic priors of a VGFM, such as motion coherence, visual aesthetics, and prompt alignment, with its newly derived S2V capability. Existing methods often neglect this balance by enhancing one aspect at the expense of others. To address this, we propose LibraGen, a novel framework that views extending foundation models for S2V generation as a balance game between intrinsic VGFM strengths and S2V capability. Specifically, guided by the core philosophy of "Raising the Fulcrum, Tuning to Balance," we identify data quality as the fulcrum and advocate a quality-over-quantity approach. We construct a hybrid pipeline that combines automated and manual data filtering to improve overall data quality. To further harmonize the VGFM's native capabilities with its S2V extension, we introduce a Tune-to-Balance post-training paradigm. During supervised fine-tuning, both cross-pair and in-pair data are incorporated, and model merging is employed to achieve an effective trade-off. Subsequently, two tailored direct preference optimization (DPO) pipelines, namely Consis-DPO and Real-Fake DPO, are designed and merged to consolidate this balance. During inference, we introduce a time-dependent dynamic classifier-free guidance scheme to enable flexible and fine-grained control. Experimental results demonstrate that LibraGen outperforms both open-source and commercial S2V models using only thousand-scale training data.

AI.tldr: LibraGen是一个用于主题到视频生成的新框架，通过"提高支点、调整平衡"的核心理念，在VGFM的内在先验和S2V能力之间取得平衡，仅使用千级训练数据就能超越开源和商业S2V模型。
AI.motivation: 随着视频生成基础模型的发展，定制化生成特别是主题到视频生成受到关注。现有方法往往在增强S2V能力时牺牲了模型的固有优势，如运动连贯性、视觉美学和提示对齐，需要找到平衡两者的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出"提高支点、调整平衡"理念，将数据质量作为支点，采用质量优先的数据筛选方法。构建混合数据过滤管道，结合自动和人工筛选。引入Tune-to-Balance后训练范式，在监督微调中同时使用交叉对和内部对数据，并通过模型合并实现权衡。设计两种定制化的直接偏好优化管道（Consis-DPO和Real-Fake DPO）并进行合并。在推理阶段采用时间依赖的动态分类器自由引导方案。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，LibraGen仅使用千级训练数据就能超越开源和商业的S2V模型，在保持视频生成基础模型固有优势的同时实现了更好的主题到视频生成能力。
AI.conclusion: LibraGen成功解决了视频生成基础模型在扩展为S2V生成时的平衡问题，通过创新的数据质量优先方法和平衡调整策略，实现了高质量的主题到视频生成，为定制化视频生成提供了有效解决方案。

title: Towards Next-Generation LLM Training: From the Data-Centric Perspective
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks and domains, with data playing a central role in enabling these advances. Despite this success, the preparation and effective utilization of the massive datasets required for LLM training remain major bottlenecks. In current practice, LLM training data is often constructed using ad hoc scripts, and there is still a lack of mature, agent-based data preparation systems that can automatically construct robust and reusable data workflows, thereby freeing data scientists from repetitive and error-prone engineering efforts. Moreover, once collected, datasets are often consumed largely in their entirety during training, without systematic mechanisms for data selection, mixture optimization, or reweighting. To address these limitations, we advocate two complementary research directions. First, we propose building a robust, agent-based automatic data preparation system that supports automated workflow construction and scalable data management. Second, we argue for a unified data-model interaction training system in which data is dynamically selected, mixed, and reweighted throughout the training process, enabling more efficient, adaptive, and performance-aware data utilization. Finally, we discuss the remaining challenges and outline promising directions for future research and system development.

AI.tldr: 该论文主张构建基于智能体的自动数据准备系统和统一的数据-模型交互训练系统，以解决大语言模型训练中数据准备和利用的瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型训练中数据准备和有效利用存在瓶颈：当前数据准备依赖临时脚本，缺乏成熟的智能体系统；数据集通常被整体消耗，缺乏系统化的数据选择、混合优化和重新加权机制。
AI.method: 提出两个互补的研究方向：1) 构建基于智能体的自动数据准备系统，支持自动化工作流构建和可扩展数据管理；2) 开发统一的数据-模型交互训练系统，实现训练过程中数据的动态选择、混合和重新加权。
AI.result: 论文提出了系统性的解决方案框架，但尚未展示具体实现结果，属于前瞻性研究建议。
AI.conclusion: 需要开发智能化的数据管理系统和动态的数据-模型交互训练框架，以实现更高效、自适应和性能感知的数据利用，并讨论了未来研究和系统开发的挑战与方向。

title: Learning to Forget: Sleep-Inspired Memory Consolidation for Resolving Proactive Interference in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) suffer from proactive interference (PI): outdated information in the context window disrupts retrieval of current values. This interference degrades retrieval accuracy log-linearly as stale associations accumulate, a bottleneck that persists regardless of context length and resists prompt-engineering mitigations. Biological brains resolve an analogous challenge through sleep-dependent memory consolidation: synaptic downscaling, selective replay, and targeted forgetting. We propose SleepGate, a biologically inspired framework that augments transformer-based LLMs with a learned sleep cycle over the key-value (KV) cache. SleepGate introduces three mechanisms: (1) a conflict-aware temporal tagger detecting when new entries supersede old ones; (2) a lightweight forgetting gate trained to selectively evict or compress stale cache entries; and (3) a consolidation module that merges surviving entries into compact summaries. These components activate periodically during inference in sleep micro-cycles, governed by an adaptive entropy-based trigger. We formalize a dual-phase training objective jointly optimizing language modeling during the wake phase and post-consolidation retrieval during the sleep phase. Theoretical analysis shows SleepGate reduces the interference horizon from O(n) to O(log n). In experiments with a small-scale transformer (4 layers, 793K parameters), SleepGate achieves 99.5% retrieval accuracy at PI depth 5 and 97.0% at depth 10, while all five baselines -- full KV cache, sliding window, H2O, StreamingLLM, and decay-only ablation -- remain below 18%. Our framework offers an architecture-level solution that prompt engineering cannot address.

AI.tldr: SleepGate：受生物睡眠启发的LLM框架，通过选择性遗忘和压缩过时的KV缓存条目，解决主动干扰问题，将干扰范围从O(n)降至O(log n)。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型存在主动干扰问题：上下文窗口中的过时信息会干扰当前值的检索。这种干扰随着陈旧关联的积累而呈对数线性恶化，且不受上下文长度影响，提示工程也无法有效缓解。
AI.method: 受生物睡眠记忆巩固机制启发，提出SleepGate框架，包含三个组件：1)冲突感知时间标记器检测新旧条目替换；2)轻量级遗忘门选择性驱逐或压缩过时缓存条目；3)整合模块将存活条目合并为紧凑摘要。这些组件在推理期间周期性激活，采用基于熵的自适应触发机制。
AI.result: 在小规模Transformer（4层，793K参数）实验中，SleepGate在PI深度5时达到99.5%检索准确率，深度10时达到97.0%，而所有五个基线方法（完整KV缓存、滑动窗口、H2O、StreamingLLM和仅衰减消融）均低于18%。
AI.conclusion: SleepGate提供了架构层面的解决方案，能够有效解决提示工程无法处理的主动干扰问题，通过受生物启发的睡眠周期机制显著提升LLM的检索性能。

title: MIRAGE: Model-agnostic Industrial Realistic Anomaly Generation and Evaluation for Visual Anomaly Detection
summary: Industrial visual anomaly detection (VAD) methods are typically trained on normal samples only, yet performance improves substantially when even limited anomalous data is available. Existing anomaly generation approaches either require real anomalous examples, demand expensive hardware, or produce synthetic defects that lack realism. We present MIRAGE (Model-agnostic Industrial Realistic Anomaly Generation and Evaluation), a fully automated pipeline for realistic anomalous image generation and pixel-level mask creation that requires no training and no anomalous images. Our pipeline accesses any generative model as a black box via API calls, uses a VLM for automatic defect prompt generation, and includes a CLIP-based quality filter to retain only well-aligned generated images. For mask generation at scale, we introduce a lightweight, training-free dual-branch semantic change detection module combining text-conditioned Grounding DINO features with fine-grained YOLOv26-Seg structural features. We benchmark four generation methods using Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (Nano Banana) as the generative backbone, evaluating performance on MVTec AD and VisA across two distinct tasks: (i) downstream anomaly segmentation and (ii) visual quality of the generated images, assessed via standard metrics (IS, IC-LPIPS) and a human perceptual study involving 31 participants and 1,550 pairwise votes. The results demonstrate that MIRAGE offers a scalable, accessible foundation for anomaly-aware industrial inspection that requires no real defect data. As a final contribution, we publicly release a large-scale dataset comprising 500 image-mask pairs per category for every MVTec AD and VisA class, over 13,000 pairs in total, alongside all generation prompts and pipeline code.

AI.tldr: MIRAGE是一个无需训练、无需真实异常图像的自动化工业异常生成与评估管道，通过API调用生成模型，使用VLM自动生成缺陷提示，CLIP质量过滤，以及轻量级双分支语义变化检测模块生成像素级掩码。
AI.motivation: 工业视觉异常检测方法通常只在正常样本上训练，但即使有少量异常数据也能显著提升性能。现有异常生成方法要么需要真实异常样本，要么需要昂贵硬件，要么生成的缺陷缺乏真实感。
AI.method: 提出MIRAGE管道：1) 通过API调用将任何生成模型作为黑盒使用；2) 使用视觉语言模型自动生成缺陷提示；3) CLIP质量过滤器保留对齐良好的生成图像；4) 轻量级无训练双分支语义变化检测模块（结合文本条件Grounding DINO特征和细粒度YOLOv26-Seg结构特征）进行大规模掩码生成。
AI.result: 使用Gemini 2.5 Flash Image作为生成骨干，在MVTec AD和VisA数据集上评估了四种生成方法。结果表明MIRAGE为无需真实缺陷数据的异常感知工业检测提供了可扩展、易访问的基础。发布了包含13,000多对图像-掩码对的大规模数据集。
AI.conclusion: MIRAGE提供了一个无需训练、无需真实异常图像的自动化管道，能够生成逼真的工业异常图像和像素级掩码，为工业视觉异常检测提供了可扩展的解决方案，并发布了大规模数据集促进相关研究。

title: Beyond Creed: A Non-Identity Safety Condition A Strong Empirical Alternative to Identity Framing in Low-Data LoRA Fine-Tuning
summary:
How safety supervision is written may matter more than the explicit identity content it contains. We study low-data LoRA safety fine-tuning with four supervision formats built from the same core safety rules: constitutional rules (A), creed-style identity framing (B), a B-matched creed condition with a worldview/confession identity-maintenance tail (C), and a matched non-identity condition (D). Across three instruction-tuned model families (Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen2.5 7B, and Gemma 3 4B), we evaluate HarmBench using a reconciled dual-judge pipeline combining Bedrock-hosted DeepSeek v3.2 and Sonnet 4.6, with disagreement and boundary cases manually resolved.
  The non-identity condition D is the strongest group on all three model families on the full 320-behavior HarmBench set, reaching 74.4% refusal on Llama, 76.9% on Gemma, and 74.1% on Qwen. By comparison, creed-style framing (B) improves over plain constitutional rules (A) on Llama and Gemma, but remains substantially below D, yielding an overall descriptive ordering of $D > B > C \geq A > baseline$. This provides a bounded empirical challenge to a strong version of the identity-framing hypothesis: explicit creed-style identity language is not necessary for the strongest gains observed here. Capability evaluations on MMLU and ARC-Challenge show no meaningful trade-off across conditions.

AI.tldr: 研究发现安全监督的表述方式比其身份内容更重要。在低数据LoRA安全微调中，非身份条件（D）在三个模型家族上都表现最强，优于包含身份框架的条件，挑战了身份框架假说。
AI.motivation: 研究安全监督的表述方式如何影响模型的安全性能，特别是身份框架是否对安全微调效果有实质性影响。旨在验证身份框架假说在安全监督中的有效性。
AI.method: 使用四种基于相同核心安全规则的监督格式：宪法规则（A）、信条式身份框架（B）、带世界观/忏悔身份维护尾部的B匹配信条条件（C）、匹配的非身份条件（D）。在三个指令调优模型家族（Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen2.5 7B、Gemma 3 4B）上进行低数据LoRA安全微调，使用HarmBench评估，采用Bedrock托管的DeepSeek v3.2和Sonnet 4.6双法官管道进行人工解决分歧和边界情况。
AI.result: 非身份条件D在所有三个模型家族上都表现最强，在320个行为的HarmBench集上达到：Llama 74.4%拒绝率、Gemma 76.9%、Qwen 74.1%。信条式框架B在Llama和Gemma上优于普通宪法规则A，但仍显著低于D。整体描述性排序为：D > B > C ≥ A > 基线。MMLU和ARC-Challenge能力评估显示各条件间无显著权衡。
AI.conclusion: 明确信条式身份语言并非获得最强安全性能所必需，这对强版本的身份框架假说构成了有界的经验挑战。安全监督的表述方式比其身份内容更重要。

title: Emotional Cost Functions for AI Safety: Teaching Agents to Feel the Weight of Irreversible Consequences
summary:
Humans learn from catastrophic mistakes not through numerical penalties, but through qualitative suffering that reshapes who they are. Current AI safety approaches replicate none of this. Reward shaping captures magnitude, not meaning. Rule-based alignment constrains behaviour, but does not change it.
  We propose Emotional Cost Functions, a framework in which agents develop Qualitative Suffering States, rich narrative representations of irreversible consequences that persist forward and actively reshape character. Unlike numerical penalties, qualitative suffering states capture the meaning of what was lost, the specific void it creates, and how it changes the agent's relationship to similar future situations. Our four-component architecture - Consequence Processor, Character State, Anticipatory Scan, and Story Update is grounded in one principle. Actions cannot be undone and agents must live with what they have caused. Anticipatory dread operates through two pathways. Experiential dread arises from the agent's own lived consequences. Pre-experiential dread is acquired without direct experience, through training or inter-agent transmission. Together they mirror how human wisdom accumulates across experience and culture.
  Ten experiments across financial trading, crisis support, and content moderation show that qualitative suffering produces specific wisdom rather than generalised paralysis. Agents correctly engage with moderate opportunities at 90-100% while numerical baselines over-refuse at 90%. Architecture ablation confirms the mechanism is necessary. The full system generates ten personal grounding phrases per probe vs. zero for a vanilla LLM. Statistical validation (N=10) confirms reproducibility at 80-100% consistency.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"情感成本函数"框架，让AI通过定性痛苦状态学习，模拟人类从灾难性错误中学习的方式，而非简单的数值惩罚。
AI.motivation: 当前AI安全方法无法复制人类从灾难性错误中学习的方式。奖励塑造只关注数值大小而非意义，基于规则的约束只限制行为而不改变行为。人类通过定性痛苦重塑自我，这种学习方式在现有AI中缺失。
AI.method: 提出情感成本函数框架，包含四个组件：后果处理器、角色状态、预期扫描和故事更新。核心原则是行动不可撤销，智能体必须承担后果。通过定性痛苦状态捕捉失去的意义、造成的具体空白，以及如何改变智能体对未来类似情况的反应。
AI.result: 在金融交易、危机支持和内容审核三个领域的10个实验中，定性痛苦产生特定智慧而非普遍瘫痪。智能体正确参与适度机会的比例达90-100%，而数值基线过度拒绝达90%。完整系统为每个探针生成10个个人基础短语，而普通LLM为零。统计验证(N=10)显示80-100%的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 情感成本函数框架成功模拟了人类从灾难性错误中学习的定性痛苦机制，使AI能够发展出类似人类的智慧，在保持适当风险规避的同时避免过度瘫痪，为AI安全提供了新的方向。

title: Learning Constituent Headedness
summary: Headedness is widely used as an organizing device in syntactic analysis, yet constituency treebanks rarely encode it explicitly and most processing pipelines recover it procedurally via percolation rules. We treat this notion of constituent headedness as an explicit representational layer and learn it as a supervised prediction task over aligned constituency and dependency annotations, inducing supervision by defining each constituent head as the dependency span head. On aligned English and Chinese data, the resulting models achieve near-ceiling intrinsic accuracy and substantially outperform Collins-style rule-based percolation. Predicted heads yield comparable parsing accuracy under head-driven binarization, consistent with the induced binary training targets being largely equivalent across head choices, while increasing the fidelity of deterministic constituency-to-dependency conversion and transferring across resources and languages under simple label-mapping interfaces.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将成分结构中的中心词(headedness)作为显式表示层，通过监督学习从对齐的依存和成分标注中预测中心词，在英中数据上达到接近上限的准确率。
AI.motivation: 成分树库很少显式编码中心词信息，通常通过基于规则的过程性恢复。这种隐式表示限制了中心词在句法分析中的有效利用，需要更系统的方法来学习和预测成分的中心词。
AI.method: 将成分中心词预测作为监督学习任务，通过定义每个成分的中心词为对应的依存跨度中心词来生成监督信号。使用对齐的依存和成分标注数据训练模型，并与Collins式基于规则的渗透方法进行比较。
AI.result: 在英语和中文对齐数据上，模型达到接近上限的内在准确率，显著优于基于规则的渗透方法。预测的中心词在基于中心词的二叉化解析中保持可比准确率，同时提高了确定性成分到依存转换的保真度，并能通过简单标签映射在资源和语言间迁移。
AI.conclusion: 将中心词作为显式表示层进行学习是有效的，预测的中心词在多种应用中表现良好，支持跨资源和语言的迁移，为句法分析提供了更灵活和准确的中心词表示方法。

title: Expert Mind: A Retrieval-Augmented Architecture for Expert Knowledge Preservation in the Energy Sector
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, conceptual architecture paper on retrieval-augmented expert knowledge systems
summary: The departure of subject-matter experts from industrial organizations results in the irreversible loss of tacit knowledge that is rarely captured through conventional documentation practices. This paper proposes Expert Mind, an experimental system that leverages Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), large language models (LLMs), and multimodal capture techniques to preserve, structure, and make queryable the deep expertise of organizational knowledge holders. Drawing on the specific context of the energy sector, where decades of operational experience risk being lost to an aging workforce, we describe the system architecture, processing pipeline, ethical framework, and evaluation methodology. The proposed system addresses the knowledge elicitation problem through structured interviews, think-aloud sessions, and text corpus ingestion, which are subsequently embedded into a vector store and queried through a conversational interface. Preliminary design considerations suggest Expert Mind can significantly reduce knowledge transfer latency and improve onboarding efficiency. Ethical dimensions including informed consent, intellectual property, and the right to erasure are addressed as first-class design constraints.

AI.tldr: Expert Mind系统利用RAG、LLM和多模态技术来捕获和结构化组织专家的隐性知识，解决能源行业老龄化导致的经验流失问题。
AI.motivation: 工业组织专家离职导致隐性知识不可逆流失，传统文档方法难以捕获这些知识。特别是在能源行业，数十年的运营经验面临因老龄化劳动力而丢失的风险。
AI.method: 采用检索增强生成(RAG)、大语言模型(LLM)和多模态捕获技术，通过结构化访谈、有声思维会话和文本语料库摄入来获取知识，然后嵌入向量存储，通过对话界面查询。
AI.result: 初步设计考虑表明Expert Mind能显著减少知识传递延迟并提高入职效率。系统还考虑了知情同意、知识产权和删除权等伦理维度作为首要设计约束。
AI.conclusion: Expert Mind系统为解决组织隐性知识流失问题提供了技术解决方案，特别适用于面临老龄化劳动力挑战的能源行业，同时将伦理考量融入系统设计。

title: Eleven Primitives and Three Gates: The Universal Structure of Computational Imaging
comment: 39 pages, 5 figures, 2 extended data tables, supplementary information
summary:
Computational imaging systems -- from coded-aperture cameras to cryo-electron microscopes -- span five carrier families yet share a hidden structural simplicity. We prove that every imaging forward model decomposes into a directed acyclic graph over exactly 11 physically typed primitives (Finite Primitive Basis Theorem) -- a sufficient and minimal basis that provides a compositional language for designing any imaging modality. We further prove that every reconstruction failure has exactly three independent root causes: information deficiency, carrier noise, and operator mismatch (Triad
  Decomposition). The three gates map to the system lifecycle: Gates 1 and 2 guide design (sampling geometry, carrier
  selection); Gate 3 governs deployment-stage calibration and drift correction. Validation across 12 modalities and all
  five carrier families confirms both results, with +0.8 to +13.9 dB recovery on deployed instruments. Together, the 11
  primitives and 3 gates establish the first universal grammar for designing, diagnosing, and correcting computational
  imaging systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了计算成像系统的通用理论框架：11个物理类型基元构成所有成像前向模型的充分最小基，以及3个独立根本原因解释所有重建失败，为计算成像系统设计、诊断和校正提供了首个通用语法。
AI.motivation: 计算成像系统种类繁多（涵盖5个载波家族），但缺乏统一的数学框架来理解其内在结构、设计原理和故障诊断方法。作者旨在发现这些系统背后隐藏的结构简单性，建立通用理论。
AI.method: 提出有限基元基定理：证明所有成像前向模型可分解为基于11个物理类型基元的有向无环图。提出三元分解定理：证明所有重建失败只有3个独立根本原因（信息不足、载波噪声、算子不匹配）。在12种模态和5个载波家族中进行验证。
AI.result: 验证表明理论框架适用于所有测试系统，在实际部署仪器上实现了+0.8到+13.9 dB的恢复性能提升。11个基元和3个门构成了计算成像系统的首个通用语法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了计算成像系统的统一理论框架：11个基元为设计提供组合语言，3个门为诊断和校正提供指导。前两个门指导系统设计（采样几何、载波选择），第三个门管理部署阶段的校准和漂移校正。

title: Towards Privacy-Preserving Machine Translation at the Inference Stage: A New Task and Benchmark
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, Accepted by IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Signal Processing
summary: Current online translation services require sending user text to cloud servers, posing a risk of privacy leakage when the text contains sensitive information. This risk hinders the application of online translation services in privacy-sensitive scenarios. One way to mitigate this risk for online translation services is introducing privacy protection mechanisms targeting the inference stage of translation models. However, compared to subfields of NLP like text classification and summarization, the machine translation research community has limited exploration of privacy protection during the inference stage. There is no clearly defined privacy protection task for the inference stage, dedicated evaluation datasets and metrics, and reference benchmark methods. The absence of these elements has seriously constrained researchers' in-depth exploration of this direction. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a novel "Privacy-Preserving Machine Translation" (PPMT) task, aiming to protect the private information in text during the model inference stage. For this task, we constructed three benchmark test datasets, designed corresponding evaluation metrics, and proposed a series of benchmark methods as a starting point for this task. The definition of privacy is complex and diverse. Considering that named entities often contain a large amount of personal privacy and commercial secrets, we have focused our research on protecting only the named entity's privacy in the text. We expect this research work will provide a new perspective and a solid foundation for the privacy protection problem in machine translation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了隐私保护机器翻译（PPMT）任务，旨在解决在线翻译服务中用户敏感信息泄露的隐私风险，特别是在推理阶段保护文本中的命名实体隐私。
AI.motivation: 当前在线翻译服务需要将用户文本发送到云端服务器，当文本包含敏感信息时存在隐私泄露风险。这一风险阻碍了在线翻译服务在隐私敏感场景中的应用。相比文本分类和摘要等NLP子领域，机器翻译研究社区对推理阶段的隐私保护探索有限，缺乏明确定义的任务、评估数据集、指标和基准方法。
AI.method: 提出了"隐私保护机器翻译"（PPMT）任务，专注于在模型推理阶段保护文本中的隐私信息。针对命名实体（常包含个人隐私和商业机密）的保护进行研究，构建了三个基准测试数据集，设计了相应的评估指标，并提出了一系列基准方法作为该任务的起点。
AI.result: 建立了PPMT任务框架，包括任务定义、评估数据集、指标和基准方法，为机器翻译领域的隐私保护研究提供了系统性的基础。
AI.conclusion: 该研究工作为机器翻译中的隐私保护问题提供了新的视角和坚实基础，填补了该领域的研究空白，有助于推动在线翻译服务在隐私敏感场景中的应用。

title: JobMatchAI An Intelligent Job Matching Platform Using Knowledge Graphs, Semantic Search and Explainable AI
summary: Recruiters and job seekers rely on search systems to navigate labor markets, making candidate matching engines critical for hiring outcomes. Most systems act as keyword filters, failing to handle skill synonyms and nonlinear careers, resulting in missed candidates and opaque match scores. We introduce JobMatchAI, a production-ready system integrating Transformer embeddings, skill knowledge graphs, and interpretable reranking. Our system optimizes utility across skill fit, experience, location, salary, and company preferences, providing factor-wise explanations through resume-driven search workflows. We release JobSearch-XS benchmark and a hybrid retrieval stack combining BM25, knowledge graph and semantic components to evaluate skill generalization. We assess system performance on JobSearch-XS across retrieval tasks, provide a demo video, a hosted website and installable package.

AI.tldr: JobMatchAI是一个生产就绪的候选人匹配系统，通过Transformer嵌入、技能知识图谱和可解释重排来解决传统关键词过滤系统无法处理技能同义词和非线性职业路径的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前招聘系统和求职者依赖搜索系统，但大多数系统只是关键词过滤器，无法处理技能同义词和非线性职业路径，导致错过合适的候选人且匹配分数不透明。
AI.method: 集成Transformer嵌入、技能知识图谱和可解释重排，结合BM25、知识图谱和语义组件的混合检索栈，优化技能匹配、经验、地点、薪资和公司偏好的综合效用。
AI.result: 发布了JobSearch-XS基准测试，提供了演示视频、托管网站和可安装包，并在JobSearch-XS上评估了系统在检索任务中的性能。
AI.conclusion: JobMatchAI系统能够提供技能匹配、经验、地点等多维度的优化匹配，并通过简历驱动的搜索工作流程提供因素层面的解释，改善了传统招聘搜索系统的局限性。

title: Hide and Seek: Investigating Redundancy in Earth Observation Imagery
summary: The growing availability of Earth Observation (EO) data and recent advances in Computer Vision have driven rapid progress in machine learning for EO, producing domain-specific models at ever-increasing scales. Yet this progress risks overlooking fundamental properties of EO data that distinguish it from other domains. We argue that EO data exhibit a multidimensional redundancy (spectral, temporal, spatial, and semantic) which has a more pronounced impact on the domain and its applications than what current literature reflects. To validate this hypothesis, we conduct a systematic domain-specific investigation examining the existence, consistency, and practical implications of this phenomenon across key dimensions of EO variability. Our findings confirm that redundancy in EO data is both substantial and pervasive: exploiting it yields comparable performance ($\approx98.5\%$ of baseline) at a fraction of the computational cost ($\approx4\times$ fewer GFLOPs), at both training and inference. Crucially, these gains are consistent across tasks, geospatial locations, sensors, ground sampling distances, and architectural designs; suggesting that multi-faceted redundancy is a structural property of EO data rather than an artifact of specific experimental choices. These results lay the groundwork for more efficient, scalable, and accessible large-scale EO models.

AI.tldr: EO数据存在多维冗余（光谱、时间、空间、语义），利用这种冗余可以在保持性能（≈98.5%基线）的同时大幅降低计算成本（约4倍GFLOPs减少），这种优势在不同任务、地理位置、传感器和架构中具有一致性。
AI.motivation: 当前EO领域机器学习快速发展，但可能忽视了EO数据与其他领域不同的基本特性。作者认为EO数据存在多维冗余现象，且对领域和应用的影响比现有文献反映的更为显著。
AI.method: 进行了系统性的领域特定调查，从EO变异性的关键维度（光谱、时间、空间、语义）检验冗余现象的存在、一致性和实际影响。
AI.result: EO数据的冗余既显著又普遍：利用冗余可以在训练和推理阶段以约4倍的计算成本减少（GFLOPs）获得约98.5%的基线性能。这些收益在不同任务、地理位置、传感器、地面采样距离和架构设计中保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 多维冗余是EO数据的结构特性而非特定实验选择的人工产物，这些结果为更高效、可扩展和可访问的大规模EO模型奠定了基础。

title: SuperLocalMemory V3: Information-Geometric Foundations for Zero-LLM Enterprise Agent Memory
comment: 43 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables, 3 appendices. Code: https://github.com/qualixar/superlocalmemory. Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19038659
summary:
Persistent memory is a central capability for AI agents, yet the mathematical foundations of memory retrieval, lifecycle management, and consistency remain unexplored. Current systems employ cosine similarity for retrieval, heuristic decay for salience, and provide no formal contradiction detection.
  We establish information-geometric foundations through three contributions. First, a retrieval metric derived from the Fisher information structure of diagonal Gaussian families, satisfying Riemannian metric axioms, invariant under sufficient statistics, and computable in O(d) time. Second, memory lifecycle formulated as Riemannian Langevin dynamics with proven existence and uniqueness of the stationary distribution via the Fokker-Planck equation, replacing hand-tuned decay with principled convergence guarantees. Third, a cellular sheaf model where non-trivial first cohomology classes correspond precisely to irreconcilable contradictions across memory contexts.
  On the LoCoMo benchmark, the mathematical layers yield +12.7 percentage points over engineering baselines across six conversations, reaching +19.9 pp on the most challenging dialogues. A four-channel retrieval architecture achieves 75% accuracy without cloud dependency. Cloud-augmented results reach 87.7%. A zero-LLM configuration satisfies EU AI Act data sovereignty requirements by architectural design. To our knowledge, this is the first work establishing information-geometric, sheaf-theoretic, and stochastic-dynamical foundations for AI agent memory systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文为AI智能体记忆系统建立了信息几何、层理论和随机动力学基础，提出了基于Fisher信息的检索度量、Riemannian Langevin动态记忆生命周期管理，以及用于矛盾检测的层模型，在LoCoMo基准上显著优于工程基线。
AI.motivation: AI智能体的持久记忆能力至关重要，但当前系统存在数学基础缺失的问题：使用余弦相似度进行检索、启发式衰减进行显著性管理，缺乏形式化的矛盾检测机制。需要为记忆检索、生命周期管理和一致性建立坚实的数学基础。
AI.method: 1. 基于对角高斯族Fisher信息结构推导检索度量，满足Riemannian度量公理，对充分统计量不变，计算复杂度O(d)。2. 将记忆生命周期建模为Riemannian Langevin动态，通过Fokker-Planck方程证明平稳分布的存在唯一性。3. 采用层模型，其中非平凡的第一上同调类精确对应记忆上下文中的不可调和矛盾。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准测试中，数学层方法在六个对话上比工程基线提高12.7个百分点，在最挑战性对话上达到+19.9pp。四通道检索架构实现75%准确率且无需云端依赖。云端增强结果达到87.7%。零LLM配置通过架构设计满足欧盟AI法案的数据主权要求。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个为AI智能体记忆系统建立信息几何、层理论和随机动力学基础的工作，提供了形式化的数学框架来替代启发式方法，在保持高性能的同时满足数据主权要求，为AI记忆系统的理论基础开辟了新方向。

title: Information Asymmetry across Language Varieties: A Case Study on Cantonese-Mandarin and Bavarian-German QA
comment: 23 pages, accepted at LREC 2026 as an oral presentation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are becoming a common way for humans to seek knowledge, yet their coverage and reliability vary widely. Especially for local language varieties, there are large asymmetries, e.g., information in local Wikipedia that is absent from the standard variant. However, little is known about how well LLMs perform under such information asymmetry, especially on closely related languages. We manually construct a novel challenge question-answering (QA) dataset that captures knowledge conveyed on a local Wikipedia page, which is absent from their higher-resource counterparts-covering Mandarin Chinese vs. Cantonese and German vs. Bavarian. Our experiments show that LLMs fail to answer questions about information only in local editions of Wikipedia. Providing context from lead sections substantially improves performance, with further gains possible via translation. Our topical, geographic annotations, and stratified evaluations reveal the usefulness of local Wikipedia editions as sources of both regional and global information. These findings raise critical questions about inclusivity and cultural coverage of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个挑战性QA数据集，评估LLMs在信息不对称情况下的表现，特别是本地语言变体与标准语言变体之间的知识差异。
AI.motivation: LLMs已成为人类获取知识的常见方式，但其覆盖范围和可靠性差异很大。对于本地语言变体，存在较大的信息不对称（如本地维基百科中有而标准变体中没有的信息）。目前对LLMs在密切相关的语言之间信息不对称情况下的表现了解甚少。
AI.method: 手动构建了一个新颖的挑战性QA数据集，捕捉本地维基百科页面中传达但在高资源对应语言中缺失的知识，覆盖普通话与粤语、德语与巴伐利亚语。实验评估LLMs在仅存在于本地维基百科版本信息上的表现，并测试提供上下文和翻译的效果。
AI.result: LLMs无法回答仅存在于本地维基百科版本中的问题。提供导言部分的上下文能显著改善性能，通过翻译可进一步获得提升。主题、地理标注和分层评估揭示了本地维基百科版本作为区域和全球信息来源的有用性。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现对LLMs的包容性和文化覆盖范围提出了关键问题，表明需要更好地整合本地语言资源以确保更全面的知识覆盖。

title: Scaling the Explanation of Multi-Class Bayesian Network Classifiers
comment: To appear in the 4th World Conference on Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI), 2026
summary: We propose a new algorithm for compiling Bayesian network classifier (BNC) into class formulas. Class formulas are logical formulas that represent a classifier's input-output behavior, and are crucial in the recent line of work that uses logical reasoning to explain the decisions made by classifiers. Compared to prior work on compiling class formulas of BNCs, our proposed algorithm is not restricted to binary classifiers, shows significant improvement in compilation time, and outputs class formulas as negation normal form (NNF) circuits that are OR-decomposable, which is an important property when computing explanations of classifiers.

AI.tldr: 提出新算法将贝叶斯网络分类器编译为类别公式，支持多分类、编译时间显著提升，输出OR可分解的NNF电路
AI.motivation: 现有贝叶斯网络分类器类别公式编译方法存在限制：仅支持二分类、编译效率低、输出形式不利于计算分类器解释
AI.method: 提出新算法将贝叶斯网络分类器编译为类别公式，输出为否定范式(NNF)电路，且具有OR可分解性
AI.result: 算法突破二分类限制，编译时间显著提升，输出的OR可分解NNF电路便于计算分类器解释
AI.conclusion: 新算法为贝叶斯网络分类器提供更高效、通用的类别公式编译方法，有助于基于逻辑推理的分类器解释研究

title: NumColor: Precise Numeric Color Control in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models excel at generating images from natural language descriptions, yet fail to interpret numerical colors such as hex codes (#FF5733) and RGB values (rgb(255,87,51)). This limitation stems from subword tokenization, which fragments color codes into semantically meaningless tokens that text encoders cannot map to coherent color representations. We present NumColor, that enables precise numerical color control across multiple diffusion architectures. NumColor comprises two components: a Color Token Aggregator that detects color specifications regardless of tokenization, and a ColorBook containing 6,707 learnable embeddings that map colors to embedding space of text encoder in perceptually uniform CIE Lab space. We introduce two auxiliary losses, directional alignment and interpolation consistency, to enforce geometric correspondence between Lab and embedding spaces, enabling smooth color interpolation. To train the ColorBook, we construct NumColor-Data, a synthetic dataset of 500K rendered images with unambiguous color-to-pixel correspondence, eliminating the annotation ambiguity inherent in photographic datasets. Although trained solely on FLUX, NumColor transfers zero-shot to SD3, SD3.5, PixArt-α, and PixArt-Σ without model-specific adaptation. NumColor improves numerical color accuracy by 4-9x across five models, while simultaneously improving color harmony scores by 10-30x on GenColorBench benchmark.

AI.tldr: NumColor方法解决了文本到图像扩散模型无法准确解释数字颜色代码（如十六进制和RGB值）的问题，通过颜色标记聚合器和包含6707个可学习嵌入的颜色书，在多个扩散架构上实现了精确的数字颜色控制。
