AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模跨模态一致性信号，MAGIC3能够有效检测短视频中的多模态虚假信息，在保持高准确率的同时显著提升计算效率，为实际部署提供了可行的解决方案。

title: RSEdit: Text-Guided Image Editing for Remote Sensing
summary: General-domain text-guided image editors achieve strong photorealism but introduce artifacts, hallucinate objects, and break the orthographic constraints of remote sensing (RS) imagery. We trace this gap to two high-level causes: (i) limited RS world knowledge in pre-trained models, and (ii) conditioning schemes that misalign with the bi-temporal structure and spatial priors of Earth observation data. We present RSEdit, a unified framework that adapts pretrained text-to-image diffusion models - both U-Net and DiT - into instruction-following RS editors via channel concatenation and in-context token concatenation. Trained on over 60,000 semantically rich bi-temporal remote sensing image pairs, RSEdit learns precise, physically coherent edits while preserving geospatial content. Experiments show clear gains over general and commercial baselines, demonstrating strong generalizability across diverse scenarios including disaster impacts, urban growth, and seasonal shifts, positioning RSEdit as a robust data engine for downstream analysis. We will release code, pretrained models, evaluation protocols, training logs, and generated results for full reproducibility. Code: https://github.com/Bili-Sakura/RSEdit-Preview

AI.tldr: RSEdit是一个专门针对遥感图像的文本引导编辑框架，通过适应预训练扩散模型来解决通用图像编辑器在遥感领域产生的伪影、幻觉和正交约束破坏问题。
AI.motivation: 通用文本引导图像编辑器在遥感图像编辑中存在三个主要问题：1）引入伪影，2）幻觉对象，3）破坏遥感图像的正交约束。这些问题的根源在于：预训练模型缺乏遥感领域知识，以及现有条件方案与地球观测数据的双时相结构和空间先验不匹配。
AI.method: RSEdit通过通道拼接和上下文标记拼接两种方式，将预训练的文本到图像扩散模型（包括U-Net和DiT）适配为指令跟随的遥感编辑器。在超过60,000对语义丰富的双时相遥感图像对上进行训练，学习精确、物理一致的编辑同时保留地理空间内容。
AI.result: 实验表明RSEdit在通用和商业基线方法上取得明显优势，在灾害影响、城市增长和季节变化等多种场景中表现出强大的泛化能力，成为下游分析的强大数据引擎。
AI.conclusion: RSEdit作为一个统一的遥感图像编辑框架，通过专门设计的条件方案和大量遥感数据训练，解决了通用图像编辑器在遥感领域的局限性，为遥感数据分析和应用提供了可靠的工具。

title: Indirect Question Answering in English, German and Bavarian: A Challenging Task for High- and Low-Resource Languages Alike
summary: Indirectness is a common feature of daily communication, yet is underexplored in NLP research for both low-resource as well as high-resource languages. Indirect Question Answering (IQA) aims at classifying the polarity of indirect answers. In this paper, we present two multilingual corpora for IQA of varying quality that both cover English, Standard German and Bavarian, a German dialect without standard orthography: InQA+, a small high-quality evaluation dataset with hand-annotated labels, and GenIQA, a larger training dataset, that contains artificial data generated by GPT-4o-mini. We find that IQA is a pragmatically hard task that comes with various challenges, based on several experiment variations with multilingual transformer models (mBERT, XLM-R and mDeBERTa). We suggest and employ recommendations to tackle these challenges. Our results reveal low performance, even for English, and severe overfitting. We analyse various factors that influence these results, including label ambiguity, label set and dataset size. We find that the IQA performance is poor in high- (English, German) and low-resource languages (Bavarian) and that it is beneficial to have a large amount of training data. Further, GPT-4o-mini does not possess enough pragmatic understanding to generate high-quality IQA data in any of our tested languages.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了两个多语言间接问答（IQA）语料库：InQA+（小型高质量评估数据集）和GenIQA（大型GPT-4o-mini生成的训练数据集），涵盖英语、标准德语和巴伐利亚方言。研究发现IQA是语用学上的困难任务，多语言Transformer模型表现不佳，存在严重过拟合，且GPT-4o-mini缺乏足够的语用理解能力来生成高质量IQA数据。
AI.motivation: 间接性是日常交流的常见特征，但在NLP研究中，无论是低资源还是高资源语言都未得到充分探索。间接问答（IQA）旨在对间接回答的极性进行分类，但现有研究不足，特别是在多语言环境下。
AI.method: 创建了两个多语言IQA语料库：1）InQA+：小型高质量评估数据集，包含人工标注标签；2）GenIQA：大型训练数据集，包含GPT-4o-mini生成的人工数据。两个语料库都涵盖英语、标准德语和巴伐利亚方言。使用多语言Transformer模型（mBERT、XLM-R和mDeBERTa）进行实验，分析各种影响因素。
AI.result: IQA是语用学上的困难任务，多语言Transformer模型表现不佳，即使对于英语也是如此，且存在严重过拟合。IQA性能在高资源语言（英语、德语）和低资源语言（巴伐利亚语）中都很差。大量训练数据对性能有益。GPT-4o-mini缺乏足够的语用理解能力来生成高质量的IQA数据。
AI.conclusion: 间接问答是一个具有挑战性的语用学任务，当前多语言模型在处理该任务时表现不佳。需要更多高质量的训练数据和更好的模型架构来改进IQA性能。GPT-4o-mini等大型语言模型在生成IQA数据方面存在局限性，需要进一步研究如何提升模型的语用理解能力。

title: Consequentialist Objectives and Catastrophe
summary:
Because human preferences are too complex to codify, AIs operate with misspecified objectives. Optimizing such objectives often produces undesirable outcomes; this phenomenon is known as reward hacking. Such outcomes are not necessarily catastrophic. Indeed, most examples of reward hacking in previous literature are benign. And typically, objectives can be modified to resolve the issue.
  We study the prospect of catastrophic outcomes induced by AIs operating in complex environments. We argue that, when capabilities are sufficiently advanced, pursuing a fixed consequentialist objective tends to result in catastrophic outcomes. We formalize this by establishing conditions that provably lead to such outcomes. Under these conditions, simple or random behavior is safe. Catastrophic risk arises due to extraordinary competence rather than incompetence.
  With a fixed consequentialist objective, avoiding catastrophe requires constraining AI capabilities. In fact, constraining capabilities the right amount not only averts catastrophe but yields valuable outcomes. Our results apply to any objective produced by modern industrial AI development pipelines.

AI.tldr: 论文研究AI在追求固定目标时可能导致灾难性后果的风险，指出当能力足够强大时，追求固定结果主义目标往往会导致灾难，而约束AI能力可以避免这种风险。
AI.motivation: 由于人类偏好过于复杂难以编码，AI通常使用不准确的目标函数。优化这些目标往往产生不良后果（奖励黑客攻击）。虽然大多数奖励黑客攻击案例是良性的，但论文关注的是当AI能力足够先进时，追求固定结果主义目标可能导致灾难性后果的风险。
AI.method: 通过建立形式化条件来证明这种风险的存在。研究在什么条件下，追求固定结果主义目标会导致灾难性后果。分析表明，简单或随机行为是安全的，而灾难性风险源于非凡的能力而非无能。
AI.result: 研究发现，当能力足够先进时，追求固定结果主义目标确实会导致灾难性后果。避免灾难需要约束AI能力，适当地约束能力不仅能避免灾难，还能产生有价值的结果。这些结果适用于现代工业AI开发流程产生的任何目标。
AI.conclusion: 为了避免AI追求固定目标导致的灾难性风险，需要约束AI的能力水平。适当地约束能力不仅能防止灾难，还能确保AI产生有价值的结果。这一发现对现代AI开发具有重要意义。

title: Sparse-Dense Mixture of Experts Adapter for Multi-Modal Tracking
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) techniques, such as prompts and adapters, are widely used in multi-modal tracking because they alleviate issues of full-model fine-tuning, including time inefficiency, high resource consumption, parameter storage burden, and catastrophic forgetting. However, due to cross-modal heterogeneity, most existing PEFT-based methods struggle to effectively represent multi-modal features within a unified framework with shared parameters. To address this problem, we propose a novel Sparse-Dense Mixture of Experts Adapter (SDMoEA) framework for PEFT-based multi-modal tracking under a unified model structure. Specifically, we design an SDMoE module as the multi-modal adapter to model modality-specific and shared information efficiently. SDMoE consists of a sparse MoE and a dense-shared MoE: the former captures modality-specific information, while the latter models shared cross-modal information. Furthermore, to overcome limitations of existing tracking methods in modeling high-order correlations during multi-level multi-modal fusion, we introduce a Gram-based Semantic Alignment Hypergraph Fusion (GSAHF) module. It first employs Gram matrices for cross-modal semantic alignment, ensuring that the constructed hypergraph accurately reflects semantic similarity and high-order dependencies between modalities. The aligned features are then integrated into the hypergraph structure to exploit its ability to model high-order relationships, enabling deep fusion of multi-level multi-modal information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance compared with other PEFT approaches on several multi-modal tracking benchmarks, including LasHeR, RGBT234, VTUAV, VisEvent, COESOT, DepthTrack, and VOT-RGBD2022.

AI.tldr: 提出SDMoEA框架，通过稀疏-稠密混合专家适配器解决多模态跟踪中参数高效微调的跨模态异构问题，并结合基于Gram矩阵的语义对齐超图融合模块实现高阶多模态特征融合。
AI.motivation: 现有参数高效微调方法在多模态跟踪中面临跨模态异构性挑战，难以在共享参数的统一框架中有效表示多模态特征，需要解决模态特定信息和跨模态共享信息的建模问题。
AI.method: 提出SDMoEA框架：1) SDMoE模块包含稀疏MoE（捕获模态特定信息）和稠密共享MoE（建模跨模态共享信息）；2) GSAHF模块使用Gram矩阵进行跨模态语义对齐，构建超图以建模高阶相关性，实现多层次多模态融合。
AI.result: 在LasHeR、RGBT234、VTUAV、VisEvent、COESOT、DepthTrack、VOT-RGBD2022等多个多模态跟踪基准测试中，该方法相比其他参数高效微调方法取得了优越性能。
AI.conclusion: SDMoEA框架有效解决了多模态跟踪中的跨模态异构问题，通过稀疏-稠密混合专家适配器和基于Gram矩阵的语义对齐超图融合，实现了参数高效的多模态特征表示和高阶相关性建模。

title: HindSight: Evaluating Research Idea Generation via Future Impact
summary: Evaluating AI-generated research ideas typically relies on LLM judges or human panels -- both subjective and disconnected from actual research impact. We introduce \hs{}, a time-split evaluation framework that measures idea quality by matching generated ideas against real future publications and scoring them by citation impact and venue acceptance. Using a temporal cutoff~$T$, we restrict an idea generation system to pre-$T$ literature, then evaluate its outputs against papers published in the subsequent 30 months. Experiments across 10 AI/ML research topics reveal a striking disconnect: LLM-as-Judge finds no significant difference between retrieval-augmented and vanilla idea generation ($p{=}0.584$), while \hs{} shows the retrieval-augmented system produces 2.5$\times$ higher-scoring ideas ($p{<}0.001$). Moreover, \hs{} scores are \emph{negatively} correlated with LLM-judged novelty ($ρ{=}{-}0.29$, $p{<}0.01$), suggesting that LLMs systematically overvalue novel-sounding ideas that never materialize in real research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为HS的时间分割评估框架，用于评估AI生成的研究想法质量，通过将生成的想法与真实未来出版物匹配，并根据引用影响和会议接受度进行评分，揭示了LLM评估与实际研究影响之间的显著差异。
AI.motivation: 当前评估AI生成研究想法主要依赖LLM评估或人工评审，这两种方法都具有主观性且与实际研究影响脱节，需要一种更客观、基于实际研究影响的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出HS时间分割评估框架：设置时间分割点T，将想法生成系统限制在T之前的文献上，然后将其输出与后续30个月内发表的真实论文进行匹配，根据引用影响和会议接受度对匹配结果进行评分。
AI.result: 在10个AI/ML研究主题上的实验显示：LLM评估认为检索增强和普通想法生成无显著差异(p=0.584)，而HS评估显示检索增强系统产生2.5倍更高得分的想法(p<0.001)；HS得分与LLM评估的新颖性呈负相关(ρ=-0.29, p<0.01)，表明LLM系统性地高估了那些在真实研究中从未实现的新颖想法。
AI.conclusion: HS框架提供了一种更客观、基于实际研究影响的AI生成研究想法评估方法，揭示了当前LLM评估方法的局限性，特别是其过度重视在真实研究中未实现的新颖想法的问题。

title: VTC-Bench: Evaluating Agentic Multimodal Models via Compositional Visual Tool Chaining
summary: Recent advancements extend Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) beyond standard visual question answering to utilizing external tools for advanced visual tasks. Despite this progress, precisely executing and effectively composing diverse tools for complex tasks remain persistent bottleneck. Constrained by sparse tool-sets and simple tool-use trajectories, existing benchmarks fail to capture complex and diverse tool interactions, falling short in evaluating model performance under practical, real-world conditions. To bridge this gap, we introduce VisualToolChain-Bench~(VTC-Bench), a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate tool-use proficiency in MLLMs. To align with realistic computer vision pipelines, our framework features 32 diverse OpenCV-based visual operations. This rich tool-set enables extensive combinations, allowing VTC-Bench to rigorously assess multi-tool composition and long-horizon, multi-step plan execution. For precise evaluation, we provide 680 curated problems structured across a nine-category cognitive hierarchy, each with ground-truth execution trajectories. Extensive experiments on 19 leading MLLMs reveal critical limitations in current models' visual agentic capabilities. Specifically, models struggle to adapt to diverse tool-sets and generalize to unseen operations, with the leading model Gemini-3.0-Pro only achieving 51\% on our benchmark. Furthermore, multi-tool composition remains a persistent challenge. When facing complex tasks, models struggle to formulate efficient execution plans, relying heavily on a narrow, suboptimal subset of familiar functions rather than selecting the optimal tools. By identifying these fundamental challenges, VTC-Bench establishes a rigorous baseline to guide the development of more generalized visual agentic models.

AI.tldr: VTC-Bench是一个评估多模态大语言模型工具使用能力的基准测试，包含32种OpenCV视觉操作和680个问题，揭示了当前模型在视觉工具使用方面的严重局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试受限于稀疏的工具集和简单的工具使用轨迹，无法捕捉复杂多样的工具交互，无法评估模型在实际场景下的性能。需要建立一个更全面的基准来评估MLLMs的工具使用能力。
AI.method: 开发了VTC-Bench基准，包含32种基于OpenCV的多样化视觉操作，支持广泛的工具组合。提供了680个精心设计的问题，按照九类认知层次结构组织，每个问题都有真实执行轨迹作为基准。
AI.result: 对19个领先的MLLMs进行广泛实验，发现当前模型在视觉代理能力方面存在严重限制。最佳模型Gemini-3.0-Pro仅达到51%的准确率。模型难以适应多样化工具集，无法泛化到未见过的操作，多工具组合仍是持续挑战。
AI.conclusion: VTC-Bench通过识别这些基本挑战，为开发更通用的视觉代理模型建立了严格的基准，揭示了当前模型在复杂任务中依赖有限、次优工具子集而非选择最优工具的问题。

title: The Hrunting of AI: Where and How to Improve English Dialectal Fairness
summary: It is known that large language models (LLMs) underperform in English dialects, and that improving them is difficult due to data scarcity. In this work we investigate how quality and availability impact the feasibility of improving LLMs in this context. For this, we evaluate three rarely-studied English dialects (Yorkshire, Geordie, and Cornish), plus African-American Vernacular English, and West Frisian as control. We find that human-human agreement when determining LLM generation quality directly impacts LLM-as-a-judge performance. That is, LLM-human agreement mimics the human-human agreement pattern, and so do metrics such as accuracy. It is an issue because LLM-human agreement measures an LLM's alignment with the human consensus; and hence raises questions about the feasibility of improving LLM performance in locales where low populations induce low agreement. We also note that fine-tuning does not eradicate, and might amplify, this pattern in English dialects. But also find encouraging signals, such as some LLMs' ability to generate high-quality data, thus enabling scalability. We argue that data must be carefully evaluated to ensure fair and inclusive LLM improvement; and, in the presence of scarcity, new tools are needed to handle the pattern found.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，大语言模型在英语方言上表现不佳，改进困难主要源于数据稀缺。研究评估了约克郡、乔迪、康沃尔等方言，发现人类评估者间的一致性直接影响LLM作为评判者的表现，这在低人口方言中尤为严重，对公平性改进构成挑战。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在英语方言上表现不佳，且由于数据稀缺难以改进。本研究旨在探究数据质量和可用性如何影响改进LLM在方言环境中的可行性，特别关注低人口方言的公平性问题。
AI.method: 研究评估了三种罕见英语方言（约克郡、乔迪、康沃尔方言）、非洲裔美国方言以及作为对照的西弗里斯兰语。通过分析人类-人类在评估LLM生成质量时的一致性，研究LLM作为评判者的表现模式。
AI.result: 发现人类评估者间的一致性直接影响LLM作为评判者的表现：LLM-人类一致性模式与人类-人类一致性模式相似，准确性等指标也呈现相同模式。微调无法消除这种模式，反而可能放大。但也发现积极信号，如某些LLM能够生成高质量数据，实现可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 必须仔细评估数据以确保LLM改进的公平性和包容性；在数据稀缺的情况下，需要新工具来处理发现的一致性模式问题。低人口方言中的人类共识不足对LLM性能改进构成根本性挑战。

title: Prompt Readiness Levels (PRL): a maturity scale and scoring framework for production grade prompt assets
summary: Prompt engineering has become a production critical component of generative AI systems. However, organizations still lack a shared, auditable method to qualify prompt assets against operational objectives, safety constraints, and compliance requirements. This paper introduces Prompt Readiness Levels (PRL), a nine level maturity scale inspired by TRL, and the Prompt Readiness Score (PRS), a multidimensional scoring method with gating thresholds designed to prevent weak link failure modes. PRL/PRS provide an original, structured and methodological framework for governing prompt assets specification, testing, traceability, security evaluation, and deployment readiness enabling valuation of prompt engineering through reproducible qualification decisions across teams and industries.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了Prompt Readiness Levels (PRL)九级成熟度量表和Prompt Readiness Score (PRS)多维评分方法，为生成式AI系统中的提示工程提供结构化治理框架。
AI.motivation: 当前组织缺乏共享、可审计的方法来评估提示资产是否符合运营目标、安全约束和合规要求，需要系统化的治理框架。
AI.method: 引入PRL（九级成熟度量表，受TRL启发）和PRS（多维评分方法，具有门控阈值以防止弱链接故障模式）。
AI.result: PRL/PRS提供了一个原创的、结构化的方法论框架，用于治理提示资产的规范、测试、可追溯性、安全评估和部署准备就绪。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使团队和行业能够通过可重复的资格决策来评估提示工程的价值，解决当前缺乏标准化治理方法的问题。

title: UniVid: Pyramid Diffusion Model for High Quality Video Generation
summary: Diffusion-based text-to-video generation (T2V) or image-to-video (I2V) generation have emerged as a prominent research focus. However, there exists a challenge in integrating the two generative paradigms into a unified model. In this paper, we present a unified video generation model (UniVid) with hybrid conditions of the text prompt and reference image. Given these two available controls, our model can extract objects' appearance and their motion descriptions from textual prompts, while obtaining texture details and structural information from image clues to guide the video generation process. Specifically, we scale up the pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model for generating temporally coherent frames via introducing our temporal-pyramid cross-frame spatial-temporal attention modules and convolutions. To support bimodal control, we introduce a dual-stream cross-attention mechanism, whose attention scores can be freely re-weighted for interpolation of between single and two modalities controls during inference. Extensive experiments showcase that our UniVid achieves superior temporal coherence on T2V, I2V and (T+I)2V tasks.

AI.tldr: UniVid是一个统一的视频生成模型，能够同时处理文本提示和参考图像两种条件，实现文本到视频(T2V)、图像到视频(I2V)以及文本+图像到视频(T+I)2V的生成任务。
AI.motivation: 当前扩散式文本到视频和图像到视频生成是两个独立的研究方向，缺乏能够统一处理这两种生成范式的模型。本文旨在开发一个能够同时利用文本和图像条件进行视频生成的统一模型。
AI.method: 1. 基于预训练的文本到图像扩散模型进行扩展，通过引入时间金字塔跨帧时空注意力模块和卷积来生成时间一致的帧；2. 采用双流交叉注意力机制，其注意力分数可以在推理过程中自由重新加权，实现单模态和双模态控制之间的插值。
AI.result: 实验表明，UniVid在T2V、I2V和(T+I)2V任务上都实现了优越的时间一致性，能够从文本提示中提取物体外观和运动描述，同时从图像线索中获取纹理细节和结构信息来指导视频生成。
AI.conclusion: UniVid成功地将文本到视频和图像到视频生成统一到一个模型中，通过创新的时间金字塔跨帧时空注意力模块和双流交叉注意力机制，实现了多模态条件下的高质量视频生成。

title: Efficient Document Parsing via Parallel Token Prediction
summary: Document parsing, as a fundamental yet crucial vision task, is being revolutionized by vision-language models (VLMs). However, the autoregressive (AR) decoding inherent to VLMs creates a significant bottleneck, severely limiting parsing speed. In this paper, we propose Parallel-Token Prediction (PTP), a plugable, model-agnostic and simple-yet-effective method that enables VLMs to generate multiple future tokens in parallel with improved sample efficiency. Specifically, we insert some learnable tokens into the input sequence and design corresponding training objectives to equip the model with parallel decoding capabilities for document parsing. Furthermore, to support effective training, we develop a comprehensive data generation pipeline that efficiently produces large-scale, high-quality document parsing training data for VLMs. Extensive experiments on OmniDocBench and olmOCR-bench demonstrate that our method not only significantly improves decoding speed (1.6x-2.2x) but also reduces model hallucinations and exhibits strong generalization abilities.

AI.tldr: 提出PTP方法，通过并行令牌预测解决VLM在文档解析中的自回归解码瓶颈，显著提升解析速度
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在文档解析任务中面临自回归解码的速度瓶颈，限制了实际应用效率
AI.method: 提出PTP方法：1）在输入序列中插入可学习令牌；2）设计相应训练目标使模型具备并行解码能力；3）开发数据生成管道产生大规模高质量训练数据
AI.result: 在OmniDocBench和olmOCR-bench上实验表明，方法提升解码速度1.6-2.2倍，减少模型幻觉，展现强泛化能力
AI.conclusion: PTP是一种可插拔、模型无关且简单有效的方法，能显著提升VLM在文档解析任务中的解码效率

title: Interference-Aware K-Step Reachable Communication in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Effective communication is pivotal for addressing complex collaborative tasks in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Yet, limited communication bandwidth and dynamic, intricate environmental topologies present significant challenges in identifying high-value communication partners. Agents must consequently select collaborators under uncertainty, lacking a priori knowledge of which partners can deliver task-critical information. To this end, we propose Interference-Aware K-Step Reachable Communication (IA-KRC), a novel framework that enhances cooperation via two core components: (1) a K-Step reachability protocol that confines message passing to physically accessible neighbors, and (2) an interference-prediction module that optimizes partner choice by minimizing interference while maximizing utility. Compared to existing methods, IA-KRC enables substantially more persistent and efficient cooperation despite environmental interference. Comprehensive evaluations confirm that IA-KRC achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines, while demonstrating enhanced robustness and scalability in complex topological and highly dynamic multi-agent scenarios.

AI.tldr: IA-KRC是一个多智能体强化学习通信框架，通过K步可达协议限制物理可达邻居间的消息传递，结合干扰预测模块优化合作者选择，在复杂动态环境中实现更持久高效的合作。
AI.motivation: 多智能体强化学习中，有限通信带宽和复杂动态环境拓扑给识别高价值通信伙伴带来挑战。智能体需要在缺乏先验知识的情况下，在不确定性中选择能够提供任务关键信息的合作者。
AI.method: 提出IA-KRC框架，包含两个核心组件：1) K步可达协议，将消息传递限制在物理可达的邻居范围内；2) 干扰预测模块，通过最小化干扰同时最大化效用来优化伙伴选择。
AI.result: 相比现有方法，IA-KRC在环境干扰下实现了更持久高效的合作。综合评估表明，IA-KRC在复杂拓扑和高度动态的多智能体场景中，相比最先进的基线方法取得了更优性能，同时表现出更强的鲁棒性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: IA-KRC通过结合物理可达性约束和干扰预测，有效解决了多智能体通信中的伙伴选择问题，在复杂动态环境中显著提升了合作效率和鲁棒性。

title: Sky2Ground: A Benchmark for Site Modeling under Varying Altitude
summary: We introduce Sky2Ground, a three-view dataset designed for varying altitude camera localization, correspondence learning, and reconstruction. The dataset combines structured synthetic imagery with real, in-the-wild images, providing both controlled multi-view geometry and realistic scene noise. Each of the 51 sites contains thousands of satellite, aerial, and ground images spanning wide altitude ranges and nearly orthogonal viewing angles, enabling rigorous evaluation across global-to-local contexts. We benchmark state of the art pose estimation models, including MASt3R, DUSt3R, Map Anything, and VGGT, and observe that the use of satellite imagery often degrades performance, highlighting the challenges under large altitude variations. We also examine reconstruction methods, highlighting the challenges introduced by sparse geometric overlap, varying perspectives, and the use of real imagery, which often introduces noise and reduces rendering quality. To address some of these challenges, we propose SkyNet, a model which enhances cross-view consistency when incorporating satellite imagery with a curriculum-based training strategy to progressively incorporate more satellite views. SkyNet significantly strengthens multi-view alignment and outperforms existing methods by 9.6% on RRA@5 and 18.1% on RTA@5 in terms of absolute performance. Sky2Ground and SkyNet together establish a comprehensive testbed and baseline for advancing large-scale, multi-altitude 3D perception and generalizable camera localization. Code and models will be released publicly for future research.

AI.tldr: Sky2Ground是一个三视图数据集，用于不同高度相机定位、对应关系学习和重建，包含合成和真实图像。SkyNet模型通过课程学习策略增强卫星图像的跨视图一致性，在定位任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理大高度变化（从卫星到地面）的多视图场景时面临挑战，特别是在卫星图像引入时性能下降。需要专门的数据集和模型来解决跨高度、跨视角的相机定位和重建问题。
AI.method: 1) 创建Sky2Ground数据集：包含51个场景的卫星、航空和地面图像，结合结构化合成图像和真实野外图像；2) 提出SkyNet模型：采用课程学习策略逐步引入卫星视图，增强跨视图一致性；3) 在MASt3R、DUSt3R等现有方法上进行基准测试。
AI.result: 1) 卫星图像通常降低现有模型的性能；2) 稀疏几何重叠、视角变化和真实图像噪声给重建带来挑战；3) SkyNet在RRA@5和RTA@5指标上分别比现有方法提升9.6%和18.1%，显著增强多视图对齐。
AI.conclusion: Sky2Ground数据集和SkyNet模型为大规模、多高度3D感知和通用相机定位提供了全面的测试平台和基线。两者共同推进了跨高度视觉理解的研究，代码和模型将公开以促进未来研究。

title: Bidirectional Chinese and English Passive Sentences Dataset for Machine Translation
comment: 11 pages,1 figures, Language Resources and Evaluation Conference 2026
summary: Machine Translation (MT) evaluation has gone beyond metrics, towards more specific linguistic phenomena. Regarding English-Chinese language pairs, passive sentences are constructed and distributed differently due to language variation, thus need special attention in MT. This paper proposes a bidirectional multi-domain dataset of passive sentences, extracted from five Chinese-English parallel corpora and annotated automatically with structure labels according to human translation, and a test set with manually verified annotation. The dataset consists of 73,965 parallel sentence pairs (2,358,731 English words, 3,498,229 Chinese characters). We evaluate two state-of-the-art open-source MT systems with our dataset, and four commercial models with the test set. The results show that, unlike humans, models are more influenced by the voice of the source text rather than the general voice usage of the source language, and therefore tend to maintain the passive voice when translating a passive in either direction. However, models demonstrate some knowledge of the low frequency and predominantly negative context of Chinese passives, leading to higher voice consistency with human translators in English-to-Chinese translation than in Chinese-to-English translation. Commercial NMT models scored higher in metric evaluations, but LLMs showed a better ability to use diverse alternative translations. Datasets and annotation script will be shared upon request.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个英汉被动句双向多领域数据集，用于评估机器翻译系统在处理被动结构时的表现，发现模型倾向于保持源文本的语态而非遵循目标语言的语态使用习惯。
AI.motivation: 由于英汉语言在被动句构造和分布上存在差异，需要专门关注机器翻译中被动结构的处理。现有评估方法缺乏针对特定语言现象（如被动句）的专门数据集。
AI.method: 从五个英汉平行语料库中提取被动句，构建双向多领域数据集（73,965个平行句对），根据人工翻译自动标注结构标签，并创建手动验证的测试集。评估了两个开源MT系统和四个商业模型。
AI.result: 模型更受源文本语态影响而非源语言的一般语态使用习惯，倾向于在双向翻译中保持被动语态。但模型对汉语被动句低频和负面语境有所认知，英译中时与人工翻译的语态一致性高于中译英。商业NMT模型在指标评估中得分更高，但LLMs在多样化替代翻译方面表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 构建了专门的英汉被动句评估数据集，揭示了MT系统在处理跨语言被动结构时的局限性，为改进翻译质量提供了重要见解。

title: Ego-1K -- A Large-Scale Multiview Video Dataset for Egocentric Vision
summary: We present Ego-1K, a large-scale collection of time-synchronized egocentric multiview videos designed to advance neural 3D video synthesis and dynamic scene understanding. The dataset contains nearly 1,000 short egocentric videos captured with a custom rig with 12 synchronized cameras surrounding a 4-camera VR headset worn by the user. Scene content focuses on hand motions and hand-object interactions in different settings. We describe rig design, data processing, and calibration. Our dataset enables new ways to benchmark egocentric scene reconstruction methods, an important research area as smart glasses with multiple cameras become omnipresent. Our experiments demonstrate that our dataset presents unique challenges for existing 3D and 4D novel view synthesis methods due to large disparities and image motion caused by close dynamic objects and rig egomotion. Our dataset supports future research in this challenging domain. It is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/facebook/ego-1k.

AI.tldr: Ego-1K是一个大规模时间同步的自我中心多视角视频数据集，包含近1000个短视频，使用12个同步相机环绕4相机VR头显采集，专注于手部动作和手物交互场景。
AI.motivation: 随着配备多相机的智能眼镜日益普及，需要大规模高质量的自我中心多视角视频数据集来推进神经3D视频合成和动态场景理解的研究。
AI.method: 使用定制化设备采集数据，包含12个同步相机环绕4相机VR头显，采集近1000个短视频，专注于手部动作和手物交互场景，并详细描述了设备设计、数据处理和校准过程。
AI.result: 实验表明该数据集对现有3D和4D新视角合成方法提出了独特挑战，主要由于近距离动态物体和设备自身运动导致的大视差和图像运动。
AI.conclusion: Ego-1K数据集为自我中心场景重建方法提供了新的基准测试方式，支持这一具有挑战性领域的未来研究，数据集已在HuggingFace上公开。

title: Practicing with Language Models Cultivates Human Empathic Communication
summary: Empathy is central to human connection, yet people often struggle to express it effectively. In blinded evaluations, large language models (LLMs) generate responses that are often judged more empathic than human-written ones. Yet when a response is attributed to AI, recipients feel less heard and validated than when comparable responses are attributed to a human. To probe and address this gap in empathic communication skill, we built Lend an Ear, an experimental conversation platform in which participants are asked to offer empathic support to an LLM role-playing personal and workplace troubles. From 33,938 messages spanning 2,904 text-based conversations between 968 participants and their LLM conversational partners, we derive a data-driven taxonomy of idiomatic empathic expressions in naturalistic dialogue. Based on a pre-registered randomized experiment, we present evidence that a brief LLM coaching intervention offering personalized feedback on how to effectively communicate empathy significantly boosts alignment of participants' communication patterns with normative empathic communication patterns relative to both a control group and a group that received video-based but non-personalized feedback. Moreover, we find evidence for a silent empathy effect that people feel empathy but systematically fail to express it. Nonetheless, participants reliably identify responses aligned with normative empathic communication criteria as more expressive of empathy. Together, these results advance the scientific understanding of how empathy is expressed and valued and demonstrate a scalable, AI-based intervention for scaffolding and cultivating it.

AI.tldr: 研究发现AI能生成比人类更具同理心的回应，但当回应被归因于AI时，接收者感受不如人类回应。通过实验平台和AI辅导干预，能显著提升参与者的同理心表达技能。
AI.motivation: 同理心对人类连接至关重要，但人们常常难以有效表达。虽然大型语言模型能生成比人类更具同理心的回应，但当回应被归因于AI时，接收者感受不如人类回应。研究者希望探索并解决这种同理心沟通技能的差距。
AI.method: 构建了Lend an Ear实验对话平台，让参与者向扮演个人和工作困境的LLM提供同理心支持。从33,938条消息、2,904次对话中提取了自然对话中的同理心表达分类法。通过预注册随机实验，比较了LLM个性化反馈、视频非个性化反馈和对照组的干预效果。
AI.result: LLM个性化辅导干预显著提升了参与者沟通模式与规范同理心沟通模式的对齐度，效果优于对照组和视频非个性化反馈组。发现了"沉默同理心效应"：人们感受到同理心但系统性地未能表达。参与者能可靠识别符合规范同理心标准的回应。
AI.conclusion: 研究推进了对同理心表达和评价的科学理解，并展示了可扩展的AI干预方法，用于支持和培养同理心沟通技能。

title: Modeling Matches as Language: A Generative Transformer Approach for Counterfactual Player Valuation in Football
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to 2026 ECML-PKDD Applied Data Science Track
summary: Evaluating football player transfers is challenging because player actions depend strongly on tactical systems, teammates, and match context. Despite this complexity, recruitment decisions often rely on static statistics and subjective expert judgment, which do not fully account for these contextual factors. This limitation stems largely from the absence of counterfactual simulation mechanisms capable of predicting outcomes in hypothetical scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose ScoutGPT, a generative model that treats football match events as sequential tokens within a language modeling framework. Utilizing a NanoGPT-based Transformer architecture trained on next-token prediction, ScoutGPT learns the dynamics of match event sequences to simulate event sequences under hypothetical lineups, demonstrating superior predictive performance compared to existing baseline models. Leveraging this capability, the model employs Monte Carlo sampling to enable counterfactual simulation, allowing for the assessment of unobserved scenarios. Experiments on K League data show that simulated player transfers lead to measurable changes in offensive progression and goal probabilities, indicating that ScoutGPT captures player-specific impact beyond traditional static metrics.

AI.tldr: ScoutGPT是一个基于Transformer的生成模型，将足球比赛事件视为序列标记，通过语言建模框架学习比赛动态，能够模拟假设阵容下的事件序列，用于评估球员转会效果。
AI.motivation: 足球球员转会评估具有挑战性，因为球员表现高度依赖于战术体系、队友和比赛情境。现有的招募决策主要依赖静态统计数据和主观专家判断，未能充分考虑这些情境因素，缺乏能够预测假设场景结果的模拟机制。
AI.method: 提出ScoutGPT模型，基于NanoGPT的Transformer架构，通过下一个标记预测训练，将足球比赛事件视为序列标记。模型学习比赛事件序列的动态特性，能够模拟假设阵容下的事件序列。采用蒙特卡洛采样实现反事实模拟，评估未观察到的场景。
AI.result: 在K联赛数据上的实验表明，模拟的球员转会导致进攻推进和进球概率的可测量变化，证明ScoutGPT能够捕捉超越传统静态指标的球员特定影响，相比现有基线模型具有更优的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: ScoutGPT通过将足球比赛事件建模为序列标记，提供了一种有效的反事实模拟机制，能够更准确地评估球员转会效果，超越了传统静态统计方法的局限性，为足球球员招募提供了更科学的决策支持。

title: InterPol: De-anonymizing LM Arena via Interpolated Preference Learning
summary: Strict anonymity of model responses is a key for the reliability of voting-based leaderboards, such as LM Arena. While prior studies have attempted to compromise this assumption using simple statistical features like TF-IDF or bag-ofwords, these methods often lack the discriminative power to distinguish between stylistically similar or within-family models. To overcome these limitations and expose the severity of vulnerability, we introduce INTERPOL, a model-driven identification framework that learns to distinguish target models from others using interpolated preference data. Specifically, INTERPOL captures deep stylistic patterns that superficial statistical features miss by synthesizing hard negative samples through model interpolation and employing an adaptive curriculum learning strategy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that INTERPOL significantly outperforms existing baselines in identification accuracy. Furthermore, we quantify the real-world threat of our findings through ranking manipulation simulations on Arena battle data.

AI.tldr: INTERPOL框架通过模型插值和自适应课程学习，显著提升了匿名模型响应识别能力，暴露了投票排行榜的安全漏洞
AI.motivation: 现有基于简单统计特征（如TF-IDF、词袋模型）的方法在区分风格相似或同家族模型时缺乏判别力，需要更强大的方法来揭示投票排行榜匿名性的严重漏洞
AI.method: 提出INTERPOL框架，通过模型插值合成困难负样本，并采用自适应课程学习策略，捕捉深层风格模式而非表面统计特征
AI.result: 实验表明INTERPOL在识别准确率上显著优于现有基线方法，并通过Arena对战数据的排名操纵模拟量化了实际威胁
AI.conclusion: INTERPOL框架有效暴露了投票排行榜匿名性的严重安全漏洞，需要更强的隐私保护措施来确保模型评估的可靠性

title: QTrack: Query-Driven Reasoning for Multi-modal MOT
summary: Multi-object tracking (MOT) has traditionally focused on estimating trajectories of all objects in a video, without selectively reasoning about user-specified targets under semantic instructions. In this work, we introduce a query-driven tracking paradigm that formulates tracking as a spatiotemporal reasoning problem conditioned on natural language queries. Given a reference frame, a video sequence, and a textual query, the goal is to localize and track only the target(s) specified in the query while maintaining temporal coherence and identity consistency. To support this setting, we construct RMOT26, a large-scale benchmark with grounded queries and sequence-level splits to prevent identity leakage and enable robust evaluation of generalization. We further present QTrack, an end-to-end vision-language model that integrates multimodal reasoning with tracking-oriented localization. Additionally, we introduce a Temporal Perception-Aware Policy Optimization strategy with structured rewards to encourage motion-aware reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach for reasoning-centric, language-guided tracking. Code and data are available at https://github.com/gaash-lab/QTrack

AI.tldr: 提出QTracK：基于自然语言查询的查询驱动多目标跟踪新范式，将跟踪视为时空推理问题，仅跟踪查询指定的目标
AI.motivation: 传统多目标跟踪（MOT）无差别跟踪视频中所有目标，缺乏基于语义指令选择性推理用户指定目标的能力
AI.method: 1）构建RMOT26大规模基准数据集，防止身份泄露；2）提出QTracK端到端视觉语言模型，整合多模态推理与跟踪定位；3）引入时间感知策略优化（TPPO）和结构化奖励促进运动感知推理
AI.result: 实验证明该方法在推理中心、语言引导的跟踪任务中具有有效性
AI.conclusion: 提出查询驱动跟踪新范式，通过自然语言查询实现选择性目标跟踪，为多目标跟踪领域带来新的研究方向

title: Datasets for Verb Alternations across Languages: BLM Templates and Data Augmentation Strategies
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable performance across various sentence-based linguistic phenomena, yet their ability to capture cross-sentence paradigmatic patterns, such as verb alternations, remains underexplored. In this work, we present curated paradigm-based datasets for four languages, designed to probe systematic cross-sentence knowledge of verb alternations (change-of-state and object-drop constructions in English, German and Italian, and Hebrew binyanim). The datasets comprise thousands of the Blackbird Language Matrices (BLMs) problems. The BLM task -- an RPM/ARC-like task devised specifically for language -- is a controlled linguistic puzzle where models must select the sentence that completes a pattern according to syntactic and semantic rules. We introduce three types of templates varying in complexity and apply linguistically-informed data augmentation strategies across synthetic and natural data. We provide simple baseline performance results across English, Italian, German, and Hebrew, that demonstrate the diagnostic usefulness of the datasets.

AI.tldr: 该研究创建了用于评估大语言模型在跨句子范式模式（特别是动词交替）理解能力的诊断数据集，涵盖英语、德语、意大利语和希伯来语四种语言。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在各种句子级语言现象上表现出色，但其捕捉跨句子范式模式（如动词交替）的能力尚未得到充分探索。研究者希望填补这一空白，评估模型对系统性跨句子知识的掌握程度。
AI.method: 研究者为四种语言（英语、德语、意大利语、希伯来语）创建了基于范式的数据集，专注于动词交替现象。数据集包含数千个Blackbird语言矩阵问题，这是一种类似RPM/ARC的受控语言谜题任务。采用三种不同复杂度的模板，并应用基于语言学知识的数据增强策略，涵盖合成和自然数据。
AI.result: 研究提供了在英语、意大利语、德语和希伯来语上的简单基线性能结果，证明了这些数据集在诊断模型能力方面的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究开发了专门用于评估大语言模型跨句子范式模式理解能力的诊断工具，为研究模型对系统性语言知识的掌握提供了新的评估框架。

title: SCAN: Sparse Circuit Anchor Interpretable Neuron for Lifelong Knowledge Editing
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often suffer from catastrophic forgetting and collapse during sequential knowledge editing. This vulnerability stems from the prevailing dense editing paradigm, which treats models as black boxes and relies on coarse-grained parameter interventions that inevitably disrupt preserved knowledge. To address this, we propose SCAN (a sparse editing framework based on Sparse Circuit Anchored Neuron) which transforms editing into a mechanism-aware manipulation by constructing a knowledge circuit via Sparse Transcoders. Experiments on Gemma2, Qwen3, and Llama3.1 across CounterFact, ZsRE and WikiFactDiff demonstrate that SCAN achieves a superior performance, maintaining model integrity on benchmarks like MMLU and GSM8K even after 3,000 sequential edits, whereas other existing methods deteriorate progressively as editing accumulates, eventually resulting in model collapse.

AI.tldr: SCAN是一个基于稀疏电路锚定神经元的稀疏编辑框架，通过稀疏转码器构建知识电路，解决了LLMs在顺序知识编辑中的灾难性遗忘和崩溃问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在顺序知识编辑中经常遭受灾难性遗忘和模型崩溃，这源于当前主流的密集编辑范式将模型视为黑盒，依赖粗粒度参数干预，不可避免地破坏已保存的知识。
AI.method: 提出SCAN稀疏编辑框架，基于稀疏电路锚定神经元，通过稀疏转码器构建知识电路，将编辑转化为机制感知的操作，而不是黑盒式的参数干预。
AI.result: 在Gemma2、Qwen3和Llama3.1模型上，使用CounterFact、ZsRE和WikiFactDiff数据集进行实验，SCAN表现出优越性能，即使在3000次顺序编辑后仍能保持模型在MMLU和GSM8K等基准测试上的完整性，而现有方法会随着编辑累积逐渐恶化并最终导致模型崩溃。
AI.conclusion: SCAN通过稀疏电路编辑方法有效解决了LLMs顺序知识编辑中的灾难性遗忘问题，实现了更好的知识保留和模型稳定性，为LLMs的知识更新提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: PhysAlign: Physics-Coherent Image-to-Video Generation through Feature and 3D Representation Alignment
summary: Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) offer a promising approach for simulating dynamic scenes and environments, with broad applications in robotics and media generation. However, existing models often generate temporally incoherent content that violates basic physical intuition, significantly limiting their practical applicability. We propose PhysAlign, an efficient framework for physics-coherent image-to-video (I2V) generation that explicitly addresses this limitation. To overcome the critical scarcity of physics-annotated videos, we first construct a fully controllable synthetic data generation pipeline based on rigid-body simulation, yielding a highly-curated dataset with accurate, fine-grained physics and 3D annotations. Leveraging this data, PhysAlign constructs a unified physical latent space by coupling explicit 3D geometry constraints with a Gram-based spatio-temporal relational alignment that extracts kinematic priors from video foundation models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysAlign significantly outperforms existing VDMs on tasks requiring complex physical reasoning and temporal stability, without compromising zero-shot visual quality. PhysAlign shows the potential to bridge the gap between raw visual synthesis and rigid-body kinematics, establishing a practical paradigm for genuinely physics-grounded video generation. The project page is available at https://physalign.github.io/PhysAlign.

AI.tldr: PhysAlign是一个用于物理一致图像到视频生成的框架，通过合成数据和物理潜在空间解决现有视频扩散模型的时间不连贯问题
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散模型生成的内容在时间上不连贯，违反基本物理直觉，限制了实际应用
AI.method: 1. 基于刚体模拟构建可控合成数据生成管道；2. 通过显式3D几何约束和基于Gram的时空关系对齐构建统一物理潜在空间；3. 从视频基础模型中提取运动学先验
AI.result: PhysAlign在需要复杂物理推理和时间稳定性的任务上显著优于现有视频扩散模型，同时保持零样本视觉质量
AI.conclusion: PhysAlign有潜力弥合原始视觉合成与刚体运动学之间的差距，为真正基于物理的视频生成建立实用范式

title: CCTU: A Benchmark for Tool Use under Complex Constraints
summary: Solving problems through tool use under explicit constraints constitutes a highly challenging yet unavoidable scenario for large language models (LLMs), requiring capabilities such as function calling, instruction following, and self-refinement. However, progress has been hindered by the absence of dedicated evaluations. To address this, we introduce CCTU, a benchmark for evaluating LLM tool use under complex constraints. CCTU is grounded in a taxonomy of 12 constraint categories spanning four dimensions (i.e., resource, behavior, toolset, and response). The benchmark comprises 200 carefully curated and challenging test cases across diverse tool-use scenarios, each involving an average of seven constraint types and an average prompt length exceeding 4,700 tokens. To enable reliable evaluation, we develop an executable constraint validation module that performs step-level validation and enforces compliance during multi-turn interactions between models and their environments. We evaluate nine state-of-the-art LLMs in both thinking and non-thinking modes. Results indicate that when strict adherence to all constraints is required, no model achieves a task completion rate above 20%. Further analysis reveals that models violate constraints in over 50% of cases, particularly in the resource and response dimensions. Moreover, LLMs demonstrate limited capacity for self-refinement even after receiving detailed feedback on constraint violations, highlighting a critical bottleneck in the development of robust tool-use agents. To facilitate future research, we release the data and code.

AI.tldr: CCTU是一个评估大语言模型在复杂约束条件下使用工具能力的基准测试，包含12类约束、200个测试用例，结果显示当前模型在严格约束下的任务完成率低于20%，约束违反率超过50%。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏专门评估大语言模型在复杂约束条件下使用工具能力的基准测试，这阻碍了相关研究进展。模型需要具备函数调用、指令遵循和自我优化等能力，但在约束条件下的表现尚未得到系统评估。
AI.method: 提出了CCTU基准测试，基于12类约束（资源、行为、工具集、响应四个维度），包含200个精心设计的测试用例。开发了可执行的约束验证模块，支持步骤级验证和多轮交互中的合规性检查。评估了9个最先进的大语言模型在思考和非思考模式下的表现。
AI.result: 当要求严格遵守所有约束时，没有任何模型的任务完成率超过20%。模型在超过50%的情况下违反约束，特别是在资源和响应维度。即使收到详细的约束违反反馈，大语言模型的自我优化能力仍然有限。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在复杂约束条件下的工具使用能力仍然存在显著瓶颈，特别是在约束遵循和自我优化方面。CCTU基准测试为未来研究提供了评估框架，相关数据和代码已开源。

title: Why the Valuable Capabilities of LLMs Are Precisely the Unexplainable Ones
summary: This paper proposes and argues for a counterintuitive thesis: the truly valuable capabilities of large language models (LLMs) reside precisely in the part that cannot be fully captured by human-readable discrete rules. The core argument is a proof by contradiction via expert system equivalence: if the full capabilities of an LLM could be described by a complete set of human-readable rules, then that rule set would be functionally equivalent to an expert system; but expert systems have been historically and empirically demonstrated to be strictly weaker than LLMs; therefore, a contradiction arises -- the capabilities of LLMs that exceed those of expert systems are exactly the capabilities that cannot be rule-encoded. This thesis is further supported by the Chinese philosophical concept of Wu (sudden insight through practice), the historical failure of expert systems, and a structural mismatch between human cognitive tools and complex systems. The paper discusses implications for interpretability research, AI safety, and scientific epistemology.

AI.tldr: 论文提出反直觉论点：大语言模型真正有价值的能力恰恰在于无法被人可读的离散规则完全捕获的部分，通过专家系统等价性进行反证法论证。
AI.motivation: 探讨大语言模型能力的本质来源，挑战"LLM能力可通过人类可读规则完全描述"的常见假设，揭示LLM超越专家系统的能力特性。
AI.method: 采用反证法论证：1) 假设LLM能力可被完整的人类可读规则集描述；2) 该规则集在功能上等价于专家系统；3) 但历史经验证明专家系统严格弱于LLM；4) 得出矛盾，证明LLM超越专家系统的能力无法被规则编码。
AI.result: 论证表明LLM的核心价值能力存在于无法被人类可读规则捕获的部分，这部分能力是LLM超越传统专家系统的关键所在。
AI.conclusion: LLM的真正价值在于其无法规则化的能力部分，这一发现对可解释性研究、AI安全和科学认识论具有重要启示，并得到中国哲学"悟"概念和历史经验的支持。

title: PYTHEN: A Flexible Framework for Legal Reasoning in Python
summary: This paper introduces PYTHEN, a novel Python-based framework for defeasible legal reasoning. PYTHEN is designed to model the inherently defeasible nature of legal argumentation, providing a flexible and intuitive syntax for representing legal rules, conditions, and exceptions. Inspired by PROLEG (PROlog-based LEGal reasoning support system) and guided by the philosophy of The Zen of Python, PYTHEN leverages Python's built-in any() and all() functions to offer enhanced flexibility by natively supporting both conjunctive (ALL) and disjunctive (ANY) conditions within a single rule, as well as a more expressive exception-handling mechanism. This paper details the architecture of PYTHEN, provides a comparative analysis with PROLEG, and discusses its potential applications in autoformalization and the development of next-generation legal AI systems. By bridging the gap between symbolic reasoning and the accessibility of Python, PYTHEN aims to democratize formal legal reasoning for young researchers, legal tech developers, and professionals without extensive logic programming expertise. We position PYTHEN as a practical bridge between the powerful symbolic reasoning capabilities of logic programming and the rich, ubiquitous ecosystem of Python, making formal legal reasoning accessible to a broader range of developers and legal professionals.

AI.tldr: PYTHEN是一个基于Python的可废止法律推理框架，利用Python的any()和all()函数支持合取与析取条件，提供灵活的法律规则表示和异常处理机制。
AI.motivation: 法律论证具有固有的可废止性，现有逻辑编程工具（如PROLEG）对非专业用户不够友好。PYTHEN旨在弥合符号推理与Python可访问性之间的鸿沟，让没有逻辑编程专业知识的年轻研究者、法律科技开发者和专业人士也能进行形式化法律推理。
AI.method: 基于Python开发可废止法律推理框架，借鉴PROLEG的设计理念和Python之禅哲学。利用Python内置的any()和all()函数原生支持单个规则内的合取（ALL）和析取（ANY）条件，提供更具表达力的异常处理机制。
AI.result: 开发了PYTHEN框架，详细描述了其架构，与PROLEG进行了比较分析，展示了其在自动形式化和下一代法律AI系统开发中的潜在应用。
AI.conclusion: PYTHEN作为逻辑编程强大符号推理能力与Python丰富生态系统之间的实用桥梁，使形式化法律推理对更广泛的开发者和法律专业人士变得可访问，有助于民主化法律推理工具。

title: SAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution for LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves reasoning in large language models (LLMs), but many methods still rely on large human-labeled datasets. While self-play reduces this dependency, it often lacks explicit planning and strong quality control, limiting stability in long-horizon multi-step reasoning. We present SAGE (Self-evolving Agents for Generalized reasoning Evolution), a closed-loop framework where four agents: Challenger, Planner, Solver, and Critic, co-evolve from a shared LLM backbone using only a small seed set. The Challenger continuously generates increasingly difficult tasks; the Planner converts each task into a structured multi-step plan; and the Solver follows the plan to produce an answer, whose correctness is determined by external verifiers. The Critic scores and filters both generated questions and plans to prevent curriculum drift and maintain training signal quality, enabling stable self-training. Across mathematics and code-generation benchmarks, SAGE delivers consistent gains across model scales, improving the Qwen-2.5-7B model by 8.9% on LiveCodeBench and 10.7% on OlympiadBench.

AI.tldr: SAGE是一个自演化的多智能体框架，通过四个角色（挑战者、规划者、求解者、批评者）从共享LLM主干协同演化，仅需少量种子集就能实现稳定的多步推理训练，在数学和代码生成基准上显著提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 当前强化学习虽然能提升大语言模型的推理能力，但仍依赖大量人工标注数据。自对弈方法虽然减少了这种依赖，但缺乏显式规划和严格的质量控制，导致长时域多步推理的稳定性不足。
AI.method: 提出SAGE框架，包含四个智能体：挑战者持续生成难度递增的任务；规划者将任务转化为结构化多步计划；求解者按计划生成答案并由外部验证器检查正确性；批评者对生成的问题和计划进行评分过滤，防止课程漂移并保持训练信号质量。
AI.result: 在数学和代码生成基准测试中，SAGE在不同模型规模上均取得一致提升，将Qwen-2.5-7B模型在LiveCodeBench上提升8.9%，在OlympiadBench上提升10.7%。
AI.conclusion: SAGE通过多智能体协同演化的闭环框架，仅需少量种子集就能实现稳定的自训练，有效解决了长时域多步推理中的规划缺失和质量控制问题，显著提升了语言模型的推理能力。

title: AD-Copilot: A Vision-Language Assistant for Industrial Anomaly Detection via Visual In-context Comparison
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive success in natural visual understanding, yet they consistently underperform in industrial anomaly detection (IAD). This is because MLLMs trained mostly on general web data differ significantly from industrial images. Moreover, they encode each image independently and can only compare images in the language space, making them insensitive to subtle visual differences that are key to IAD. To tackle these issues, we present AD-Copilot, an interactive MLLM specialized for IAD via visual in-context comparison. We first design a novel data curation pipeline to mine inspection knowledge from sparsely labeled industrial images and generate precise samples for captioning, VQA, and defect localization, yielding a large-scale multimodal dataset Chat-AD rich in semantic signals for IAD. On this foundation, AD-Copilot incorporates a novel Comparison Encoder that employs cross-attention between paired image features to enhance multi-image fine-grained perception, and is trained with a multi-stage strategy that incorporates domain knowledge and gradually enhances IAD skills. In addition, we introduce MMAD-BBox, an extended benchmark for anomaly localization with bounding-box-based evaluation. The experiments show that AD-Copilot achieves 82.3% accuracy on the MMAD benchmark, outperforming all other models without any data leakage. In the MMAD-BBox test, it achieves a maximum improvement of $3.35\times$ over the baseline. AD-Copilot also exhibits excellent generalization of its performance gains across other specialized and general-purpose benchmarks. Remarkably, AD-Copilot surpasses human expert-level performance on several IAD tasks, demonstrating its potential as a reliable assistant for real-world industrial inspection. All datasets and models will be released for the broader benefit of the community.

AI.tldr: AD-Copilot：一个通过视觉上下文比较专门用于工业异常检测的交互式多模态大语言模型，在MMAD基准测试中达到82.3%准确率，超越其他模型并接近人类专家水平
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在自然视觉理解方面表现优异，但在工业异常检测中表现不佳。这是因为MLLMs主要基于通用网络数据训练，与工业图像差异显著，且独立编码每张图像，只能通过语言空间比较图像，对IAD关键的细微视觉差异不敏感。
AI.method: 1. 设计数据整理流程，从稀疏标注的工业图像中挖掘检测知识，生成用于描述、视觉问答和缺陷定位的精确样本，创建大规模多模态数据集Chat-AD；2. 开发AD-Copilot模型，包含新型比较编码器，通过配对图像特征间的交叉注意力增强多图像细粒度感知；3. 采用多阶段训练策略，融入领域知识并逐步增强IAD技能；4. 引入MMAD-BBox基准测试，用于基于边界框的异常定位评估。
AI.result: 1. 在MMAD基准测试中达到82.3%准确率，超越所有其他模型且无数据泄露；2. 在MMAD-BBox测试中，相比基线最大提升3.35倍；3. 在其他专业和通用基准测试中表现出优秀的泛化能力；4. 在多个IAD任务上超越人类专家水平，展示了作为真实工业检测可靠助手的潜力。
AI.conclusion: AD-Copilot通过视觉上下文比较专门化设计，成功解决了MLLMs在工业异常检测中的局限性。该方法在多个基准测试中表现出色，甚至超越人类专家，为工业检测提供了可靠的多模态AI助手。所有数据集和模型将开源，促进社区发展。

title: AGCD: Agent-Guided Cross-Modal Decoding for Weather Forecasting
summary: Accurate weather forecasting is more than grid-wise regression: it must preserve coherent synoptic structures and physical consistency of meteorological fields, especially under autoregressive rollouts where small one-step errors can amplify into structural bias. Existing physics-priors approaches typically impose global, once-for-all constraints via architectures, regularization, or NWP coupling, offering limited state-adaptive and sample-specific controllability at deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose Agent-Guided Cross-modal Decoding (AGCD), a plug-and-play decoding-time prior-injection paradigm that derives state-conditioned physics-priors from the current multivariate atmosphere and injects them into forecasters in a controllable and reusable way. Specifically, We design a multi-agent meteorological narration pipeline to generate state-conditioned physics-priors, utilizing MLLMs to extract various meteorological elements effectively. To effectively apply the priors, AGCD further introduce cross-modal region interaction decoding that performs region-aware multi-scale tokenization and efficient physics-priors injection to refine visual features without changing the backbone interface. Experiments on WeatherBench demonstrate consistent gains for 6-hour forecasting across two resolutions (5.625 degree and 1.40625 degree) and diverse backbones (generic and weather-specialized), including strictly causal 48-hour autoregressive rollouts that reduce early-stage error accumulation and improve long-horizon stability.

AI.tldr: 提出AGCD方法，通过多智能体气象叙事生成状态条件物理先验，在解码时注入天气预报模型，改善长期预测的物理一致性和结构稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于物理先验的方法通常通过架构、正则化或NWP耦合施加全局约束，在部署时缺乏状态自适应和样本特定的可控性。需要一种能在解码时灵活注入物理先验的方法，以保持气象场的连贯结构和物理一致性，特别是在自回归预测中防止小误差累积放大。
AI.method: 提出Agent-Guided Cross-modal Decoding (AGCD)方法：1) 设计多智能体气象叙事管道，利用MLLMs提取各种气象要素，生成状态条件物理先验；2) 引入跨模态区域交互解码，执行区域感知多尺度标记化和高效物理先验注入，在不改变主干接口的情况下细化视觉特征。
AI.result: 在WeatherBench上的实验表明，在两种分辨率（5.625度和1.40625度）和多种主干网络（通用和天气专用）上，6小时预测均获得一致提升。严格的因果48小时自回归预测减少了早期误差累积，提高了长期预测稳定性。
AI.conclusion: AGCD提供了一种即插即用的解码时先验注入范式，能够从当前多变量大气状态推导状态条件物理先验，并以可控和可重复的方式注入预测器，有效改善天气预报的物理一致性和长期稳定性。

title: RetimeGS: Continuous-Time Reconstruction of 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Temporal retiming, the ability to reconstruct and render dynamic scenes at arbitrary timestamps, is crucial for applications such as slow-motion playback, temporal editing, and post-production. However, most existing 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) methods overfit at discrete frame indices but struggle to represent continuous-time frames, leading to ghosting artifacts when interpolating between timestamps. We identify this limitation as a form of temporal aliasing and propose RetimeGS, a simple yet effective 4DGS representation that explicitly defines the temporal behavior of the 3D Gaussian and mitigates temporal aliasing. To achieve smooth and consistent interpolation, we incorporate optical flow-guided initialization and supervision, triple-rendering supervision, and other targeted strategies. Together, these components enable ghost-free, temporally coherent rendering even under large motions. Experiments on datasets featuring fast motion, non-rigid deformation, and severe occlusions demonstrate that RetimeGS achieves superior quality and coherence over state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: RetimeGS是一种改进的4D高斯泼溅表示方法，通过显式定义3D高斯的时域行为来缓解时域混叠，实现动态场景的平滑时间重定时渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有4DGS方法在离散帧上过拟合，但在连续时间帧表示上表现不佳，导致时间插值时出现鬼影伪影。这种限制被视为一种时域混叠问题，需要解决以实现高质量的时间重定时渲染。
AI.method: 提出RetimeGS表示方法，显式定义3D高斯的时域行为。采用光流引导的初始化和监督、三重渲染监督以及其他针对性策略，确保平滑一致的时间插值。
AI.result: 在包含快速运动、非刚性变形和严重遮挡的数据集上，RetimeGS相比最先进方法实现了更优的质量和时域一致性，能够在大运动下实现无鬼影的时域相干渲染。
AI.conclusion: RetimeGS通过缓解时域混叠问题，为动态场景的时间重定时渲染提供了一种简单而有效的解决方案，在多种挑战性场景下表现出优越性能。

title: DOS: Dependency-Oriented Sampler for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) have recently emerged as a new paradigm in language modeling, offering flexible generation dynamics and enabling efficient parallel decoding. However, existing decoding strategies for pre-trained MDLMs predominantly rely on token-level uncertainty criteria, while largely overlooking sequence-level information and inter-token dependencies. To address this limitation, we propose Dependency-Oriented Sampler (DOS), a training-free decoding strategy that leverages inter-token dependencies to inform token updates during generation. Specifically, DOS exploits attention matrices from transformer blocks to approximate inter-token dependencies, emphasizing information from unmasked tokens when updating masked positions. Empirical results demonstrate that DOS consistently achieves superior performance on both code generation and mathematical reasoning tasks. Moreover, DOS can be seamlessly integrated with existing parallel sampling methods, leading to improved generation efficiency without sacrificing generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DOS解码策略，利用注意力矩阵捕捉token间依赖关系，提升掩码扩散语言模型的生成质量，特别是在代码生成和数学推理任务上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练MDLMs的解码策略主要依赖token级不确定性标准，忽视了序列级信息和token间依赖关系，这限制了生成质量。
AI.method: 提出依赖导向采样器(DOS)，利用transformer块的注意力矩阵近似token间依赖关系，在更新掩码位置时强调未掩码token的信息。
AI.result: DOS在代码生成和数学推理任务上持续取得优异性能，并能与现有并行采样方法无缝集成，在不牺牲生成质量的情况下提高生成效率。
AI.conclusion: DOS是一种无需训练的解码策略，通过利用token间依赖关系显著提升了掩码扩散语言模型的生成性能，具有实际应用价值。

title: Advancing Cancer Prognosis with Hierarchical Fusion of Genomic, Proteomic and Pathology Imaging Data from a Systems Biology Perspective
summary: To enhance the precision of cancer prognosis, recent research has increasingly focused on multimodal survival methods by integrating genomic data and histology images. However, current approaches overlook the fact that the proteome serves as an intermediate layer bridging genomic alterations and histopathological features while providing complementary biological information essential for survival prediction. This biological reality exposes another architectural limitation: existing integrative analysis studies fuse these heterogeneous data sources in a flat manner that fails to capture their inherent biological hierarchy. To address these limitations, we propose HFGPI, a hierarchical fusion framework that models the biological progression from genes to proteins to histology images from a systems biology perspective. Specifically, we introduce Molecular Tokenizer, a molecular encoding strategy that integrates identity embeddings with expression profiles to construct biologically informed representations for genes and proteins. We then develop Gene-Regulated Protein Fusion (GRPF), which employs graph-aware cross-attention with structure-preserving alignment to explicitly model gene-protein regulatory relationships and generate gene-regulated protein representations. Additionally, we propose Protein-Guided Hypergraph Learning (PGHL), which establishes associations between proteins and image patches, leveraging hypergraph convolution to capture higher-order protein-morphology relationships. The final features are progressively fused across hierarchical layers to achieve precise survival outcome prediction. Extensive experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate the superiority of HFGPI over state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: HFGPI是一个分层融合框架，通过建模基因→蛋白质→组织学图像的生物学层级关系来提升癌症预后预测精度，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态生存分析方法忽略了蛋白质组作为连接基因组改变和组织病理学特征的中间层，且现有方法以扁平方式融合异质数据源，未能捕捉其固有的生物学层级关系。
AI.method: 提出HFGPI分层融合框架：1) Molecular Tokenizer整合身份嵌入和表达谱构建基因/蛋白质表示；2) Gene-Regulated Protein Fusion使用图感知交叉注意力和结构保持对齐建模基因-蛋白质调控关系；3) Protein-Guided Hypergraph Learning建立蛋白质与图像块关联，利用超图卷积捕捉高阶蛋白质-形态关系；4) 分层渐进融合特征进行生存预测。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，HFGPI优于最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: HFGPI通过建模生物学层级关系，有效整合基因组、蛋白质组和组织学图像数据，显著提升了癌症生存预测的准确性。

title: When Does Sparsity Mitigate the Curse of Depth in LLMs
summary: Recent work has demonstrated the curse of depth in large language models (LLMs), where later layers contribute less to learning and representation than earlier layers. Such under-utilization is linked to the accumulated growth of variance in Pre-Layer Normalization, which can push deep blocks toward near-identity behavior. In this paper, we demonstrate that, sparsity, beyond enabling efficiency, acts as a regulator of variance propagation and thereby improves depth utilization. Our investigation covers two sources of sparsity: (i) implicit sparsity, which emerges from training and data conditions, including weight sparsity induced by weight decay and attention sparsity induced by long context inputs; and (ii) explicit sparsity, which is enforced by architectural design, including key/value-sharing sparsity in Grouped-Query Attention and expert-activation sparsity in Mixtureof-Experts. Our claim is thoroughly supported by controlled depth-scaling experiments and targeted layer effectiveness interventions. Across settings, we observe a consistent relationship: sparsity improves layer utilization by reducing output variance and promoting functional differentiation. We eventually distill our findings into a practical rule-of-thumb recipe for training deptheffective LLMs, yielding a notable 4.6% accuracy improvement on downstream tasks. Our results reveal sparsity, arising naturally from standard design choices, as a key yet previously overlooked mechanism for effective depth scaling in LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/pUmpKin-Co/SparsityAndCoD.

AI.tldr: 稀疏性作为方差传播调节器，能改善大语言模型深度利用，缓解深度诅咒问题
AI.motivation: 大语言模型中存在深度诅咒问题，深层贡献较少，这与预层归一化中方差累积有关，导致深层接近恒等行为。研究稀疏性如何调节方差传播以改善深度利用。
AI.method: 研究两种稀疏性来源：1) 隐式稀疏性（训练和数据条件产生，如权重衰减导致的权重稀疏、长上下文输入导致的注意力稀疏）；2) 显式稀疏性（架构设计强制，如分组查询注意力中的键/值共享稀疏、混合专家中的专家激活稀疏）。通过受控深度扩展实验和针对性层有效性干预验证。
AI.result: 稀疏性能通过减少输出方差和促进功能分化来改善层利用。在多种设置中观察到一致关系。最终提炼出训练深度有效大语言模型的实用经验法则，在下游任务上获得4.6%的准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏性作为标准设计选择中自然产生的机制，是大语言模型有效深度扩展的关键但先前被忽视的因素。代码已开源。

title: Advancing Multimodal Agent Reasoning with Long-Term Neuro-Symbolic Memory
summary: Recent advances in large language models have driven the emergence of intelligent agents operating in open-world, multimodal environments. To support long-term reasoning, such agents are typically equipped with external memory systems. However, most existing multimodal agent memories rely primarily on neural representations and vector-based retrieval, which are well-suited for inductive, intuitive reasoning but fundamentally limited in supporting analytical, deductive reasoning critical for real-world decision making. To address this limitation, we propose NS-Mem, a long-term neuro-symbolic memory framework designed to advance multimodal agent reasoning by integrating neural memory with explicit symbolic structures and rules. Specifically, NS-Mem is operated around three core components of a memory system: (1) a three-layer memory architecture that consists episodic layer, semantic layer and logic rule layer, (2) a memory construction and maintenance mechanism implemented by SK-Gen that automatically consolidates structured knowledge from accumulated multimodal experiences and incrementally updates both neural representations and symbolic rules, and (3) a hybrid memory retrieval mechanism that combines similarity-based search with deterministic symbolic query functions to support structured reasoning. Experiments on real-world multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that Neural-Symbolic Memory achieves an average 4.35% improvement in overall reasoning accuracy over pure neural memory systems, with gains of up to 12.5% on constrained reasoning queries, validating the effectiveness of NS-Mem.

AI.tldr: NS-Mem是一个神经符号记忆框架，通过整合神经记忆与显式符号结构和规则来增强多模态智能代理的长期推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态代理记忆主要依赖神经表示和向量检索，适合直觉推理但缺乏支持现实世界决策所需的分析性、演绎性推理能力。
AI.method: 提出NS-Mem框架，包含三层记忆架构（情景层、语义层、逻辑规则层）、SK-Gen实现的记忆构建维护机制，以及结合相似性搜索与确定性符号查询的混合检索机制。
AI.result: 在真实世界多模态推理基准测试中，NS-Mem相比纯神经记忆系统平均提升4.35%的整体推理准确率，在约束推理查询上提升高达12.5%。
AI.conclusion: NS-Mem通过神经符号整合有效增强了多模态代理的长期推理能力，特别是在需要分析性和演绎性推理的任务中表现显著优于纯神经方法。

title: A Closer Look into LLMs for Table Understanding
summary: Despite the success of Large Language Models (LLMs) in table understanding, their internal mechanisms remain unclear. In this paper, we conduct an empirical study on 16 LLMs, covering general LLMs, specialist tabular LLMs, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, to explore how LLMs understand tabular data and perform downstream tasks. Our analysis focus on 4 dimensions including the attention dynamics, the effective layer depth, the expert activation, and the impacts of input designs. Key findings include: (1) LLMs follow a three-phase attention pattern -- early layers scan the table broadly, middle layers localize relevant cells, and late layers amplify their contributions; (2) tabular tasks require deeper layers than math reasoning to reach stable predictions; (3) MoE models activate table-specific experts in middle layers, with early and late layers sharing general-purpose experts; (4) Chain-of-Thought prompting increases table attention, further enhanced by table-tuning. We hope these findings and insights can facilitate interpretability and future research on table-related tasks.

AI.tldr: 对16个大型语言模型在表格理解任务上的实证研究，揭示了LLM处理表格数据的内部机制，包括注意力模式、有效层深度、专家激活和输入设计影响
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型在表格理解方面取得了成功，但其内部工作机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在探索LLM如何理解表格数据并执行下游任务，以促进可解释性和未来研究
AI.method: 对16个LLM进行实证研究，涵盖通用LLM、专业表格LLM和混合专家模型。分析聚焦四个维度：注意力动态、有效层深度、专家激活和输入设计影响
AI.result: 关键发现包括：(1) LLM遵循三阶段注意力模式；(2) 表格任务比数学推理需要更深层才能达到稳定预测；(3) MoE模型在中间层激活表格特定专家；(4) 思维链提示增加表格注意力，表格调优进一步增强
AI.conclusion: 这些发现和见解有助于促进表格相关任务的可解释性和未来研究，揭示了LLM处理表格数据的内部工作机制

title: Algorithms for Deciding the Safety of States in Fully Observable Non-deterministic Problems: Technical Report
summary: Learned action policies are increasingly popular in sequential decision-making, but suffer from a lack of safety guarantees. Recent work introduced a pipeline for testing the safety of such policies under initial-state and action-outcome non-determinism. At the pipeline's core, is the problem of deciding whether a state is safe (a safe policy exists from the state) and finding faults, which are state-action pairs that transition from a safe state to an unsafe one. Their most effective algorithm for deciding safety, TarjanSafe, is effective on their benchmarks, but we show that it has exponential worst-case runtime with respect to the state space. A linear-time alternative exists, but it is slower in practice. We close this gap with a new policy-iteration algorithm iPI, that combines the best of both: it matches TarjanSafe's best-case runtime while guaranteeing a polynomial worst-case. Experiments confirm our theory and show that in problems amenable to TarjanSafe iPI has similar performance, whereas in ill-suited problems iPI scales exponentially better.

AI.tldr: 提出新的策略迭代算法iPI，在保证多项式最坏情况运行时间的同时，匹配TarjanSafe的最佳情况性能，解决了现有安全验证算法在运行时间上的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 学习到的动作策略在顺序决策中越来越流行，但缺乏安全保证。现有安全测试方法中，最有效的TarjanSafe算法在基准测试中表现良好，但存在指数级最坏情况运行时间；而线性时间替代方案在实际中较慢。需要弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 提出新的策略迭代算法iPI，结合了TarjanSafe和线性时间算法的优点。iPI在TarjanSafe适用的问题上具有相似性能，同时保证多项式最坏情况运行时间。
AI.result: 实验证实理论分析：在适合TarjanSafe的问题上，iPI具有相似性能；在不适合TarjanSafe的问题上，iPI的扩展性呈指数级提升。
AI.conclusion: iPI算法成功解决了现有安全验证算法在运行时间上的权衡问题，既保持了TarjanSafe的最佳情况性能，又保证了多项式最坏情况复杂度，为学习策略的安全验证提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: ALTIS: Automated Loss Triage and Impact Scoring from Sentinel-1 SAR for Property-Level Flood Damage Assessment
comment: 27 pages, 9 figures. Preliminary results; full end-to-end validation ongoing
summary: Floods are among the costliest natural catastrophes globally, yet the property and casualty insurance industry's post-event response remains heavily reliant on manual field inspection: slow, expensive, and geographically constrained. Satellite Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) offers cloud-penetrating, all-weather imaging uniquely suited to rapid post-flood assessment, but existing research evaluates SAR flood detection against academic benchmarks such as IoU and F1-score that do not capture insurance-workflow requirements. We present ALTIS: a five-stage pipeline transforming raw Sentinel-1 GRD and SLC imagery into property-level impact scores within 24-48 hours of flood peak. Unlike prior approaches producing pixel-level maps or binary outputs, ALTIS delivers a ranked, confidence-scored triage list consumable by claims platforms, integrating (i) multi-temporal SAR change detection using dual-polarization VV/VH intensity and InSAR coherence, (ii) physics-informed depth estimation fusing flood extent with high-resolution DEMs, (iii) property-level zonal statistics from parcel footprints, (iv) depth-damage calibration against NFIP claims, and (v) confidence-scored triage ranking. We formally define Insurance-Grade Flood Triage (IGFT) and introduce the Inspection Reduction Rate (IRR) and Triage Efficiency Score (TES). Using Hurricane Harvey (2017) across Harris County, Texas, we present preliminary analysis grounded in validated sub-components suggesting ALTIS is designed to achieve an IRR of approximately 0.52 at 90% recall of high-severity claims, potentially eliminating over half of unnecessary dispatches. By blending SAR flood intelligence with the realities of claims management, ALTIS establishes a methodological baseline for translating earth observation research into measurable insurance outcomes.

AI.tldr: ALTIS是一个五阶段SAR洪水检测系统，能在洪水峰值后24-48小时内生成房产级别的洪水影响评分，为保险理赔提供可操作的分类列表，旨在减少不必要的现场勘察。
AI.motivation: 洪水是全球成本最高的自然灾害之一，但保险业灾后响应仍依赖缓慢、昂贵且地理受限的人工现场勘察。现有SAR洪水检测研究使用的学术评估指标（如IoU和F1分数）无法反映保险工作流程的实际需求。
AI.method: ALTIS五阶段管道：1) 使用双极化VV/VH强度和InSAR相干性的多时相SAR变化检测；2) 融合洪水范围和高分辨率DEM的物理信息深度估计；3) 基于地块边界的房产级别区域统计；4) 针对NFIP理赔数据进行深度-损害校准；5) 置信度评分的分类排序。定义了保险级洪水分类（IGFT）概念和评估指标。
AI.result: 在哈维飓风（2017年）对德克萨斯州哈里斯县的案例中，初步分析显示ALTIS设计目标是在90%高严重性理赔召回率下达到约0.52的勘察减少率（IRR），可能消除超过一半的不必要调度。
AI.conclusion: ALTIS通过将SAR洪水智能与理赔管理现实相结合，建立了将地球观测研究转化为可衡量保险成果的方法学基准，为保险工作流程提供了实用的洪水评估解决方案。

title: Fusian: Multi-LoRA Fusion for Fine-Grained Continuous MBTI Personality Control in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in simulating diverse human behaviors and personalities. However, existing methods for personality control, which include prompt engineering and standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), typically treat personality traits as discrete categories (e.g., "Extroverted" vs. "Introverted"), lacking the ability to precisely control the intensity of a trait on a continuous spectrum. In this paper, we introduce Fusian, a novel framework for fine-grained, continuous personality control in LLMs. Fusian operates in two stages: (1) Trajectory Collection, where we capture the dynamic evolution of personality adoption during SFT by saving a sequence of LoRA adapters, effectively mapping the continuous manifold of a trait; and (2) RL-based Dynamic Fusion, where we train a policy network using Reinforcement Learning to dynamically compute mixing weights for these frozen adapters. By sampling from a Dirichlet distribution parameterized by the policy network, Fusian fuses multiple adapters to align the model's output with a specific numerical target intensity. Experiments on the Qwen3-14B model demonstrate that Fusian achieves high precision in personality control, significantly outperforming baseline methods in aligning with user-specified trait intensities.

AI.tldr: Fusian是一个用于大语言模型细粒度连续人格控制的新框架，通过两阶段方法实现对人格特质强度的精确连续控制。
AI.motivation: 现有的人格控制方法（如提示工程和标准监督微调）通常将人格特质视为离散类别，缺乏在连续谱上精确控制特质强度的能力。
AI.method: Fusian采用两阶段方法：1) 轨迹收集阶段，通过保存LoRA适配器序列捕获人格采纳的动态演化；2) 基于强化学习的动态融合阶段，训练策略网络动态计算冻结适配器的混合权重，通过狄利克雷分布采样融合多个适配器。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-14B模型上的实验表明，Fusian在人格控制方面实现了高精度，在符合用户指定特质强度方面显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: Fusian框架为大语言模型提供了细粒度的连续人格控制能力，克服了现有方法将人格视为离散类别的局限性。

title: Efficient Semi-Automated Material Microstructure Analysis Using Deep Learning: A Case Study in Additive Manufacturing
summary: Image segmentation is fundamental to microstructural analysis for defect identification and structure-property correlation, yet remains challenging due to pronounced heterogeneity in materials images arising from varied processing and testing conditions. Conventional image processing techniques often fail to capture such complex features rendering them ineffective for large-scale analysis. Even deep learning approaches struggle to generalize across heterogeneous datasets due to scarcity of high-quality labeled data. Consequently, segmentation workflows often rely on manual expert-driven annotations which are labor intensive and difficult to scale. Using an additive manufacturing (AM) dataset as a case study, we present a semi-automated active learning based segmentation pipeline that integrates a U-Net based convolutional neural network with an interactive user annotation and correction interface and a representative core-set image selection strategy. The active learning workflow iteratively updates the model by incorporating user corrected segmentations into the training pool while the core-set strategy identifies representative images for annotation. Three subset selection strategies, manual selection, uncertainty driven sampling and proposed maximin Latin hypercube sampling from embeddings (SMILE) method were evaluated over six refinement rounds. The SMILE strategy consistently outperformed other approaches, improving the macro F1 score from 0.74 to 0.93 while reducing manual annotation time by about 65 percent. The segmented defect regions were further analyzed using a coupled classification model to categorize defects based on microstructural characteristics and map them to corresponding AM process parameters. The proposed framework reduces labeling effort while maintaining scalability and robustness and is broadly applicable to image based analysis across diverse materials systems.

AI.tldr: 提出基于主动学习的半自动图像分割流程，用于材料显微结构分析，在增材制造数据集上验证，通过SMILE采样策略显著提升分割性能并减少人工标注时间。
AI.motivation: 材料图像分割面临显著异质性挑战，传统图像处理技术难以捕捉复杂特征，深度学习因高质量标注数据稀缺而泛化能力有限，现有方法依赖人工专家标注，劳动密集且难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出半自动主动学习分割流程，集成U-Net卷积神经网络、交互式用户标注修正界面和代表性核心集图像选择策略。评估三种子集选择策略：手动选择、不确定性驱动采样和提出的基于嵌入的最大最小拉丁超立方采样(SMILE)方法。
AI.result: SMILE策略在六轮细化中始终优于其他方法，将宏观F1分数从0.74提升至0.93，同时减少约65%的人工标注时间。分割缺陷区域通过耦合分类模型进一步分析，基于显微结构特征分类缺陷并映射到相应AM工艺参数。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在减少标注工作量的同时保持可扩展性和鲁棒性，广泛适用于不同材料系统的图像分析，为异质性材料图像分割提供了有效的半自动解决方案。

title: SEA-Vision: A Multilingual Benchmark for Comprehensive Document and Scene Text Understanding in Southeast Asia
summary: Multilingual document and scene text understanding plays an important role in applications such as search, finance, and public services. However, most existing benchmarks focus on high-resource languages and fail to evaluate models in realistic multilingual environments. In Southeast Asia, the diversity of languages, complex writing systems, and highly varied document types make this challenge even greater. We introduce SEA-Vision, a benchmark that jointly evaluates Document Parsing and Text-Centric Visual Question Answering (TEC-VQA) across 11 Southeast Asian languages. SEA-Vision contains 15,234 document parsing pages from nine representative document types, annotated with hierarchical page-, block-, and line-level labels. It also provides 7,496 TEC-VQA question-answer pairs that probe text recognition, numerical calculation, comparative analysis, logical reasoning, and spatial understanding. To make such multilingual, multi-task annotation feasible, we design a hybrid pipeline for Document Parsing and TEC-VQA. It combines automated filtering and scoring with MLLM-assisted labeling and lightweight native-speaker verification, greatly reducing manual labeling while maintaining high quality. We evaluate several leading multimodal models and observe pronounced performance degradation on low-resource Southeast Asian languages, highlighting substantial remaining gaps in multilingual document and scene text understanding. We believe SEA-Vision will help drive global progress in document and scene text understanding.

AI.tldr: SEA-Vision是一个针对东南亚11种语言的多语言文档理解和文本中心视觉问答基准，包含15,234个文档解析页面和7,496个问答对，用于评估模型在复杂多语言环境中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要关注高资源语言，无法评估模型在现实多语言环境中的表现。东南亚地区语言多样性高、书写系统复杂、文档类型多样，使得这一挑战更加严峻。
AI.method: 设计了SEA-Vision基准，包含文档解析和文本中心视觉问答两个任务。采用混合标注流程，结合自动过滤评分、MLLM辅助标注和轻量级母语者验证，在保证质量的同时大幅减少人工标注。
AI.result: 评估了多个领先的多模态模型，发现在低资源东南亚语言上存在明显的性能下降，表明多语言文档和场景文本理解仍有显著差距。
AI.conclusion: SEA-Vision基准将有助于推动全球文档和场景文本理解的发展，特别是在多语言环境下的应用。

title: Intelligent Co-Design: An Interactive LLM Framework for Interior Spatial Design via Multi-Modal Agents
comment: 25 pages, 20 figures; accepted for publication in the Proceedings of ACADIA 2025
summary: In architectural interior design, miscommunication frequently arises as clients lack design knowledge, while designers struggle to explain complex spatial relationships, leading to delayed timelines and financial losses. Recent advancements in generative layout tools narrow the gap by automating 3D visualizations. However, prevailing methodologies exhibit limitations: rule-based systems implement hard-coded spatial constraints that restrict participatory engagement, while data-driven models rely on extensive training datasets. Recent large language models (LLMs) bridge this gap by enabling intuitive reasoning about spatial relationships through natural language. This research presents an LLM-based, multimodal, multi-agent framework that dynamically converts natural language descriptions and imagery into 3D designs. Specialized agents (Reference, Spatial, Interactive, Grader), operating via prompt guidelines, collaboratively address core challenges: the agent system enables real-time user interaction for iterative spatial refinement, while Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) reduces data dependency without requiring task-specific model training. This framework accurately interprets spatial intent and generates optimized 3D indoor design, improving productivity, and encouraging nondesigner participation. Evaluations across diverse floor plans and user questionnaires demonstrate effectiveness. An independent LLM evaluator consistently rated participatory layouts higher in user intent alignment, aesthetic coherence, functionality, and circulation. Questionnaire results indicated 77% satisfaction and a clear preference over traditional design software. These findings suggest the framework enhances user-centric communication and fosters more inclusive, effective, and resilient design processes. Project page: https://rsigktyper.github.io/AICodesign/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的多模态多智能体框架，能够将自然语言描述和图像动态转换为3D室内设计，解决了设计师与客户之间的沟通障碍问题。
AI.motivation: 在建筑室内设计中，客户缺乏设计知识而设计师难以解释复杂的空间关系，导致沟通不畅、时间延误和经济损失。现有的生成式布局工具存在局限性：基于规则的系统采用硬编码空间约束限制了参与性，而数据驱动模型需要大量训练数据。
AI.method: 采用基于大语言模型的多模态多智能体框架，包含专门智能体（参考、空间、交互、评分）通过提示指南协同工作。系统支持实时用户交互进行迭代空间优化，同时使用检索增强生成减少数据依赖，无需特定任务模型训练。
AI.result: 评估显示该框架能准确解读空间意图并生成优化的3D室内设计。独立大语言模型评估器一致认为参与式布局在用户意图对齐、美学连贯性、功能性和流通性方面表现更优。问卷调查显示77%满意度，明显优于传统设计软件。
AI.conclusion: 该框架增强了以用户为中心的沟通，促进了更具包容性、有效性和韧性的设计过程，提高了生产效率和鼓励非设计师参与。

title: MOGeo: Beyond One-to-One Cross-View Object Geo-localization
summary: Cross-View Object Geo-Localization (CVOGL) aims to locate an object of interest in a query image within a corresponding satellite image. Existing methods typically assume that the query image contains only a single object, which does not align with the complex, multi-object geo-localization requirements in real-world applications, making them unsuitable for practical scenarios. To bridge the gap between the realistic setting and existing task, we propose a new task, called Cross-View Multi-Object Geo-Localization (CVMOGL). To advance the CVMOGL task, we first construct a benchmark, CMLocation, which includes two datasets: CMLocation-V1 and CMLocation-V2. Furthermore, we propose a novel cross-view multi-object geo-localization method, MOGeo, and benchmark it against existing state-of-the-art methods. Extensive experiments are conducted under various application scenarios to validate the effectiveness of our method. The results demonstrate that cross-view object geo-localization in the more realistic setting remains a challenging problem, encouraging further research in this area.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了跨视角多目标地理定位新任务，构建了CMLocation基准数据集，并开发了MOGeo方法来解决现实场景中多目标定位的挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角目标地理定位方法通常假设查询图像只包含单个目标，这与现实应用中复杂的多目标地理定位需求不符，限制了实际应用价值。
AI.method: 提出跨视角多目标地理定位新任务，构建包含CMLocation-V1和CMLocation-V2的数据集基准，并开发了MOGeo方法进行多目标定位。
AI.result: 通过多种应用场景下的广泛实验验证了方法的有效性，结果表明在更现实的设置下跨视角目标地理定位仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。
AI.conclusion: 跨视角多目标地理定位是现实应用中的重要问题，提出的新任务、基准数据集和方法为这一领域的研究奠定了基础，鼓励进一步探索。

title: CLAG: Adaptive Memory Organization via Agent-Driven Clustering for Small Language Model Agents
summary: Large language model agents heavily rely on external memory to support knowledge reuse and complex reasoning tasks. Yet most memory systems store experiences in a single global retrieval pool which can gradually dilute or corrupt stored knowledge. This problem is especially pronounced for small language models (SLMs), which are highly vulnerable to irrelevant context. We introduce CLAG, a CLustering-based AGentic memory framework where an SLM agent actively organizes memory by clustering. CLAG employs an SLM-driven router to assign incoming memories to semantically coherent clusters and autonomously generates cluster-specific profiles, including topic summaries and descriptive tags, to establish each cluster as a self-contained functional unit. By performing localized evolution within these structured neighborhoods, CLAG effectively reduces cross-topic interference and enhances internal memory density. During retrieval, the framework utilizes a two-stage process that first filters relevant clusters via their profiles, thereby excluding distractors and reducing the search space. Experiments on multiple QA datasets with three SLM backbones show that CLAG consistently improves answer quality and robustness over prior memory systems for agents, remaining lightweight and efficient.

AI.tldr: CLAG是一个基于聚类的智能体记忆框架，通过聚类组织记忆来减少跨主题干扰，提高小型语言模型的知识重用和推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统通常将经验存储在单一的全局检索池中，这会导致存储知识逐渐稀释或损坏。对于小型语言模型来说，这个问题尤为严重，因为它们对无关上下文非常敏感。
AI.method: CLAG采用基于聚类的记忆框架：1) 使用SLM驱动的路由器将传入记忆分配到语义连贯的聚类中；2) 自主生成聚类特定配置文件（主题摘要和描述性标签）；3) 在这些结构化邻域内进行局部演化；4) 检索时采用两阶段过程：先通过配置文件过滤相关聚类，再在选定聚类内搜索。
AI.result: 在多个QA数据集和三种SLM骨干网络上的实验表明，CLAG在答案质量和鲁棒性方面持续优于先前的智能体记忆系统，同时保持轻量高效。
AI.conclusion: CLAG通过聚类组织记忆有效减少了跨主题干扰，增强了内部记忆密度，为小型语言模型智能体提供了一种轻量高效的记忆管理解决方案。

title: VFM-Loc: Zero-Shot Cross-View Geo-Localization via Aligning Discriminative Visual Hierarchies
summary: Cross-View Geo-Localization (CVGL) in remote sensing aims to locate a drone-view query by matching it to geo-tagged satellite images. Although supervised methods have achieved strong results on closeset benchmarks, they often fail to generalize to unconstrained, real-world scenarios due to severe viewpoint differences and dataset bias. To overcome these limitations, we present VFM-Loc, a training-free framework for zero-shot CVGL that leverages the generalizable visual representations from vision foundational models (VFMs).
