VFM-Loc identifies and matches discriminative visual clues across different viewpoints through a progressive alignment strategy. First, we design a hierarchical clue extraction mechanism using Generalized Mean pooling and Scale-Weighted RMAC to preserve distinctive visual clues across scales while maintaining hierarchical confidence. Second, we introduce a statistical manifold alignment pipeline based on domain-wise PCA and Orthogonal Procrustes analysis, linearly aligning heterogeneous feature distributions in a shared metric space. Experiments demonstrate that VFM-Loc exhibits strong zero-shot accuracy on standard benchmarks and surpasses supervised methods by over 20% in Recall@1 on the challenging LO-UCV dataset with large oblique angles. This work highlights that principled alignment of pre-trained features can effectively bridge the cross-view gap, establishing a robust and training-free paradigm for real-world CVGL. The relevant code is made available at: https://github.com/DingLei14/VFM-Loc.

AI.tldr: VFM-Loc是一个无需训练的零样本跨视角地理定位框架，利用视觉基础模型的通用表示，通过渐进对齐策略匹配无人机视角和卫星图像，在标准基准测试中表现优异，在具有大倾斜角的挑战性数据集上比监督方法提升20%以上。
AI.motivation: 现有的监督方法在封闭基准测试中表现良好，但由于严重的视角差异和数据集偏差，难以泛化到无约束的真实世界场景。需要一种能够克服这些限制、无需训练且能有效处理跨视角差异的解决方案。
AI.method: 1. 分层线索提取机制：使用广义均值池化和尺度加权RMAC在不同尺度上保留判别性视觉线索，同时保持分层置信度。2. 统计流形对齐流程：基于领域PCA和正交Procrustes分析，在共享度量空间中线性对齐异构特征分布。
AI.result: VFM-Loc在标准基准测试中表现出强大的零样本准确性，在具有大倾斜角的挑战性LO-UCV数据集上，Recall@1指标比监督方法高出20%以上，展示了预训练特征对齐的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 预训练特征的原则性对齐可以有效弥合跨视角差距，为真实世界跨视角地理定位建立了一个鲁棒且无需训练的新范式，证明了视觉基础模型通用表示在零样本地理定位任务中的潜力。

title: Invisible failures in human-AI interactions
summary: AI systems fail silently far more often than they fail visibly. In a large-scale quantitative analysis of human-AI interactions from the WildChat dataset, we find that 78% of AI failures are invisible: something went wrong but the user gave no overt indication that there was a problem. These invisible failures cluster into eight archetypes that help us characterize where and how AI systems are failing to meet users' needs. In addition, the archetypes show systematic co-occurrence patterns indicating higher-level failure types. To address the question of whether these archetypes will remain relevant as AI systems become more capable, we also assess failures for whether they are primarily interactional or capability-driven, finding that 91% involve interactional dynamics, and we estimate that 94% of such failures would persist even with a more capable model. Finally, we illustrate how the archetypes help us to identify systematic and variable AI limitations across different usage domains. Overall, we argue that our invisible failure taxonomy can be a key component in reliable failure monitoring for product developers, scientists, and policy makers. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/bigspinai/bigspin-invisible-failure-archetypes

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析WildChat数据集发现，78%的AI失败是隐形的，用户没有明显表示有问题。这些隐形失败可分为8种原型，91%涉及交互动态而非能力限制，94%的交互失败即使模型更强大也会持续存在。
AI.motivation: AI系统在失败时往往悄无声息，用户不会明确表示有问题，这使得开发者难以发现和解决这些失败。当前缺乏对AI隐形失败的系统性分析和分类框架，阻碍了可靠的失败监控和改进。
AI.method: 研究使用WildChat数据集进行大规模定量分析，识别AI隐形失败模式。通过分析人类-AI交互数据，识别出8种失败原型，并分析它们的共现模式。同时评估失败是交互驱动还是能力驱动，并估计在更强大模型下这些失败的持续性。
AI.result: 研究发现78%的AI失败是隐形的，这些失败可分为8种原型。91%的失败涉及交互动态而非能力限制，94%的交互失败即使模型更强大也会持续存在。原型分析有助于识别不同使用领域中的系统和可变AI限制。
AI.conclusion: 隐形失败分类法可以作为产品开发者、科学家和政策制定者进行可靠失败监控的关键组成部分。该框架有助于系统性地发现和解决AI系统中的隐形失败问题，即使AI能力提升，交互动态相关的失败仍将持续存在。

title: Learning through Creation: A Hash-Free Framework for On-the-Fly Category Discovery
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 Findings. Code available at https://github.com/brandinzhang/LTC
summary: On-the-Fly Category Discovery (OCD) aims to recognize known classes while simultaneously discovering emerging novel categories during inference, using supervision only from known classes during offline training. Existing approaches rely either on fixed label supervision or on diffusion-based augmentations to enhance the backbone, yet none of them explicitly train the model to perform the discovery task required at test time. It is fundamentally unreasonable to expect a model optimized on limited labeled data to carry out a qualitatively different discovery objective during inference. This mismatch creates a clear optimization misalignment between the offline learning stage and the online discovery stage. In addition, prior methods often depend on hash-based encodings or severe feature compression, which further limits representational capacity. To address these issues, we propose Learning through Creation (LTC), a fully feature-based and hash-free framework that injects novel-category awareness directly into offline learning. At its core is a lightweight, online pseudo-unknown generator driven by kernel-energy minimization and entropy maximization (MKEE). Unlike previous methods that generate synthetic samples once before training, our generator evolves jointly with the model dynamics and synthesizes pseudo-novel instances on the fly at negligible cost. These samples are incorporated through a dual max-margin objective with adaptive thresholding, strengthening the model's ability to delineate and detect unknown regions through explicit creation. Extensive experiments across seven benchmarks show that LTC consistently outperforms prior work, achieving improvements ranging from 1.5 percent to 13.1 percent in all-class accuracy. The code is available at https://github.com/brandinzhang/LTC

AI.tldr: 提出LTC框架，通过在线伪未知生成器在训练阶段注入新类别感知，解决现有OCD方法中离线学习与在线发现阶段的优化不匹配问题
AI.motivation: 现有OCD方法存在两个主要问题：1) 离线训练阶段与在线发现阶段的优化目标不匹配，模型在有限标注数据上训练却要在推理时执行不同的发现任务；2) 依赖哈希编码或严重特征压缩限制了表征能力
AI.method: 提出LTC框架，核心是轻量级在线伪未知生成器(MKEE)，基于核能量最小化和熵最大化动态生成伪新类别样本。通过双重最大间隔目标与自适应阈值，在训练中显式创建未知区域
AI.result: 在7个基准测试上，LTC始终优于先前方法，全类别准确率提升1.5%到13.1%
AI.conclusion: LTC通过特征基础、无哈希的框架，在离线学习阶段直接注入新类别感知，解决了OCD中的优化不匹配问题，显著提升了性能

title: Brain-Inspired Graph Multi-Agent Systems for LLM Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of language tasks, yet complex multi-step reasoning remains a fundamental challenge. While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) equipped with extended chain-of-thought mechanisms demonstrate improved performance over standard LLMs, both model types still suffer from accuracy collapse on sufficiently complex tasks, suggesting that scaling model-level reasoning alone is insufficient. Inspired by the global workspace theory of human cognition, we propose Brain-Inspired Graph Multi-Agent Systems (BIGMAS), in which specialized LLM agents are organized as nodes in a dynamically constructed directed graph and coordinate exclusively through a centralized shared workspace. A problem-adaptive GraphDesigner constructs task-specific agent topologies, while a global Orchestrator leverages the complete shared state for routing decisions, overcoming the local-view bottleneck of reactive approaches. Experiments on Game24, Six Fives, and Tower of London across six frontier LLMs demonstrate that BIGMAS consistently improves reasoning performance for both standard LLMs and LRMs, outperforming existing multi-agent baselines including ReAct and Tree of Thoughts, showing that multi-agent architectural design provides complementary gains orthogonal to model-level reasoning enhancements.

AI.tldr: BIGMAS是一种受大脑全局工作空间理论启发的图多智能体系统，通过动态构建的智能体图结构和集中式共享工作空间，提升了大型语言模型在复杂多步推理任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型在语言任务上表现出色，但在复杂多步推理方面仍面临挑战。现有的推理模型虽然通过扩展思维链机制有所改进，但在足够复杂的任务上仍会出现准确率崩溃，表明仅靠模型级推理扩展是不够的。
AI.method: 提出BIGMAS系统：1）将专门的LLM智能体组织为动态构建的有向图中的节点；2）通过集中式共享工作空间进行协调；3）问题自适应的GraphDesigner构建任务特定的智能体拓扑；4）全局Orchestrator利用完整共享状态进行路由决策，克服反应式方法的局部视图瓶颈。
AI.result: 在Game24、Six Fives和Tower of London三个任务上，对六个前沿LLM进行实验，BIGMAS持续提升了标准LLM和LRM的推理性能，超越了包括ReAct和Tree of Thoughts在内的现有多智能体基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体架构设计提供了与模型级推理增强正交的补充收益，表明通过智能体组织架构的创新可以显著提升复杂推理任务的性能。

title: Geo-ID: Test-Time Geometric Consensus for Cross-View Consistent Intrinsics
summary: Intrinsic image decomposition aims to estimate physically based rendering (PBR) parameters such as albedo, roughness, and metallicity from images. While recent methods achieve strong single-view predictions, applying them independently to multiple views of the same scene often yields inconsistent estimates, limiting their use in downstream applications such as editable neural scenes and 3D reconstruction. Video-based models can improve cross-frame consistency but require dense, ordered sequences and substantial compute, limiting their applicability to sparse, unordered image collections. We propose Geo-ID, a novel test-time framework that repurposes pretrained single-view intrinsic predictors to produce cross-view consistent decompositions by coupling independent per-view predictions through sparse geometric correspondences that form uncertainty-aware consensus targets. Geo-ID is model-agnostic, requires no retraining or inverse rendering, and applies directly to off-the-shelf intrinsic predictors. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and real-world scenes demonstrate substantial improvements in cross-view intrinsic consistency as the number of views increases, while maintaining comparable single-view decomposition performance. We further show that the resulting consistent intrinsics enable coherent appearance editing and relighting in downstream neural scene representations.

AI.tldr: Geo-ID是一个测试时框架，通过稀疏几何对应关系将预训练的单视角本征预测器耦合起来，实现跨视角一致的本征图像分解，无需重新训练或逆向渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有单视角本征图像分解方法在多视角场景中会产生不一致的估计结果，限制了其在可编辑神经场景和3D重建等下游应用中的使用。视频模型虽然能提高跨帧一致性，但需要密集有序序列和大量计算，不适用于稀疏无序图像集合。
AI.method: 提出Geo-ID框架，利用稀疏几何对应关系将独立的每视角预测耦合起来，形成不确定性感知的共识目标。该框架模型无关，无需重新训练或逆向渲染，可直接应用于现成的本征预测器。
AI.result: 在合成基准测试和真实场景实验中，随着视角数量增加，跨视角本征一致性得到显著改善，同时保持可比的单视角分解性能。一致的本征结果能够在下游神经场景表示中实现连贯的外观编辑和重光照。
AI.conclusion: Geo-ID通过利用稀疏几何对应关系有效解决了多视角本征图像分解的一致性问题，为下游应用提供了高质量的跨视角一致本征分解结果。

title: Beyond the Covariance Trap: Unlocking Generalization in Same-Subject Knowledge Editing for Large Language Models
summary: While locate-then-edit knowledge editing efficiently updates knowledge encoded within Large Language Models (LLMs), a critical generalization failure mode emerges in the practical same-subject knowledge editing scenario: models fail to recall the updated knowledge when following user instructions, despite successfully recalling it in the original edited form. This paper identifies the geometric root of this generalization collapse as a fundamental conflict where the inner activation drifts induced by prompt variations exceed the model's geometric tolerance for generalization after editing. We attribute this instability to a dual pathology: (1) The joint optimization with orthogonal gradients collapses solutions into sharp minima with narrow stability, and (2) the standard covariance constraint paradoxically acts as a Covariance Trap that amplifies input perturbations. To resolve this, we introduce RoSE (Robust Same-subject Editing), which employs Isotropic Geometric Alignment to minimize representational deviation and Hierarchical Knowledge Integration to smooth the optimization landscape. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RoSE significantly improves instruction-following capabilities, laying the foundation for robust interactive parametric memory of LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoSE方法解决大语言模型知识编辑中的泛化失败问题，即模型在遵循用户指令时无法回忆更新后的知识，尽管在原始编辑形式下能成功回忆。
AI.motivation: 在实践中的同主题知识编辑场景中，大语言模型存在关键的泛化失败模式：尽管在原始编辑形式下能成功回忆更新后的知识，但在遵循用户指令时却无法回忆。这种泛化崩溃的几何根源是提示变化引起的内激活漂移超过了编辑后模型的几何容忍度。
AI.method: 提出RoSE（鲁棒同主题编辑）方法，采用各向同性几何对齐来最小化表示偏差，并使用分层知识集成来平滑优化景观。该方法解决了正交梯度联合优化导致解决方案陷入尖锐最小值的问题，以及标准协方差约束作为协方差陷阱放大输入扰动的问题。
AI.result: 大量实验证明，RoSE显著提高了指令遵循能力，为大语言模型代理的鲁棒交互式参数记忆奠定了基础。
AI.conclusion: RoSE方法有效解决了大语言模型知识编辑中的泛化失败问题，通过几何对齐和分层集成技术，显著提升了模型在遵循用户指令时回忆更新知识的能力，为构建更鲁棒的交互式参数记忆系统提供了基础。

title: Why AI systems don't learn and what to do about it: Lessons on autonomous learning from cognitive science
summary: We critically examine the limitations of current AI models in achieving autonomous learning and propose a learning architecture inspired by human and animal cognition. The proposed framework integrates learning from observation (System A) and learning from active behavior (System B) while flexibly switching between these learning modes as a function of internally generated meta-control signals (System M). We discuss how this could be built by taking inspiration on how organisms adapt to real-world, dynamic environments across evolutionary and developmental timescales.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种受人类和动物认知启发的学习架构，整合了观察学习（系统A）和主动行为学习（系统B），并通过元控制系统（系统M）灵活切换学习模式。
AI.motivation: 当前AI模型在实现自主学习方面存在局限性，需要从人类和动物的认知机制中获取灵感，以更好地适应真实世界的动态环境。
AI.method: 提出一个三系统学习框架：系统A负责观察学习，系统B负责主动行为学习，系统M作为元控制系统，根据内部生成的元控制信号灵活切换A和B的学习模式。
AI.result: 论文主要提出了理论框架和概念设计，讨论了如何借鉴生物体在进化和发育时间尺度上适应动态环境的机制来构建这一系统。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合观察学习和主动学习，并引入元控制机制，可以构建更接近生物认知的AI学习架构，为开发具有更强自主学习能力的AI系统提供了新的理论方向。

title: SlovKE: A Large-Scale Dataset and LLM Evaluation for Slovak Keyphrase Extraction
summary: Keyphrase extraction for morphologically rich, low-resource languages remains understudied, largely due to the scarcity of suitable evaluation datasets. We address this gap for Slovak by constructing a dataset of 227,432 scientific abstracts with author-assigned keyphrases -- scraped and systematically cleaned from the Slovak Central Register of Theses -- representing a 25-fold increase over the largest prior Slovak resource and approaching the scale of established English benchmarks such as KP20K. Using this dataset, we benchmark three unsupervised baselines (YAKE, TextRank, KeyBERT with SlovakBERT embeddings) and evaluate KeyLLM, an LLM-based extraction method using GPT-3.5-turbo. Unsupervised baselines achieve at most 11.6\% exact-match $F1@6$, with a large gap to partial matching (up to 51.5\%), reflecting the difficulty of matching inflected surface forms to author-assigned keyphrases. KeyLLM narrows this exact--partial gap, producing keyphrases closer to the canonical forms assigned by authors, while manual evaluation on 100 documents ($κ= 0.61$) confirms that KeyLLM captures relevant concepts that automated exact matching underestimates. Our analysis identifies morphological mismatch as the dominant failure mode for statistical methods -- a finding relevant to other inflected languages. The dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/NaiveNeuron/SlovKE) and evaluation code (https://github.com/NaiveNeuron/SlovKE) are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文为斯洛伐克语构建了大规模关键词提取数据集（227,432篇科学摘要），评估了无监督方法和LLM方法，发现形态学不匹配是统计方法的主要失败模式。
AI.motivation: 针对形态丰富、资源匮乏语言的关键词提取研究不足，主要原因是缺乏合适的评估数据集。本文旨在填补斯洛伐克语在这一领域的空白。
AI.method: 从斯洛伐克中央论文注册系统中爬取并系统清理了227,432篇科学摘要及作者分配的关键词，构建了SlovKE数据集。评估了三种无监督基线方法（YAKE、TextRank、KeyBERT with SlovakBERT）和基于LLM的KeyLLM方法（使用GPT-3.5-turbo）。
AI.result: 无监督基线方法在精确匹配F1@6上最高仅11.6%，部分匹配可达51.5%，表明匹配屈折变化的表面形式与作者分配关键词的困难。KeyLLM缩小了精确-部分匹配差距，产生更接近作者规范形式的关键词。人工评估（κ=0.61）证实KeyLLM能捕捉相关概念，而自动精确匹配会低估这些概念。
AI.conclusion: 形态学不匹配是统计方法的主要失败模式，这一发现对其他屈折语言也相关。数据集和评估代码已公开可用，为斯洛伐克语关键词提取研究提供了重要资源。

title: A Hybrid Modeling Framework for Crop Prediction Tasks via Dynamic Parameter Calibration and Multi-Task Learning
summary: Accurate prediction of crop states (e.g., phenology stages and cold hardiness) is essential for timely farm management decisions such as irrigation, fertilization, and canopy management to optimize crop yield and quality. While traditional biophysical models can be used for season-long predictions, they lack the precision required for site-specific management. Deep learning methods are a compelling alternative, but can produce biologically unrealistic predictions and require large-scale data. We propose a \emph{hybrid modeling} approach that uses a neural network to parameterize a differentiable biophysical model and leverages multi-task learning for efficient data sharing across crop cultivars in data limited settings. By predicting the \emph{parameters} of the biophysical model, our approach improves the prediction accuracy while preserving biological realism. Empirical evaluation using real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrates that our method improves prediction accuracy by 60\% for phenology and 40\% for cold hardiness compared to deployed biophysical models.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种混合建模方法，使用神经网络参数化可微分的生物物理模型，通过多任务学习在数据有限情况下实现作物品种间的数据共享，提高了预测精度并保持生物真实性。
AI.motivation: 准确预测作物状态（如物候期和抗寒性）对于及时进行灌溉、施肥和冠层管理等农业决策至关重要。传统生物物理模型缺乏站点特异性管理所需的精度，而深度学习方法可能产生不切实际的预测且需要大量数据。
AI.method: 采用混合建模方法，使用神经网络参数化可微分生物物理模型，并利用多任务学习在数据有限情况下实现不同作物品种间的数据共享。通过预测生物物理模型的参数，提高预测精度同时保持生物真实性。
AI.result: 在真实世界和合成数据集上的实证评估表明，与已部署的生物物理模型相比，该方法将物候期预测精度提高了60%，抗寒性预测精度提高了40%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的混合建模方法在保持生物真实性的同时显著提高了作物状态预测精度，为数据有限情况下的精准农业管理提供了有效解决方案。

title: Listening to the Echo: User-Reaction Aware Policy Optimization via Scalar-Verbal Hybrid Reinforcement Learning
summary: While current emotional support dialogue systems typically rely on expert-defined scalar rewards for alignment, these signals suffer from severe information sparsity. They cannot explain why a response failed or how to adapt to dynamic user states, often diverging from the actual goal of facilitating positive emotional shifts. In practice, the most direct and reliable learning signal emerges from the user's continuous reactions during ongoing interaction. We therefore propose Reaction Aware Policy Optimization (RAPO), a framework that optimizes over interaction consequences rather than rubric scores. RAPO treats dialogue as a reaction-driven process and utilizes simulated user responses to generate dense natural-language feedback through three core components: Hindsight Dialogue Selection, which isolates pivotal turns that meaningfully alter user emotional trajectories; Generative Hindsight Feedback, which transforms user reactions into contrastive ranking signals and natural-language critiques; and Scalar-Verbal Hybrid Policy Optimization, which couples scalar reward optimization for global alignment with verbal feedback distillation for fine-grained semantic refinement. Extensive experiments on ESC and Sotopia demonstrate that RAPO significantly outperforms strong reinforcement learning baselines in driving positive interaction outcomes.

AI.tldr: RAPO框架通过用户反应驱动的策略优化，利用模拟用户反馈生成密集自然语言指导，显著提升情感支持对话系统的效果
AI.motivation: 当前情感支持对话系统依赖专家定义的标量奖励存在信息稀疏问题，无法解释响应失败原因或适应动态用户状态，偏离了促进积极情绪转变的实际目标。最直接可靠的学习信号来自用户持续互动中的反应。
AI.method: 提出反应感知策略优化(RAPO)框架，包含三个核心组件：1)后见对话选择：识别显著改变用户情绪轨迹的关键轮次；2)生成式后见反馈：将用户反应转化为对比排序信号和自然语言批评；3)标量-语言混合策略优化：结合标量奖励优化实现全局对齐，以及语言反馈蒸馏实现细粒度语义精炼。
AI.result: 在ESC和Sotopia数据集上的广泛实验表明，RAPO在驱动积极互动结果方面显著优于强化的学习基线方法。
AI.conclusion: RAPO通过将对话视为反应驱动过程，利用模拟用户响应生成密集自然语言反馈，优化互动结果而非规则评分，为情感支持对话系统提供了更有效的学习框架。

title: Code-A1: Adversarial Evolving of Code LLM and Test LLM via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning for code generation relies on verifiable rewards from unit test pass rates. Yet high-quality test suites are scarce, existing datasets offer limited coverage, and static rewards fail to adapt as models improve. Recent self-play methods unify code and test generation in a single model, but face a inherent dilemma: white-box access leads to self-collusion where the model produces trivial tests for easy rewards, yet black-box restriction yields generic tests that miss implementation-specific bugs. We introduce Code-A1, an adversarial co-evolution framework that jointly optimizes a Code LLM and a Test LLM with opposing objectives. The Code LLM is rewarded for passing more tests, while the Test LLM is rewarded for exposing more defects. This architectural separation eliminates self-collusion risks and safely enables white-box test generation, where the Test LLM can inspect candidate code to craft targeted adversarial tests. We further introduce a Mistake Book mechanism for experience replay and a composite reward balancing test validity with adversarial difficulty. Experiments on Qwen2.5-Coder models demonstrate that Code-A1 achieves code generation performance matching or exceeding models trained on human-annotated tests, while significantly improving test generation capability.

AI.tldr: Code-A1：一个对抗性协同进化框架，通过分离代码生成LLM和测试生成LLM，解决传统自博弈方法中的自我共谋问题，实现更有效的代码和测试生成。
AI.motivation: 当前强化学习代码生成依赖单元测试通过率作为奖励，但高质量测试套件稀缺，现有数据集覆盖有限，静态奖励无法随模型改进而适应。现有自博弈方法面临两难：白盒访问导致自我共谋（模型生成简单测试获取奖励），黑盒限制则产生通用测试而错过实现特定bug。
AI.method: Code-A1采用对抗性协同进化框架，联合优化具有对立目标的代码LLM和测试LLM。代码LLM奖励通过更多测试，测试LLM奖励暴露更多缺陷。这种架构分离消除了自我共谋风险，安全启用白盒测试生成，测试LLM可检查候选代码以创建针对性对抗测试。还引入错误簿机制进行经验回放和复合奖励平衡测试有效性与对抗难度。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Coder模型上的实验表明，Code-A1在代码生成性能上匹配或超过使用人工标注测试训练的模型，同时显著提升测试生成能力。
AI.conclusion: Code-A1通过对抗性协同进化框架有效解决了代码生成强化学习中的测试质量难题，实现了代码和测试生成的双重改进，为自动化代码质量保证提供了新途径。

title: Unlocking the Value of Text: Event-Driven Reasoning and Multi-Level Alignment for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Existing time series forecasting methods primarily rely on the numerical data itself. However, real-world time series exhibit complex patterns associated with multimodal information, making them difficult to predict with numerical data alone. While several multimodal time series forecasting methods have emerged, they either utilize text with limited supplementary information or focus merely on representation extraction, extracting minimal textual information for forecasting. To unlock the Value of Text, we propose VoT, a method with Event-driven Reasoning and Multi-level Alignment. Event-driven Reasoning combines the rich information in exogenous text with the powerful reasoning capabilities of LLMs for time series forecasting. To guide the LLMs in effective reasoning, we propose the Historical In-context Learning that retrieves and applies historical examples as in-context guidance. To maximize the utilization of text, we propose Multi-level Alignment. At the representation level, we utilize the Endogenous Text Alignment to integrate the endogenous text information with the time series. At the prediction level, we design the Adaptive Frequency Fusion to fuse the frequency components of event-driven prediction and numerical prediction to achieve complementary advantages. Experiments on real-world datasets across 10 domains demonstrate significant improvements over existing methods, validating the effectiveness of our approach in the utilization of text. The code is made available at https://github.com/decisionintelligence/VoT.

AI.tldr: VoT是一个利用文本信息进行时间序列预测的新方法，通过事件驱动推理和多层次对齐来充分挖掘文本价值，相比现有方法有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测方法主要依赖数值数据，但现实世界的时间序列包含与多模态信息相关的复杂模式，仅靠数值数据难以准确预测。虽然已有一些多模态时间序列预测方法，但它们要么使用信息有限的文本，要么只关注表示提取，未能充分利用文本信息。
AI.method: 提出VoT方法，包含事件驱动推理和多层次对齐两个核心组件。事件驱动推理结合外生文本的丰富信息和LLM的强大推理能力进行预测，采用历史上下文学习检索历史示例作为上下文指导。多层次对齐包括表示层的"内生文本对齐"将内生文本信息与时间序列整合，以及预测层的"自适应频率融合"融合事件驱动预测和数值预测的频率成分。
AI.result: 在10个领域的真实世界数据集上的实验表明，相比现有方法有显著改进，验证了该方法在文本利用方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VoT方法通过充分挖掘文本价值，有效提升了时间序列预测性能，证明了文本信息在时间序列预测中的重要作用。

title: SCoCCA: Multi-modal Sparse Concept Decomposition via Canonical Correlation Analysis
summary: Interpreting the internal reasoning of vision-language models is essential for deploying AI in safety-critical domains. Concept-based explainability provides a human-aligned lens by representing a model's behavior through semantically meaningful components. However, existing methods are largely restricted to images and overlook the cross-modal interactions. Text-image embeddings, such as those produced by CLIP, suffer from a modality gap, where visual and textual features follow distinct distributions, limiting interpretability. Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) offers a principled way to align features from different distributions, but has not been leveraged for multi-modal concept-level analysis. We show that the objectives of CCA and InfoNCE are closely related, such that optimizing CCA implicitly optimizes InfoNCE, providing a simple, training-free mechanism to enhance cross-modal alignment without affecting the pre-trained InfoNCE objective. Motivated by this observation, we couple concept-based explainability with CCA, introducing Concept CCA (CoCCA), a framework that aligns cross-modal embeddings while enabling interpretable concept decomposition. We further extend it and propose Sparse Concept CCA (SCoCCA), which enforces sparsity to produce more disentangled and discriminative concepts, facilitating improved activation, ablation, and semantic manipulation. Our approach generalizes concept-based explanations to multi-modal embeddings and achieves state-of-the-art performance in concept discovery, evidenced by reconstruction and manipulation tasks such as concept ablation.

AI.tldr: 提出CoCCA和SCoCCA框架，通过CCA增强跨模态对齐，实现视觉语言模型的概念级可解释性分析
AI.motivation: 现有概念可解释性方法主要局限于图像，忽视了跨模态交互；CLIP等文本-图像嵌入存在模态鸿沟问题，限制了可解释性；CCA提供了对齐不同分布特征的原则性方法，但尚未用于多模态概念级分析
AI.method: 提出Concept CCA (CoCCA)框架，将CCA与概念可解释性结合，对齐跨模态嵌入并实现可解释的概念分解；进一步提出Sparse Concept CCA (SCoCCA)，通过稀疏性约束产生更解耦和判别性的概念
AI.result: CCA和InfoNCE目标密切相关，优化CCA隐式优化InfoNCE，提供无需训练的跨模态对齐机制；CoCCA和SCoCCA在多模态嵌入中实现概念级解释，在概念发现、重建和操作任务中达到最先进性能
AI.conclusion: 将概念可解释性与CCA结合，为视觉语言模型提供跨模态对齐和可解释的概念分解框架，解决了模态鸿沟问题，提升了多模态模型的可解释性

title: Mechanistic Origin of Moral Indifference in Language Models
summary: Existing behavioral alignment techniques for Large Language Models (LLMs) often neglect the discrepancy between surface compliance and internal unaligned representations, leaving LLMs vulnerable to long-tail risks. More crucially, we posit that LLMs possess an inherent state of moral indifference due to compressing distinct moral concepts into uniform probability distributions. We verify and remedy this indifference in LLMs' latent representations, utilizing 251k moral vectors constructed upon Prototype Theory and the Social-Chemistry-101 dataset. Firstly, our analysis across 23 models reveals that current LLMs fail to represent the distinction between opposed moral categories and fine-grained typicality gradients within these categories; notably, neither model scaling, architecture, nor explicit alignment reshapes this indifference. We then employ Sparse Autoencoders on Qwen3-8B, isolate mono-semantic moral features, and targetedly reconstruct their topological relationships to align with ground-truth moral vectors. This representational alignment naturally improves moral reasoning and granularity, achieving a 75% pairwise win-rate on the independent adversarial Flames benchmark. Finally, we elaborate on the remedial nature of current intervention methods from an experientialist philosophy, arguing that endogenously aligned AI might require a transformation from post-hoc corrections to proactive cultivation.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出当前大语言模型存在道德冷漠问题，即表面行为对齐与内在表征未对齐的差异，并提出基于原型理论和社会化学数据集构建道德向量来验证和修复这一问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型行为对齐技术往往忽视表面合规与内在未对齐表征之间的差异，使模型容易受到长尾风险影响。更重要的是，作者认为大语言模型具有固有的道德冷漠状态，因为其将不同的道德概念压缩为统一的概率分布。
AI.method: 1. 基于原型理论和社会化学-101数据集构建251k个道德向量；2. 分析23个模型，发现当前大语言模型无法区分对立道德类别和细粒度典型性梯度；3. 在Qwen3-8B上使用稀疏自编码器分离单语义道德特征，并重构其拓扑关系以与真实道德向量对齐。
AI.result: 表征对齐自然改善了道德推理和粒度，在独立的对抗性Flames基准测试中实现了75%的成对胜率。分析表明，模型缩放、架构或显式对齐都无法改变这种道德冷漠状态。
AI.conclusion: 从经验主义哲学角度阐述了当前干预方法的补救性质，认为内生对齐的人工智能可能需要从事后修正转变为主动培养。表征对齐是改善大语言模型道德推理的有效方法。

title: Agent Lifecycle Toolkit (ALTK): Reusable Middleware Components for Robust AI Agents
summary:
As AI agents move from demos into enterprise deployments, their failure modes become consequential: a misinterpreted tool argument can corrupt production data, a silent reasoning error can go undetected until damage is done, and outputs that violate organizational policy can create legal or compliance risk. Yet, most agent frameworks leave builders to handle these failure modes ad hoc, resulting in brittle, one-off safeguards that are hard to reuse or maintain. We present the Agent Lifecycle Toolkit (ALTK), an open-source collection of modular middleware components that systematically address these gaps across the full agent lifecycle.
  Across the agent lifecycle, we identify opportunities to intervene and improve, namely, post-user-request, pre-LLM prompt conditioning, post-LLM output processing, pre-tool validation, post-tool result checking, and pre-response assembly. ALTK provides modular middleware that detects, repairs, and mitigates common failure modes. It offers consistent interfaces that fit naturally into existing pipelines. It is compatible with low-code and no-code tools such as the ContextForge MCP Gateway and Langflow. Finally, it significantly reduces the effort of building reliable, production-grade agents.

AI.tldr: ALTK是一个开源模块化中间件工具包，用于系统化处理AI代理在整个生命周期中的故障模式，提高生产环境下的可靠性和安全性。
AI.motivation: AI代理从演示环境进入企业部署后，其故障模式变得至关重要：工具参数误解可能破坏生产数据，静默推理错误可能造成损害后才被发现，违反组织政策的输出可能带来法律或合规风险。然而，大多数代理框架让开发者临时处理这些故障模式，导致脆弱、一次性且难以维护的安全措施。
AI.method: 提出了Agent Lifecycle Toolkit (ALTK)，这是一个开源模块化中间件组件集合，系统化地解决AI代理全生命周期中的问题。在代理生命周期的六个关键干预点提供中间件：用户请求后、LLM提示条件前、LLM输出处理后、工具验证前、工具结果检查后、响应组装前。这些中间件能够检测、修复和缓解常见故障模式，提供一致的接口，并与低代码/无代码工具兼容。
AI.result: ALTK显著降低了构建可靠、生产级代理的工作量，提供了模块化的解决方案来系统化处理AI代理的故障模式。
AI.conclusion: ALTK通过提供系统化的中间件工具包，解决了AI代理在企业部署中的关键可靠性问题，为构建生产级AI代理提供了标准化、可维护的解决方案。

title: Multi-Modal Character Localization and Extraction for Chinese Text Recognition
comment: On January 08th, 2026, this paper has been accepted by the IEEE Transactions on Multimedia journal. To appear
summary: Scene text recognition (STR) methods have demonstrated their excellent capability in English text images. However, due to the complex inner structures of Chinese and the extensive character categories, it poses challenges for recognizing Chinese text in images. Recently, studies have shown that the methods designed for English text recognition encounter an accuracy bottleneck when recognizing Chinese text images. This raises the question: Is it appropriate to apply the model developed for English to the Chinese STR task? To explore this issue, we propose a novel method named LER, which explicitly decouples each character and independently recognizes characters while taking into account the complex inner structures of Chinese. LER consists of three modules: Localization, Extraction, and Recognition. Firstly, the localization module utilizes multimodal information to determine the character's position precisely. Then, the extraction module dissociates all characters in parallel. Finally, the recognition module considers the unique inner structures of Chinese to provide the text prediction results. Extensive experiments conducted on large-scale Chinese benchmarks indicate that our method significantly outperforms existing methods. Furthermore, extensive experiments conducted on six English benchmarks and the Union14M benchmark show impressive results in English text recognition by LER. Code is available at https://github.com/Pandarenlql/LER.

AI.tldr: LER方法通过定位、提取和识别三个模块，显式解耦中文字符并考虑其复杂内部结构，显著提升了中文场景文本识别性能，同时在英文识别任务上也表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有英文场景文本识别方法在处理中文文本图像时遇到准确率瓶颈，因为中文具有复杂的内部结构和庞大的字符类别，需要专门针对中文特性的识别方法。
AI.method: 提出LER方法，包含三个模块：1) 定位模块利用多模态信息精确定位字符位置；2) 提取模块并行解耦所有字符；3) 识别模块考虑中文独特的内部结构提供文本预测结果。
AI.result: 在大规模中文基准测试中显著优于现有方法，同时在六个英文基准测试和Union14M基准测试中也取得了令人印象深刻的结果。
AI.conclusion: LER方法通过显式解耦字符并考虑中文内部结构，有效解决了中文场景文本识别的挑战，证明了专门针对中文特性设计识别方法的必要性。

title: Mixture-of-Depths Attention
summary: Scaling depth is a key driver for large language models (LLMs). Yet, as LLMs become deeper, they often suffer from signal degradation: informative features formed in shallow layers are gradually diluted by repeated residual updates, making them harder to recover in deeper layers. We introduce mixture-of-depths attention (MoDA), a mechanism that allows each attention head to attend to sequence KV pairs at the current layer and depth KV pairs from preceding layers. We further describe a hardware-efficient algorithm for MoDA that resolves non-contiguous memory-access patterns, achieving 97.3% of FlashAttention-2's efficiency at a sequence length of 64K. Experiments on 1.5B-parameter models demonstrate that MoDA consistently outperforms strong baselines. Notably, it improves average perplexity by 0.2 across 10 validation benchmarks and increases average performance by 2.11% on 10 downstream tasks, with a negligible 3.7% FLOPs computational overhead. We also find that combining MoDA with post-norm yields better performance than using it with pre-norm. These results suggest that MoDA is a promising primitive for depth scaling. Code is released at https://github.com/hustvl/MoDA .

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种混合深度注意力机制（MoDA），通过让注意力头同时关注当前层的序列KV对和来自前几层的深度KV对，解决了大语言模型深度扩展时的信号退化问题。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型变得越来越深，它们经常遭受信号退化问题：浅层形成的信息特征被重复的残差更新逐渐稀释，使得在深层中更难恢复这些特征。
AI.method: 引入混合深度注意力机制（MoDA），允许每个注意力头同时关注当前层的序列KV对和来自前几层的深度KV对。论文还描述了一种硬件高效的MoDA算法，解决了非连续内存访问模式问题。
AI.result: 在1.5B参数模型上的实验表明，MoDA始终优于强基线。在10个验证基准上平均困惑度提高了0.2，在10个下游任务上平均性能提高了2.11%，计算开销仅增加3.7% FLOPs。MoDA与后归一化结合比与前归一化结合效果更好。
AI.conclusion: MoDA是深度扩展的一个有前景的基本构建块，能有效缓解深度扩展时的信号退化问题，同时保持较高的计算效率。

title: Talk, Evaluate, Diagnose: User-aware Agent Evaluation with Automated Error Analysis
comment: Accepted as a conference paper at ICLR 2026. Code and dataset are available in the repository https://github.com/SAP-samples/agent-quality-inspect
summary: Agent applications are increasingly adopted to automate workflows across diverse tasks. However, due to the heterogeneous domains they operate in, it is challenging to create a scalable evaluation framework. Prior works each employ their own methods to determine task success, such as database lookups, regex match, etc., adding complexity to the development of a unified agent evaluation approach. Moreover, they do not systematically account for the user's role nor expertise in the interaction, providing incomplete insights into the agent's performance. We argue that effective agent evaluation goes beyond correctness alone, incorporating conversation quality, efficiency and systematic diagnosis of agent errors. To address this, we introduce the TED framework (Talk, Evaluate, Diagnose). (1) Talk: We leverage reusable, generic expert and non-expert user persona templates for user-agent interaction. (2) Evaluate: We adapt existing datasets by representing subgoals-such as tool signatures, and responses-as natural language grading notes, evaluated automatically with LLM-as-a-judge. We propose new metrics that capture both turn efficiency and intermediate progress of the agent complementing the user-aware setup. (3) Diagnose: We introduce an automated error analysis tool that analyzes the inconsistencies of the judge and agents, uncovering common errors, and providing actionable feedback for agent improvement. We show that our TED framework reveals new insights regarding agent performance across models and user expertise levels. We also demonstrate potential gains in agent performance with peaks of 8-10% on our proposed metrics after incorporating the identified error remedies into the agent's design.

AI.tldr: TED框架（Talk, Evaluate, Diagnose）为异构领域的智能体应用提供可扩展的评估方法，通过用户角色模拟、自然语言评分和自动错误分析，超越单纯正确性评估，提升智能体性能8-10%。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体应用在不同领域采用各自的任务成功评估方法（如数据库查询、正则匹配等），缺乏统一的评估框架，且未系统考虑用户角色和专业知识，导致对智能体性能的洞察不完整。
AI.method: 提出TED框架：1) Talk：使用可复用的专家和非专家用户角色模板进行用户-智能体交互；2) Evaluate：将子目标（如工具签名、响应）表示为自然语言评分说明，使用LLM-as-a-judge自动评估，并提出捕捉回合效率和中间进度的新指标；3) Diagnose：引入自动错误分析工具，分析评估者和智能体间的不一致性，发现常见错误并提供可操作的改进建议。
AI.result: TED框架揭示了跨模型和用户专业知识水平的智能体性能新洞察，通过将识别出的错误补救措施纳入智能体设计，在提出的指标上实现了8-10%的性能提升峰值。
AI.conclusion: 有效的智能体评估应超越单纯正确性，包含对话质量、效率和系统错误诊断。TED框架通过用户感知设置、自动评估和诊断工具，为异构领域的智能体应用提供了可扩展的评估方法，显著提升了智能体性能。

title: Understanding Reasoning in LLMs through Strategic Information Allocation under Uncertainty
summary: LLMs often exhibit Aha moments during reasoning, such as apparent self-correction following tokens like "Wait," yet their underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We introduce an information-theoretic framework that decomposes reasoning into procedural information and epistemic verbalization - the explicit externalization of uncertainty that supports downstream control actions. We show that purely procedural reasoning can become informationally stagnant, whereas epistemic verbalization enables continued information acquisition and is critical for achieving information sufficiency. Empirical results demonstrate that strong reasoning performance is driven by uncertainty externalization rather than specific surface tokens. Our framework unifies prior findings on Aha moments and post-training experiments, and offers insights for future reasoning model design.

AI.tldr: 论文提出信息论框架，将推理分解为程序性信息和认知性言语化，后者通过外部化不确定性实现持续信息获取，是推理性能提升的关键而非特定表面标记。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在推理过程中经常表现出"顿悟时刻"，比如在"Wait"等标记后出现自我修正，但这些现象背后的机制尚不清楚。研究者希望理解这些表面现象背后的深层机制。
AI.method: 引入信息论框架，将推理过程分解为程序性信息和认知性言语化。认知性言语化是指将不确定性外部化，支持下游控制行动。通过理论分析和实证研究验证框架的有效性。
AI.result: 研究发现纯程序性推理会陷入信息停滞，而认知性言语化能够实现持续信息获取，对达到信息充分性至关重要。实证结果表明，强大的推理性能主要源于不确定性外部化，而非特定的表面标记。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一了先前关于"顿悟时刻"和训练后实验的发现，为未来推理模型设计提供了理论指导，强调了外部化不确定性在推理过程中的重要性。

title: Pixel-level Scene Understanding in One Token: Visual States Need What-is-Where Composition
summary: For robotic agents operating in dynamic environments, learning visual state representations from streaming video observations is essential for sequential decision making. Recent self-supervised learning methods have shown strong transferability across vision tasks, but they do not explicitly address what a good visual state should encode. We argue that effective visual states must capture what-is-where by jointly encoding the semantic identities of scene elements and their spatial locations, enabling reliable detection of subtle dynamics across observations. To this end, we propose CroBo, a visual state representation learning framework based on a global-to-local reconstruction objective. Given a reference observation compressed into a compact bottleneck token, CroBo learns to reconstruct heavily masked patches in a local target crop from sparse visible cues, using the global bottleneck token as context. This learning objective encourages the bottleneck token to encode a fine-grained representation of scene-wide semantic entities, including their identities, spatial locations, and configurations. As a result, the learned visual states reveal how scene elements move and interact over time, supporting sequential decision making. We evaluate CroBo on diverse vision-based robot policy learning benchmarks, where it achieves state-of-the-art performance. Reconstruction analyses and perceptual straightness experiments further show that the learned representations preserve pixel-level scene composition and encode what-moves-where across observations.

AI.tldr: CroBo是一个基于全局到局部重建目标的视觉状态表示学习框架，通过压缩参考观察为瓶颈标记，学习从稀疏可见线索重建局部目标裁剪，从而编码场景元素的语义身份和空间位置。
AI.motivation: 在动态环境中操作的机器人代理需要从流式视频观察中学习视觉状态表示以进行顺序决策。现有自监督学习方法虽然在不同视觉任务间有良好迁移性，但未明确解决什么是好的视觉状态应该编码的问题。有效的视觉状态必须通过联合编码场景元素的语义身份和空间位置来捕获"什么在哪里"，从而能够可靠检测观察间的细微动态变化。
AI.method: 提出CroBo框架，基于全局到局部重建目标。给定压缩为紧凑瓶颈标记的参考观察，CroBo学习从稀疏可见线索重建局部目标裁剪中的高度掩码补丁，使用全局瓶颈标记作为上下文。这种学习目标鼓励瓶颈标记编码场景范围的细粒度语义实体表示，包括它们的身份、空间位置和配置。
AI.result: 在多样化的基于视觉的机器人策略学习基准测试中，CroBo实现了最先进的性能。重建分析和感知直线性实验进一步表明，学习到的表示保留了像素级场景组成，并编码了观察间的"什么移动到哪里"。
AI.conclusion: CroBo通过学习编码场景元素的语义身份和空间位置的视觉状态表示，能够揭示场景元素如何随时间移动和交互，从而支持顺序决策制定。该框架为机器人代理在动态环境中的视觉状态表示学习提供了有效解决方案。

title: Are Dilemmas and Conflicts in LLM Alignment Solvable? A View from Priority Graph
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become more powerful and autonomous, they increasingly face conflicts and dilemmas in many scenarios. We first summarize and taxonomize these diverse conflicts. Then, we model the LLM's preferences to make different choices as a priority graph, where instructions and values are nodes, and the edges represent context-specific priorities determined by the model's output distribution. This graph reveals that a unified stable LLM alignment is very challenging, because the graph is neither static nor necessarily consistent in different contexts. Besides, it also reveals a potential vulnerability: priority hacking, where adversaries can craft deceptive contexts to manipulate the graph and bypass safety alignments. To counter this, we propose a runtime verification mechanism, enabling LLMs to query external sources to ground their context and resist manipulation. While this approach enhances robustness, we also acknowledge that many ethical and value dilemmas are philosophically irreducible, posing a long-term, open challenge for the future of AI alignment.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了大型语言模型面临的冲突与困境，提出了优先级图模型来理解LLM在不同情境下的选择偏好，揭示了统一稳定对齐的挑战和优先级攻击漏洞，并提出运行时验证机制来增强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型变得更强大和自主，它们在许多场景中面临越来越多的冲突和困境。需要理解这些冲突的性质，并解决模型对齐中的挑战，特别是面对潜在的安全漏洞。
AI.method: 首先对LLM面临的各种冲突进行分类和归纳。然后提出优先级图模型，将指令和价值观作为节点，边表示由模型输出分布决定的上下文特定优先级。最后提出运行时验证机制，使LLM能够查询外部来源来验证上下文并抵抗操纵。
AI.result: 优先级图揭示了统一稳定的LLM对齐非常困难，因为图既不是静态的，在不同上下文中也不一定一致。同时发现了优先级攻击漏洞，即攻击者可以制作欺骗性上下文来操纵优先级图并绕过安全对齐。运行时验证机制可以增强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 虽然运行时验证机制能提高鲁棒性，但许多伦理和价值困境在哲学上是不可简化的，这构成了AI对齐领域长期存在的开放挑战。需要持续研究来解决这些根本性问题。

title: Scene Generation at Absolute Scale: Utilizing Semantic and Geometric Guidance From Text for Accurate and Interpretable 3D Indoor Scene Generation
summary: We present GuidedSceneGen, a text-to-3D generation framework that produces metrically accurate, globally consistent, and semantically interpretable indoor scenes. Unlike prior text-driven methods that often suffer from geometric drift or scale ambiguity, our approach maintains an absolute world coordinate frame throughout the entire generation process. Starting from a textual scene description, we predict a global 3D layout encoding both semantic and geometric structure, which serves as a guiding proxy for downstream stages. A semantics- and depth-conditioned panoramic diffusion model then synthesizes 360° imagery aligned with the global layout, substantially improving spatial coherence. To explore unobserved regions, we employ a video diffusion model guided by optimized camera trajectories that balances coverage and collision avoidance, achieving up to 10x faster sampling compared to exhaustive path exploration. The generated views are fused using 3D Gaussian Splatting, yielding a consistent and fully navigable 3D scene in absolute scale. GuidedSceneGen enables accurate transfer of object poses and semantic labels from layout to reconstruction, and supports progressive scene expansion without re-alignment. Quantitative results and a user study demonstrate greater 3D consistency and layout plausibility compared to recent panoramic text-to-3D baselines.

AI.tldr: GuidedSceneGen是一个文本到3D生成框架，通过全局3D布局引导、全景扩散模型和优化相机轨迹，生成度量准确、全局一致且语义可解释的室内场景。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动的3D生成方法存在几何漂移和尺度模糊问题，缺乏全局一致性和度量准确性，难以生成可导航的室内场景。
AI.method: 1. 从文本描述预测全局3D布局（语义和几何结构）；2. 使用语义和深度条件全景扩散模型合成对齐布局的360°图像；3. 通过优化相机轨迹的视频扩散模型探索未观测区域；4. 使用3D高斯泼溅融合生成视图。
AI.result: 相比现有全景文本到3D基线方法，GuidedSceneGen在3D一致性和布局合理性方面表现更优，采样速度提升10倍，支持对象姿态和语义标签从布局到重建的准确转移。
AI.conclusion: GuidedSceneGen通过维护绝对世界坐标系和全局布局引导，实现了度量准确、全局一致且可导航的3D室内场景生成，支持渐进式场景扩展而无需重新对齐。

title: Computational Concept of the Psyche
summary: This article presents an overview of approaches to modeling the human psyche in the context of constructing an artificial one. Based on this overview, a concept of cognitive architecture is proposed, in which the psyche is viewed as the operating system of a living or artificial subject, comprising a space of states, including the state of needs that determine the meaning of a subject's being in relation to stimuli from the external world, and intelligence as a decision-making system regarding actions in this world to satisfy these needs. Based on this concept, a computational formalization is proposed for creating artificial general intelligence systems for an agent through experiential learning in a state space that includes agent's needs, taking into account their biological or existential significance for the intelligent agent, along with agent's sensations and actions. Thus, the problem of constructing artificial general intelligence is formalized as a system for making optimal decisions in the space of specific agent needs under conditions of uncertainty, maximizing success in achieving goals, minimizing existential risks, and maximizing energy efficiency. A minimal experimental implementation of the model is presented.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种将人类心理建模为"操作系统"的认知架构概念，并基于此提出了通过经验学习创建通用人工智能系统的计算形式化方法。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于为构建人工通用智能系统提供理论基础，通过模拟人类心理作为"操作系统"的概念，解决智能体在不确定环境中满足需求、实现目标的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种认知架构，将心理视为包含需求状态空间的"操作系统"，并在此基础上建立了计算形式化方法，通过经验学习在包含智能体需求的状态空间中训练智能体。
AI.result: 成功将人工通用智能构建问题形式化为在特定智能体需求空间中的最优决策系统，实现了最大化目标达成、最小化存在风险、最大化能量效率的平衡，并提供了最小实验实现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为人工通用智能的发展提供了新的理论框架和计算模型，将智能视为满足生物或存在需求的决策系统，为未来智能系统设计提供了重要参考。

title: OpenSeeker: Democratizing Frontier Search Agents by Fully Open-Sourcing Training Data
summary: Deep search capabilities have become an indispensable competency for frontier Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet the development of high-performance search agents remains dominated by industrial giants due to a lack of transparent, high-quality training data. This persistent data scarcity has fundamentally hindered the progress of the broader research community in developing and innovating within this domain. To bridge this gap, we introduce OpenSeeker, the first fully open-source search agent (i.e., model and data) that achieves frontier-level performance through two core technical innovations: (1) Fact-grounded scalable controllable QA synthesis, which reverse-engineers the web graph via topological expansion and entity obfuscation to generate complex, multi-hop reasoning tasks with controllable coverage and complexity. (2) Denoised trajectory synthesis, which employs a retrospective summarization mechanism to denoise the trajectory, therefore promoting the teacher LLMs to generate high-quality actions. Experimental results demonstrate that OpenSeeker, trained (a single training run) on only 11.7k synthesized samples, achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks including BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, xbench-DeepSearch, and WideSearch. Notably, trained with simple SFT, OpenSeeker significantly outperforms the second-best fully open-source agent DeepDive (e.g., 29.5% v.s. 15.3% on BrowseComp), and even surpasses industrial competitors such as Tongyi DeepResearch (trained via extensive continual pre-training, SFT, and RL) on BrowseComp-ZH (48.4% v.s. 46.7%). We fully open-source the complete training dataset and the model weights to democratize frontier search agent research and foster a more transparent, collaborative ecosystem.

AI.tldr: OpenSeeker是首个完全开源的搜索代理，仅用11.7k合成样本训练就在多个基准测试中达到前沿性能，超越了工业竞争对手。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM搜索代理能力已成为关键竞争力，但由于缺乏透明高质量训练数据，高性能搜索代理开发被工业巨头垄断，阻碍了研究社区的创新。
AI.method: 采用两种核心技术：1) 基于事实的可扩展可控QA合成，通过拓扑扩展和实体混淆反向工程网络图生成复杂多跳推理任务；2) 去噪轨迹合成，使用回顾性总结机制去噪轨迹，促进教师LLM生成高质量动作。
AI.result: OpenSeeker在BrowseComp、BrowseComp-ZH、xbench-DeepSearch和WideSearch等多个基准测试中达到最先进性能，显著优于其他开源代理DeepDive，甚至超越工业竞争对手Tongyi DeepResearch。
AI.conclusion: OpenSeeker通过创新的数据合成方法解决了搜索代理训练数据稀缺问题，完全开源模型和数据集以促进搜索代理研究的民主化和透明协作生态系统发展。

title: Evaluation of Visual Place Recognition Methods for Image Pair Retrieval in 3D Vision and Robotics
comment: Accepted at the XXV ISPRS Congress 2026; to appear in the ISPRS Annals
summary: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is a core component in computer vision, typically formulated as an image retrieval task for localization, mapping, and navigation. In this work, we instead study VPR as an image pair retrieval front-end for registration pipelines, where the goal is to find top-matching image pairs between two disjoint image sets for downstream tasks such as scene registration, SLAM, and Structure-from-Motion. We comparatively evaluate state-of-the-art VPR families - NetVLAD-style baselines, classification-based global descriptors (CosPlace, EigenPlaces), feature-mixing (MixVPR), and foundation-model-driven methods (AnyLoc, SALAD, MegaLoc) - on three challenging datasets: object-centric outdoor scenes (Tanks and Temples), indoor RGB-D scans (ScanNet-GS), and autonomous-driving sequences (KITTI). We show that modern global descriptor approaches are increasingly suitable as off-the-shelf image pair retrieval modules in challenging scenarios including perceptual aliasing and incomplete sequences, while exhibiting clear, domain-dependent strengths and weaknesses that are critical when choosing VPR components for robust mapping and registration.

AI.tldr: 该研究将视觉地点识别重新定义为图像对检索任务，用于场景配准、SLAM等下游应用，并系统评估了多种先进VPR方法在三个挑战性数据集上的表现。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉地点识别通常被构建为图像检索任务用于定位，但本研究将其重新定义为图像对检索前端，用于场景配准、SLAM和运动恢复结构等下游任务，需要找到两个不相交图像集之间的最佳匹配图像对。
AI.method: 在三个具有挑战性的数据集上比较了最先进的VPR方法：基于NetVLAD的基线方法、基于分类的全局描述符（CosPlace、EigenPlaces）、特征混合方法（MixVPR）以及基础模型驱动方法（AnyLoc、SALAD、MegaLoc）。数据集包括面向对象的户外场景（Tanks and Temples）、室内RGB-D扫描（ScanNet-GS）和自动驾驶序列（KITTI）。
AI.result: 研究表明，现代全局描述符方法越来越适合作为现成的图像对检索模块，在感知混淆和不完整序列等挑战性场景中表现良好。同时，不同方法在不同领域表现出明显的优势和劣势，这些差异在选择VPR组件用于鲁棒的建图和配准时至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 全局描述符方法作为图像对检索前端具有实用价值，但需要根据具体应用领域的特点选择合适的方法，因为不同方法在不同场景下表现出明显的性能差异。

title: Do Metrics for Counterfactual Explanations Align with User Perception?
comment: Accepted at the 4th World Conference on eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI 2026)
summary: Explainability is widely regarded as essential for trustworthy artificial intelligence systems. However, the metrics commonly used to evaluate counterfactual explanations are algorithmic evaluation metrics that are rarely validated against human judgments of explanation quality. This raises the question of whether such metrics meaningfully reflect user perceptions. We address this question through an empirical study that directly compares algorithmic evaluation metrics with human judgments across three datasets. Participants rated counterfactual explanations along multiple dimensions of perceived quality, which we relate to a comprehensive set of standard counterfactual metrics. We analyze both individual relationships and the extent to which combinations of metrics can predict human assessments. Our results show that correlations between algorithmic metrics and human ratings are generally weak and strongly dataset-dependent. Moreover, increasing the number of metrics used in predictive models does not lead to reliable improvements, indicating structural limitations in how current metrics capture criteria relevant for humans. Overall, our findings suggest that widely used counterfactual evaluation metrics fail to reflect key aspects of explanation quality as perceived by users, underscoring the need for more human-centered approaches to evaluating explainable artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 研究发现当前用于评估反事实解释的算法指标与人类对解释质量的感知相关性较弱，表明需要更以人为中心的评估方法
AI.motivation: 当前广泛使用的反事实解释评估指标主要是算法评估指标，很少与人类对解释质量的判断进行验证，这引发了一个问题：这些指标是否真正反映了用户的感知
AI.method: 通过实证研究，直接比较算法评估指标与人类判断，参与者对反事实解释在多个感知质量维度上进行评分，并与一套全面的标准反事实指标相关联
AI.result: 算法指标与人类评分之间的相关性普遍较弱且强烈依赖于数据集；增加预测模型中使用的指标数量不会带来可靠的改进，表明当前指标在捕捉人类相关标准方面存在结构性限制
AI.conclusion: 广泛使用的反事实评估指标未能反映用户感知的解释质量关键方面，强调需要更以人为中心的方法来评估可解释人工智能

title: OpenCOOD-Air: Prompting Heterogeneous Ground-Air Collaborative Perception with Spatial Conversion and Offset Prediction
summary: While Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) collaboration extends sensing ranges through multi-agent data sharing, its reliability remains severely constrained by ground-level occlusions and the limited perspective of chassis-mounted sensors, which often result in critical perception blind spots. We propose OpenCOOD-Air, a novel framework that integrates UAVs as extensible platforms into V2V collaborative perception to overcome these constraints. To mitigate gradient interference from ground-air domain gaps and data sparsity, we adopt a transfer learning strategy to fine-tune UAV weights from pre-trained V2V models. To prevent the spatial information loss inherent in this transition, we formulate ground-air collaborative perception as a heterogeneous integration task with explicit altitude supervision and introduce a Cross-Domain Spatial Converter (CDSC) and a Spatial Offset Prediction Transformer (SOPT). Furthermore, we present the OPV2V-Air benchmark to validate the transition from V2V to Vehicle-to-Vehicle-to-UAV. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, our approach improves 2D and 3D AP@0.7 by 4% and 7%, respectively.

AI.tldr: OpenCOOD-Air是一个将无人机整合到V2V协同感知中的新框架，通过迁移学习、跨域空间转换和空间偏移预测来解决地面-空中域差距和数据稀疏问题，显著提升了感知性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的V2V协同感知受到地面遮挡和底盘安装传感器视角限制，存在严重的感知盲区问题。无人机作为可扩展平台可以克服这些限制，但需要解决地面-空中域差距和数据稀疏的挑战。
AI.method: 1) 采用迁移学习策略，从预训练的V2V模型微调无人机权重；2) 将地面-空中协同感知建模为具有明确高度监督的异构集成任务；3) 引入跨域空间转换器(CDSC)和空间偏移预测变换器(SOPT)；4) 提出OPV2V-Air基准来验证从V2V到V2V2UAV的过渡。
AI.result: 相比最先进的方法，该框架在2D AP@0.7上提升了4%，在3D AP@0.7上提升了7%。
AI.conclusion: OpenCOOD-Air成功地将无人机整合到V2V协同感知中，通过创新的迁移学习和空间信息保留方法，显著提升了感知范围和可靠性，为解决地面感知盲区问题提供了有效方案。

title: Bidirectional Cross-Attention Fusion of High-Res RGB and Low-Res HSI for Multimodal Automated Waste Sorting
comment: Submitted to Information Fusion (Elsevier). 23 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables
summary: Growing waste streams and the transition to a circular economy require efficient automated waste sorting. In industrial settings, materials move on fast conveyor belts, where reliable identification and ejection demand pixel-accurate segmentation. RGB imaging delivers high-resolution spatial detail, which is essential for accurate segmentation, but it confuses materials that look similar in the visible spectrum. Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) provides spectral signatures that separate such materials, yet its lower spatial resolution limits detail. Effective waste sorting therefore needs methods that fuse both modalities to exploit their complementary strengths. We present Bidirectional Cross-Attention Fusion (BCAF), which aligns high-resolution RGB with low-resolution HSI at their native grids via localized, bidirectional cross-attention, avoiding pre-upsampling or early spectral collapse. BCAF uses two independent backbones: a standard Swin Transformer for RGB and an HSI-adapted Swin backbone that preserves spectral structure through 3D tokenization with spectral self-attention. We also analyze trade-offs between RGB input resolution and the number of HSI spectral slices. Although our evaluation targets RGB-HSI fusion, BCAF is modality-agnostic and applies to co-registered RGB with lower-resolution, high-channel auxiliary sensors. On the benchmark SpectralWaste dataset, BCAF achieves state-of-the-art performance of 76.4% mIoU at 31 images/s and 75.4% mIoU at 55 images/s. We further evaluate a novel industrial dataset: K3I-Cycling (first RGB subset already released on Fordatis). On this dataset, BCAF reaches 62.3% mIoU for material segmentation (paper, metal, plastic, etc.) and 66.2% mIoU for plastic-type segmentation (PET, PP, HDPE, LDPE, PS, etc.).

AI.tldr: 提出BCAF双向交叉注意力融合方法，将高分辨率RGB与低分辨率高光谱图像融合，用于工业废料自动分选，在SpectralWaste数据集上达到76.4% mIoU，在K3I-Cycling数据集上实现62.3%材料分割和66.2%塑料类型分割。
AI.motivation: 工业废料自动分选需要高精度分割。RGB图像提供高空间分辨率但难以区分视觉相似材料，高光谱图像提供光谱特征但空间分辨率较低。需要融合两种模态以发挥互补优势。
AI.method: 提出双向交叉注意力融合(BCAF)方法，使用两个独立骨干网络：标准Swin Transformer处理RGB，HSI适配的Swin骨干通过3D标记化和光谱自注意力保持光谱结构。在原生网格上通过局部双向交叉注意力对齐两种模态，避免预上采样或早期光谱坍缩。
AI.result: 在SpectralWaste基准数据集上达到76.4% mIoU（31帧/秒）和75.4% mIoU（55帧/秒）的SOTA性能。在K3I-Cycling工业数据集上，材料分割达到62.3% mIoU，塑料类型分割达到66.2% mIoU。
AI.conclusion: BCAF有效融合RGB和高光谱图像，在工业废料分选中实现高精度分割。该方法模态无关，适用于共配准的RGB与低分辨率高通道辅助传感器融合。

title: Sat-JEPA-Diff: Bridging Self-Supervised Learning and Generative Diffusion for Remote Sensing
summary: Predicting satellite imagery requires a balance between structural accuracy and textural detail. Standard deterministic methods like PredRNN or SimVP minimize pixel-based errors but suffer from the "regression to the mean" problem, producing blurry outputs that obscure subtle geographic-spatial features. Generative models provide realistic textures but often misleadingly reveal structural anomalies. To bridge this gap, we introduce Sat-JEPA-Diff, which combines Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) with Hidden Diffusion Models (LDM). An IJEPA module predicts stable semantic representations, which then route a frozen Stable Diffusion backbone via a lightweight cross-attention adapter. This ensures that the synthesized high-accuracy textures are based on absolutely accurate structural predictions. Evaluated on a global Sentinel-2 dataset, Sat-JEPA-Diff excels at resolving sharp boundaries. It achieves leading perceptual scores (GSSIM: 0.8984, FID: 0.1475) and significantly outperforms deterministic baselines, despite standard autoregressive stability limits. The code and dataset are publicly available on https://github.com/VU-AIML/SAT-JEPA-DIFF.

AI.tldr: Sat-JEPA-Diff结合自监督学习和隐扩散模型，通过IJEPA模块预测稳定语义表示，再用轻量级交叉注意力适配器引导冻结的Stable Diffusion生成高精度纹理，解决卫星图像预测中结构准确性与纹理细节的平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有卫星图像预测方法存在局限性：确定性方法（如PredRNN、SimVP）会产生模糊输出，丢失地理空间细节；生成模型能提供真实纹理但可能产生结构异常。需要一种能同时保证结构准确性和纹理细节的方法。
AI.method: 提出Sat-JEPA-Diff框架：1）IJEPA模块通过自监督学习预测稳定的语义表示；2）使用轻量级交叉注意力适配器将这些表示路由到冻结的Stable Diffusion骨干网络；3）结合隐扩散模型生成高精度纹理，确保纹理基于准确的结构预测。
AI.result: 在全球Sentinel-2数据集上评估，Sat-JEPA-Diff在清晰边界解析方面表现出色，获得领先的感知分数（GSSIM: 0.8984, FID: 0.1475），显著优于确定性基线方法，尽管存在标准自回归稳定性限制。
AI.conclusion: Sat-JEPA-Diff成功解决了卫星图像预测中结构准确性与纹理细节的平衡问题，通过结合自监督学习和隐扩散模型，实现了基于准确结构预测的高质量纹理合成，代码和数据集已公开。

title: IMS3: Breaking Distributional Aggregation in Diffusion-Based Dataset Distillation
summary: Dataset Distillation aims to synthesize compact datasets that can approximate the training efficacy of large-scale real datasets, offering an efficient solution to the increasing computational demands of modern deep learning. Recently, diffusion-based dataset distillation methods have shown great promise by leveraging the strong generative capacity of diffusion models to produce diverse and structurally consistent samples. However, a fundamental goal misalignment persists: diffusion models are optimized for generative likelihood rather than discriminative utility, resulting in over-concentration in high-density regions and inadequate coverage of boundary samples crucial for classification. To address this issue, we propose two complementary strategies. Inversion-Matching (IM) introduces an inversion-guided fine-tuning process that aligns denoising trajectories with their inversion counterparts, broadening distributional coverage and enhancing diversity. Selective Subgroup Sampling(S^3) is a training-free sampling mechanism that improves inter-class separability by selecting synthetic subsets that are both representative and distinctive. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances the discriminative quality and generalization of distilled datasets, achieving state-of-the-art performance among diffusion-based methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种互补策略解决扩散模型在数据集蒸馏中的目标错配问题：反演匹配（IM）和选择性子组采样（S³），显著提升蒸馏数据集的判别质量和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在数据集蒸馏中表现出色，但其生成优化目标（生成似然）与判别任务目标存在根本性错配，导致过度集中于高密度区域，缺乏对分类至关重要的边界样本覆盖。
AI.method: 提出两种互补策略：1）反演匹配（IM）- 通过反演引导的微调过程，使去噪轨迹与其反演对应物对齐，扩大分布覆盖并增强多样性；2）选择性子组采样（S³）- 无需训练的选择机制，通过选择既具代表性又具区分性的合成子集来提升类间分离性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法显著提升了蒸馏数据集的判别质量和泛化能力，在基于扩散的方法中实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过解决扩散模型在数据集蒸馏中的目标错配问题，提出的IM和S³策略有效提升了合成数据集的判别效用，为高效深度学习训练提供了更好的解决方案。

title: Fine-tuning MLLMs Without Forgetting Is Easier Than You Think
summary: The paper demonstrate that simple adjustments of the fine-tuning recipes of multimodal large language models (MLLM) are sufficient to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. On visual question answering, we design a 2x2 experimental framework to assess model performance across in-distribution and out-of-distribution image and text inputs. Our results show that appropriate regularization, such as constraining the number of trainable parameters or adopting a low learning rate, effectively prevents forgetting when dealing with out-of-distribution images. However, we uncover a distinct form of forgetting in settings with in-distribution images and out-of-distribution text. We attribute this forgetting as task-specific overfitting and address this issue by introducing a data-hybrid training strategy that combines datasets and tasks. Finally, we demonstrate that this approach naturally extends to continual learning, outperforming existing methods with complex auxiliary mechanisms. In general, our findings challenge the prevailing assumptions by highlighting the inherent robustness of MLLMs and providing practical guidelines for adapting them while preserving their general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该研究表明，通过简单的微调策略调整即可有效缓解多模态大语言模型中的灾难性遗忘问题，无需复杂机制。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在微调时容易出现灾难性遗忘问题，传统方法通常需要复杂的辅助机制。本研究旨在探索是否可以通过简单的微调策略调整来有效缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 设计了2×2实验框架评估模型在分布内和分布外图像与文本输入上的性能。采用正则化方法（如限制可训练参数数量、采用低学习率），并针对特定遗忘问题提出了数据混合训练策略，将不同数据集和任务结合训练。
AI.result: 适当的正则化能有效防止处理分布外图像时的遗忘；发现了分布内图像与分布外文本组合时的特定遗忘模式，归因于任务特定过拟合；数据混合训练策略成功解决了这一问题，并在持续学习任务中超越了现有复杂方法。
AI.conclusion: 多模态大语言模型具有内在鲁棒性，简单的微调策略调整即可有效缓解灾难性遗忘，挑战了需要复杂机制的普遍假设，为模型适应提供了实用指导。

title: VID-AD: A Dataset for Image-Level Logical Anomaly Detection under Vision-Induced Distraction
summary: Logical anomaly detection in industrial inspection remains challenging due to variations in visual appearance (e.g., background clutter, illumination shift, and blur), which often distract vision-centric detectors from identifying rule-level violations. However, existing benchmarks rarely provide controlled settings where logical states are fixed while such nuisance factors vary. To address this gap, we introduce VID-AD, a dataset for logical anomaly detection under vision-induced distraction. It comprises 10 manufacturing scenarios and five capture conditions, totaling 50 one-class tasks and 10,395 images. Each scenario is defined by two logical constraints selected from quantity, length, type, placement, and relation, with anomalies including both single-constraint and combined violations. We further propose a language-based anomaly detection framework that relies solely on text descriptions generated from normal images. Using contrastive learning with positive texts and contradiction-based negative texts synthesized from these descriptions, our method learns embeddings that capture logical attributes rather than low-level features. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over baselines across the evaluated settings. The dataset is available at: https://github.com/nkthiroto/VID-AD.

AI.tldr: VID-AD数据集专注于视觉干扰下的逻辑异常检测，包含10个制造场景和5种采集条件，共50个单类任务和10,395张图像。作者提出基于文本描述的异常检测框架，通过对比学习学习逻辑属性而非低级特征。
AI.motivation: 工业检测中的逻辑异常检测面临视觉外观变化（如背景杂乱、光照变化、模糊）的挑战，这些变化会分散视觉检测器对规则级别违规的注意力。现有基准测试很少提供逻辑状态固定而干扰因素变化的受控设置。
AI.method: 提出基于语言的异常检测框架，仅使用正常图像生成的文本描述。通过对比学习，使用正面文本和从这些描述合成的基于矛盾的负面文本，学习捕捉逻辑属性而非低级特征的嵌入表示。
AI.result: 在评估的所有设置中，该方法相比基线模型都取得了持续改进。数据集包含10个制造场景，每个场景由数量、长度、类型、放置和关系中的两个逻辑约束定义，异常包括单约束和组合违规。
AI.conclusion: VID-AD数据集填补了逻辑异常检测在视觉干扰下的基准测试空白，提出的基于语言的检测框架能够有效学习逻辑属性，在视觉干扰条件下实现更稳健的逻辑异常检测。

title: Visual Confused Deputy: Exploiting and Defending Perception Failures in Computer-Using Agents
summary: Computer-using agents (CUAs) act directly on graphical user interfaces, yet their perception of the screen is often unreliable. Existing work largely treats these failures as performance limitations, asking whether an action succeeds, rather than whether the agent is acting on the correct object at all. We argue that this is fundamentally a security problem. We formalize the visual confused deputy: a failure mode in which an agent authorizes an action based on a misperceived screen state, due to grounding errors, adversarial screenshot manipulation, or time-of-check-to-time-of-use (TOCTOU) races. This gap is practically exploitable: even simple screen-level manipulations can redirect routine clicks into privileged actions while remaining indistinguishable from ordinary agent mistakes. To mitigate this threat, we propose the first guardrail that operates outside the agent's perceptual loop. Our method, dual-channel contrastive classification, independently evaluates (1) the visual click target and (2) the agent's reasoning about the action against deployment-specific knowledge bases, and blocks execution if either channel indicates risk. The key insight is that these two channels capture complementary failure modes: visual evidence detects target-level mismatches, while textual reasoning reveals dangerous intent behind visually innocuous controls. Across controlled attacks, real GUI screenshots, and agent traces, the combined guardrail consistently outperforms either channel alone. Our results suggest that CUA safety requires not only better action generation, but independent verification of what the agent believes it is clicking and why. Materials are provided\footnote{Model, benchmark, and code: https://github.com/vllm-project/semantic-router}.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出计算机使用代理（CUAs）存在视觉混淆代理的安全问题，即代理基于错误感知的屏幕状态授权危险操作，并设计了一种双通道对比分类的护栏机制来独立验证点击目标和代理意图。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将计算机使用代理在图形用户界面上的感知失败视为性能限制问题，只关注动作是否成功，而不关注代理是否点击了正确的对象。作者认为这本质上是一个安全问题，需要关注代理基于错误屏幕感知授权危险操作的风险。
AI.method: 提出了双通道对比分类方法，该方法在代理的感知循环之外独立评估：(1) 视觉点击目标，以及(2) 代理对动作的推理。通过对比部署特定的知识库，如果任一通道显示风险，则阻止执行。两个通道捕获互补的失败模式：视觉证据检测目标级别的不匹配，而文本推理揭示视觉无害控制背后的危险意图。
AI.result: 在受控攻击、真实GUI截图和代理轨迹的实验中，组合护栏始终优于任一单独通道。结果表明，计算机使用代理的安全性不仅需要更好的动作生成，还需要独立验证代理认为自己在点击什么以及为什么点击。
AI.conclusion: 计算机使用代理存在视觉混淆代理的安全威胁，需要超越传统性能评估的安全防护。提出的双通道对比分类方法通过独立验证视觉目标和代理意图，有效缓解了这一威胁，为CUA安全提供了新的防护思路。

title: When Visual Privacy Protection Meets Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: The emergence of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and the widespread usage of MLLM cloud services such as GPT-4V raised great concerns about privacy leakage in visual data. As these models are typically deployed in cloud services, users are required to submit their images and videos, posing serious privacy risks. However, how to tackle such privacy concerns is an under-explored problem. Thus, in this paper, we aim to conduct a new investigation to protect visual privacy when enjoying the convenience brought by MLLM services. We address the practical case where the MLLM is a "black box", i.e., we only have access to its input and output without knowing its internal model information. To tackle such a challenging yet demanding problem, we propose a novel framework, in which we carefully design the learning objective with Pareto optimality to seek a better trade-off between visual privacy and MLLM's performance, and propose critical-history enhanced optimization to effectively optimize the framework with the black-box MLLM. Our experiments show that our method is effective on different benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种保护视觉隐私的新框架，用于应对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）云服务中的隐私泄露风险，在MLLM作为黑盒的情况下，通过帕累托最优和关键历史增强优化来平衡隐私保护与模型性能。
AI.motivation: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLM）及其云服务（如GPT-4V）的广泛应用，用户需要提交图像和视频数据，这带来了严重的隐私泄露风险。然而，如何解决这种隐私问题是一个尚未充分探索的领域。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的框架，针对MLLM作为"黑盒"的实际情况（只能访问输入输出，不了解内部模型信息）。设计了基于帕累托最优的学习目标，以寻求视觉隐私与MLLM性能之间的更好权衡，并提出了关键历史增强优化方法来有效优化这个黑盒MLLM框架。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在不同基准测试中都是有效的。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为解决MLLM云服务中的视觉隐私保护问题提供了一种有效的解决方案，特别是在MLLM作为黑盒的实用场景下，通过帕累托最优和优化技术实现了隐私保护与模型性能的良好平衡。

title: VAD4Space: Visual Anomaly Detection for Planetary Surface Imagery
summary: Space missions generate massive volumes of high-resolution orbital and surface imagery that far exceed the capacity for manual inspection. Detecting rare phenomena is scientifically critical, yet traditional supervised learning struggles due to scarce labeled examples and closed-world assumptions that prevent discovery of genuinely novel observations. In this work, we investigate Visual Anomaly Detection (VAD) as a framework for automated discovery in planetary exploration. We present the first empirical evaluation of state-of-the-art feature-based VAD methods on real planetary imagery, encompassing both orbital lunar data and Mars rover surface imagery. To support this evaluation, we introduce two benchmarks: (i) a lunar dataset derived from Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera Narrow Angle imagery, comprising of fresh and degraded craters as anomalies alongside normal terrain; and (ii) a Mars surface dataset designed to reflect the characteristics of rover-acquired imagery. We evaluate multiple VAD approaches with a focus on computationally efficient, edge-oriented solutions suitable for onboard deployment, applicable to both orbital platforms surveying the lunar surface and surface rovers operating on Mars. Our results demonstrate that feature-based VAD methods can effectively identify rare planetary surface phenomena while remaining feasible for resource-constrained environments. By grounding anomaly detection in planetary science, this work establishes practical benchmarks and highlights the potential of open-world perception systems to support a range of mission-critical applications, including tactical planning, landing site selection, hazard detection, bandwidth-aware data prioritization, and the discovery of unanticipated geological processes.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次在真实行星图像上评估了基于特征的视觉异常检测方法，建立了月球和火星数据集基准，证明了这些方法在资源受限环境中有效检测罕见行星表面现象的能力。
AI.motivation: 太空任务产生大量高分辨率图像，远超人工检查能力。检测罕见现象对科学至关重要，但传统监督学习因标记样本稀缺和封闭世界假设而难以发现真正新颖的观测结果。
AI.method: 引入两个基准数据集：基于月球勘测轨道器窄角相机图像的月球数据集（包含新鲜和退化陨石坑作为异常）和反映火星车获取图像特征的火星表面数据集。评估多种基于特征的视觉异常检测方法，重点关注适用于轨道平台和火星车的计算高效、边缘导向解决方案。
AI.result: 基于特征的视觉异常检测方法能够有效识别罕见行星表面现象，同时在资源受限环境中保持可行性。这些方法适用于轨道平台和表面探测器的机载部署。
AI.conclusion: 通过将异常检测应用于行星科学，这项工作建立了实用基准，并突显了开放世界感知系统在支持任务关键应用方面的潜力，包括战术规划、着陆点选择、危险检测、带宽感知数据优先级排序以及意外地质过程的发现。

title: MER-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Meme Reappraisal
summary: Memes represent a tightly coupled, multimodal form of social expression, in which visual context and overlaid text jointly convey nuanced affect and commentary. Inspired by cognitive reappraisal in psychology, we introduce Meme Reappraisal, a novel multimodal generation task that aims to transform negatively framed memes into constructive ones while preserving their underlying scenario, entities, and structural layout. Unlike prior works on meme understanding or generation, Meme Reappraisal requires emotion-controllable, structure-preserving multimodal transformation under multiple semantic and stylistic constraints. To support this task, we construct MER-Bench, a benchmark of real-world memes with fine-grained multimodal annotations, including source and target emotions, positively rewritten meme text, visual editing specifications, and taxonomy labels covering visual type, sentiment polarity, and layout structure. We further propose a structured evaluation framework based on a multimodal large language model (MLLM)-as-a-Judge paradigm, decomposing performance into modality-level generation quality, affect controllability, structural fidelity, and global affective alignment. Extensive experiments across representative image-editing and multimodal-generation systems reveal substantial gaps in satisfying the constraints of structural preservation, semantic consistency, and affective transformation. We believe MER-Bench establishes a foundation for research on controllable meme editing and emotion-aware multimodal generation. Our code is available at: https://github.com/one-seven17/MER-Bench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"Meme Reappraisal"任务，旨在将负面情绪的表情包转化为建设性内容，同时保持原始场景、实体和结构布局不变。为此构建了MER-Bench基准数据集和基于MLLM的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 表情包作为一种紧密耦合的多模态社交表达形式，其视觉内容和叠加文本共同传达微妙的情感和评论。受心理学中认知重评的启发，需要开发能够将负面情绪表情包转化为建设性内容的技术，同时保持原始结构和语义完整性。
AI.method: 1. 提出Meme Reappraisal任务：要求在多模态约束下进行情感可控、结构保留的转换；2. 构建MER-Bench基准数据集：包含真实世界表情包，带有细粒度多模态标注；3. 提出结构化评估框架：基于MLLM-as-a-Judge范式，分解为模态级生成质量、情感可控性、结构保真度和全局情感对齐等维度。
AI.result: 通过对代表性图像编辑和多模态生成系统进行广泛实验，发现现有系统在满足结构保留、语义一致性和情感转换等约束方面存在显著差距。MER-Bench为可控表情包编辑和情感感知多模态生成研究奠定了基础。
AI.conclusion: 该研究引入了Meme Reappraisal这一新颖的多模态生成任务，并提供了相应的基准数据集和评估框架。这项工作推动了可控表情包编辑和情感感知多模态生成领域的发展，为未来研究建立了重要基础。

title: Human-like Object Grouping in Self-supervised Vision Transformers
summary: Vision foundation models trained with self-supervised objectives achieve strong performance across diverse tasks and exhibit emergent object segmentation properties. However, their alignment with human object perception remains poorly understood. Here, we introduce a behavioral benchmark in which participants make same/different object judgments for dot pairs on naturalistic scenes, scaling up a classical psychophysics paradigm to over 1000 trials. We test a diverse set of vision models using a simple readout from their representations to predict subjects' reaction times. We observe a steady improvement across model generations, with both architecture and training objective contributing to alignment, and transformer-based models trained with the DINO self-supervised objective showing the strongest performance. To investigate the source of this improvement, we propose a novel metric to quantify the object-centric component of representations by measuring patch similarity within and between objects. Across models, stronger object-centric structure predicts human segmentation behavior more accurately. We further show that matching the Gram matrix of supervised transformer models, capturing similarity structure across image patches, with that of a self-supervised model through distillation improves their alignment with human behavior, converging with the prior finding that Gram anchoring improves DINOv3's feature quality. Together, these results demonstrate that self-supervised vision models capture object structure in a behaviorally human-like manner, and that Gram matrix structure plays a role in driving perceptual alignment.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过行为基准测试发现，自监督视觉模型（特别是基于Transformer的DINO模型）在物体感知方面与人类行为最接近，模型表征中的物体中心结构是预测人类分割行为的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 虽然自监督视觉基础模型在各种任务上表现优异并展现出物体分割特性，但它们与人类物体感知的对应关系尚不清楚。研究者希望量化评估不同视觉模型在物体感知方面与人类行为的对齐程度。
AI.method: 1) 建立行为基准：参与者对自然场景中的点对做出相同/不同物体判断，扩展经典心理物理学范式至1000+试次；2) 测试多种视觉模型：使用简单读出机制从模型表征预测被试反应时；3) 提出新度量：通过测量物体内部和物体间的补丁相似性来量化表征的物体中心成分；4) 进行蒸馏实验：通过匹配监督模型与自监督模型的Gram矩阵来改善对齐效果。
AI.result: 1) 模型性能随代际稳步提升，架构和训练目标都影响对齐程度；2) 基于Transformer的DINO自监督模型表现最佳；3) 更强的物体中心结构能更准确预测人类分割行为；4) 通过Gram矩阵蒸馏匹配监督模型与自监督模型的相似性结构，能改善与人类行为的对齐，这与先前发现Gram锚定提升DINOv3特征质量的结论一致。
AI.conclusion: 自监督视觉模型以行为上类似人类的方式捕捉物体结构，Gram矩阵结构在驱动感知对齐中起重要作用。这为理解视觉模型与人类感知的对应关系提供了量化证据。

title: PhyGaP: Physically-Grounded Gaussians with Polarization Cues
comment: The paper is accepted by CVPR 2026
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have demonstrated great success in modeling reflective 3D objects and their interaction with the environment via deferred rendering (DR). However, existing methods often struggle with correctly reconstructing physical attributes such as albedo and reflectance, and therefore they do not support high-fidelity relighting. Observing that this limitation stems from the lack of shape and material information in RGB images, we present PhyGaP, a physically-grounded 3DGS method that leverages polarization cues to facilitate precise reflection decomposition and visually consistent relighting of reconstructed objects. Specifically, we design a polarimetric deferred rendering (PolarDR) process to model polarization by reflection, and a self-occlusion-aware environment map building technique (GridMap) to resolve indirect lighting of non-convex objects. We validate on multiple synthetic and real-world scenes, including those featuring only partial polarization cues, that PhyGaP not only excels in reconstructing the appearance and surface normal of reflective 3D objects (~2 dB in PSNR and 45.7% in Cosine Distance better than existing RGB-based methods on average), but also achieves state-of-the-art inverse rendering and relighting capability. Our code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: PhyGaP是一种基于物理的3D高斯泼溅方法，利用偏振线索实现精确的反射分解和视觉一致的重光照，解决了现有方法在重建物理属性和支持高保真重光照方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅方法在重建反射性3D物体时，由于RGB图像缺乏形状和材质信息，难以正确重建物理属性（如反照率和反射率），因此不支持高保真重光照。
AI.method: 提出PhyGaP方法：1）设计偏振延迟渲染过程建模反射偏振；2）开发自遮挡感知环境贴图构建技术解决非凸物体的间接光照；3）利用偏振线索促进精确反射分解。
AI.result: 在合成和真实场景（包括仅部分偏振线索的场景）上验证，PhyGaP在重建外观和表面法线方面优于现有RGB方法（PSNR平均提高约2dB，余弦距离提高45.7%），并实现最先进的逆渲染和重光照能力。
AI.conclusion: PhyGaP通过整合偏振线索，显著提升了反射性3D物体的重建质量和重光照能力，为物理准确的逆渲染提供了有效解决方案。

title: U-Face: An Efficient and Generalizable Framework for Unsupervised Facial Attribute Editing via Subspace Learning
summary: Latent space-based facial attribute editing methods have gained popularity in applications such as digital entertainment, virtual avatar creation, and human-computer interaction systems due to their potential for efficient and flexible attribute manipulation, particularly for continuous edits. Among these, unsupervised latent space-based methods, which discover effective semantic vectors without relying on labeled data, have attracted considerable attention in the research community. However, existing methods still encounter difficulties in disentanglement, as manipulating a specific facial attribute may unintentionally affect other attributes, complicating fine-grained controllability. To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework designed to offer an effective and adaptable solution for unsupervised facial attribute editing, called Unsupervised Facial Attribute Controllable Editing (U-Face). The proposed method frames semantic vector learning as a subspace learning problem, where latent vectors are approximated within a lower-dimensional semantic subspace spanned by a semantic vector matrix. This formulation can also be equivalently interpreted from a projection-reconstruction perspective and further generalized into an autoencoder framework, providing a foundation that can support disentangled representation learning in a flexible manner. To improve disentanglement and controllability, we impose orthogonal non-negative constraints on the semantic vectors and incorporate attribute boundary vectors to reduce entanglement in the learned directions. Although these constraints make the optimization problem challenging, we design an alternating iterative algorithm, called Alternating Iterative Disentanglement and Controllability (AIDC), with closed-form updates and provable convergence under specific conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出U-Face框架，通过子空间学习和正交非负约束解决无监督面部属性编辑中的解耦问题，提高细粒度可控性
AI.motivation: 现有无监督潜在空间面部属性编辑方法存在解耦困难，编辑特定属性时会影响其他属性，限制了细粒度可控性
AI.method: 将语义向量学习构建为子空间学习问题，引入正交非负约束和属性边界向量，设计AIDC交替迭代算法进行优化
AI.result: 提出的U-Face框架能够有效实现解耦表示学习，在特定条件下具有可证明的收敛性
AI.conclusion: U-Face为无监督面部属性编辑提供了灵活有效的解决方案，通过子空间学习和约束优化改善了属性解耦和可控性

title: Towards Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Real Distribution Bias Correction
summary: To generalize deepfake detectors to future unseen forgeries, most existing methods attempt to simulate the dynamically evolving forgery types using available source domain data. However, predicting an unbounded set of future manipulations from limited prior examples is infeasible. To overcome this limitation, we propose to exploit the invariance of \textbf{real data} from two complementary perspectives: the fixed population distribution of the entire real class and the inherent Gaussianity of individual real images. Building on these properties, we introduce the Real Distribution Bias Correction (RDBC) framework, which consists of two key components: the Real Population Distribution Estimation module and the Distribution-Sampled Feature Whitening module. The former utilizes the independent and identically distributed (\iid) property of real samples to derive the normal distribution form of their statistics, from which the distribution parameters can be estimated using limited source domain data. Based on the learned population distribution, the latter utilizes the inherent Gaussianity of real data as a discriminative prior and performs a sampling-based whitening operation to amplify the Gaussianity gap between real and fake samples. Through synergistic coupling of the two modules, our model captures the real-world properties of real samples, thereby enhancing its generalizability to unseen target domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RDBC achieves state-of-the-art performance in both in-domain and cross-domain deepfake detection.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RDBC框架，通过利用真实数据的固定总体分布和固有高斯性来增强深度伪造检测器的泛化能力，无需预测未来未知的伪造类型。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测方法试图用有限的源域数据模拟动态演变的伪造类型，但预测无限未来操作是不可行的。作者提出利用真实数据的不变性来克服这一限制。
AI.method: 提出Real Distribution Bias Correction (RDBC)框架，包含两个核心模块：1) 真实总体分布估计模块，利用真实样本的独立同分布特性推导统计量的正态分布形式；2) 分布采样特征白化模块，基于学习到的总体分布，利用真实数据固有高斯性作为判别先验，执行采样白化操作放大真实与伪造样本的高斯性差异。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RDBC在域内和跨域深度伪造检测中都达到了最先进的性能，证明了其增强模型泛化能力的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过协同耦合两个模块，RDBC能够捕捉真实样本的真实世界属性，从而增强对未见目标域的泛化能力，为深度伪造检测提供了一种新的泛化方法。

title: Multi-Grained Vision-Language Alignment for Domain Generalized Person Re-Identification
